project_tagline: Rozmarra ki cheezon ke peeche ka asli vigyan — bina kitaabi bhasha ke, ghar ke examples ke sath.

cards.title: Bottled Water mein Bromate: Saaf Paani mein Chemical Kaise Banta Hai?
cards.hook: Bottle ka paani bahar se bilkul saaf aur sealed dikhta hai, par uske andar bacteria maarne ka tarika hi kabhi-kabhi naya chemical bana deta hai.
cards.illusion: Aam taur par log maante hain ki sealed bottle ka mineral water 100% pure aur har tarah ke chemical se azaad hota hai.
cards.myth: Bromide aur Bromate ek hi cheez hain aur ek bottle peete hi cancer ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Dono alag hain. Bromide natural salt hai, Bromate ozone reaction ke baad banta hai. Ek-do bottle se turant koi nuksan nahi hota, khatra sirf rozana aur lambe samay tak limit se zyada lene par hota hai.

cards.title: Malted Health Drinks mein 'Energy' ka Asli Matlab: Sirf Cheeni aur Maltodextrin?
cards.hook: Dabbe par likha hota hai 'Stronger, Taller, Sharper' aur 'High Energy', par jab piche ka label padhte hain to aadhe se zyada dabba sirf meetha powder nikalta hai.
cards.illusion: Maa-baap sochte hain ki doodh mein ye powder milane se bachche ki haddiyan mazboot hongi, dimaag tez chalega aur usmein asli taakat aayegi.
cards.myth: Bina health drink powder ke bachche ko doodh se poora poshan nahi milta.
cards.reality: Saade doodh mein pehle se hi natural protein (Casein/Whey), calcium aur vitamin B12 hota hai. Usmein zyada cheeni milane se fayda nahi balki calcium aur teeth par bura asar padta hai.

cards.title: Ek hi Tel mein Baar-Baar Talna: Purana Tel 'Zeher' Kaise Ban Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Halwai ki kadhai ka kaala tel ya ghar mein pakode ke baad bache tel ko 4-5 baar use karna—dikhta toh tel hi hai, par uski andar ki banawat poori tarah badal chuki hoti hai.
cards.illusion: Log sochte hain ki agar tel ko chhan (filter) kar diya aur usmein se jale hue tukde nikal diye, to tel fir se fresh aur istemal ke layak ho gaya.
cards.myth: Purane tel mein thoda naya tel mila dene se tel fir se sahi ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Naya tel milane se purane tel ke zeherile chemicals (TPC) khatam nahi hote, balki purana tel naye tel ko bhi tezi se kharab karne lagta hai—bilkul waise hi jaise ek sada hua aam tokri ke baki aamon ko sadha deta hai.

cards.title: 'Zero Cholesterol' Oil aur 'Vegetable Oil' ke Peeche Palm Oil ka Chhupa Khel
cards.hook: Tel ki bottle par bade-bade aksharon mein 'Heart Friendly: 0% Cholesterol' likha hota hai, aur biscuits ke packet par 'Edible Vegetable Oil'—par dono mein aapki aankhon ko dhokha diya ja raha hai.
cards.illusion: Grahak ko lagta hai ki 'Zero Cholesterol' likha hai matlab ye tel baaki telon se khaas aur dil ke liye behtar hai, aur 'Vegetable Oil' matlab sabzi/sarso/moongfali jaisa koi healthy tel hoga.
cards.myth: Refined oil bilkul halka aur sabse healthy hota hai kyunki usmein koi smell ya rang nahi hota.
cards.reality: Cold-pressed (Kachchi Ghani) tel mein natural vitamins (Vitamin E) aur antioxidants bache rehte hain. Refining ke tez taapman aur chemical process mein tel ke natural poshak tatva khatam ho jaate hain.

cards.title: Non-Stick Pan (Teflon) mein Scratch aur Khali Pan Garam Karne ka Khatra
cards.hook: Dosa ya cheela na chipke isliye har ghar mein non-stick tawa aa gaya hai, par jab uski kaali parat par kharoch (scratch) pad jaati hai to wo aapke khane mein kya milata hai?
cards.illusion: Log maante hain ki non-stick pan ek steel ke tawa jaisa hi mazboot bartan hai—bas thodi kaali parat utar bhi jaaye to koi baat nahi, jab tak khana pak raha hai chalao.
cards.myth: Thoda sa Teflon pet mein chala bhi jaaye to koi baat nahi, pachtaa nahi bas bahar nikal jaata hai.
cards.reality: Bade tukde shayad bahar nikal jayein, par baarik microplastics aur zyada garam hone par nikalne wali gases + niche khule aluminium ka asar sharir ke liye bilkul safe nahi hai.

cards.title: Aluminium ke Bartan aur Foil mein Khatti Cheez (Tamatar, Nimbu, Achar) Pakana
cards.hook: Har ghar mein aluminium ki kadhai, kukar ya foil paper use hota hai—par kya aapne dekha hai ki khatti kadhi ya tamatar pakane ke baad kadhai andar se bilkul chamakdaar safed kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Grahini khush hoti hai ki arey wah, tamatar ya imli pakane se meri kaali kadhai bilkul chandi jaisi chamak gayi!
cards.myth: Aluminium mein khatti sabzi pakane se bartan saaf hota hai, khane par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.reality: Bartan apne aap saaf nahi hua, balki acid ne bartan ki upari dhatu ko ghol kar aapke khane mein utaar diya.

cards.title: Tambe (Copper) ke Bartan mein Paani Amrit, par Nimbu-Lassi Zeher Kyun?
cards.hook: Raat ko tambe ke lote mein paani rakhkar peena faydemand hai, par usi tambe ke glass mein nimbu paani ya lassi peene se turant ulti kyun ho sakti hai?
cards.illusion: Log maante hain ki 'tamba toh shuddh aur Ayurvedic dhatu hai, ismein kuch bhi khana-peena fayda hi karega.'
cards.myth: Tambe ki bottle mein subah-subah nimbu aur shahad milakar peena wajan ghatane ke liye best hai.
cards.reality: Tambe ki bottle se paani pehle glass (steel ya kaanch) mein nikaalein, FIR usmein nimbu aur shahad milayein—seedhe tambe mein nimbu kabhi na nichodein!

cards.title: Nakli Paneer aur Synthetic Doodh: Tel, Paani aur Powder Milakar Asli Doodh Kaise Banta Hai?
cards.hook: Jahan asli doodh ₹60-₹70 litre hai aur 1 kilo paneer banane mein 5 litre doodh lagta hai, wahan bazaar mein ₹180-₹220 kilo paneer kaise bik raha hai?
cards.illusion: Grahak ko lagta hai ki paneer safed, mulayam aur bhari hai aur ghee jaisa dikh raha hai—matlab asli doodh ka hi bana hoga.
cards.myth: Har soft aur safed paneer asli doodh ka hota hai.
cards.reality: Aajkal machine aur emulsifier ki madad se bina 1 boond doodh ke bhi bilkul soft aur dudhiya safed paneer banaya ja raha hai.

cards.title: Pake Hue Chawal ko Fridge ke Bahar Chhodna ('Fried Rice Syndrome')
cards.hook: Raat ke bache hue chawal agar subah tak kitchen ke counter par rakhe rahein, to unhe tez gas par achche se fry ya garam karne ke baad bhi pet kharab kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har ghar mein maana jaata hai ki 'Chawal thode rakhe bhi rahe to kya hua, tawa ya kadhai mein tez garam kar lenge to saare keetanu mar jayenge!'
cards.myth: Basi chawal mein koi badbu nahi aa rahi aur kadhai mein tej garam kar liya hai, to wo bilkul safe hai.
cards.reality: Bacillus cereus ke toxin mein na koi badbu hoti hai aur na hi swad badalta hai—aur na hi ye dobara tez fry karne se marta hai!

cards.title: 'Brown Bread' aur Packaged Food Labels ka Chhupa Ganit (Maida + Jali Cheeni ka Rang)
cards.hook: Healthy samajhkar aap rozana ₹10-₹20 mehengi Brown Bread kharidti hain, par uska bhoora rang aate ki wajah se nahi balki 'jali hui cheeni' (Caramel Colour) ki wajah se ho sakta hai!
cards.illusion: Packet par gehun ki baaliyan bani hoti hain aur bade-bade shabdon mein 'Brown Bread' ya 'Multi-grain' likha hota hai, isliye lagta hai ye 100% atta se bani hai.
cards.myth: Jo bread dekhne mein bhoori (brown) hai, wo sehatmand aur aate ki hi hoti hai.
cards.reality: Bhoora rang aksar burnt sugar colour (INS 150) se aata hai; asli aate ki bread halka grey-brown aur thodi bhari (dense) hoti hai.

cards.title: Sendha Namak (Pink Salt) vs Iodine Namak, aur Chamakdaar Haldi mein Milawat ka Sach
cards.hook: Aajkal trend mein log ghar ka saara sada namak band karke sirf 'Pink Salt' kha rahe hain, aur bazaar se bilkul chamakdaar peeli haldi kharidte hain—dono mein kya chhupa khatra hai?
cards.illusion: Log sochte hain ki Pink Salt mein 84 magical minerals hote hain isliye saadha namak chhod dena chahiye, aur jo haldi jitni zyada chamakdaar peeli dikhe wo utni hi shuddh hai.
cards.myth: Pink Salt mein BP nahi badhta aur usmein bahut taakat hoti hai.
cards.reality: BP sodium se badhta hai, aur Pink Salt mein bhi lagbhag utna hi sodium hota hai jitna safed namak mein. Bas usmein Iodine nahi hota.

cards.title: Paper Cup mein Garam Chai, Tea Bags aur Garam Khane mein Plastic Dabba
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki plastic cup ki jagah 'Paper Cup' mein chai peena safe aur eco-friendly hai—par agar wo sirf kagaz hota to chai 10 second mein bahar beh jaati!
cards.illusion: Paper cup aur pyramid tea bags dekhne mein kagaz/kapde jaise lagte hain, isliye log befikar hokar usmein khaulti hui chai ya coffee peete hain.
cards.myth: Paper cup bilkul kagaz ka bana hota hai, isliye usmein koi plastic nahi hota.
cards.reality: Bina andar plastic ki film lagaye koi bhi paper cup 1 minute bhi garam chai nahi rok sakta—har regular disposable paper cup andar se plastic-lined hota hai.

cards.title: Rasoi ke 3 Chhupe Natural & Chemical Khatre: Carbide Wale Aam, Hara Aloo aur Kachcha Rajma
cards.hook: Fal meetha dikhe isliye chemical se pakana, aloo ka hara hissa kaatna bhool jaana, aur rajma dheemi aanch par adh-paka chhod dena—teeno mein ek jaisi badi science chhupi hai.
cards.illusion: Log maante hain ki 'Peela aam matlab pakka aur meetha', 'Aloo thoda hara hai to koi baat nahi sabzi mein pak jayega', aur 'Slow cooker mein rajma bina tez ubaale bhi gal jaata hai'.
cards.myth: Aloo ka hara rang sirf kachchapan hai, ubaalne se khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Hara rang Chlorophyll hai aur uske sath Solanine zeher banta hai jo aam ubaalne se nahi marta—usse chhilkar gehrai se kaat kar nikalna zaroori hai.

cards.title: RO Paani ka Sahi TDS Kitna Ho? Aur Mehnge 'Alkaline Water' ka Asli Vigyan
cards.hook: Log paani ki purity sirf ek number (TDS) se naapte hain ki jitna kam utna achcha—ya fir hazaaron rupaye ki 'Alkaline Machine' lagwa lete hain. Par hamare pet ka acid iske sath kya karta hai?
cards.illusion: Aam dharna hai ki 20-30 TDS wala RO paani sabse shuddh hai, aur Alkaline water peene se sharir ki saari bimariyan aur acidity jad se khatam ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: RO paani ka TDS 10 ya 20 hona sabse shuddh aur healthy paani ki nishani hai.
cards.reality: WHO ke mutabik bahut kam TDS (<50) wale paani mein zaroori calcium aur magnesium nahi bachte—RO mein 75-150 TDS sabse balanced hota hai.

cards.title: '100% Real Juice' aur 'Sugar-Free' Biscuits ka Sach: Liquid Sugar aur Artificial Sweeteners
cards.hook: Subah nashte mein bacchon ko '100% Real Fruit Juice' ka tetra pack dena aur ghar mein 'Sugar-Free' biscuit khana—dono ko healthy samjha jaata hai, par pet ke andar dono kya karte hain?
cards.illusion: Pack par taaze phalon ki photo aur 'No Added Sugar' likha dekhkar lagta hai ki ye ghar par phal khane jaisa hi healthy hai.
cards.myth: '100% Fruit Juice - No Added Sugar' peena poora phal khane ke barabar healthy hai.
cards.reality: Juice mein phal ka asli hero (Fiber) nikal jaata hai; peene par uski natural fructose sugar bhi sharir mein cold drink ki tarah tez asar karti hai.

cards.title: Chamakdaar Sunahra Gud (Jaggery) vs Asli Bhoora Gud: Hydro Powder ka Khel
cards.hook: Bazaar mein jo gud bilkul safed ya chamakdaar peela dikhta hai, wo shuddh nahi balki kapde/cheeni saaf karne wale chemical se dhoya gaya ho sakta hai.
cards.illusion: Grahak ko lagta hai ki gehra bhoora ya kaala gud ganda hoga, aur chamakdaar peela-safed gud sabse taaza aur saaf hai.
cards.myth: Gehra kaala/bhoora gud ganda aur purana hota hai.
cards.reality: Asli bina chemical wala gud lohe ki kadhai mein banne ke karan hamesha gehra bhoora hi hota hai; safed-chamakdaar gud aksar chemical bleach ki den hai.

cards.title: Mithai par Chandi ka Vark vs Sasta Aluminium Vark: Haath par Masalne ka Science
cards.hook: Kaju katli aur barfi par chamakti hui patli chandi ki parat dekhkar hum shaan samajhte hain, par kai halwai chandi ki jagah sasta aluminium chipka dete hain.
cards.illusion: Har chamakdaar safed patli panni jo mithai par lagi hai, wo shuddh chandi (Silver) hi hogi.
cards.myth: Chandi ka vark khane se sharir mein taakat aati hai.
cards.reality: Chandi ek inert metal hai—hamara pet ise pacha kar khoon mein nahi sokh sakta, ye sirf sajawat ke liye hai.

cards.title: Ghar ka Dahi vs Packet Dahi: Bazaar ka Dahi Itna Gaadha aur Meetha Kaise Rehta Hai?
cards.hook: Ghar mein jamaya dahi 2 din mein khatta aur paani chhodne lagta hai, par market ka cup wala dahi 15 din fridge mein bhi bilkul malai jaisa tight rehta hai—kyun?
cards.illusion: Log maante hain ki packet dahi shayad bahut gaadhe bhains ke doodh se jamaya gaya hoga isliye itna smooth aur thick hai.
cards.myth: Dahi ke upar aane wala paani kharab hota hai aur use fenk dena chahiye.
cards.reality: Wo paani 'Whey' hai jismein sabse asaan pachne wala protein, Vitamin B2 aur minerals hote hain—use fenkein nahi, dahi mein mila lein ya aate mein use karein.

cards.title: Desi Ghee mein Vanaspati (Dalda) aur Uble Aloo ki Milawat ka Vigyan
cards.hook: ₹600-₹800 kilo ke zamane mein ₹300 kilo 'Shuddh Desi Ghee' kaise bikta hai? Saste Vanaspati aur uble aloo ka khel kaise kaam karta hai.
cards.illusion: Daanedaar texture aur peela rang dekhkar log maan lete hain ki ye gaay/bhains ka asli daanedaar ghee hai.
cards.myth: Har daanedaar aur peela ghee shuddh gaay ka ghee hota hai.
cards.reality: Daanedaar texture aur peela rang (beta-carotene colour se) vanaspati aur palm oil mein aasani se banaya ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Shahad (Honey) mein Chawal/Makke ka Syrup: Internet ka 'Paani Test' Fail Kyun Ho Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Log glass ke paani mein shahad daal kar check karte hain ki niche baitha to asli—par nayi Chinese aur factory syrup milawat ne is ghar ke test ko poori tarah fail kar diya hai!
cards.illusion: Agar shahad glass ke paani mein ghule bina seedhe tale mein jaakar baith jaaye ya kagaz ko geela na kare, to wo 100% shuddh shahad hai.
cards.myth: Jo shahad thand mein jam jaaye wo cheeni wala nakli shahad hai.
cards.reality: Ulta sach hai! Asli raw shahad (khaaskar sarson ke phoolon wala) thand mein natural glucose ki wajah se jam jaata hai, jabki processed sugar syrup wala shahad kabhi nahi jamta.

cards.title: Kesar (Saffron) mein Bhutte ke Baal aur Nakli Rang: 1 Minute ka Paani Test
cards.hook: Duniya ke sabse mehenge masale Kesar ke ek gram ki keemat ₹300-₹500 hai—isliye bhutte ke baal aur kagaz ke tukde rang kar bechne ka dhandha chalta hai.
cards.illusion: Doodh ya paani mein daalte hi agar turant gehra laal-kesariya rang nikal aaye, to kesar bahut tez aur asli hai.
cards.myth: Asli kesar doodh ko laal ya gehra orange kar deta hai.
cards.reality: Asli kesar doodh ya paani ko hamesha chamakdaar sunahra PEELA (Golden Yellow) karta hai, laal nahi.

cards.title: Hing (Asafoetida) mein Maida aur Gond ka Milawat Game: Doodhiya Paani Test
cards.hook: Bazaar mein jo dabbi wali sasti hing milti hai, uske peeche chhote aksharon mein 'Compounded Asafoetida' likha hota hai—jismein asli hing sirf 10-30% hi hoti hai!
cards.illusion: Har hing ki dabbi mein 100% pure hing hoti hai, bas kuch teekhi hoti hai aur kuch halki.
cards.myth: Har dabbi wali powder hing 100% shuddh hing hoti hai.
cards.reality: 90% dabbi wali powder hing 'Compounded Hing' hoti hai jismein 60-85% maida/chawal ka aata aur gond hota hai—label par percentage check karein.

cards.title: Laal Mirch Powder mein Eent ka Choora aur Sudan Dye: Paani mein Tairne ka Test
cards.hook: Bazaar ki mirchi bahut tez laal dikhti hai par dalte waqt wajan bhari lagti hai—kya usmein rang aur eent ka choora mila ho sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Jitni gehri laal aur chamakdaar mirchi hogi, wo utni hi shuddh aur Kashmiri quality ki hogi.
cards.myth: Khuli mirch mein thoda rang to har jagah chalta hai, sabzi achchi dikhti hai.
cards.reality: Sudan dye aam food colour nahi hai, ye petrol/polish industry ka zeherila chemical hai jo thodi matra mein bhi sharir ke liye khatarnak hai.

cards.title: Kaali Mirch (Black Pepper) mein Papite ke Beej: 10 Second ka Density Test
cards.hook: Papita khakar hum beej fenk dete hain, par sukha kar wahi kaale gol beej ₹600-₹800 kilo wali kaali mirch mein milakar beche jaate hain!
cards.illusion: Dono dekhne mein gol, kaale aur jhurridar (wrinkled) lagte hain, isliye upar se dekhkar farq pata hi nahi chalta.
cards.myth: Kaali mirch chamakdaar aur ekdum kaali dikh rahi hai matlab high quality hai.
cards.reality: Bahut zyada chamak aksar Mineral Oil polishing ki wajah se hoti hai; asli kaali mirch thodi matte dark-brown/blackish hoti hai.

cards.title: Chai Patti mein Purani Chai + Coal Tar Colour aur Lohe ka Choora kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Kya aapki chai thande paani mein bhi turant rang chhodti hai? Ho sakta hai purani istamal ki hui chai patti ko rang kar dobara becha gaya ho!
cards.illusion: Jis chai patti ko dalte hi ekdum tez aur gehra rang aa jaaye, log use sabse 'Kadak aur First-Class' chai maan lete hain.
cards.myth: Chai patti jitni jaldi gaadha rang chhode, utni hi kadak aur asli hai.
cards.reality: Thande paani mein turant rang chhodna kadak-pan nahi balki upar lagaye gaye nakli rang ki nishani hai.

cards.title: Chamakdaar Safed Cheeni vs 'Sulphur-Free' Sugar: Cheeni Safed Kaise Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Ganne ka ras toh halka hara-bhoora hota hai, fir factory se nikalne wali cheeni barf jaisi chamakdaar safed kaise ban jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Safed cheeni shuddh aur saaf hai, aur 'Sulphur-Free' ya 'Brown Sugar' bilkul natural aur healthy hoti hai.
cards.myth: Brown sugar ya Sulphur-free sugar khane se diabetes aur motapa nahi hota.
cards.reality: White, Sulphur-free aur Brown sugar teeno mein lagbhag 98-99.9% wahi Sucrose aur utni hi calories hoti hain.

cards.title: Seb (Apple) par Chamakdaar Mom (Wax Coating): Natural Wax vs Petroleum Wax
cards.hook: Supermarket ke seb aaine ki tarah chamakte hain aur chaku se khurachne par safed mom jaisa nikalta hai—par kya har seb ka mom zeher hota hai?
cards.illusion: Seb khurachne par safed powder/mom nikle to iska matlab dukandar ne uspar mombatti ka wax lagaya hai, ya fir 'sab wax food-grade hota hai kuch nahi hota'.
cards.myth: Seb par thoda bhi mom nikle to matlab vyapari ne mombatti pighla kar lagayi hai.
cards.reality: Seb mein natural wax bhi hota hai aur legal food-grade wax bhi; par agar moti parat ho ya petroleum smell aaye to dhona/chhilna zaroori hai.

cards.title: Hari Matar, Bhindi aur Parwal mein Chamakdaar Hara Rang (Malachite Green)
cards.hook: Kabhi-kabhi bazaar ki hari matar ya bhindi itni gehri hari hoti hai ki ubaalne ke baad paani bilkul hara ho jaata hai—wo qudrati rang nahi, chemical dye hai!
cards.illusion: Jitni gehri hari aur chamakdaar sabzi dikhegi, wo utni hi taaza aur khet se abhi todi hui hogi.
cards.myth: Ubaal kar paani fenk dene se rang ka saara asar nikal jaata hai.
cards.reality: Chemical dye daanon aur sabzi ki skin ke andar sokh jaata hai—poori tarah nahi nikalta, isliye rangi hui sabzi kabhi na khayein.

cards.title: Tarbooz (Watermelon) mein Laal Rang ka Injection: Tissue Paper se Kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Bina mausam ke bhi tarbooz andar se bilkul surkh laal aur meetha dikhta hai—par kya usmein 'Erythrosine' dye ka injection lagaya gaya hai?
cards.illusion: Kaatne par agar tarbooz andar se ekdum gehra laal dikhe, to wo bilkul pakka aur rasila hai.
cards.myth: Har tarbooz mein laal rang injection se hi aata hai.
cards.reality: Har tarbooz injected nahi hota—mausam ke pakke desi tarbooz natural taur par hi laal hote hain. Tissue test se sirf 5 second mein farq pakda ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Chamakdaar Safed 'Chinese Lahsun' vs Desi Lahsun: Bleaching aur Chemical Preservation
cards.hook: Desi lahsun thoda maila, chhota aur jadh wala hota hai, par bazaar mein bilkul barf jaisa safed, mota aur bina jadh wala lahsun kaise milta hai?
cards.illusion: Safed mota lahsun saaf-suthra, chhilne mein aasaan aur high-quality lagta hai.
cards.myth: Mota safed lahsun zyada gunwari aur taaza hota hai.
cards.reality: Chhote desi lahsun mein Allicin (asli aushadhiya tatva) aur khushbu mote safed lahsun se kahin zyada hoti hai.

cards.title: Instant Noodles & Soup Packets: 'Noodles pe Wax' ka Sach aur Asli Khatra (Sodium + Maida)
cards.hook: Social media par chalte viral messages kehte hain ki noodles par 'wax' laga hota hai—par vigyan kehta hai wax nahi, iske andar chhupa Maida, Palm Oil aur 1 din ka aadha Namak asli khatra hai!
cards.illusion: Noodles sirf jaldi banne wala halka nashta hai, ya fir 'unmein mombatti ka wax hota hai jo pet mein chipak jaata hai'.
cards.myth: Noodles par wax coating hoti hai jo pet mein 3 din tak pachti nahi.
cards.reality: Noodles par wax nahi balki Palm Oil frying hoti hai; maida hone ke karan wo jaldi pach jaata hai, asli dikkat uska high sodium, palm oil aur zero fiber hai.

cards.title: Ice Cream vs 'Frozen Dessert': Aap Doodh ki Malai Kha Rahi Hain ya Palm Oil?
cards.hook: Bazaar ke 50% family packs aur cones par 'Ice Cream' likha hi nahi hota—unpar chhote aksharon mein 'Frozen Dessert' likha hota hai!
cards.illusion: Har thandi, creamy, vanilla/chocolate cup ya brick jo freezer mein bikti hai, wo doodh aur cream se bani Ice Cream hi hoti hai.
cards.myth: Frozen Dessert matlab koi low-calorie ya healthy thandi mithai hai.
cards.reality: Ulta hai—Frozen Dessert ka matlab hai doodh ke makkhan ki jagah saste palm oil aur vegetable fat se bani thandi cream!

cards.title: Instant Coffee mein 'Chicory' (कासनी) Kya Hota Hai? 100% Coffee vs 70-30 Mix
cards.hook: Kai mashhoor coffee jars aur pouches ke peeche likha hota hai '70% Coffee, 30% Chicory'—par ye Chicory kya hai, aur ise coffee mein kyun milaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har coffee jar mein 100% coffee beans ka powder hi hota hai, aur chicory shayad koi special coffee flavour hai.
cards.myth: Jis coffee ka rang jitna kaala aur taste jitna kadwa ho, usmein utni zyada coffee aur caffeine hai.
cards.reality: Gehra kaala rang aur kadwa-gaadha taste aksar Chicory ki wajah se aata hai, jismein 0% caffeine hota hai.

cards.title: Chocolate Spread aur Peanut Butter: 'Healthy Breakfast' ke Naam pe Cheeni aur Palm Oil
cards.hook: Bread par lagane wale mehenge chocolate-hazelnut spread aur kai 'creamy' peanut butter mein asli nuts se zyada Cheeni aur Palm Oil bhara hota hai!
cards.illusion: TV ad mein dikhate hain ki subah bachche ko bread par spread lagakar dene se pure din ki protein aur taakat milti hai.
cards.myth: Peanut butter ke jar ke upar agar tel dikhe to wo kharab ho gaya hai.
cards.reality: Bilkul ulta! Upar tel aana 100% natural peanut butter ki nishani hai kyunki usmein tel ko jamane wala hydrogen chemical nahi milaya gaya.

cards.title: Soya Chunks (Soyabean Badi) Kaise Banti Hai? Hexane aur 'Estrogen Hormone' ka Sach
cards.hook: Shakahari logon ke liye Soya Badi sasta aur sabse bada protein source hai, par log darte hain ki ye factory ke kachre ya mardon mein hormones badhne ka kaaran to nahi?
cards.illusion: Do tarah ke confusion hain: ek ki soya chunks plastic/kachre se bante hain, ya doosra ki ladkon ke soya khane se 'female hormones' badh jaate hain.
cards.myth: Soya khane se ladkon mein female hormones badh jaate hain.
cards.reality: Human clinical studies mein ye myth galat sabit ho chuka hai—normal diet (25-50g/day) mein soya testosterone ya male hormones par koi bura asar nahi daalta.

cards.title: Safed Cheeni vs Gud vs Shahad: Kya Gud aur Shahad Khane se Sugar/Wajan Nahi Badhta?
cards.hook: Log chai mein cheeni band karke 2 chammach gud ya shahad daal lete hain aur khush rehte hain ki ab wo 'Zero Sugar' healthy life jee rahe hain—par khoon mein teeno kya karte hain?
cards.illusion: Safed cheeni zeher hai, par gud, khandsari aur shahad khane se diabetes aur motapa nahi badhta.
cards.myth: Gud mein iron hota hai aur shahad wajan ghatata hai, isliye dono kitna bhi kha sakte hain.
cards.reality: Gud mein iron hota hai par itne iron ke liye aapko 100g gud khana padega jismein 380 calories sugar hogi—iron ke liye palak, chana, anar aur dal khayein, gud sirf kam matra mein swad ke liye rakhein.

cards.title: Microwave mein Khana Garam Karna: 'Radiation' ka Jhooth vs Plastic Bowl ka Asli Khatra
cards.hook: Log darte hain ki microwave mein garam kiya khana 'radioactive' ho jaata hai ya uske vitamins mar jaate hain—par asli khatra microwave ki kirnon se nahi, usmein rakhe plastic ke dabbe se hota hai!
cards.illusion: Microwave ki waves khane mein reh jaati hain aur usse cancer hota hai, ya fir koi bhi plastic ka dabba microwave mein rakh sakte hain.
cards.myth: Microwave khane mein radiation chhod deta hai aur saare nutrients jala deta hai.
cards.reality: WHO ke mutabik microwave khane ko radioactive nahi banata, aur jaldi pakne ki wajah se ubaalne ke mukable ismein vitamins zyada bachte hain—bas plastic ka bartan istemal na karein.

cards.title: Pressure Cooker mein Daal Jaldi Kyun Galti Hai? Aur Kya Seeti se Nutrition Ud Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Khule bhagone mein rajma ya chana pakane mein 1 ghanta lagta hai, par cooker ki 3 seeti mein 10 minute mein gal jaata hai—kya ye tez pakna poshan kam kar deta hai?
cards.illusion: Bahut log maante hain ki cooker mein khana 'pichak' kar pakta hai isliye uske saare vitamins aur poshan khatam ho jaate hain.
cards.myth: Cooker ka khana poshan-heen (nutritionless) hota hai kyunki wo bhaap ke dabav se pakta hai.
cards.reality: Food science studies dikhati hain ki kam samay mein pakne ki wajah se pressure cooking khule mein ubaalne se zyada vitamins bachati hai.

cards.title: Lohe ki Kadhai (Iron Kadhai) mein Sabzi Pakana: Khoon Badhta Hai par Sabzi Kaali Kyun Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Doctors aur dadi-naani lohe ki kadhai mein khana banane ko kehte hain kyunki isse khoon (Haemoglobin) badhta hai—par palak ya tamatar ismein kaala kyun pad jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Lohe ki kadhai mein sab kuch pakana best hai, ya fir kaala rang aana matlab sabzi kharab ho gayi.
cards.myth: Lohe ki kadhai mein sabzi kaali ho jaaye to wo zeherili ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Kaala rang sirf iron aur sabzi ke tannins ka reaction hai—ye khatarnak nahi hota, bas swad thoda metallic lagta hai.

cards.title: Mitti ke Matke ka Paani Bina Bijli Thanda Kaise Hota Hai? Aur Safai ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Fridge ka paani gale mein lagta hai, par mitti ke ghade/matke ka paani bina ek unit bijli kharch kiye hamesha sukun dene wala thanda kaise rehta hai?
cards.illusion: Mitti khud thandi hoti hai isliye paani thanda rehta hai, aur ek hi matka saalon tak bina khaas safai ke chalaya ja sakta hai.
cards.myth: Kaale/chamkile painted matke zyada achche aur mazboot hote hain.
cards.reality: Paint aur glaze mitti ke chhed band kar deta hai jisse evaporative cooling ruk jaati hai aur paani thanda nahi hota.

cards.title: Fridge mein Goondha hua Aata aur Kata hua Pyaz Rakhna: Bacteria vs Myth
cards.hook: Viral forwards mein kehte hain ki fridge mein kata pyaz 'zeherila magnet' ban jaata hai aur goondha aata bhoot-pret/zeher bulaata hai—asli science kya kehti hai?
cards.illusion: Kata hua pyaz ek raat mein saare bacteria sokh kar zeher ban jaata hai, ya fir goondhe hue aate ko 4 din fridge mein rakhkar roti banana bilkul fresh roti jaisa hai.
cards.myth: Kata pyaz kamre se saare virus-bacteria kheench kar zeherila ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: National Onion Association aur food scientists saaf kar chuke hain ki pyaz 'bacteria magnet' nahi hai—ultha iske sulphur compounds bacteria ki growth slow karte hain.

cards.title: Ubalne par Doodh Bahar Kyun Gir Jaata Hai jabki Paani Nahi Girta?
cards.hook: Chulhe par paani jitni der bhi uble wo patile mein hi rehta hai, par doodh se 10 second nazar hatate hi poora gas par ufan kar gir jaata hai—is mein kaun si science hai?
cards.illusion: Doodh mein paani se zyada gas hoti hai ya doodh jaldi garam hota hai isliye wo bahar aata hai.
cards.myth: Doodh ko 15 minute tak ubaalne se hi keetanu marte hain aur doodh zyada taakatwar banta hai.
cards.reality: Packet doodh pehle hi factory mein pasteurized hota hai; 1 ubaal kaafi hai. Zyada der ubaalne se Vitamin B12 aur Folate kam ho jaate hain.

cards.title: Doodh Wali Chai vs Black Tea: Chai Peene se Gas/Acidity Kyun Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Subah khali pet doodh wali kadak chai peene ke baad aksar seene mein jalan aur gas kyun banti hai, aur kya doodh chai ke fayde khatam kar deta hai?
cards.illusion: Chai mein doodh daalne se chai thandi aur pet ke liye halki (gentle) ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Subah chai peene se pet saaf hota hai aur din bhar energy rehti hai.
cards.reality: Garam liquid aur caffeine ki aadat se pet ki movement hoti hai, jo kaam ek glass gunguna paani bina acidity kiye kar sakta hai!

cards.title: Khana Khane ke Turant Baad Chai/Coffee Peena: Khoon (Iron) Kyun Kam Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Bahut logon ko daal-roti khane ke turant baad ek cup chai peene ki aadat hoti hai—par ICMR kehta hai ye aadat aapke khane ka aadha Iron mitti kar deti hai!
cards.illusion: Khane ke baad chai peene se khana jaldi pach jaata hai aur aalas nahi aata.
cards.myth: Khane ke baad chai peene se khana achche se hazam hota hai.
cards.reality: Chai hazma nahi badhati balki khane se milne wale zaroori Iron ko block kar deti hai.

cards.title: Roadside Ganne ka Ras (Sugarcane Juice) aur Barf: Kaala Padna aur Industrial Ice
cards.hook: Garmiyon mein thele par ₹20 ka thanda ganne ka ras bada rahat deta hai—par usmein dalne wali barf ki silli aur kaala-pan kis vigyan se aata hai?
cards.illusion: Barf toh paani hi hoti hai aur ganne ka ras aankh ke samne nikala gaya hai, isliye ye bilkul safe aur natural hai.
cards.myth: Barf mein itni thand hoti hai ki usmein koi bacteria zinda nahi reh sakta.
cards.reality: Bahut se bacteria aur virus (jaise Hepatitis A aur Salmonella) barf mein marte nahi, bas sote rehte hain—pighalte hi aapke pet mein jaag jaate hain!

cards.title: Achar (Pickle) mein Zyada Tel aur Namak Kyun Dalte Hain? Ghar ka Natural Science
cards.hook: Bina fridge aur bina kisi chemical preservative ke bhi dadi ke haath ka aam ka achar 2-3 saal tak kharab nahi hota—is mein kaun si science kaam karti hai?
cards.illusion: Achar mein tel aur namak sirf chatpate swad ke liye daala jaata hai—agar kam tel daalein to bhi achar utne hi saal chal jayega.
cards.myth: Achar par thodi safed phaphoondi (fungus) aaye to upar se chammach se hata kar neeche ka achar kha sakte hain.
cards.reality: Fungus ki dikhne wali parat sirf phool hoti hai—uski baarik jadhein aur zeherile toxins naram achar ke andar tak fail chuke hote hain.

cards.title: Chips ka Packet Aadha Khali Kyun Hota Hai? 'Hawa' Nahi, Nitrogen Gas ka Vigyan
cards.hook: ₹20 ke chips ke packet mein 40% chips aur 60% hawa dekhkar gussa aata hai—par kya company sirf thagi kar rahi hai ya us gas ke bina chips kharab ho jayenge?
cards.illusion: Companiyan sirf packet bada dikhane ke liye usmein saadi hawa bhar deti hain.
cards.myth: Chips ke packet mein koi zeherili gas bhari hoti hai jo pet mein gas banati hai.
cards.reality: Wo Nitrogen gas hai—wahi gas jo hamari saans ki hawa mein 78% pehle se hai, aur packet kholte hi seconds mein udd jaati hai.

cards.title: Paneer Phadne ke Baad Bacha Hara-Peela Paani (Whey Water): Naali mein Fenkein ya Istemal Karein?
cards.hook: Ghar mein 1 litre doodh se paneer banane ke baad jo 700 ml paani bachta hai, use hum kachra samajhkar sink mein baha dete hain—jabki usmein gym ke mehenge Whey Protein ka asli khazana hota hai!
cards.illusion: Doodh phadne par jo kaam ki cheez thi wo sirf safed paneer tha, aur bacha hua paani sirf bekaar kachra hai.
cards.myth: Paneer ke paani ka peela-hara rang doodh ki gandagi ya acidity karne wala paani hota hai.
cards.reality: Wo halka peela-hara rang Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) aur soluble proteins ki nishani hai—ye bilkul healthy aur poshan-yukt hai.

cards.title: Anda Taaza Hai ya Baasi? Paani mein Doobne-Tairne ka Science (Density & Air Cell)
cards.hook: Bina anda tode sirf ek glass paani mein daalkar 5 second mein pata chal jaata hai ki anda aaj ka taaza hai ya hafton purana baasi!
cards.illusion: Anda upar se bilkul safed aur chhilka band hai, isliye todne se pehle pata hi nahi chal sakta ki andar se taaza hai ya kharab.
cards.myth: Brown anda white ande se 10 guna zyada taakatwar aur desi hota hai.
cards.reality: Chhilke ka rang murgi ki nasl (breed) par depend karta hai—nutrition (protein ~6g) dono mein lagbhag ek barabar hota hai!

cards.title: Golden Kishmish, Kaju-Badam mein Keede aur Sulphur Gas ka Sach
cards.hook: Bina fridge rakhe badam-kaju mein 1 mahine mein jaale/keede lag jaate hain, par bazaar ki chamakdaar peeli (Golden) kishmish mahino bina badrang hue kaise tikti hai?
cards.illusion: Golden peeli kishmish sabse mehengi aur healthy hai, aur dry fruits sukhe hain isliye unhe bahar dabbe mein saal bhar rakh sakte hain.
cards.myth: Dry fruits ko fridge mein rakhne se wo seele (naram) aur kharab ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Airtight dabbe mein fridge mein rakhne se unka healthy tel fresh rehta hai, keede nahi lagte aur akhrot-badam mahino kurkure rehte hain.

cards.title: Caffeinated Energy Drinks: Caffeine + Sugar ka Jhatka aur Heartbeat par Asar
cards.hook: ₹20 ki laal bottle ya ₹120 ke can pe likha hota hai 'Instant Energy'—par kya ismein sachmuch koi taakat hai, ya ye sirf Caffeine aur 7 chammach cheeni ka cocktail hai?
cards.illusion: Students aur young log sochte hain ki exam ya workout se pehle energy drink peene se dimaag aur sharir mein alag taakat aati hai.
cards.myth: Energy drink peene se sharir mein vitamins aur taakat badhti hai, isliye gym/khelte waqt peena best hai.
cards.reality: Caffeine sharir se paani nikalta hai (diuretic) aur tez workout ke sath heart rate khatarnak level par badha sakta hai—khelte waqt saada paani ya ORS best hai.

cards.title: Diet Soda / Zero-Calorie Cold Drinks: Bina Cheeni ke Meetha Kaise aur Kya ye Weight Ghatati Hai?
cards.hook: Ek bottle Diet Coke ya Zero-Sugar drink mein 0 calories likhi hoti hain par taste bilkul meetha hota hai—to kya roz 2 bottle peene se wajan kam hota hai?
cards.illusion: Kyunki ismein 0 sugar aur 0 calories hain, isliye diet soda paani ki tarah kitna bhi pi sakte hain aur isse motapa nahi badhta.
cards.myth: Diet soda peene se body ki charbi ghat-ti hai.
cards.reality: WHO ki 2023-2025 guidelines saaf kehti hain ki non-sugar sweeteners lambe samay mein body fat kam karne mein madad nahi karte.

cards.title: Sarson ke Tel mein Argemone (सत्यानाशी के बीज) ki Milawat: Dropsy ka Khatra
cards.hook: Khule sarson ke tel mein kabhi-kabhi khet ke ek zeherile jangli paudhe 'Satyanashi' (Argemone) ke beej mil jaate hain—jisse haath-pair mein sujan (Dropsy) aa sakti hai!
cards.illusion: Gaon se aaya khula peela sarson ka tel hamesha 100% shuddh hota hai, aur packet wale se zyada safe hai.
cards.myth: Jis sarson ke tel mein jitni tez jhaanjh (aankh mein lagna) ho, wo utna hi shuddh hai.
cards.reality: Aajkal saste refined/palm oil mein synthetic Allyl Isothiocyanate ki 2 boond daalkar bhi nakli teekhi jhaanjh banayi ja sakti hai—isliye sirf mehak par bharosa na karein.

cards.title: Bakery Cake ki Safed Cream: Doodh ki Malai Nahi, Phenta Hua Hydrogenated Palm Oil!
cards.hook: Birthday cake ke upar jo barf jaisi chamakdaar safed cream ki moti parat hoti hai, wo doodh ki malai se nahi balki saste Tel aur Cheeni ko machine se phent kar banti hai!
cards.illusion: Cake par lagi safed frosting doodh ki fresh dairy cream (Malai/Makkhan) se bani hoti hai.
cards.myth: Har bakery ka 'Fresh Cream Cake' doodh ki taaza cream se hi banta hai.
cards.reality: Local bakeries mein 'Fresh Cream' sirf ek naam ban gaya hai; andar 90% jagah non-dairy palm-oil whipping cream hi hoti hai.

cards.title: Packet Doodh vs Tetra Pack (UHT) vs Khula Doodh: Bina Fridge ke Tetra Pack 6 Mahine Kaise Tikta Hai?
cards.hook: Thaili wala doodh fridge mein 2 din mein phat jaata hai, par Tetra Pack wala doodh bina fridge ke kitchen ki shelf par 6 mahine kaise sahi rehta hai—kya usmein chemical preservative hota hai?
cards.illusion: Tetra Pack wale doodh mein zaroor koi tez chemical preservative milaya gaya hoga tabhi wo 6 mahine bina fridge ke kharab nahi hota!
cards.myth: 6 mahine chalne wale Tetra Pack doodh mein khatarnak preservatives hote hain.
cards.reality: UHT milk mein koi preservative nahi hota; ye 135°C ki 2-second sterilization aur 6-layer airtight aseptic packing ki wajah se surakshit rehta hai.

cards.title: Safed Chamakdaar Chawal vs Usna (Parboiled) vs Brown Rice: Polishing mein Kya Chala Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Moti jaisa chamakdaar safed chawal dekhne mein bada shahi lagta hai, par chawal ke daane ko itna chamkane mein uska sabse keemti Vitamin B1 kahan gaya?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada safed aur chamakdaar chawal hoga, wo utna hi high-quality aur healthy hoga.
cards.myth: Chawal khane se hamesha motapa aata hai, chahe kitna bhi kam khayein.
cards.reality: Chawal bura nahi hai—problem polished chawal bina daal-sabzi ke bahut zyada matra mein khane se hoti hai; Usna/Brown rice aur sahi portion bilkul healthy hai.

cards.title: Packet Atta vs Chakki ka Taaza Atta: Chhilka aur Gehun ka 'Dil' (Germ) Kahan Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Ghar ke aas-paas chakki ka pisa aata 15-20 din mein kharab ya keede-daar hone lagta hai, par supermarket ka 10 kg packet aata 3-4 mahine kaise bilkul white aur taaza rehta hai?
cards.illusion: Bade brands ka packet aata sabse high-tech aur 100% pure chakki aata hota hai.
cards.myth: Aata jitna safed aur baarik hoga aur chokar nikalne ke baad chikna dikhega, roti utni hi healthy hogi.
cards.reality: Chokar nikalte hi aata lagbhag maida ban jaata hai—asli health aur pet ki safai usi chokar (fiber) mein hoti hai.

cards.title: Kala Namak (Black Salt) mein Ajeeb Mehak Kahan se Aati Hai? Aur Gas mein Aaram ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Nimbu shikanji, chhat masala ya pet kharab hone par kala namak dalte hi aaram milta hai—par ismein uble ande jaisi teekhi mehak kis chemical se aati hai?
cards.illusion: Kala namak koi pahad se seedha nikalne wala bina process ka namak hai aur ismein bilkul sodium nahi hota.
cards.myth: High BP ke mareez safed namak ki jagah jitna chahein kala namak kha sakte hain.
cards.reality: Kale namak mein bhi ~95% Sodium Chloride hota hai—BP control ke liye har tarah ka namak kam karna zaroori hai.

cards.title: Pyaz Kaatne par Aankhon se Aansu Kyun Aate Hain? Aur Fridge mein Rakhne ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Pyaz chhilte waqt ekdum se aankhon mein teekhi jalan aur aansu aane lagte hain—par agar pyaz ko 15 minute fridge mein rakhkar kaatein to aansu gayab kyun ho jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Pyaz mein teekhi mirch jaisa koi ras hota hai jo hawa mein udta hai, aur munh mein paani rakhne se aansu ruk jaate hain.
cards.myth: Kaat-te waqt daanton ke beech bread ya chammach dabane se pyaz ki gas ruk jaati hai.
cards.reality: Gas aapki aankhon mein hawa ke raste seedhe jaati hai—bread/chammach nahi, balki thanda temperature aur sharp knife hi asli science hai.

cards.title: Ubalte Khane mein Nimbu ya Amla Daalna: Tez Aanch par Vitamin C Gayab Kyun Ho Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Poha, sabzi ya nimbu-chana banate waqt gas chalu rehne par hi nimbu nichod dene se uska khatta swad toh rehta hai, par uska sabse bada gun (Vitamin C) kahan udd jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Nimbu ya amla ka swad khatta hai, isliye jab tak sabzi mein khatta-pan hai, Vitamin C bhi poora mil raha hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak sabzi/chai mein khatta swad aa raha hai, Vitamin C bilkul sahi salamat hai.
cards.reality: Khatta swad Citric Acid se aata hai (jo heat-stable hai), jabki Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) 70°C+ ubaalne par tezi se toot jaata hai.

cards.title: Besan mein Khesari Dal aur Peela Rang (Metanil Yellow): Pakode Chamakdaar Kyun Dikhte Hain?
cards.hook: Bazaar ka khula sasta besan bina chana dale hi itna chamakdaar peela dikhta hai—par usmein Khesari Dal aur non-food rang milne se pairo mein kamzori kaise aa sakti hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada chamakdaar peela besan hoga, wo utne hi taaze aur shuddh chane se pisa hua hoga.
cards.myth: Pakode aur kadhi peele banane ke liye gehra peela besan sabse best quality ka hota hai.
cards.reality: Asli shuddh chane ka besan halka peela hota hai—zyada chamakdaar peela rang aksar Metanil Yellow ya haldi milawat ki nishani hoti hai.

cards.title: Pise Dhania Powder mein Lakdi ka Burada aur Gobar Milawat: Khushbu Gayab hone ki Asli Wajah
cards.hook: 2 chammach dhania powder sabzi mein daalne ke baad bhi na khushbu aati hai na gaadhapan—khule pise dhanie mein lakdi ka burada aur ghode ki leed kyun milayi jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Khula pisa dhania masala chakki se taaza aata hai isliye packed dhania se zyada shuddh hota hai.
cards.myth: Chakki par khula bikne wala masala factory ke packet se zyada fresh hota hai.
cards.reality: Agar aap apni aankhon ke saamne sabut dhania piswa rahi hain tabhi fresh hai; pehle se pisa khula masala milawat ka sabse bada adda hota hai.

cards.title: Jeera mein Ghans ke Beej aur Koyla/Gud ka Paani: Haath Kaala Karne Wala Nakli Jeera Scam
cards.hook: Jeera mehenga hote hi bazaar mein ₹150 kilo 'Nakli Jeera' aa jaata hai—jo phool-jhadu ki ghans aur gud-koyle ke paani se bilkul asli jeere jaisa dikhta hai!
cards.illusion: Sabut jeera dekhne mein bilkul ek jaisa lagta hai, sabut masale mein bhala kaun kya milayega?
cards.myth: Milawat sirf pise masalon mein hoti hai, sabut jeera-kali mirch mein nahi ho sakti.
cards.reality: Sabut jeere mein ghans ke beej aur sabut kali mirch mein papite ke beej ki milawat Bharat ki sabse common sabut-masala milawat hai.

cards.title: Asli Dalchini (Ceylon) vs Nakli Sasti Cassia: Roz Dalchini Chai Peene se Liver ko Khatra Kyun?
cards.hook: Weight loss aur sugar control ke liye log roz dalchini ka paani pite hain—par 90% Indian kitchens mein jo moti sakht chhal rakhi hai wo asli dalchini nahi, balki Cassia hai!
cards.illusion: Bazaar mein milne wali har bhoore rang ki chhal 'Dalchini' hi hoti hai aur roz khane ke liye bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Moti sakht dalchini hi asli aur tez hoti hai.
cards.reality: Moti sakht lakdi sasti Cassia hoti hai; asli Ceylon Dalchini hamesha patli, multi-layered, halki bhoore rang ki aur naram hoti hai.

cards.title: Tel Nikali Hui Sookhi Laung aur Elaichi ka Dhokha: Khushbu aur Eugenol Gayab!
cards.hook: Bazaar ki sasti laung aur hari elaichi chabane par munh mein na jhanjhanahat aati hai na khushbu—kyunki factory mein pehle hi unka mehenga tel nichod liya gaya hota hai!
cards.illusion: Laung aur elaichi sabut hain aur chhilka band hai, to andar ka saara ras aur tel salamat hoga.
cards.myth: Chhoti sikudi aur bina top-bud wali laung bhi wahi kaam karti hai bas sasti milti hai.
cards.reality: Wo tel-nikali (exhausted) laung hoti hai jismein Eugenol aur flavour pehle hi nikala ja chuka hota hai.

cards.title: Kaali Sarson / Rai mein Argemone ke Beej ki Pahchan: Tadke se Pehle 10 Second ka Test
cards.hook: Bazaar ki kaali sarson ya rai dekhne mein bilkul ek jaisi lagti hai—par usmein mila sasta Argemone (Satyanashi) ka beej sharir mein sujan kaise la sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Rai/sarson ke chhote-chhote daane sab ek jaise hain, unmein koi zeherila beej nahi mil sakta.
cards.myth: Sabut sarson mein har chhota kaala daana rai ya sarson hi hota hai.
cards.reality: Argemone ke beej bilkul rai jaise kaale hote hain par surface khurdura aur andar ka hissa safed hota hai.

cards.title: Zyada Hari Chamakdaar Elaichi ka Raaz: Purani Peeli Elaichi par Hara Rang (Dye) Kaise Chadhta Hai?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein ₹1,200 wali sasti elaichi bhi ₹2,500 wali elaichi jitni gehri hari chamak rahi hai—par paani mein daalte hi hara rang kyun chhootne lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Jitni zyada hari elaichi hogi, wo utni hi taazi aur meethi hogi.
cards.myth: Chamakdaar neon-hari elaichi hi sabse taazi aur A-grade hoti hai.
cards.reality: Natural elaichi hamesha mild natural green hoti hai; extra chamakdaar parrot-green rang aksar chemical dye ki nishani hota hai.

cards.title: Sabut Haldi ki Gaanth par Peeli Chamak: 'Lead Chromate' Polish Bachchon ke Dimaag par Asar?
cards.hook: Pise haldi se bachne ke liye log sabut haldi ki gaanth kharid kar piswate hain—par sasti sabut haldi ko bhi chamkane ke liye Lead Chromate ki polish ki jaati hai!
cards.illusion: Sabut haldi ki gaanth toh bilkul mitti se nikli natural cheez hai, ispar koi chemical nahi ho sakta.
cards.myth: Haldi ki sabut gaanth par sirf mitti hoti hai, koi chemical polish nahi ho sakti.
cards.reality: Haldi ko chamakdaar dikhane ke liye Lead Chromate aur Metanil Yellow polish ka istemal kai research papers mein pakda gaya hai.

cards.title: Namak Khula Rakhne ya Ubalti Dal mein Shuru mein Daalne se Iodine Ud Jaata Hai? Asli Chemistry
cards.hook: Gas ke bilkul bagal mein khule dabbe mein namak rakhne ya dal ubalte waqt shuru mein hi namak daal dene se kya sachmuch Iodine khatam ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Namak ke packet par 'Iodized' likha hai to chahe jaise rakh lo aur pakao, poora Iodine mil hi jayega.
cards.myth: Ek baar namak mein Iodine mil gaya to wo 5 saal tak khule mein bhi nahi udta.
cards.reality: Nami, dhoop aur garmi se Iodine dheere-dheere ghat-ta hai—isliye airtight dry storage aur 1 saal ke andar use karna best hai.

cards.title: Sirf Sendha Namak (Rock Salt) Roz Khane ka Trend: Iodine ki Kami aur Thyroid ka Risk!
cards.hook: Social media videos dekhkar logon ne safed namak poori tarah band karke ghar mein roz sirf Sendha Namak khana shuru kar diya—par doctors Thyroid wapas badhne ki warning kyun de rahe hain?
cards.illusion: Sendha namak prakritik aur Ayurvedic hai, isliye safed iodized namak bilkul band karke 365 din sirf sendha namak hi khana chahiye.
cards.myth: Sendha namak mein 84 minerals hote hain isliye isse BP nahi badhta aur poora Iodine bhi mil jaata hai.
cards.reality: Wo 84 minerals sirf 1–2% trace matra mein hote hain (ek chutki mein 0.001 mg!)—baaki 98% wahi Sodium Chloride hai aur Iodine lagbhag zero hota hai.

cards.title: Kadwi ya Silan Wali Mungfali / Badam: 'Aflatoxin' Jo Ubalne aur Bhunne par Bhi Nahi Marta!
cards.hook: Mungfali ya kaju-badam chabate waqt agar ek daana kadwa ya badbudar lage, to log usse thookne ke bajaye nigal jaate hain—par ek kadwa daana liver ke liye kitna khatarnak hai?
cards.illusion: Mungfali ya dry fruit thoda sa seel gaya hai to use kadhai mein tez bhun kar khane se uska phaphoond khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Thodi si phaphoond wali mungfali ya badam ko dho kar dhoop mein sukhane ya bhunne se wo bilkul safe ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Phaphoond dikhni band ho sakti hai, par uska banaya Aflatoxin zeher daane ke andar sama chuka hota hai jo 200°C par bhunne se bhi nahi toot-ta!

cards.title: Kachche Ankurit Moong-Chana (Raw Sprouts): Superfood ya Garmi mein Food Poisoning ka Ghar?
cards.hook: Subah healthy rehne ke liye log kachche ankurit moong khate hain—par garmi-baarish mein wahi sprouts kabhi-kabhi gas, pet dard aur food poisoning kyun de dete hain?
cards.illusion: Sprouts bilkul ghar par ugaye hain isliye unhe hamesha 100% kachcha hi khana chahiye, thoda ubalne par saari taakat mar jaati hai.
cards.myth: Sprouts ko 4 minute bhaap (steam) dene se unka saara protein aur nutrition khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Protein, fibre, iron aur calcium bhaap se bilkul nahi marte—ulta protein aur minerals sharir ko zyada aasani se absorb hote hain aur harmful bacteria khatam ho jaate hain!

cards.title: Pital aur Tambe ke Bartan mein Dahi, Kadhi ya Achar Rakhna Zeherila Kyun Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Purane zamane ke log pital aur tambe ki katori mein kabhi dahi, rayta ya nimbu wala khana nahi paroste the—iske peeche kaun sa chemical reaction hai?
cards.illusion: Tamba aur Pital toh bahut shuddh dhatu hain, inmein rakha har khana sehat ke liye amrit hota hai.
cards.myth: Tambe ke bartan mein nimbu-dahi rakhne se usmein tambe ke gun aur taakat badh jaati hai.
cards.reality: Saade paani mein sirf 0.1–0.5 mg/L trace copper aata hai jo healthy hai, par nimbu-dahi mein itna zyada copper ghul jaata hai ki wo food poisoning kar deta hai!

cards.title: Lohe/Cast Iron ke Tawa aur Kadhai par Sabun Lagane se Zang Kyun Lagta Hai? (Seasoning Science)
cards.hook: Naya Cast Iron tawa kharida tha ki natural non-stick rahega—par vim liquid aur lohe ke juna se ragad kar dhote hi uspar zang lag gaya aur dosa chipakne laga!
cards.illusion: Har bartan ko aam steel ki tarah sabun aur metal scrubber se chamka kar rakhna hi best safai hai.
cards.myth: Cast Iron tawe ko kabhi paani se nahi dhona chahiye aur agar zang lag jaaye to tawa kharab ho gaya.
cards.reality: Cast iron ko paani (aur halka mild dish soap) se dho sakte hain, bas turant sukhakar 2 boond tel lagana hota hai—aur zang ko ragad kar aasani se dubara season kiya ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Tooti/Chitki Hui Ceramic Cup-Plates (Chipped Crockery): Kinare se 'Lead' aur Bacteria ka Khatra
cards.hook: Chai ke cup ya kaanch-ceramic plate ka kinara thoda sa toot/chitak gaya hai, par hum use 'chalta hai' bolkar chalate rehte hain—par wahan se khatra kya hai?
cards.illusion: Cup ya plate ka bas thoda sa kinara hi to chhila hai, usmein chai-khana peene se kya nuksan ho sakta hai?
cards.myth: Chipped cup ko ubalte paani aur sabun se dho dene par usmein koi keetanu nahi rehte.
cards.reality: Exposed kachchi ceramic mitti porous (sponge jaisi) hoti hai—sabun aur bacteria uske bareek chhedon ke andar sama jaate hain.

cards.title: Melamine Plates (Shatterproof Crockery): Garam Dal-Sabzi aur Microwave mein Kyun Khatarnak?
cards.hook: Shaadi-party aur ghar mein safed chamakdaar 'Melamine' plates mein garam-garam dal, chole aur rasam parosa jaata hai—par kya Melamine garmi mein Formaldehyde chhodta hai?
cards.illusion: Melamine dekhne mein bilkul kaanch/bone-china jaisa lagta hai aur toot-ta bhi nahi, to ismein har garam khana aur microwave heating safe hai.
cards.myth: Melamine plates ceramic (mitti) ya fiber ki hoti hain isliye 100% heat-proof hain.
cards.reality: Melamine ek synthetic plastic resin (Melamine-Formaldehyde) hai—ye microwave aur bahut garam khatte khane ke liye safe nahi hota.

cards.title: Saste Silicone Spatula aur Air-Fryer/Baking Moulds: 'Pinch Test' se Pakdein Plastic Filler Scam!
cards.hook: Online ₹99 mein milne wala Silicone Spatula aur Cake Mould oven ya garam kadhai mein badbu aur dhuan chhod raha hai—1 second ka 'Twist & Pinch Test' asli aur nakli kaise batata hai?
cards.illusion: Har rubber jaisa lachila baking mould aur spatula pure food-grade silicone hota hai jo 230°C garmi jhel leta hai.
cards.myth: Jo bhi spatula naram aur rubber jaisa mudta hai wo 100% pure heat-proof silicone hota hai.
cards.reality: Saste plastic fillers milakar bhi silicone ko naram banaya jaata hai—Pinch Test mein safed line turant pakad leti hai.

cards.title: Lohe ka Juna (Steel Wool Scrubber): Chhote Taar ke Tukde Khane mein Aane ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Jali hui kadhai ya kukar ragadne ke liye hum lohe ka juna use karte hain—par purane juna ke chhote-chhote nukile taar bartan mein chipak kar pet aur gale ko kaise chot pahuncha sakte hain?
cards.illusion: Lohe ka juna bahut mazboot hai aur thoda purana hone par bhi aaram se bartan saaf karta rehta hai.
cards.myth: Lohe ka juna jab tak poora ghul kar chhota na ho jaaye tab tak use karte rehna chahiye.
cards.reality: Toot-ta aur zang khata purana metal scrubber sabse zyada wire fragments bartan mein chhodta hai.

cards.title: Bartan Dhone ke Sabun / Gel (Dishwash) ki Bachi Hui Parat: Sabun Pet mein Jaane se Kaise Rokein?
cards.hook: Thoda sa dishwash liquid katori mein paani ke sath gholne ki jagah hum direct juna par bharpoor gel daal dete hain—par agar thali achche se nahi dhuli to bacha chemical pet ke andar kya karta hai?
cards.illusion: Bartan chamak raha hai aur uspar sabun ka jhaag nahi dikh raha, to bartan 100% chemical-free saaf ho gaya.
cards.myth: Bina paani milaye seedhe sponge par gaadha dishwash gel daalne se bartan zyada saaf aur safe dhulte hain.
cards.reality: Gaadha gel rinse karne mein mushkil hota hai aur bartan par zyada chemical residue chhodta hai—paani mein dilute karke dhona zyada effective aur safe hai.

cards.title: Rasoi ka Geela Peela Sponge Toilet Seat se 100 Guna Ganda Kyun Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Jis peele foam sponge se hum poore ghar ki thali-katori saaf karte hain, microbiology labs ne paya ki uske andar karodon bacteria rehte hain—isse rozana bacteria-free kaise rakhein?
cards.illusion: Bartan sponge to roz sabun aur paani mein dhoobta rehta hai, isliye wo khud hamesha bilkul saaf aur germ-free rehta hai.
cards.myth: Bartan sabun lagne se sponge ke andar ke saare germs apne aap mar jaate hain.
cards.reality: Dish soap chiknai nikalta hai, sponge ke geela andar chhupe bacteria ke biofilm ko poori tarah nahi maarta.

cards.title: Plastic vs Lakdi (Wood) Chopping Board: Sabzi ke Sath Microplastic aur Chicken Bacteria ka Sach
cards.hook: Safed plastic chopping board par chaaku chalane se jo nishan padte hain, wahan se har saal hazaaron microplastics hamare pet mein jaate hain—par kya lakdi ka board zyada safe hai?
cards.illusion: Plastic ka chopping board dhone mein aasaan aur zyada hygienic hota hai, jabki lakdi mein keetanu ghus jaate hain.
cards.myth: Lakdi ke chopping board mein plastic se zyada bacteria ugte hain.
cards.reality: UC Davis / Wisconsin ke lab tests mein paya gaya ki hardwood boards plastic ke gahre cuts ke mukable bacteria ko zyada tezi se sukhakar khatam karte hain—bas unhe dhone ke baad khada karke sukhana zaroori hai!

cards.title: Lakdi ke Chakla-Belan mein Geela Aata aur Kaali Phaphoondi: Paani mein Dubona Kyun Galat Hai?
cards.hook: Roti belne ke baad log lakdi ke chakla-belan ko sink mein baki bartanon ke sath geela chhod dete hain—par kuch mahine baad kinaron aur handle ke paas kaali phaphoondi kaise ug aati hai?
cards.illusion: Har bartan ki tarah lakdi ke chakla-belan ko bhi roz sabun-paani mein dho kar bhigo rakhna sabse saaf tarika hai.
cards.myth: Lakdi ke belan ko roz sabun aur dher saare paani se ragad kar dhone se hi wo saaf rehta hai.
cards.reality: Zyada paani aur sabun lakdi ko phula kar cracks paida karta hai jahan aata phans kar phaphoondi ugti hai—dry wipe aur weekly sun-dry hi best hai.

cards.title: Car mein Dhoop mein Rakhi Packaged Water Bottle: Garmi se Plastic mein 'Antimony' aur Microplastics Kyun?
cards.hook: Garmiyon mein car ke dashboard ya dhoop mein din bhar padi paani ki plastic bottle garam hokar naram pad jaati hai—kya wo garam paani peena safe hota hai?
cards.illusion: Paani toh seal-pack bottle ke andar hai, dhoop se bas garam hi to hua hai—thanda hone par wapas peene layak hai.
cards.myth: Seal-band packaged water bottle dhoop mein kitni bhi garam ho jaaye, fir fridge mein thandi karke peene par bilkul safe rehti hai.
cards.reality: High heat (60°C+) par plastic se paani mein ghule microplastics aur trace Antimony thanda karne par gayab nahi hote.

cards.title: Steel Thermos Flask mein Garam Doodh ya Chai Ghanton Rakhna: Khatti Badbu aur Bacteria ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Subah bachche ke liye thermos mein garam doodh ya office ke liye doodh wali chai bhar kar le gaye—par shaam ko dhakkan kholte hi saade doodh jaisi bhayankar badbu kyun aati hai?
cards.illusion: Thermos mein doodh garam rehta hai isliye 8–10 ghante tak bilkul kharab nahi hota.
cards.myth: Thermos mein rakha doodh jab tak phat kar chhenna na ban jaaye tab tak peene ke liye safe hota hai.
cards.reality: Doodh dikhne aur taste mein phatne se pehle hi gungune temperature mein bacteria danger level tak badh chuke hote hain.

cards.title: Tambe ki Bottle mein Hara-Kaala Daag (Patina): Steel Juna se Ragadna Galat, Nimbu-Namak Science
cards.hook: Raat bhar tambe ke lota/bottle mein paani rakhne ke kuch hafte baad andar kaale-hare dhabbe jam jaate hain—kya wo zeher hain aur bina mehnat 1 minute mein kaise chamkayein?
cards.illusion: Tambe ki bottle andar se kaali ya hari pad rahi hai to wo nakli tamba hai ya zang se sad rahi hai.
cards.myth: Din bhar 24 ghante sirf tambe ki bottle se hi paani peena chahiye aur nimbu-paani bhi usmein best rehta hai.
cards.reality: Tambe mein sirf saada normal paani 1-2 glass subah peena sahi hai; din bhar peene aur nimbu-paani ke liye Steel/Glass bottle hi safe hai.

cards.title: Pital (Brass) ke Bartanon par Safed 'Kalai' (Tin Coating) Kyun Karwayi Jaati Hai? Purana Desi Vigyan
cards.hook: Pital ke patile aur lagan mein jab shaadi-biah ya ghar par biryani-dal pakti hai to andar ek safed chandi jaisi parat (Kalai) lagwayi jaati hai—iske bina pakane mein kya khatra hai?
cards.illusion: Kalai sirf bartan ko chamakdaar aur chikna dikhane ke liye karwayi jaati hai, bina kalai ke pital mein bhi koi dikkat nahi.
cards.myth: Ek baar kalai karwa li to wo 10 saal tak chalti rehti hai.
cards.reality: Tin ek naram dhatu hai—daily cooking aur chammach chalne se 6–12 mahine mein ghis jaati hai, isliye samay-samay par check zaroori hai.

cards.title: Garam Paratha-Roti par Plastic 'Cling Film' aur Bazaari Polythene: Phthalates Kaise Ghulte Hain?
cards.hook: Street food wale bhaiya garam-garam chhole-bhature, samosa ya dal chawal patli safed/kaali polythene mein daal kar de dete hain—is garmi se polythene se kaun se chemicals khane mein ghul rahe hain?
cards.illusion: Polythene aur transparent plastic wrap khane ke liye hi bante hain—bas garm dal pighalni nahi chahiye, baaki sab safe hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak polythene pighal kar khane mein na gire, garam dal ya samosa polythene mein pack karne se kuch nahi hota.
cards.reality: Chemical leaching aankhon ko dikhe bina hoti hai—garam oil aur steam polythene ke plasticizers ko seconds mein khane mein ghula dete hain.

cards.title: Butter Paper vs Wax Paper vs Baking Parchment Paper: Oven mein Kaun Pighal Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Cake bake karte waqt log paratha lapetne wala 'Butter Paper / Wax Paper' oven ya air-fryer mein daal dete hain—par kuch minute mein hi kagaz jalne ya mom pighalne lagta hai! Farq kya hai?
cards.illusion: Har chikna safed/bhoora khane ka kagaz (Butter Paper, Wax Paper, Parchment Paper) bilkul ek hi cheez hota hai.
cards.myth: Har safed butter paper cake bake karne ke liye oven mein daala ja sakta hai.
cards.reality: Waxed butter paper oven ki garmi mein pighal kar dhuan aur fire hazard paida kar sakta hai—oven mein sirf Parchment Baking Paper hi safe hai.

cards.title: Steel ke Cup aur Ketli mein Chai ke Peela-Kaale Daag: Kya Ye Zang Hai ya 'Tannin'?
cards.hook: Electric kettle ya steel thermos ke andar chai-coffee ke gehre bhooray daag jam jaate hain jo sabun se bhi nahi nikalte—par 1 chammach Baking Soda se 5 minute mein naye jaise kaise chamakte hain?
cards.illusion: Steel ke thermos ya ketli ke andar bhoora daag lag gaya hai iska matlab sasta steel zang kha raha hai.
cards.myth: Ketli ya thermos ke andar ki bhoori/safed parat zang hai aur bartan phenk dena chahiye.
cards.reality: Bhoori parat chai ke tannins aur safed parat paani ke calcium minerals hote hain—baking soda ya vinegar se 5 minute mein bilkul saaf ho jaati hai.

cards.title: Asli Makkhan (Butter) vs 'Fat Spread / Margarine' (Nutralite): Chhupa Hua Dalda aur Trans Fat!
cards.hook: Cholesterol aur budget ke chakkar mein log Pure Dairy Butter ki jagah 'Cholesterol-Free Fat Spread / Margarine' kharid lete hain—par doodh ke bina ye tel patthar jaisa jamta kaise hai?
cards.illusion: Vegetable oil se bana 'Cholesterol-Free Fat Spread' asli makkhan se zyada healthy aur dil ke liye accha hota hai.
cards.myth: Cholesterol-free Fat Spread dil ke mareezon ke liye unlimited khana bilkul safe hai.
cards.reality: Cholesterol zero hone par bhi usmein maujood refined palm/saturated fats aur emulsifiers dil ki sehat ke liye achche nahi hote.

cards.title: Veg Mayonnaise ka Asli Sach: Doodh/Cream Nahi, 70% Refined Tel (Oil) Hota Hai!
cards.hook: Momos, burger, pizza aur bachchon ke sandwich par log dher saara safed 'Eggless Veg Mayonnaise' lagate hain—ye soch kar ki ye doodh-cream se bana hai, par usmein 70% sirf Refined Tel hai!
cards.illusion: Safed creamy 'Veg Mayonnaise' doodh ya dahi se bani halka-phulka healthy sauce hai.
cards.myth: Veg Mayonnaise doodh ya cream se banti hai aur dahi jitni hi halki hoti hai.
cards.reality: Mayonnaise ka mukhya ingredient (50%–75%) Refined Vegetable Oil hota hai—dahi ke mukable ismein 10 guna zyada calories aur fat hota hai.

cards.title: Tomato Ketchup ka Asli Sach: Saste Sauce mein Tamatar Kam, Kaddu (Pumpkin), Starch aur 30% Cheeni!
cards.hook: Samosa-pakode ke sath milne wali sasti ₹40 litre wali laal chatni ya bottle wale ketchup mein asli tamatar sirf 15–25% hota hai—baaki gaadhapan aur mithaas kahan se aati hai?
cards.illusion: Har laal gaadha tomato ketchup aur dhaba sauce pakke laal tamataron ko pees kar hi banta hai.
cards.myth: Tomato ketchup khane se tamatar ka nutrition aur vitamin milta hai.
cards.reality: High-heat processing, 25–30% sugar aur high salt ki wajah se ketchup ek condiment (swad) hai, taaze tamatar ka replacement nahi.

cards.title: Sasta Chowmein Soy Sauce: Asli Soya Fermentation Nahi, Caramel Colour aur Acid-HVP ka Khel!
cards.hook: Street chowmein aur sasti dark soy sauce ki bottle mein soya bean 1% bhi nahi hota—fir wo kaala rang aur namkeen swad kahan se aata hai?
cards.illusion: Har kaala Soy Sauce soyabean ko ferment karke banaya jaata hai.
cards.myth: Jitna gaadha kaala soy sauce hoga, usmein utna hi zyada asli soyabean hoga.
cards.reality: Asli brewed soy sauce halka translucent reddish-brown hota hai—gehra koyla-jaisa kaala rang aksar Caramel Colour (E150) ki wajah se hota hai.

cards.title: Bazaar ka Safed Sirka (White Vinegar): Ganne/Seb se Bana Hai ya Factory ke 'Glacial Acetic Acid' se?
cards.hook: Noodles, manchurian aur achar mein dalne wala ₹30 ka white vinegar aur ₹300 ka Apple Cider Vinegar—kya saara safed sirka petrol/chemical se banta hai?
cards.illusion: Har sirka (vinegar) phalon, seb ya ganne ke ras ko sada kar naturally banaya jaata hai.
cards.myth: Har bottle wala safed sirka seb ya ganne ke ras se banta hai.
cards.reality: Aam sasta safed vinegar lagbhag hamesha paani + synthetic Acetic Acid ka ghool hota hai.

cards.title: Pizza aur Street Burger ka Nakli 'Cheese Analogue': Doodh Nahi, Palm Oil + Starch ka Jaal!
cards.hook: ₹60 ke street cheese burst pizza aur saste cafe sandwiches par itna dher saara pighla cheese kaise aata hai—kya wo asli doodh ka Mozzarella hai ya 'Cheese Analogue'?
cards.illusion: Pizza par jo white cheez kheench kar pighal rahi hai, wo 100% doodh se bana asli cheese hai.
cards.myth: Street burger aur ₹50 wale cheese pizza par milne wali safed sauce asli pighla hua cheese hota hai.
cards.reality: Saste street food mein lagbhag hamesha 'Mayonnaise / Liquid Palm-Oil Dressing' ya 'Analogue Cheese' use hota hai, asli milk cheese nahi.

cards.title: Condensed Milk (Milkmaid) vs Ghar ka Khoya: Mithai mein 50% Cheeni aur Calories ka Ganit
cards.hook: Jaldi mithai banane ke liye log doodh jala kar khoya banane ke bajaye ek tin Condensed Milk daal dete hain—par ek tin mein kitne chammach cheeni chhupi hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Condensed milk bas gaadha kiya hua doodh hi to hai, isliye usse bani kheer/barfi ghar ke khoye jitni hi healthy hoti hai.
cards.myth: Condensed milk mein cheeni nahi hoti, wo bas doodh ko gaadha karne ki wajah se meetha lagta hai.
cards.reality: Doodh mein itna meethapan nahi hota—preservation ke liye usmein wajan ka lagbhag aadha hissa (45%+) cheeni milayi jaati hai.

cards.title: Tyoharon par Khoya (Mawa) mein Aloo, Maida aur Blotting Paper Milawat: 10-Second Test
cards.hook: Diwali aur Holi par ₹250 kilo khoya kaise mil jaata hai jabki 1 kilo asli khoya banane mein ₹300 ka 5 litre doodh lagta hai? Khoye mein uble aloo aur maide ki milawat kaise pakdein?
cards.illusion: Safed chikna khoya dekhne mein bilkul taaza lag raha hai, isliye usse bani mithai bilkul shuddh hogi.
cards.myth: Halwai ke yahan garam-garam taaza khoya ₹220 kilo mil raha hai to asli hi hoga.
cards.reality: 5 litre doodh ki laagat hi ₹300+ aati hai—uske baad gas aur mehnat jod kar asli khoya kabhi ₹220 mein bik hi nahi sakta!

cards.title: Sasti Mithai aur Chashni mein Cheeni ki Jagah 'Saccharin': Gande Kadwe Swad ka Asli Raaz!
cards.hook: Mele aur sasti dukanon ke gulab jamun, jalebi ya lassi peene ke 10 second baad gale ke peeche ek ajeeb kadwa-sa metallic meethapan kyun reh jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Mithai ki chashni mein bas cheeni kam-zyada hui hai, thoda sa kadwa swad pakane ki wajah se aaya hoga.
cards.myth: Saccharin bhi cheeni ka hi ek roop hai aur mithai mein thoda sa dalna kanooni roop se sahi hai.
cards.reality: Aam mithaiyon, rasgulla, jalebi aur roadside drinks mein Saccharin milana FSSAI ke tahat gair-kanooni hai.

cards.title: Chamakdaar Peela Laddu, Jalebi aur Biryani: 'Metanil Yellow' vs Safe Haldi/Kesar Rang
cards.hook: Shaadi ki biryani, motichoor laddu aur jalebi itni neon-narangi aur peeli chamakti hai ki 2 baar haath dhone par bhi rang nahi chhoot-ta—ye kaun sa rang hai?
cards.illusion: Mithaiyon aur biryani mein halwai ne bahut zyada kesar (saffron) ya haldi daali hai isliye itna sundar rang aaya hai.
cards.myth: Mithai par bikne wala har chamakdaar laal-peela rang FSSAI approved 'Meetha Rang' hi hota hai.
cards.reality: Saste shops aur street vendors aksar sasta non-food textile dye (Metanil Yellow / Rhodamine-B) ya permitted colour ka 10x overdose daal dete hain.

cards.title: Sadak ka Barf Gola (Chuski): Ganda Industrial Ice + Non-Food Rang + Saccharin ka Triple Khatra!
cards.hook: Garmi mein ₹20 ka rang-biranga Kala Khatta Barf Gola dekhkar bacche khush ho jaate hain—par usi shaam unhe gala kharab, bukhar ya diarrhoea kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Barf ka gola to bas thanda paani aur meetha sharbat hi hai, garmi mein thandak deta hai.
cards.myth: Paani jab barf ban jaata hai to uske andar ke saare germs thand se mar jaate hain.
cards.reality: Freezing bacteria aur viruses ko maarti nahi, sirf pause karti hai—pighalte hi wo dubara bimari failate hain!

cards.title: Synthetic / Analogue Paneer mein Detergent, Starch aur Palm Oil: Ghar par 3-Step Pakka Test
cards.hook: Shaadi-party ya sasti dairy ka ₹220 kilo paneer bilkul rubber jaisa chabane mein lagta hai aur 1 kilo doodh wale rate se bhi sasta milta hai—is nakli paneer mein kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Har safed mulayam chaukhor tukda jo dahi-nimbu jaisa dikhe, wo asli doodh ka hi paneer hota hai.
cards.myth: Jo paneer sabzi mein ubalne par toote nahi aur bilkul rubber jaisa tightly bana rahe, wahi best quality ka paneer hota hai.
cards.reality: Asli doodh ka paneer thoda naram aur crumbly hota hai—zyada rubbery aur bilkul na tootne wala tukda aksar starch/gum/palm-oil analogue paneer hota hai!

cards.title: Doodh mein Paani + Maida/Cheeni Milane se Lactometer bhi Dhokha Kha Jaata Hai! Asli Pehchan
cards.hook: Doodhiya bhaiya ka Lactometer to '100% Pure' dikha raha hai, par doodh ubaalne par malai patli aati hai—aakhir paani milane ke baad doodh ko gaadha kaise kiya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Agar Lactometer doodh mein sahi level par tair raha hai to usmein bilkul paani ya milawat nahi hai.
cards.myth: Lactometer agar green/pure mark par hai to doodh mein koi milawat ho hi nahi sakti.
cards.reality: Lactometer sirf density dekhta hai—paani ke sath starch, cheeni ya urea milakar density asani se fake ki ja sakti hai.

cards.title: Sardiyon mein Dahi Kyun Nahi Jamta aur Garmiyon mein Khatta Kyun Ho Jaata Hai? (Lactobacillus Temperature)
cards.hook: Thand mein raat bhar rakha doodh subah bhi paani jaisa patla rehta hai, jabki garmiyon mein 4 ghante mein hi khatta ho kar paani chhod deta hai—ismein bacteria ke kis temperature ka jaadu hai?
cards.illusion: Dahi jamane ke liye bas doodh mein jaman (khatta) daal kar chhod do, woh apne aap jam jaata hai—temperature se kya farq padta hai?
cards.myth: Sardiyon mein dahi jamane ke liye jaman khoob garam ubalte doodh mein daalna chahiye.
cards.reality: 55°C+ garam doodh jaman ke zinda bacteria ko maar deta hai—doodh sirf 40°C–42°C gunguna hona chahiye aur jamane ke baad garmi bachane ke liye hot-case/kambal mein rakhna chahiye!

cards.title: Dahi vs Chaas (Mattha): Dahi se Pet Phoolta Hai Par Chaas Turant Halka Kyun Lagta Hai?
cards.hook: Dupahar ke khane ke baad 1 katori dahi khane se neend aur bhari-pan aata hai, par wahi dahi agar paani mila kar Chaas (mattha) banakar piyein to pet turant halka ho jaata hai! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Chaas toh bas patla kiya hua dahi hai, dono ka pet par asar bilkul ek jaisa hota hai.
cards.myth: Chaas peene se bhi utna hi wajan badhta hai jitna full-cream dahi ya meethi lassi se.
cards.reality: 1 glass bina malai wale chaas mein sirf ~40–50 calories hoti hain, jabki 1 glass meethi malai lassi mein 250–350 calories hoti hain!

cards.title: Banana Milkshake aur Doodh + Khatte Phal: Kya Ye Sachmuch Zeher Hai ya Digestion Slow Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Social media par viral message aata hai ki 'Kela aur Doodh ek sath peene se sharir mein zeher banta hai'—jabki gym wale roz Banana Shake pite hain! Asli medical vigyan kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Ya toh Kela + Doodh bilkul zeher hai (Ayurveda ke naam par darr), ya fir har kisi ko roz 2 glass thanda banana shake peena chahiye.
cards.myth: Kela aur doodh milane se sharir mein safed daag (vitiligo) ya zeher ban jaata hai.
cards.reality: Vitiligo ek autoimmune skin condition hai—iska doodh, kela ya machhli khane se 0% lena-dena hai! Ye poori tarah ek myth hai.

cards.title: Haldi Doodh (Golden Milk) mein Chutki Bhar Kali Mirch Kyun Zaroori Hai? (Curcumin Absorption)
cards.hook: Raat ko chot ya sardi mein hum doodh mein sirf haldi ubaal kar pee lete hain—par vigyan kehta hai bina Kali Mirch aur Fat ke haldi ka 90% asar pet se bina sokhe bahar nikal jaata hai!
cards.illusion: Saade garam paani ya bina-malai doodh mein sirf haldi ghol kar peene se hi poori haldi sharir mein lag jaati hai.
cards.myth: Subah khaali pet saade gungune paani mein 1 chammach haldi ghol kar peene se 100% haldi sharir mein lag jaati hai.
cards.reality: Curcumin fat-soluble hai—bina thode fat aur kali mirch (piperine) ke saade paani se bahut kam haldi absorb hoti hai.

cards.title: Taaza Hara Nariyal Paani vs Bottled/Tetra-Pack Coconut Water: Heating aur Sugar ka Farq
cards.hook: Ghar ke bahar ₹60 ka taaza nariyal na milne par log supermarket se ₹70 ka tetra-pack coconut water le aate hain—par packet mein aate-aate uska potassium aur swad kaise badal jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Bottle ya tetra-pack mein band coconut water bilkul taaze nariyal se nikaal kar bhar diya jaata hai, 100% ek jaisa hota hai.
cards.myth: Har packaged coconut water tetra-pack mein bilkul zero sugar aur zero processing hoti hai.
cards.reality: Shelf life ke liye tetra-pack ko UHT/pasteurize karna zaroori hota hai aur kai brands swad ek jaisa rakhne ke liye sugar aur flavours milate hain.

cards.title: Subah Khaali Pet Green Tea Peene se Matli aur Acidity Kyun Hoti Hai? (Tannins Science)
cards.hook: Weight loss ke liye log uthte hi khaali pet kadwi Green Tea peene lagte hain—par 15 minute baad pet mein jalan, chakkar aur ulti jaisa mann kyun hone lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Subah sabse pehle khaali pet Green Tea peene se charbi tezi se pighalti hai.
cards.myth: Subah khaali pet jitni kadwi aur der tak ubaali hui Green Tea piyenge, wajan utni jaldi ghat-ta hai.
cards.reality: Zyada ubalne se sirf tannins (kadwahat) badhte hain jo acidity aur iron-deficiency karte hain—fat loss calorie deficit aur exercise se hota hai.

cards.title: Instant '3-in-1 Coffee Premix' Sachet ka Raaz: Coffee Sirf 10%, Baaki Cheeni aur Palm Creamer!
cards.hook: Office aur safar mein hum ₹15 ka '3-in-1 Instant Coffee' pouch garam paani mein ghol kar pee lete hain—par us ek chhote pouch mein 3 chammach cheeni aur refined oil creamer kaise chhupa hai?
cards.illusion: 3-in-1 Coffee sachet mein bas instant coffee, doodh ka powder aur halka meetha hota hai.
cards.myth: 3-in-1 Coffee pouch peene se wahi fayda milta hai jo ghar ki normal coffee se milta hai.
cards.reality: Ek 3-in-1 pouch mein lagbhag 55–65% cheeni aur non-dairy palm-oil creamer hota hai, jabki asli coffee sirf 10% hoti hai.

cards.title: Tetra-Pack Lassi aur Masala Chaas: Ghar ki Lassi vs Packet mein Chhupi 6 Chammach Cheeni / Namak!
cards.hook: Garmi mein cold drink chhod kar log ₹20–₹25 ki tetra-pack Lassi ya Masala Chaas le lete hain—par packet wali lassi mein ek regular cola cold-drink jitni cheeni aur chaas mein 1/3 din ka namak kaise aa gaya?
cards.illusion: Packaged Lassi aur Chaas toh dahi se bane hain, isliye inhe bina soche jitna chahe pi sakte hain.
cards.myth: Tetra-pack lassi mein ghar ke dahi jitne hi zinda probiotics hote hain aur sugar sirf doodh ki natural hoti hai.
cards.reality: Shelf-stable UHT tetra-packs heat-treated hote hain (live probiotics nahi bachte) aur unmein 5–6 chammach added sugar hoti hai.

cards.title: Healthy Breakfast bolkar Bikne Wale Cornflakes aur Choco-Flakes: Subah-Subah Sugar & GI Bomb!
cards.hook: Paratha chhod kar hum weight loss aur bachchon ki sehat ke liye 'Cornflakes / Crunchy Muesli' khane lage—par khane ke 1 ghante baad hi phir bhookh aur susti kyun lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par slim ladki aur '99% Fat-Free / Rich in Iron' likha hai, isliye Cornflakes subah ka sabse healthy nashta hai.
cards.myth: Paratha-poha se wajan badhta hai aur Cornflakes-Chocos khane se wajan ghat-ta hai.
cards.reality: High-GI refined cornflakes + cheeni se insulin tezi se badhkar bhookh aur fat storage badhate hain—besan chilla, moong chilla, vegetable dalia ya kam-tel poha kahin zyada weight-friendly hain!

cards.title: Masala Oats & Instant Oats vs Rolled / Steel-Cut Oats: 3-Minute Oats mein Namak aur Starch ka Sach
cards.hook: Heart aur weight loss ke liye sab log 'Masala Oats' aur 'Instant 3-Min Oats' kha rahe hain—par instant packet mein chhupa Maltodextrin, Namak aur Palm Oil kya asli Oats ke fayde khatam kar raha hai?
cards.illusion: Oats kisi bhi packet mein aaye—Masala Oats, Instant Oats ya Steel-Cut Oats—sab ek hi jitna healthy hota hai.
cards.myth: Flavoured Masala Oats packet wala khana aur ghar par plain rolled oats pakana sehat mein bilkul barabar hai.
cards.reality: Packet masala oats mein 500mg+ sodium, palm oil, maltodextrin aur flavour enhancers hote hain, jabki plain rolled oats 100% whole grain hota hai.

cards.title: Ghar ka Poha / Dalia / Upma vs Packet Cereal: Sabzi-Moongfali Daalte hi Nashta Balanced Kaise Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki Poha ya Upma mein sirf carbohydrates hote hain isliye wo motapa badhate hain—par 1 katori kanda-batata poha mein sirf 2 cheezein milate hi wo poori tarah balanced meal kaise ban jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Desi nashta (Poha, Dalia, Idli) bekaar carb hota hai jabki mehenga packaged Muesli/Oats hi diet food hai.
cards.myth: Desi Poha, Dalia aur Idli sab 'junk carbs' hain aur weight loss ke liye band kar dene chahiye.
cards.reality: Poha, Dalia aur Fermented Idli minimal-processed foods hain—sabzi aur protein (dahi/dal/peanuts) ke sath ye balanced healthy meals hain!

cards.title: 'High-Fibre Digestive' aur '100% Atta' Biscuit ka Sach: 50% Maida + Palm Oil + Cheeni!
cards.hook: Subah chai ke sath plain/Marie biscuits chhod kar log ₹45 wala 'Digestive / Oats / Sugar-Free Cracker' khane lage—par kya Digestive biscuit sachmuch hazma theek karta hai?
cards.illusion: Digestive aur Oats biscuit mein maida nahi hota, wo hazme ke liye banaya gaya hai aur bina dar ke 4-5 roz kha sakte hain.
cards.myth: Marie aur Digestive biscuits mein fat aur sugar nahi hoti isliye wo gym aur sugar patients ke liye safe hain.
cards.reality: Marie mein ~70% Maida + Sugar hoti hai aur Digestive mein Maida + ~20% Palm Oil + ~18% Sugar hoti hai—dono hi daily health food nahi hain.

cards.title: Chai ke Sath 'Suji Rusk / Papa Toast': Suji Kam, Maida-Palm Oil aur Double-Baking ka Sach!
cards.hook: Bimar hone par ya diet mein log roti chhod kar 'Suji Rusk (Toast)' chai mein dubokar khate hain—ye soch kar ki ye halka aur bina-tel ka hai, par usmein kitna Maida aur Palm Oil hota hai?
cards.illusion: Suji Rusk (Papa) bhuna hua aur sookha hota hai isliye usmein oil nahi hota aur bimar pet ke liye sabse halka hota hai.
cards.myth: Rusk bilkul sookha aur crisp hota hai isliye usmein tel/ghee bilkul nahi hota.
cards.reality: Rusk ko crisp aur khasta banane ke liye uske dough mein 12%–18% Refined Palm Oil ya Bakery Shortening milaya jaata hai.

cards.title: Packet Namkeen (Aloo Bhujia / Mixture): 35% Palm Oil aur Din Bhar ke Namak ka Dhokha!
cards.hook: Chai ke sath ek katori Aloo Bhujia ya Moong Dal namkeen khana aam baat hai—par kya aap jaanti hain ki 100g namkeen mein lagbhag 7 chammach refined palm oil aur aadhe din ka namak hota hai?
cards.illusion: Chips-kurkure junk food hain, par desi Bhujia, Moong Dal aur Chana Jor namkeen toh besan-dal se banti hain isliye healthy hain.
cards.myth: Moong Dal namkeen aur Besan Sev dal/besan se bante hain isliye unhe roz katori bhar ke khana healthy hai.
cards.reality: Deep-frying ki wajah se inka 30%–40% wajan seedha Palm Oil hota hai aur 100g mein ~550 calories hoti hain!

cards.title: Bazaar ke Papad mein 'Papad Khar' (Alkali) aur High Sodium: Roz 2 Papad BP Kaise Badhate Hain?
cards.hook: Khane ke sath bina tele sirf gas par seka hua 2 papad khane mein kya nuksan ho sakta hai? Par kya aap jaanti hain ki 2 papad mein 1,000 mg tak Sodium chhupa hota hai?
cards.illusion: Papad toh sirf urad/moong dal se banta hai aur gas par seka hua papad bilkul zero-oil healthy hota hai.
cards.myth: Papad sirf dal se banta hai aur bina tale sekne par zero-calorie healthy snack hai.
cards.reality: Papad mein Papad Khar (Sodium Carbonate) aur heavy namak ki wajah se bahut zyada Sodium hota hai jo BP badhata hai.

cards.title: Street Samosa-Chaat wali Chamakdaar Hari Chutney: Pudina Kam, Hara Rang + Rotiyan + Ganda Paani?
cards.hook: Sadak kinare samosa, golgappe ya chaat ke sath milne wali patli chamakdaar hari chutney itni sasti kaise milti hai jabki dhania-pudina ₹100 kilo hai—ismein kya-kya peesa jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Thele wale ki hari chutney taaze dhania, pudina aur hari mirch ko pees kar hi banayi jaati hai.
cards.myth: Hari chutney mein toh pudina aur nimbu hota hai isliye wo kabhi kharab nahi hoti.
cards.reality: Pudina-paani wali kachchi chutney agar 4+ ghante garmi mein bina fridge ke rakhi ho, to usmein bacteria tezi se ugte hain aur saste stalls mein rang-starch milawat common hai.

cards.title: Sadak ka 'Masala Soda / Banta Nimbu': Gandi Bottle Cap, Saccharin aur Industrial CO2 ka Risk
cards.hook: Garmi mein ₹15 ka goli-wala Banta Soda ya Masala Shikanji peete hi taazgi lagti hai—par kaanch ki bottle ko baar-baar bina garam dhoye bharne aur usmein Saccharin daalne se kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Nimbu shikanji aur Banta soda toh desi aur bilkul safe drink hai—cold drink se lakh guna behtar.
cards.myth: Soda gas (Carbonation) aur nimbu ki khattai paani ke saare bacteria ko maar deti hai.
cards.reality: Halka acid aur CO2 gande paani ya gandi bottle ke saare bacteria aur viruses (jaise Hepatitis A) ko nahi maar sakta.

cards.title: Cafe ki 'Cold Coffee / Frappe': Ek Glass mein 450 Calories aur 10 Chammach Cheeni ka Shock!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki coffee peene se weight kam hota hai, par cafe ya food-delivery app se mangwayi ek 'Hazelnut / Chocolate Cold Coffee' ek cheese burger se bhi zyada calories kaise de deti hai?
cards.illusion: Cold Coffee bas thanda doodh aur coffee hi to hai, thodi ice-cream upar se lene mein kya hi nuksan hai.
cards.myth: Coffee fat-burner hai isliye roz ek cafe Cold Coffee peene se metabolism tez hota hai.
cards.reality: Black coffee mein 0 sugar hoti hai; cafe ki cold coffee mein 10 chammach cheeni + ice-cream + whipped cream hota hai jo tezi se wajan badhata hai.

cards.title: Market ka 'Protein Bar' vs Chocolate Candy Bar: Glucose Syrup, Palm Oil aur Sasta Soy Protein!
cards.hook: Healthy snack samajh kar log ₹60–₹100 ka 'Chocolate Protein Bar' kha lete hain—par uske piche ingredients padhne par wo ek Dairy Milk / Snickers bar se alag kyun nahi nikalta?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par 'High Protein / Gym Snack' likha hai isliye Protein Bar bikul sugar-free aur super healthy hota hai.
cards.myth: Har 'Energy / Protein Bar' gym aur weight loss ke liye perfect low-sugar snack hota hai.
cards.reality: Zyadatar ₹40–₹70 bars mein 15–25g sugar/liquid glucose aur palm compound chocolate hoti hai, jo candy bars jaisi hi calories deti hai.

cards.title: Sardi mein Mungfali Chikki (Gajak): Asli Gud vs Liquid Glucose aur Cheeni ka Khel!
cards.hook: Bazaar ki chamakdaar aur sheeshe jaisi transparent dikhne wali Mungfali Chikki mein gud ke bajaye 'Liquid Glucose + Cheeni' bhara hota hai—asli gud wali chikki ki pehchan kya hai?
