cards.illusion: Mungfali ki chikki aur til gajak toh gud se banti hain isliye cheeni-free aur bilkul healthy hain.
cards.myth: Har chikki aur til-patti sirf shuddh desi gud se hi banayi jaati hai.
cards.reality: Commercial chikki mein crispiness aur shelf-life ke liye aksar Liquid Glucose aur White Sugar gud se zyada matra mein milayi jaati hai.

cards.title: Chamakdaar Geela Khajoor (Dates): Prakritik Mithaas hai ya Bahar se Lagaya 'Sugar Syrup'?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein sasta kaala khajoor itna chamakdaar aur shahad mein dooba kyun lagta hai—kya uspar upar se Glucose Syrup / Sugar ki coating chadhayi jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Khajoor jitna zyada chamakdaar aur chipchipa hoga, wo utna hi meetha aur taaza hoga.
cards.myth: Khajoor ke dabbe mein jo meethi chashni hoti hai wo khajoor ka apna natural shahad hota hai.
cards.reality: Saste commercial packs mein purane sukhe khajoor ko chamkane ke liye upar se Liquid Glucose / Sugar Syrup chhidka jaata hai—packet ke peeche label zaroor padhein.

cards.title: Safed Chamakdaar Kaju vs Bhoora/Peele Daane: Kaju ke Keede, Sulphur aur Fridge Storage
cards.hook: Bazaar mein jo kaju ekdum doodh jaisa safed chamak raha hai kya wahi best hai—aur 2 mahine mein kaju ke dabbe mein jale aur keede kyun pad jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Safed chamakdaar kaju bilkul fresh hota hai aur dry fruits ko kitchen ki shelf par bahar rakhna chahiye.
cards.myth: Dry fruits ko fridge mein rakhne se unmein nami (seal) aa jaati hai aur wo geela ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Khula rakhne par nami aati hai—airtight jar/ziplock mein band karke fridge mein rakhne se dry fruits 1 saal tak dry, crisp aur 100% bug-free rehte hain!

cards.title: Akhrot (Walnut) aur Alsi (Flaxseed) Bahar Rakhne se Kadwa Kyun Ho Jaata Hai? (Omega-3 Oxidation)
cards.hook: Mehenga chhila hua Akhrot laane ke 15 din baad hi chabane mein gale mein chubhan aur paint jaisi kadwahat aane lagti hai—is mein Omega-3 fat kharab kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Akhrot aur Alsi toh sukhe seeds hain, isliye wo chana-moong ki tarah 1 saal tak bahar kitchen mein kharab nahi hote.
cards.myth: Akhrot mein halka kadwapan hona uske asli aur healthy hone ki nishani hai.
cards.reality: Akhrot ke patle chhilke mein halka kasailapan (tannin) natural hai, par teekhi purane tel/paint jaisi kadwahat Omega-3 kharab (Rancid) hone ki nishani hai!

cards.title: Sukhe Chia Seeds Kha Kar Upar se Paani Peena: Gale mein Phool kar Jamne ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Weight loss ke liye log 1 chammach sukhe Chia Seeds munh mein daal kar upar se paani pee lete hain—par doctors isse 'Choking Emergency' kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Chia seeds chhote-chhote daane hi to hain, unhe sukha nigal kar upar se paani peene se wo pet mein jaakar phool jayenge.
cards.myth: Sukhe chia seeds khane se wo pet ke andar ka extra paani sokh kar pet andar kar dete hain.
cards.reality: Sukhe chia seeds gale (esophagus) mein hi phool kar atak sakte hain—bhigo kar peena hi safe aur healthy tarika hai.

cards.title: Sabja (Tukmaria) vs Chia Seeds: Dono Ek Nahi Hain! Falooda wale Beej ka Asli Vigyan
cards.hook: Mehenge Chia Seeds ke naam par bazaar mein saste kaale Sabja (Tukmaria) bech diye jaate hain—dono phoolte bilkul ek jaise hain, par unmein farq aur pehchan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Sabja seeds aur Chia seeds ek hi paudhe ke do naam hain.
cards.myth: Sabja sirf desi naam hai, angrezi mein use hi Chia Seeds kehte hain.
cards.reality: Sabja (Sweet Basil seeds) aur Chia (*Salvia hispanica*) bilkul alag paudhe hain, alag rang ke hote hain aur alag time mein phoolte hain.

cards.title: Sabut Alsi (Flaxseed) Bina Peese Khane se 0% Fayda Kyun? Sakht Chhilke ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Log roz 1 chammach sabut bhuni Alsi chammach se nigal lete hain—par doctors kehte hain sabut alsi bina pache potty mein waise hi bahar nikal jaati hai! Asli tarika kya hai?
cards.illusion: Sabut Alsi ya chammach se bhuni alsi nigal lene se saara Omega-3 aur fibre sharir ko mil jaata hai.
cards.myth: Sabut bhuni alsi chaba kar ya nigal kar khane se wahi fayda milta hai jo pisi hui alsi se.
cards.reality: Sabut alsi ke zayadatar daane bina toote pet se bahar nikal jaate hain—Omega-3 aur lignans pane ke liye usse pees kar khana zaroori hai.

cards.title: Danedaar (Grainy) Ghee hi Asli Hota Hai? Nahi! Ye Sirf Thanda Hone ki Speed ka Physics Hai!
cards.hook: Bazaar mein log sookhe chikne ghee ko nakli aur bade danon wale 'Danedaar Ghee' ko 100% shuddh maante hain—par factory mein nakli ghee ko bhi danedaar kaise bana diya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Agar ghee mein bade-bade dane (granules) dikh rahe hain, to wo 100% shuddh bilona desi ghee hai; chikna ghee nakli hai.
cards.myth: Bina danon wala chikna ghee nakli hota hai aur danedaar ghee hamesha 100% shuddh desi ghee hota hai.
cards.reality: Danedaar texture sirf cooling temperature ki speed se banta hai—shuddh ghee fast cooling par chikna jamta hai aur nakli vanaspati slow cooling par danedaar ban sakta hai!

cards.title: ₹3,000/Litre 'A2 Ghee' ka Sach: Ghee mein toh Protein Hota hi Nahi, Fir A1/A2 Kya Hai?
cards.hook: Desi gai ka ₹2,500–₹3,500 litre 'A2 Bilona Ghee' normal ₹700 wale ghee se 4 guna mehenga bik raha hai—par jab ghee mein 99.8% sirf Fat aur 0% Protein hota hai, to A1/A2 protein ghee mein kahan se aaya?
cards.illusion: A2 Ghee mein A2 protein hota hai jo normal ghee ke A1 protein se sharir ko bachata hai.
cards.myth: Normal ₹700 wala shuddh ghee dil ke liye kharab hai aur ₹3,500 wala A2 Ghee khane se cholesterol nahi badhta.
cards.reality: Dono ghee mein lagbhag ek hi tarah ka milk saturated fat (~60–65%) aur cholesterol hota hai—dono ko limit (1–2 tsp/day) mein hi khana chahiye.

cards.title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil mein Poori-Paratha Talna Galat Kyun? Pomace Olive Oil ka Asli Raaz!
cards.hook: Mehenga ₹1,200/litre Extra Virgin Olive Oil lekar log usmein tadka aur poori-pakode talne lagte hain—par wo tez aanch par dhuan kyun chhodta hai, aur 'Olive Pomace Oil' kya bacha hua kachra hota hai?
cards.illusion: Olive oil duniya ka sabse healthy tel hai isliye har Indian sabzi aur deep-frying isi mein karni chahiye.
cards.myth: Olive Pomace Oil sirf sasta Olive Oil hai jismein Extra Virgin jitne hi fayde hote hain.
cards.reality: Pomace oil olives ke bache hue chhilke-guthli se chemical solvent se nikala aur refine kiya tel hai—usmein EVOO ke polyphenols nahi hote.

cards.title: Kachchi Ghani / Wood-Pressed Oil vs Refined Oil: Hexane, Bleaching aur 'Oil Rotation' ka Sach!
cards.hook: Bina jhaag aur bina khushbu wala chamakdaar Refined Oil healthy hai ya gaadha peela Kachchi Ghani (Cold-Pressed) Tel? Aur sirf ek hi tel saal bhar khana galat kyun?
cards.illusion: Refined oil bilkul paani jaisa saaf aur bina smell ka hota hai isliye dil ke liye sabse shuddh hai.
cards.myth: Double/Triple Refined oil sabse zyada clean aur heart-healthy hota hai kyunki usmein koi smell nahi hoti.
cards.reality: Heavy chemical refining Vitamin E aur natural antioxidants hata deti hai—minimally processed Cold-Pressed (Kachchi Ghani) oils + Oil Rotation kahin zyada healthy hai.

cards.title: Sardiyon mein Nariyal Tel (Coconut Oil) Jamna: Purity Test ka Sach aur Milawat Kaise Pakdein!
cards.hook: Thand aate hi Nariyal tel ki bottle mom jaisi jam jaati hai aur log usse nikal nahi paate—kya thand mein jamne wala har nariyal tel 100% pure hota hai, ya milawat mein bhi jamta hai?
cards.illusion: Agar nariyal tel sardiyon mein ya fridge mein jam jaaye to wo 100% shuddh hai, aur na jame to nakli hai.
cards.myth: Sardiyon mein jamne wala nariyal tel kharab ho gaya hai ya usmein dalda mila hua hai.
cards.reality: Pure coconut oil 24°C se neeche naturally jam jaata hai—yahi iske shuddh lauric-acid structure ki nishani hai (aur garm karne par bina kisi badlav ke pighal jaata hai).

cards.title: Til ka Tel (Sesame Oil) aur Mungfali Tel: Sabzi Jaldi Kharab Kyun Nahi Hoti? (Sesamol Science)
cards.hook: Desi achar aur South Indian chutney mahino tak bina fridge ke kaise tik jaati hai—Til aur Mungfali ke tel mein aisa kaun sa natural antioxidant hota hai?
cards.illusion: Til ka tel bahut garm taseer ka aur bhari hota hai, isliye garmi mein khana aur achar pakane mein sirf refined tel use karna chahiye.
cards.myth: Til ka tel sirf sardiyon mein malish ya pooja ke diye jalane ke liye hota hai, khane ke liye nahi.
cards.reality: South aur West India mein sadiyon se Cold-Pressed Til Oil aur Groundnut Oil sabse healthy cooking aur pickle oils rahe hain.

cards.title: Air Fryer: Samosa-Fries Sachmuch 80% Kam Tel mein Healthy Bante Hain ya High-Heat Acrylamide Risk Hai?
cards.hook: Air Fryer mein sirf 1 chammach tel lagakar crispy aloo fries aur samosa ban jaate hain—par kya bina tel ke 200°C garam hawa mein aloo bhunne se koi alag chemical banta hai?
cards.illusion: Air Fryer ek magic machine hai jismein kuch bhi daal kar 200°C par roz khana 100% healthy aur zero-risk hota hai.
cards.myth: Air Fryer microwave/nuclear radiation se khana pakata hai jisse cancer hota hai.
cards.reality: Air Fryer mein koi radiation nahi hoti—ye sirf ek heating coil aur pankhe (hot air convection) se kaam karta hai, bilkul tandoor ya OTG oven ki tarah!

cards.title: Jali Hui Kaali Roti, Toast aur Gas par Direct Seki Roti: Kaala Hissa Khana Kyun Galat Hai?
cards.hook: Agar roti ya bread toast thoda sa jal kar kaala ho gaya hai, to hum usse phenkne ke bajaye kha lete hain—par jale hue kaale hisse mein kaun se chemicals ban jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Thodi si jali hui kaali roti ya crispy kaala toast khane se pet theek rehta hai aur gas kam banti hai.
cards.myth: Jali hui kaali roti khane se pet ka dard aur gas theek ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Burnt food mein charcoal-jaisa kadwapan aur Acrylamide/PAHs hote hain—ye gas theek karne ke bajaye pet aur sehat ko nuksan pahunchate hain.

cards.title: Imli (Tamarind) aur Tartaric Acid: Street Chatni mein Asli Imli hai ya Sasti 'Taatri' + Powder?
cards.hook: Golgappe aur chaat ki meethi-khatti chatni mein ₹150 kilo imli ke bajaye sasti 'Taatri' aur chhuara powder milaya jaata hai—asli imli ki pehchan aur metal-bowl danger kya hai?
cards.illusion: Har khatti-meethi laal chaat chatni asli pakki imli ko bhigo kar hi banayi jaati hai.
cards.myth: Imli khane se khoon paani ho jaata hai ya haddiyan gal jaati hain.
cards.reality: Limit mein asli imli khane se khoon paani nahi hota—ye sirf natural digestive spice hai; haan zyada taatri (acid) aur namak daant aur BP ke liye bura hota hai.

cards.title: Kachcha Tamatar Salad vs Paka Tamatar (Gravy/Soup): Pakane par 'Lycopene' 3 Guna Kaise Badh Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki har sabzi kachchi khane par zyada vitamin deti hai—par Tamatar (Tomato) ko thode tel ke sath pakane par uska dil-rakshak Lycopene 3 guna zyada kaise lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Tamatar hamesha kachcha salad mein khane par hi sabse zyada fayda deta hai; pakane par sab vitamins mar jaate hain.
cards.myth: Tamatar ko gas par pakane se uske saare fayde aur vitamins khatam ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Vitamin C kam hota hai, par tamatar ka sabse powerful heart/antioxidant tatva **Lycopene** pakane aur thode tel ke sath **3 guna zyada absorb** hota hai!

cards.title: Palak ki Sabzi Baar-Baar Garam Karna aur Palak + Paneer Myth: Kya Palak se Calcium-Iron Nahi Milta?
cards.hook: Viral forwards mein kehte hain ki 'Palak Paneer ek sath mat khao, calcium-iron lad jaate hain' aur 'Palak ko dobara garam karne se zeher banta hai'—asli food chemistry kya kehti hai?
cards.illusion: Palak mein sabse zyada iron hota hai (Popeye ki tarah!) aur Palak Paneer khana health ke liye bilkul bekaar hai.
cards.myth: Palak aur Paneer ek sath khane se sharir ko 0% fayda hota hai aur wo zeher ban jaata hai.
cards.reality: Bilkul galat—Protein, Folate, Vitamin A/K sab milta hai; sirf calcium absorption thoda kam hota hai jo kidney stone risk wale logon ke liye ulta faydemand hota hai!

cards.title: Button Mushroom ko 30 Min Dhoop mein Rakhne se Vitamin D 100 Guna Kaise Badh Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Vegetarians mein Vitamin D ki sabse zyada kami hoti hai kyunki paudhon mein Vitamin D nahi hota—par bazaar ke ₹50 ke Mushroom ko sirf 30 minute dhoop mein rakhne se kya jaadu hota hai?
cards.illusion: Mushroom mein pehle se hi bharpoor Vitamin D hota hai, aur mushroom ko kabhi paani se nahi dhona chahiye.
cards.myth: Har supermarket mushroom mein pehle se hi bahut saara Vitamin D hota hai.
cards.reality: Andhere mein uge white button mushrooms mein lagbhag 0 Vitamin D hota hai—jab tak unhe UV/dhoop na mile!

cards.title: Gobhi aur Broccoli ke Andar Chhupe Hara-Safed Keede aur Pesticides: Garam Namak-Haldi Paani ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Phoolgobhi aur Broccoli dikhne mein bilkul saaf lagti hai—par tukde kaatne ke baad jab garam namak wale paani mein daalte hain to andar se keede tair kar upar kaise aa jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Phoolgobhi ko bas upar se nalke ke paani se 1 baar dho kar kaat lena kaafi hai.
cards.myth: Ubalte khaulte paani mein gobhi 10 minute daal kar rakhne se hi keede marte hain.
cards.reality: Zyada ubalte paani mein daalne par keeda mar kar phool ke andar hi phansa reh jaata hai aur gobhi pichak jaati hai! Halka gunguna (warm, not boiling) namkeen paani keede ko zinda bahar nikal kar taira deta hai!

cards.title: Angoor, Seb aur Strawberry se Pesticides Hatane ka Asli Vigyan: Sirf Paani vs Baking Soda Soak!
cards.hook: Angoor aur seb ke upar safed-neele dhabbe aur chipchipa pesticide residue laga hota hai—lab tests ke mutabik seb-angoor ko sirf paani se dhone ke muqable 1 chammach Baking Soda kaise 90% pesticide hata deta hai?
cards.illusion: Nalke ke neeche 10 second paani se dho lene ya 'Veggie Wash' kharidne se phal ke saare pesticides hat jaate hain.
cards.myth: Fruits ko bartan-sabun ya antiseptic liquid ki 2 boond daal kar dhona zyada safe hai.
cards.reality: KABHI BHI fruit/sabzi par sabun, antiseptic liquid ya bleach na lagayein—porous skin sabun sokh leti hai jo pet ke liye toxic hai! Sirf Baking Soda + clean water ya plain vinegar water safe hai.

cards.title: Kela (Banana) Fridge mein Rakhne par Chhilka Kaala Kyun Padta Hai? (Chilling Injury vs Ethylene)
cards.hook: Garmiyon mein kela jaldi gal na jaaye isliye hum usse Fridge mein rakh dete hain—par agle din poora chhilka koyla jaisa kaala pad jaata hai! Kya andar ka kela kharab ho gaya hai?
cards.illusion: Fridge mein rakhne se kela kaala ho gaya hai matlab wo andar se sad gaya aur kharab ho gaya hai.
cards.myth: Kaale chhilke wala kela zeherila ya sada hua hota hai, kabhi nahi khana chahiye.
cards.reality: Agar kela fridge ki thand ya natural ripening se kaala pada hai aur andar se safed-sakht hai, to wo bilkul safe aur antioxidants se bharpoor hota hai!

cards.title: Aloo, Pyaz aur Tamatar ko Fridge mein Kyun Nahi Rakhna Chahiye? (Cold-Induced Sweetening)
cards.hook: Kachche Aloo fridge mein rakhne par sabzi itni meethi aur chipchipi kyun banti hai, aur Tamatar fridge mein jaate hi apna swad aur khushbu kyun kho deta hai?
cards.illusion: Har sabzi fridge mein rakhne par zyada taazi aur lambe samay tak chalti hai.
cards.myth: Garmiyon mein sabhi aloo-pyaz-tamatar fridge mein rakhne se 1 mahine tak bilkul fresh rehte hain.
cards.reality: Aloo fridge mein meetha aur high-acrylamide ho jaata hai, pyaz fridge ki nami mein pilpila hokar phaphoondi pakadta hai, aur tamatar apna flavour kho deta hai.

cards.title: Ankurit Hara Lehsun (Sprouted Garlic) Khana Safe Hai ya Zeher? (Aloo vs Lehsun ka Farq!)
cards.hook: Aloo mein hara ankur nikalne par hum use kaat kar phenk dete hain—par Lehsun (Garlic) ki kaliyon ke beech se hara patta nikal aaye to kya wo bhi zeherila ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Aloo ki tarah Lehsun aur Pyaz mein bhi hara ankur nikal aaye to usmein Solanine zeher ban jaata hai.
cards.myth: Har ankurit sabzi (Aloo, Pyaz, Lehsun) mein ek hi tarah ka zeher ban jaata hai.
cards.reality: Solanine zeher sirf Aloo (aur tamatar/baingan parivar) se juda hai—ankurit Lehsun aur Pyaz bilkul safe aur antioxidant-rich hote hain.

cards.title: Thodi Phaphoondi Laga Adrak ya Nimbu Kaat Kar Khana: Chhupi Hui 'Mold Roots' ka Sach!
cards.hook: Chai banate waqt adrak ke ek kone par safed-hari phaphoondi dikhi to hum utna kona chaaku se kaat kar baaki adrak chai mein koot dete hain—kya usse phaphoondi hat jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Phal ya adrak ka sirf upari kharab hissa chaaku se kaat dene par baaki hissa bilkul saaf aur safe rehta hai.
cards.myth: Phaphoondi wale adrak ya tamatar ko 5 minute chai/sabzi mein ubaal dene se sab safe ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Ubalne se live fungus mar sakti hai, par uske banaye Mycotoxins (zeherile compounds) garmi mein bhi nahi toot-te.

cards.title: Bread ke Ek Slice par Hari Phaphoondi: Baaki Saaf Slices Khane Kyun Khatarnak Hain?
cards.hook: Bread ke packet mein aakhri 2 slices par hari-safed phaphoondi dikhi, par upar ke 4 slices bilkul saaf dikh rahe hain—unhe toast karke khane mein kya khatra hai?
cards.illusion: Jis slice par phaphoondi lagi hai sirf usse phenk do, baaki saaf dikhne wale slices toast karke khana 100% safe hai.
cards.myth: Bread ko gas ya toaster mein tez sek dene se saaf slices par chhupi phaphoondi aur toxins khatam ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Porous bread ke andar phaphoondi ke spores aur heat-stable mycotoxins fail chuke hote hain—toaster unhe safe nahi bana sakta.

cards.title: Mixed Fruit Jam ka Asli Sach: Phal Sirf 35%–45%, Baaki 65% Cheeni aur Pectin Gel!
cards.hook: Subah bachche ko bread par 'Mixed Fruit Jam' lagakar tiffin mein dene par maa ko lagta hai usne phal khaye—par jam ki bottle mein 65% se zyada sirf Cheeni kaise hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Fruit Jam taaze phalon ko pees kar banta hai, isliye ye phal khane ka ek accha aur meetha tarika hai.
cards.myth: Mixed Fruit Jam khane se bacchon ko roz ke phalon ka nutrition mil jaata hai.
cards.reality: High-heat boiling aur 65%+ cheeni ki wajah se jam ek sugary dessert spread hai, taaze phal ka replacement bilkul nahi.

cards.title: Sasti Chocolates & Bakery Cakes ka 'Compound Chocolate': Cocoa Butter Nahi, Palm Oil + Cheeni!
cards.hook: ₹10 wali chocolate aur ₹300 wale bakery cake par lagi chocolate muh mein rakhte hi makkhan ki tarah pighalne ke bajaye talu (roof of mouth) par chipchipi kyun lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Har bhoore rang ki chocolate bar aur cake ki chocolate icing asli Cocoa aur Cocoa Butter se banti hai.
cards.myth: Har dark brown cake aur chocolate slab 'Dark Chocolate' hoti hai jo dil ke liye healthy hai.
cards.reality: Bakery aur saste dark compounds mein sirf palm oil, cheeni aur dark cocoa powder hota hai—heart-healthy polyphenols sirf asli 70%+ Cocoa-Butter Dark Chocolate mein hote hain.

cards.title: Bakery Bread aur Pav ko Phulane Wale Chemicals: 'Potassium Bromate' Ban ke Baad Ab Kya Milta Hai?
cards.hook: 2016 mein CSE ki report ne bataya tha ki Bharat ki 84% breads mein cancer-causing 'Potassium Bromate' mila hai—ab wo ban ho gaya hai, par sasti bakery bread mein ab kaun se improvers padte hain?
cards.illusion: Bazaar ki soft safed bread aur pav sirf aata, paani, namak aur yeast se bante hain.
cards.myth: Bazaar ki ruyi jaisi naram white/brown bread bilkul ghar ki roti jaisi hi natural hoti hai.
cards.reality: Commercial bread mein maida, dough conditioners, emulsifiers, sugar aur preservatives (E282) hote hain taaki wo hafton naram rahe.

cards.title: Koyle par Bhuna Tandoori Tikka / BBQ: Jale Tel ke Dhuen mein 'PAHs' aur Surakshit Marinate Trick!
cards.hook: Koyle ke tandoor par paneer tikka ya chicken pakte waqt jab tel-makkhan koylon par tapakta hai, to jo dhuan uth kar khane mein lagta hai usmein kya banta hai?
cards.illusion: Tandoori aur BBQ khana toh oil-free aur roasted hota hai, isliye usse chahe jitna jala kar khayein 100% healthy hota hai.
cards.myth: Restaurant mein 'Dhungar' (jalte koyle par ghee daal kar dhuan band karna) roz dal-sabzi mein karne se sehat badhti hai.
cards.reality: Jalte koyle par ghee tapkane se nikle dhuen mein PAHs hote hain—kabhi-kabhar festival dish mein chal sakta hai par rozana koyle ka dhuan khane mein dena achcha nahi hai.

cards.title: Rajma ka Bhigoya Paani Phenkna Kyun Zaroori Hai? Kachche Rajma mein 'Lectin' Zeher ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki Rajma bhigone ke baad uska laal-bhoora paani phenkne se saare vitamins beh jaate hain—par agar bina ubaale adhpaka rajma ya wahi paani pi lein to 2 ghante mein bhayankar ulti kyun hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Rajma bhigone wale paani mein saare minerals nikal aate hain, isliye usi paani mein slow cooker par pakana sabse healthy hai.
cards.myth: Rajma bhigone wale paani mein saare vitamins hote hain isliye usi paani mein sabzi banani chahiye.
cards.reality: Soaking water mein gas karne wale oligosaccharides, phytic acid aur trace lectins nikalte hain—us paani ko phenk kar naye paani mein ubaalna hi healthy aur gas-free tarika hai!

cards.title: Market ka ₹300/Litre 'Almond Milk' (Badam Milk): 95% Paani, Sirf 2% Badam + Cheeni aur Gums!
cards.hook: Lactose intolerance ya fancy diet ke naam par log ₹280–₹350 litre ka Almond Milk le aate hain—par packet ke peeche dekhne par usmein sirf 2%–3% Badam aur 0.5g Protein kaise nikalta hai?
cards.illusion: ₹300 litre wale Almond Milk mein gaye ke doodh se zyada badam ki taakat aur protein hota hai.
cards.myth: Almond Milk gaye ke doodh se zyada protein aur taakat deta hai.
cards.reality: Commercial Almond Milk mein 1 glass mein sirf ~1g protein hota hai (gaye ke doodh aur soya milk mein 7–8g protein hota hai!).

cards.title: Mitti ki Handi (Kulhad) mein Dahi Itna Gaadha, Malai-daar aur Meetha Kyun Jamta Hai?
cards.hook: Halwai ki mitti ki kundi mein jama dahi itna sakht ki chamach khada ho jaaye aur khatta bhi kam—steel ke patile ke muqable mitti ke bartan mein kaun sa science kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Halwai dahi mein koi secret chemical ya cornstarch dalte hain isliye unka dahi itna gaadha aur meetha jamta hai.
cards.myth: Mitti ki handi ko roz dishwash liquid se ragad kar dhona chahiye warna wo gandi rehti hai.
cards.reality: Porous mitti sabun ke chemicals ko andar sokh leti hai—garam paani, baking soda aur dhoop (UV sterilization) mitti ko saaf karne ka sabse safe tarika hai.

cards.title: Aate-Chawal mein Ghun/Keede Rokne ke Liye Boric Powder ya Parad Goli Daalna: Zeher ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Saal bhar ka gehu-chawal store karte waqt log usmein keede rokne ke liye 'Parad ki Goli (Mercury tablet)' ya 'Boric Powder' mila dete hain—par dhone ke baad bhi ye kitna khatarnak hai?
cards.illusion: Chawal-gehu mein Parad ki goli ya Boric acid daal kar pakane se pehle dho lene par keede bhi nahi lagte aur 0% nuksan hota hai.
cards.myth: Chawal mein Boric Powder ya Parad Goli rakh kar pakane se pehle 3 baar dho lene se 100% nikal jaata hai.
cards.reality: Daanon ke microscopic pores mein chemicals sama jaate hain aur galti se toot kar daane mein chipka tukda jaanlewa ho sakta hai—kabhi use na karein!

cards.title: Bori wale Safed Chawal par Talcum / Boric Polish ka Dhokha: Paani mein Chawal Ragadne ka Test
cards.hook: Bazaar ka sasta bori wala chawal itna safed aur chikna chamak raha hai—par pehli baar dhote hi paani bilkul chalk-jaisa safed aur phislan wala kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Chawal jitna zyada safed aur chikna dikhega, wo utna hi achchi quality ka aur saaf hoga.
cards.myth: Chawal dhone par safed paani nikalne ka matlab hamesha powder milawat hota hai.
cards.reality: Halka doodhiya paani chawal ke apne natural starch se aata hai—milawat tab hoti hai jab upar tel ki boondein tairein ya chalk/boric ki bhari safed parat jame.

cards.title: Arhar (Toor) Dal par Peeli Chamak: 'Unpolished Dal' vs Marble Powder, Tel aur Metanil Yellow!
cards.hook: Supermarket mein ek hi Arhar Dal ke do packet rakhe hain—ek 'Unpolished' (dull peeli, ₹150/kg) aur ek chamakdaar shiny peeli (₹140/kg)! Shiny dal par kya lagaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Chamakdaar sunehri peeli Arhar Dal sabse best aur taazi quality ki hoti hai.
cards.myth: Jitni chamakdaar aur ek-saman neon peeli dal hogi, wo utni hi shuddh aur jaldi galne wali hogi.
cards.reality: Dull natural rang wali Unpolished Dal hi asli aur bina-chemical wali hoti hai—neon peeli aur shiny dal par oil, soapstone ya dye polish hoti hai.

cards.title: Hari Moong aur Kaali Urad Dal par Hara-Kaala Rang aur Machine Oil Polish Kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Bazaar ki sabut hari moong aur kaali urad ko bhigone par paani bilkul hara ya kaala kyun ho jaata hai—kya ye natural rang hai ya oil + textile dye?
cards.illusion: Hari moong aur kaali urad dhone par thoda hara-kaala paani chhodna natural hai.
cards.myth: Kaali urad mein kaala rang natural hota hai isliye dhone par 4 baar tak kaala paani nikalna normal hai.
cards.reality: Unpolished asli kaali urad ka chhilka halka dull/greyish-black hota hai aur 1–2 wash mein paani saaf ho jaata hai—ink jaisa kaala ya neon hara rang dye ki nishani hai.

cards.title: Desi Chana Sattu mein Sasta Makka/Matar Milawat: Ghar ka Desi Protein Drink vs Packet Scam
cards.hook: Garmi mein taakat aur cooling ke liye hum ₹120/kg wala chana sattu pite hain—par saste sattu mein makke aur kachche aate ki milawat aur sattu peene ka sahi vigyan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Bazaar mein bikne wala har bhoora Sattu 100% bhune hue chane se hi peesa jaata hai.
cards.myth: Sattu peene se wajan kam hota hai isliye din mein 4 glass meetha/ghee wala sattu pina chahiye.
cards.reality: 100g sattu mein ~380–400 calories hoti hain—2–3 tbsp namkeen nimbu-sattu healthy aur filling hai, par zyada gud/ghee ke sath peene par calories badh jaati hain.

cards.title: Makhana ka Asli Vigyan: Ghar ka Dry-Roasted Makhana vs ₹80 wala Packet 'Flavoured Makhana'!
cards.hook: Popcorn chhod kar log ₹80–₹120 wala 'Peri-Peri / Cheese Makhana' packet khane lage—par kya packet wala makhana palm oil aur flavour powder mein bhara hota hai?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par 'Roasted Makhana' likha hai isliye har packet makhana bilkul zero-oil aur super healthy hai.
cards.myth: Makhane mein doodh se 4 guna zyada calcium hota hai aur har packet makhana oil-free hota hai.
cards.reality: Plain makhana mein calcium kam (~50–60 mg/100g, aur 1 serving 30g mein sirf ~18 mg) hota hai—ye ek shandar low-fat fibre snack hai, aur packaged flavoured versions mein 15–25% oil hota hai!

cards.title: Microwave Bag Popcorn (Act II Bag) vs Kadhai ke Makke: Kagaz ke Bag mein PFAS & Diacetyl ka Sach!
cards.hook: 3 minute mein microwave mein phoolne wala 'Butter Popcorn' kagaz ke bag mein aata hai—par us bag ki grease-proof lining aur nakli makkhan ki khushbu mein kaun se chemicals hote hain?
cards.illusion: Popcorn toh makka hai, isliye microwave bag mein 3 minute mein bana butter popcorn ghar ka sabse healthy snack hai.
cards.myth: Act II / Microwave bag popcorn sirf makka aur asli makkhan se banta hai.
cards.reality: Instant pouches mein palmolein/hydrogenated vegetable oil, artificial butter flavour aur high sodium hota hai—dry makke ghar par bhunna 100% pure aur 6 guna sasta hai.

cards.title: Doodh Jaisa Safed Murmura (Layi): Urea aur Hydros Bleach se Safedi ka Khatarnak Dhokha!
cards.hook: Bhel-puri aur laddoo mein istemal hone wala murmura (kheel/layi) kuch dukaanon par paper jaisa safed aur bada phoola hota hai—kya use phulane ke liye namak ki jagah Urea milaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Murmura jitna zyada doodh jaisa safed aur bada phoola hoga, wo utni hi achi quality ke chawal se bana hoga.
cards.myth: Jitna zyada safed murmura hota hai, wo utna hi saaf aur achche basmati chawal se bana hota hai.
cards.reality: Pure chawal bhunne par hamesha halka cream/off-white hota hai—paper-white chamak aksar bleaching ya urea treatment ki nishani ho sakti hai.

cards.title: Suji (Rava) aur Maida Ek hi Gehu ke Andar se Nikalte Hain? Fibre aur Blood Sugar ka Asli Farq!
cards.hook: Log Maide se bahut darte hain par roz Suji (Rava) ka halwa, upma aur idli shauk se khate hain—par kya aap jaanti hain ki Suji bhi gehu ke usi safed andarooni hisse se banti hai jisse Maida banta hai?
cards.illusion: Maida bilkul zeher hai aur aanton mein chipak jaata hai, jabki Suji/Rava bilkul Whole Wheat Atta jaisi high-fibre hoti hai.
cards.myth: Maida aanton (intestines) ki deewar par glue ki tarah chipak jaata hai aur wahan mahino sadta rehta hai.
cards.reality: Maida koi glue nahi balki fast-digesting starch hai—pet ke enzymes usse 2 ghante mein poori tarah glucose bana kar pacha lete hain (fibre na hone ki wajah se sirf kabz aur sugar spike hota hai).

cards.title: Vrat ka Sabudana: Ped par Nahi Ugta, Tapioca (Shakarkand jaisi Jad) ke Pure Starch se Banta Hai!
cards.hook: Navratri vrat mein log 'halka aur taakatwar' samajh kar Sabudana khichdi aur kheer khate hain—par kya aapko pata hai ki 100g Sabudane mein 88g sirf pure Starch (Carbs) aur lagbhag 0% Protein hota hai?
cards.illusion: Sabudana koi natural daana/anaj (grain) hai jo protein aur vitamins se bharpoor hota hai.
cards.myth: Sabudana chote safed daane hain isliye wo high-protein aur weight loss ke liye perfect hain.
cards.reality: Sabudana 88%–90% pure carbohydrate starch hai (protein sirf ~0.2g per 100g!)—ye instant energy ke liye hai, weight loss ya diabetes ke liye nahi.

cards.title: Navratri mein Kuttu / Singhara Aata se Food Poisoning Kyun Hoti Hai? Purane Aate mein Fungus ka Sach!
cards.hook: Har saal Navratri ke pehle 2 din mein hi hospital mein Kuttu ke aate se ulti-dast ke hazaaron cases kyun aate hain—kya Kuttu khud zeherila hai ya pichle saal ka purana aata?
cards.illusion: Kuttu ka aata bahut garam taseer ka hota hai isliye usse pakode khane par pet kharab ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Kuttu ka aata kudrati taur par zeherila ya bahut garm hota hai isliye har kisi ko ulti hoti hai.
cards.reality: Taaza Kuttu aata 100% safe aur heart-healthy superfood hai—food poisoning pichle saal ke store kiye gaye fungus-lage purane aate ki wajah se hoti hai!

cards.title: Bazaar ka Ready-Made Idli/Dosa Batter: Natural Khamir (Probiotics) hai ya Baking Soda ka Jadoo?
cards.hook: Subah 10 minute mein idli banane ke liye hum ₹80 ka ready-made Idli Batter pouch le aate hain—par usmein ghar jaisa probiotic fermentation hota hai ya sirf soda aur preservative?
cards.illusion: Supermarket ke packet wala Idli-Dosa batter bilkul ghar par overnight ferment kiye gaye batter jaisa hi healthy hota hai.
cards.myth: Har supermarket Idli-Dosa batter bilkul ek jaisa naturally fermented aur chemical-free hota hai.
cards.reality: Saste ya long-shelf-life batters mein preservatives, acidulants ya baking soda ho sakta hai—refrigerated clean-ingredient label check karna zaroori hai.

cards.title: Desi Kanji aur Raat ka Bhigoya Chawal (Panta Bhat / Pazhaya Sadam): Ghar ka Free Probiotic Superfood!
cards.hook: ₹100 ki probiotic curd drink ya mehenge gut supplements se zyada taakatwar bacteria humare purvajon ke kaali gajar ki Kanji aur raat ko mitti ki handi mein bhigoye baasi chawal mein kaise hote hain?
cards.illusion: Raat ke bache hue paani-wale chawal (Panta Bhat) ya ghar ki Kanji khana gareebon ka baasi khana hai aur sehat ke liye bekaar hai.
cards.myth: Har tarah ka raat ka chawal zeherila hota hai, chahe wo traditional paani/dahi mein ferment hi kyun na kiya gaya ho.
cards.reality: Sookha bahar rakha baasi chawal *Bacillus cereus* risk rakhta hai, jabki clean submerged water + curd starter fermentation pH kam kar ke safe Lactic Acid Probiotics banata hai (jise sadiyon se poora Bharat khata aaya hai!).

cards.title: Pakke Chawal aur Aloo ko Fridge mein Thanda Kar ke Khane se Blood Sugar Kam Kyun Badhta Hai? (Resistant Starch)
cards.hook: Diabetes wale log chawal aur aloo dekh kar dar jaate hain—par nutritional scientists kehte hain agar pakke chawal ya uble aloo ko 12 ghante fridge mein thanda kar ke phir halka garam kar ke khayein, to wo Fibre jaisa kaam karta hai! Kaise?
cards.illusion: Chawal aur Aloo ko ek baar pakane ke baad thanda karne par uski calories aur sugar bilkul wahi rehti hain.
cards.myth: Fridge mein rakha chawal dobara halka garam karne par uska resistant starch wapas toot jaata hai.
cards.reality: Retrograded Type-3 Resistant Starch ek baar banne ke baad kaafi heat-stable hota hai—halka reheating (steam/microwave) karne par bhi wo barkarar rehta hai!

cards.title: Sabzi ko Dher Saare Paani mein Ubaal kar Paani Phenkna: 50% Vitamins Sink mein Beh Jaate Hain!
cards.hook: Broccoli, gajar, palak aur matar ko khoob paani mein ubaal kar chhanne ke baad jab aap wo hara/peela paani sink mein phenk deti hain, to sabzi mein bachta kya hai?
cards.illusion: Sabzi ubaalne se sirf gandagi nikal kar paani mein jaati hai, sabzi ke saare vitamins sabzi ke andar hi rehte hain.
cards.myth: Microwave mein sabzi pakane se saare vitamins mar jaate hain, jabki gas par paani mein ubaalne se bachte hain.
cards.reality: Microwave mein kam paani aur kam waqt (3 min) lagta hai isliye ulta ubaalne ke muqable 2x zyada Vitamin C aur antioxidants bachte hain!

cards.title: Chhole-Rajma Jaldi Galane ke Liye 'Meetha Soda (Baking Soda)' Daalna: Swad aur Vitamin B1 ka Sach!
cards.hook: Chhole jaldi gal jaayein aur kaale-mulayam banein isliye log cooker mein 1 chammach Meetha Soda daal dete hain—par ye soda daal ke kaun se vitamins khatam karta hai aur pet par kya asar daalta hai?
cards.illusion: Chhole-rajma mein baking soda dalne se sirf chhilka jaldi galta hai, nutrition par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.myth: Baking soda daalne se chhole-rajma ki gas karne ki taseer khatam ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Gas karne wale oligosaccharides raat bhar paani mein bhigokar wo paani phenkne se nikalte hain—baking soda sirf chhilke ko naram kar ke Vitamin B1 ko khatam karta hai!

cards.title: Ek hi Chai ko Baar-Baar Ubaalna (Tapri Wali Kadak Chai): Acidity, Kadwahat aur Caffeine ka Sach!
cards.hook: Subah ki bachi chai ko dopahar mein dobara gas par garam karke peena ya tapri par ek hi patile mein 2 ghante se ubal rahi chai peene se pet mein turant jalan aur acidity kyun hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Chai ko jitna zyada der tak ubaal kar kadak banayenge, utni hi swadisht aur taazgi dene wali hogi.
cards.myth: Chai ko 15 minute dhimi aanch par kadhane se uske saare healthy tatva aur taste badhta hai.
cards.reality: 2–3 minute ke baad sirf kadwe tannins aur acidity badhane wale compounds nikalte hain, fayde wale antioxidants nahi!

cards.title: Shaam 5 Baje ki Coffee Raat 11 Baje ki Neend Kaise Udati Hai? (Caffeine ki 6-Ghante Half-Life)
cards.hook: Raat ko 11 baje bistar par karwatein badalte hue aapko lagta hai din bhar ki thakan hai—par kya aap jaanti hain ki shaam 5 baje pi hui 1 cup coffee ka aadha Caffeine raat 11 baje bhi aapke dimaag mein zinda ghum raha hai?
cards.illusion: Coffee peene ke 1–2 ghante baad uska nasha utar jaata hai, shaam ki coffee se raat ki neend par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.myth: Mujhe toh raat ko coffee peene ke baad bhi neend aa jaati hai, isliye caffeine meri neend kharab nahi karta.
cards.reality: Aap so zaroor jaate hain, par EEG brain scans dikhate hain ki caffeine gehri restorative (Deep NREM) sleep ko kam kar deta hai—jisse subah fresh feel nahi hota.

cards.title: Khane ke Beech Thoda Paani Peene se 'Jatharagni' Bujhti Hai? Pet ke Acid ka Asli Vigyan!
cards.hook: Viral forwards mein kehte hain 'Khane ke beech 1 ghoont paani bhi zeher hai, pet ka tezaab patla ho jaata hai'—jabki doctors kehte hain thoda paani hazma aasaan karta hai! Asli science kya hai?
cards.illusion: Khane ke sath ya turant baad 1 ghoont paani bhi pi lene se pet ka acid kamzor pad kar khana sada deta hai.
cards.myth: Khane ke beech ya turant baad ek ghoont paani peene se bhi pet ka acid khatam hokar khana sadne lagta hai.
cards.reality: Mayo Clinic ke mutabik pet khane ke hisab se turant naya acid aur digestive juices banata hai—thoda paani khane ko todne aur hazam karne mein madad hi karta hai!

cards.title: Subah Garam Paani + Nimbu + Shahad: Pet ki Charbi Pighalti Hai ya Sirf Acidity & Sugar?
cards.hook: Wajan kam karne ke liye karodon log subah khaali pet garam paani mein nimbu aur 2 chammach shahad pee rahe hain—par shahad khud meethi calories hai aur charbi pighlane mein iska kitna sach hai?
cards.illusion: Subah khaali pet garam nimbu-shahad paani peene se sharir ki jami charbi (belly fat) pighal kar peshab se nikal jaati hai.
cards.myth: Garam nimbu-shahad paani peene se 1 mahine mein bina diet/exercise ke pet ki charbi pighal jaati hai.
cards.reality: Fat loss sirf total calorie deficit, protein aur physical activity se hota hai—shahad khud ek high-calorie sugar hai jo charbi nahi pighlata.

cards.title: Ubalte Garam Paani ya Chai mein Shahad (Honey) Daalna: Kya Wo Zeher Ban Jaata Hai? (HMF Science)
cards.hook: Ayurveda mein kehte hain ki 'Garam kiye hue shahad mein zeher banta hai'—kya ubalte paani, baking ya garam doodh mein shahad dalne par koi chemical sachmuch banta hai?
cards.illusion: Ya toh shahad 100°C par jaate hi jaanlewa zeher ban jaata hai, ya fir cheeni ki tarah ubalte chai-cake mein aaram se paka sakte hain.
cards.myth: Ubalte paani mein shahad daal dene par wo turant cyanide jaisa jaanlewa zeher ban jaata hai.
cards.reality: Wo turant marne wala zeher nahi banta, par shahad ke saare beneficial enzymes mar jaate hain aur HMF chemical tezi se badh jaata hai—isliye gungune mein milana hi scientific hai.

cards.title: Apple Cider Vinegar (ACV) Shots: Bina Paani Milaye Peene se Daant ka Enamel aur Gala Jalna!
cards.hook: Social media influencers subah 1 shot seedha Apple Cider Vinegar (ACV) gatak kar dikhate hain—par dentists kehte hain sirf 2 mahine mein ye daanton ki safed parat (Enamel) ko ghol kar khatam kar sakta hai!
cards.illusion: Seedha 1 chammach Apple Cider Vinegar shot peene se pet aur sugar control mein sabse tez fayda hota hai.
cards.myth: ACV peene ke turant baad daant brush kar lene se acid saaf ho jaata hai aur daant safe rehte hain.
cards.reality: Acid peene ke turant baad enamel naram hota hai—turant brush karne se toothbrush enamel ko ghis kar utaar deta hai! Pehle paani se kulli karein aur 30–60 min baad brush karein.

cards.title: ₹2.5 Lakh ki 'Alkaline Water Machine' (Kangen) ka Sach: Kya Ye Cancer/Sugar Mitati Hai ya Pet ka Acid Ise Turant Badal Deta Hai?
cards.hook: ₹100 ki 'Black Alkaline Water' bottle aur ₹2–3 Lakh ki Ionizer machine bechne wale kehte hain ki ye sharir ko 'Alkaline' bana kar bimariyan khatam karti hai—par hamare pet ka tezaab is paani ke sath 1 second mein kya karta hai?
cards.illusion: 9.5 pH ka Alkaline Water peene se khoon aur sharir alkaline ho jaata hai aur cancer-diabetes jaisi bimariyan nahi hotin.
cards.myth: Alkaline water peene se sharir aur khoon alkaline ho jaata hai jisse cancer cells mar jaati hain.
cards.reality: Medical science mein ye 100% debunked myth hai—pet ka acid alkaline paani ko turant neutralize kar deta hai, aur blood pH sirf lungs aur kidneys control karte hain.

cards.title: Bacchon ka School Tiffin Box: Plastic, Insulated Steel ya Glass — Kaunsa Sabse Safe Hai?
cards.hook: Subah garam-garam paratha-sabzi ya pasta hum colourfull cartoon wale plastic tiffin mein pack kar ke school bhej dete hain—par dopahar tak us plastic se bacche ke khane mein kya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har 'BPA-Free' ya cartoon wala school tiffin box garam khana pack karne ke liye 100% safe hota hai.
cards.myth: Agar tiffin par 'Food-Grade BPA-Free' likha hai to usmein garam oil wali sabzi microwave aur pack karna bilkul risk-free hai.
cards.reality: BPA-free plastics mein BPS/phthalate substitutes ho sakte hain aur garmi + oil + scratches microplastics release tez karte hain—Stainless Steel sabse safe hai!

cards.title: Fridge ke Darwaze mein Doodh aur Ande Rakhna Galat Kyun? Fridge Temperature Zone Vigyan!
cards.hook: Har ghar mein doodh ka bhagona ya packet aur andon ki tray Fridge ke darwaze (Door shelf) mein rakhi jaati hai—par isi wajah se doodh 2 din mein hi kyun phat jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Fridge ke darwaze mein bottle/egg tray bani hi doodh aur ande rakhne ke liye hoti hai, wahan barabar thand rehti hai.
cards.myth: Fridge company ne door mein egg tray aur bottle rack diya hai to doodh aur ande wahin rakhna best hota hai.
cards.reality: Door shelves convenience ke liye banti hain par temperature sabse zyada wahin badalta hai—milk aur eggs andar rakhe jaane par zyada din safe rehte hain!

cards.title: Ek hi Sabzi-Dal ko 3 Baar Garam-Thanda Karna Kyun Galat Hai? 'Ek Katori Rule' ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Fridge se poori dal ka bhagona nikal kar gas par garam karna, 1 katori nikal kar bacha bhagona phir fridge mein rakh dena—baar-baar thanda-garam karne se khana zeherila kyun ban sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Har baar khana poori tarah ubaal kar fridge mein wapas rakh dene se wo 4–5 din tak bilkul safe rehta hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak dal-sabzi ko roz ek baar khoob khaulte hue ubaal dein, wo 1 hafte tak fridge mein bilkul safe rehti hai.
cards.reality: Baar-baar 5°C–60°C ke beech aane-jaane se heat-stable toxins ban sakte hain aur vitamins destroy hote hain—hamesha sirf portion nikaal kar 1 baar garam karein.

cards.title: Frozen Matar ya Ice-Cream par Barf ke Safed Crystals Jamna: Pighla kar Dobara Jamana Kyun Galat?
cards.hook: Bazaar se laayi frozen matar ya ice-cream ke dabbe mein bade-bade barf ke tukde jame hote hain—ye kab bante hain aur pighal chuke frozen food ko wapas freezer mein rakhne se kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Freezer mein rakha saman agar thoda pighal bhi gaya (light jaane ya bahar rakhne se), to wapas freezer mein rakh dene par bilkul pehle jaisa safe ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Frozen packet mein jitne bade barf ke tukde honge, utna hi zyada thanda aur fresh hoga.
cards.reality: Bade barf ke dhelay is baat ka pakka saboot hain ki cold chain toota tha aur samaan beech mein pighal kar dobara jamaya gaya hai!

cards.title: Off-Season Hari Matar aur Frozen Peas mein Hara Rang Milawat: 1 Glass Paani ka Pakka Test!
cards.hook: Garmi-baarish mein jab taazi matar nahi aati, to bazaar mein thele par chamakdaar hari bhigoyi matar bikti hai—ye safed sookhi matar ko Malachite Green mein rang kar toh nahi banayi gayi?
cards.illusion: Thele par ₹80 kilo bikne wali hari chhili hui matar sardi ki fresh hari matar hi hai.
cards.myth: Bazaar ki chhili hui hari matar dhone par halka hara rang chhode to wo natural chlorophyll hota hai.
cards.reality: Sabut chhile matar ke daane ka natural chlorophyll saade paani mein ghul kar paani ko hara nahi karta—hara paani hamesha artificial dye ki nishani hai!

cards.title: Shakarkandi (Sweet Potato) vs Aloo: Meethi Hone ke Bawajood Diabetes & Fitness ke Liye Behtar Kyun?
cards.hook: Shakarkandi chakhne mein meethi hoti hai isliye sugar ke mareez usse chhoo-te bhi nahi aur saara saal sirf Aloo khate hain—par nutrition mein dono ka asli farq kya hai?
cards.illusion: Shakarkandi mein cheeni zyada hoti hai kyunki wo meethi lagti hai, isliye aloo ke muqable wo blood sugar zyada badhati hai.
cards.myth: Shakarkandi meethi hoti hai isliye usmein aam Aloo se 3 guna zyada calories aur sugar hoti hai.
cards.reality: Dono mein calories lagbhag barabar (~80–90 kcal/100g) hoti hain, par ubli Shakarkandi mein zyada fibre, Vitamin A aur lower GI (kam sugar spike) hota hai!

cards.title: Khane ke Turant Baad Phal Khana vs Khaali Pet: 'Fructose' aur Bloating ka Asli Vigyan!
cards.hook: Viral forwards mein kehte hain ki 'Khane ke baad phal khane se wo pet mein sad kar zeher ban jaata hai'—kya phal sachmuch pet mein sadta hai, ya asli baat sirf calories aur bloating ki hai?
cards.illusion: Agar aapne lunch ke baad 1 seb ya kela kha liya to wo pet mein khane ke upar baith kar sadne lagta hai aur gas-zeher banata hai.
cards.myth: Khane ke baad ya shaam 4 baje ke baad phal khane se wo pet mein sad kar zeher aur acidity banate hain.
cards.reality: Pet ke acid mein khana sadta nahi hai—bas bhar-pet khane ke baad phal thoda der se digest hota hai, isliye mid-meal snack time zyada comfortable rehta hai.

cards.title: Pregnancy mein Papita aur Ananas (Pineapple): Paka Phal Safe Hai ya Kachcha Papita Khatarnak?
cards.hook: Pregnancy shuru hote hi ghar mein Papita (Papaya) aur Pineapple poori tarah band kar diya jaata hai—par kya poori tarah PAKA hua meetha papita aur kachcha hara papita ek hi asar karte hain?
cards.illusion: Pregnancy mein 1 tukda paka meetha papita khane se bhi turant garbhpaat (miscarriage) ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Galti se 1 chammach paka papita ya pineapple cake kha lene par turant abortion ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Khatra **Kachche/Adh-pake Papite ke Latex** aur bahut zyada Bromelain supplements se hota hai—1 chammach pake fruit se turant miscarriage nahi hota, par ahtiyat mein kachcha papita bilkul band rakhna zaroori hai.

cards.title: Aam (Mango) Khane se Pehle 30 Min Paani mein Bhigona Kyun Zaroori Hai? (Sap & Phytic Acid Science)
cards.hook: Hamari dadi-naani aam khane se pehle hamesha ek balti thande paani mein aam bhigo kar rakhti thin—par iske peeche 'Garmi nikalne' ka desi concept nahi, balki kaun sa asli chemical vigyan chhupa hai?
cards.illusion: Aam ko paani mein bhigone se sirf uski dhool dhulti hai aur thanda hota hai, baaki koi scientific farq nahi.
cards.myth: Paani mein bhigone se aam ke andar ki 'garam taseer' nikal kar thandi ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Paani mein bhigone se aam ka temperature thanda hota hai aur sabse zaroori—chhilke par laga irritating Sap (Chep) aur pesticide/carbide dhul kar nikal jaata hai!

cards.title: Kheera Kaat kar Kinara Ragadne se Safed Jhaag Kyun Nikalta Hai? ('Cucurbitacin' Kadwahat Science)
cards.hook: Desi kheera kaat-te hi hum uska upari hissa kaat kar gol-gol ragadte hain to safed jhaag nikalta hai—kya isse sachmuch kadwahat nikal jaati hai ya ye sirf thoda kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Kheere ka kona kaat kar ragadne se uske poore andar ka zeher aur kadwahat jhaag ban kar bahar nikal jaati hai.
cards.myth: Kheere ka kona 1 minute ragadne se har kadwa kheera bhi bilkul meetha aur safe ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Ragadne se sirf kate hue sire ke paas ka halka sap aur cucurbitacin nikalta hai—agar poora kheera kadwa hai to wo ragadne se theek nahi hoga!

cards.title: Kadwi Lauki (Ghiya) ka Juice Peene se Jaan ka Khatra! 'Cucurbitacin' Zeher ki Medical Warning
cards.hook: Weight loss aur BP control ke liye log subah kachchi Lauki (Bottle Gourd) ka juice pite hain—par agar lauki thodi si bhi kadwi ho to wo 2 ghante mein khoon ki ulti aur ICU kyun pahuncha sakti hai?
cards.illusion: Kadwi lauki toh bas karele ki tarah thodi kadwi hoti hai, juice mein thoda namak-pudina mila kar pee lene se aur zyada fayda hoga.
cards.myth: Lauki agar thodi kadwi hai to usmein karele ki tarah diabetes theek karne ke zyada gun hain.
cards.reality: BILKUL JHOOTH aur JAANLEWA! Karela aur Lauki alag hain—kadwi lauki mein Toxic Cucurbitacin hota hai jo ICU ya jaan le sakta hai!

cards.title: Bhindi Kaatne ke Baad Dhone se Chipchipi Kyun Banti Hai? Mucilage + Nimbu Chemistry!
cards.hook: Agar bhindi ko kaatne ke baad dho diya jaaye to poori sabzi tar-tar chipchipi (slimy) ho jaati hai—lekin kaatne se pehle dho kar sukhane aur 4 boond nimbu dalne se ekdum khili-khili kaise banti hai?
cards.illusion: Bhindi ke andar toh chipchipa-pan hamesha rehta hai, chahe pehle dhoyein ya baad mein—bas zyada tel mein bhunne se hi thik hoti hai.
cards.myth: Bina chipchipi bhindi banane ke liye usse khoob zyada tel mein deep-fry jaisa pakana zaroori hai.
cards.reality: Sirf sukhi pochhi bhindi + thoda nimbu ras (acid) + namak aakhir mein daalne se 1 chammach tel mein bhi bilkul khili bhindi banti hai!

cards.title: Desi Brown Anda vs Safed Anda: Kya Brown Ande mein Double Protein Hota Hai ya Sirf Murgi ka Rang?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein safed anda ₹6 ka milta hai aur 'Desi Brown Egg' ₹12–₹15 ka—par kya brown ande ke andar protein aur vitamins zyada hote hain, ya safed murgi aur bhoori murgi ka farq hai?
cards.illusion: Brown anda hamesha desi murgi ka hota hai aur usmein safed ande se dugna protein aur nutrition hota hai.
cards.myth: Brown ande mein safed ande se zyada protein aur calcium hota hai.
cards.reality: USDA ke mutabik dono andon ki nutritional value lagbhag bilkul ek saman (~6g protein, ~70 kcal) hoti hai—chhilke ka rang sirf murgi ki breed batata hai.

cards.title: Ande ka Peela Hissa (Yolk) Phenkna Galat Kyun? Cholesterol Myth vs Choline & Vitamin D!
cards.hook: Cholesterol aur charbi badhne ke dar se log ande ka peela hissa (Zardi/Yolk) dustbin mein phenk kar sirf safed hissa khate hain—par latest Heart Association research ispar kya kehti hai?
cards.illusion: Ande ki zardi (Yolk) mein cholesterol hota hai isliye wo seedhe heart attack karwati hai aur swasth insaan ko hamesha phenk deni chahiye.
cards.myth: Roz 1 poora anda (with yolk) khane se cholesterol aur heart attack ka khatra badhta hai.
cards.reality: Large medical studies ke mutabik swasth logon mein daily 1 whole egg heart risk nahi badhata—asli khatra trans-fat, saturated fats aur sugar se hota hai.

cards.title: Bazaar ki Machhli mein 'Formalin' (Laash Bachane Wala Chemical) Milawat: Taazi Machhli Kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Doosre rajyon se aane wali machhli (Fish) 5 din baad bhi taazi aur sakht dikh rahi hai, par uspe makkhiyan bhi nahi baith rahin—kya uspar Formalin aur Ammonia ki barf lagayi gayi hai?
cards.illusion: Machhli agar bina fridge ke bhi patthar jaisi sakht aur bina badbu ke dikh rahi hai, to wo bilkul aaj ki taazi pakdi machhli hai.
cards.myth: Machhli ko 2 baar haldi-namak se dho kar fry kar dene se saara formalin udd jaata hai.
cards.reality: Dhone se upari kuch formalin kam zaroor hota hai par andar tissues mein ghusa formalin poori tarah nahi nikalta—isliye fresh source se kharidna zaroori hai.

cards.title: Broiler Chicken mein 'Hormone Injection' ka Myth vs Asli Khatra: Antibiotic Resistance!
cards.hook: Log darte hain ki farm wale murgi ko 40 din mein mota karne ke liye roz steroid/hormone injection lagate hain—par poultry science ke mutabik asli khatra injection nahi, daane mein mili Antibiotics ka hai!
cards.illusion: Broiler murgiyon ko roz steroid aur growth hormone ke injections laga kar 40 din mein bada kiya jaata hai, jisse ladkiyon mein jaldi periods aate hain.
cards.myth: Broiler murgiyon ko roz steroid/estrogen hormone ke injections lagaye jaate hain.
cards.reality: Poultry industry mein growth hormone injections illegal aur economically impossible hain—asli focus antibiotic misuse aur kitchen hygiene par hona chahiye.

cards.title: Doodh mein 'Oxytocin' Injection ka Sach: Kya Ubalne par Bhi Doodh mein Hormone Aata Hai?
cards.hook: Khabar aati hai ki doodh badhane ke liye bhains ko Oxytocin injection lagate hain—agar us bhains ka doodh hum piyein to kya hamare sharir mein bhi hormones badh jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Oxytocin injection lagi bhains ka doodh peene se bacchon ke hormones bigad jaate hain aur ladkiyon mein jaldi periods aate hain.
cards.myth: Oxytocin wale doodh ko ubaal kar peene par bhi insaan mein hormones badh jaate hain.
cards.reality: NDRI aur ICMR ne spasht kiya hai ki Oxytocin ek peptide hai jo ubalne aur pet ke digestive enzymes se poori tarah toot jaata hai—insaan mein iska hormonal asar nahi hota.

cards.title: Ajinomoto (MSG) ka Asli Sach: Kya Ye Dimaag Kharab Karta Hai, ya Tamatar-Cheese mein Bhi Yahi Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Street chowmein aur maggi ke packet mein 'MSG / Ajinomoto' naam sunte hi log dar jaate hain ki isse cancer aur sir dard hota hai—par kya tamatar aur parmesan cheese mein bhi bilkul wahi Glutamate hota hai?
cards.illusion: Ajinomoto (MSG) ek khatarnak chemical zeher hai jo haddiyan ghalata hai aur har haal mein cancer karta hai.
cards.myth: Ek chutki Ajinomoto (MSG) khane se haddiyan galti hain aur cancer/brain damage hota hai.
cards.reality: WHO, US FDA aur FSSAI ki decades ki research mein iska koi saboot nahi mila hai—MSG bas Sodium + natural Glutamate amino acid hai.

cards.title: Cornflour (Cornstarch) vs Makke ka Aata vs Maida: Manchurian-Soup Gaadha Karne ka Asli Farq!
cards.hook: Soup aur Manchurian gaadha karne ke liye hum safed 'Cornflour' daalte hain—log isse makke ki roti wala Makke ka Aata samajh lete hain, par kya ye 100% pure starch (0% protein/fibre) hai?
cards.illusion: Safed Cornflour aur Peela Makke ka Aata ek hi cheez hain aur sabut makke ki tarah fibre se bharpoor hote hain.
cards.myth: Restaurant ka Tomato ya Veg Sweet Corn Soup zero-calorie aur diabetics ke liye perfect light dinner hai.
cards.reality: Hotel soups mein aksar 2–3 spoon Cornstarch (GI ~90), Sugar aur Butter/Cream hota hai—ghar ka bina-cornstarch lauki/tamatar/dal soup hi asli healthy soup hai!

cards.title: Baking Soda vs Baking Powder: Dhokla-Cake mein Galat Daalne par Kadwa aur Sabun Jaisa Swad Kyun?
cards.hook: Cake ya Dhokla banate waqt Baking Soda aur Baking Powder ko ek hi samajh kar badal dene par poora cake kaala/kadwa aur sabun jaisa kyun lagne lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Baking Soda aur Baking Powder bas do alag naam hain, ek ki jagah doosra barabar chammach daal sakte hain.
cards.myth: Baking Soda aur Baking Powder bilkul ek hi cheez hai—cake mein 1 tsp Baking Powder ki jagah 1 tsp Baking Soda daal sakte hain.
cards.reality: Baking Soda 3–4x stronger aur pure alkali hai—bina acid ke daalne par cake kadwa, sabun-jaisa aur dense ban jayega!

cards.title: Bhatura-Naan mein 'Fruit Salt / Baking Soda' vs 'Yeast / Dahi Khamir': Pet mein Gas aur Hazme ka Farq!
cards.hook: Halwai ke yahan bhatura ya restaurant ka naan khate hi pet pathar jaisa bhari aur gas se phool jaata hai—jabki ghar ka dahi-fermented bhatura ya yeast bread halka kyun lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Fruit Salt ya Baking Soda se 10 minute mein phoolaya gaya bhatura/dhokla aur raat bhar dahi/yeast se phoolaya gaya aata hazme mein bilkul barabar hote hain.
cards.myth: Bread aur pizza mein pada Yeast pet ke andar jaakar zinda rehta hai aur pet ko phula deta hai.
cards.reality: Baking aur tawa/tandoor ki garmi (60°C+) par saara yeast mar jaata hai—wo sirf dough ko phulane aur pre-digest karne ka kaam karta hai.

cards.title: Bacchon ki Jelly, Marshmallow aur Pudding: 'Gelatin' (Haddi/Chamdi) vs Veg 'Agar-Agar (China Grass)'!
cards.hook: Supermarket mein bacchon ki rang-birangi Jelly aur Marshmallows par kai baar Vegetarian/Non-Veg ka farq kaise hota hai—Gelatin aur China Grass (Agar-Agar) kis cheez se bante hain?
cards.illusion: Har fruit jelly aur pudding sirf falon ke ras aur cornflour/plant gum se hi banti hai.
cards.myth: Meethi fruity candies, jelly aur marshmallows hamesha vegetarian hi hote hain.
cards.reality: Duniya bhar ke zayadatar marshmallows aur chewy gummies mein animal-derived Gelatin hota hai—sirf Agar-Agar, Pectin ya Carrageenan wale Green-Dot products hi veg hote hain.

cards.title: Diabetes ke 'Sugar-Free' Sweeteners (Stevia, Sucralose, Erythritol): Kaun Safe Hai aur Kaun 'Maltodextrin' Trap?
cards.hook: Bazaar se '100% Natural Stevia Powder' kharid kar diabetes patient chai mein daalte hain—par packet ke peeche dekhne par usmein 95% Maltodextrin / Dextrose (cheeni jaisa starch!) kaise nikalta hai?
cards.illusion: Har 'Sugar-Free' ya 'Green Stevia' dabbe mein 0% calories aur 0% sugar spike karne wala tatva hota hai.
cards.myth: Sugar-Free goli ya 'Sugar-Free Mithai' khane se blood sugar bilkul 0% badhta hai, isliye jitna chahe kha sakte hain.
cards.reality: Sugar-free mithai mein khoya, maida, dried dates ya Maltodextrin/Maltitol hote hain jo ab bhi blood sugar aur calories badhate hain!

cards.title: Sone (Gold) mein Rhenium aur Ruthenium ki Milawat: XRF Machine aur Acid Test Kaise Fail Hote Hain?
cards.hook: Jwellers ki dukaan par purity check karne wali mehengi XRF machine bhi nakli sone ko 22-24 Carat bata deti hai—aakhir Rhenium aur Ruthenium mein kya vigyan hai?
cards.illusion: Agar sona hath mein bhari lage, acid test pass kar le aur XRF machine par 99.5% dikhe, to wo 100% shuddh sona hai.
cards.myth: Dukaan par XRF machine se check karwa liya hai to sona 100% andar tak shuddh hi hoga.
cards.reality: XRF sirf satah (surface) ke kuch microns scan karti hai—andar bhari Rhenium/Tungsten ko sirf ultrasound, melting ya HUID traceability se hi roka ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Sone ke Biscuit (Bullion) mein Tungsten Rods: Ultrasound aur Chumbak se Kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Tungsten sone se 1000 guna sasta hai par uska wajan sone ke bilkul barabar hai—isliye nakli sone ke sikkon aur bars mein iska sabse zyada istemal hota hai!
cards.illusion: Bank/bullion bar jaisa dikhne wala bhari gold coin ya bar wajan mein exact 10g ya 50g hai to wo shuddh hoga.
cards.myth: Sone aur paani ke wajan ka hisab (Specific Gravity Test) 100% pakka proof hai.
cards.reality: Specific gravity tamba-chandi pakad sakti hai, par Tungsten (19.25) aur Gold (19.30) ki density lagbhag same hone se ye test Tungsten par fail ho jaata hai!

cards.title: 24K vs 22K vs 18K Gold aur Jewellery mein 'Stone Weight' Billing Scam
cards.hook: Gehne kharidte waqt dukandar nag/moti (stones) aur meenakari ka wajan bhi ₹7,500/gram sone ke bhaav par jod kar ₹10,000-₹20,000 extra kaise le lete hain?
cards.illusion: Jewellery bill par total wajan likha hai to sab kuch sone ke wajan ke hisab se sahi hi calculate hua hoga.
cards.myth: 22K gehne mein 100% sona hota hai, sirf 24K mein thoda fark hota hai.
cards.reality: 22K mein 91.6% hi sona hota hai (baaki 8.4% tamba/chandi mazbooti ke liye hota hai), isliye 22K ka rate 24K se hamesha ~8.4% kam hona chahiye!

cards.title: Chandi (Silver) ke Sikke aur Payal mein Zinc-Nickel Milawat: Barf (Ice) Test ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Chandi par sirf '999' chhaap dene se wo shuddh nahi ho jaati—aap ghar ke freezer ke ek barf ke tukde se 10 second mein asli chandi ki parakh kaise kar sakti hain?
cards.illusion: Chandi par '999' ya '925' likha hai aur wo chamak rahi hai, to wo bilkul asli chandi hi hogi.
cards.myth: 'German Silver' sasti aur achchi quality ki chandi hoti hai.
cards.reality: German Silver mein EK GRAAM bhi chandi nahi hoti—ye Copper + Zinc + Nickel ka alloy hai, jiska naam sirf uske rang ki wajah se rakha gaya hai.

cards.title: Asli Heera (Diamond) vs American Diamond (CZ) vs Moissanite: Newspaper & Breath Test
cards.hook: Aankh se dekhkar ek ₹500 ka American Diamond aur ₹1,00,000 ka Asli Heera bilkul ek jaisa chamakta hai—par dono ke andar roshni aur garmi ka vigyan bilkul alag hai!
cards.illusion: Jo pathar jitni zyada rang-birangi chamak (rainbow fire) de, wo utna hi bada aur asli heera hai.
cards.myth: Asli heera kisi bhi cheez se nahi toot-ta, hathode se maaro tab bhi nahi.
cards.reality: Heera sabse 'Hard' (scratch-proof) zaroor hai, par wo 'Tough' nahi hai—ek khaas angle (cleavage plane) par chot lagne par asli heera bhi toot/chhatak sakta hai! Kabhi hathode wala test na karein.

cards.title: Saste Powerbank mein Mitti, Ret ya Lohe ki Plate: Weight Psychology aur Fake mAh Scam
cards.hook: ₹400 mein '20,000 mAh' ka bhari-bharkam powerbank liya, par phone ek baar bhi poora charge nahi hota—kholne par andar se ret ki thaili ya lohe ka tukda kyun nikalta hai?
cards.illusion: Powerbank jitna bhari aur bada hai, uske andar utni hi badi aur taakatwar battery lagi hogi.
cards.myth: 10,000 mAh ka powerbank mere 5,000 mAh phone ko poora 2 baar (200%) charge karega.
cards.reality: 3.7V se 5V/9V step-up karne mein ~30-35% energy heat banke udti hai, isliye asli 10,000 mAh powerbank ~6,200–6,500 mAh hi transfer kar paata hai.

cards.title: ₹100 ka Nakli Mobile Charger aur Sasti USB Cable: Aag Lagne aur Phone Touch Hang Hone ka Physics
cards.hook: ₹100 wale local charger par phone lagane par phone ki touch screen apne aap bhaagne (ghost touch) lagti hai aur cable garam ho jaati hai—iska vigyan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Charger toh bas bijli pahunchane wala adapter hai—₹1,500 ka original ho ya ₹100 ka local, dono mein wahi 5V current aata hai.
cards.myth: Original charger ki jagah kisi bhi ₹100 ke local charger se phone charge karne mein bas speed thodi kam hoti hai, koi nuksan nahi.
cards.reality: Local charger mein voltage stabilizer aur AC-DC isolation nahi hota—ye phone ki battery phula sakta hai, motherboard jala sakta hai aur electric shock de sakta hai.

cards.title: Ghar ki Wiring mein Asli Copper Wire vs CCA (Tambe ki Parat Wala Aluminium): Chhilne ka Test
cards.hook: Bijli ka taar upar se bilkul sunahra-laal (copper jaisa) chamakta hai, par 6 mahine mein AC/geyser ka switch pighal kar aag lag jaati hai—aakhir taar ke andar kya nikla?
cards.illusion: Taar ka rang copper jaisa laal-sunahra hai aur wo flex kar raha hai, isliye wo 100% pure copper wire hi hai.
cards.myth: Har sunahra-laal dikhne wala bijli ka taar pure copper hota hai.
cards.reality: Saste extension boards, LAN cables aur duplicate wires mein badi matra mein Copper-coated Aluminium (CCA) becha jaata hai.

cards.title: Nakli Note (₹500/₹200) ki Pahchan: Colour-Changing Ink aur Tactile Science Kaise Kaam Karta Hai?
cards.hook: Asli ₹500 ke note ko jab aap thoda tedha (tilt) karti hain, to uspar likha '500' aur security thread hara se neela ho jaata hai—aakhir is jaadui ink ke peeche kaun sa vigyan hai?
cards.illusion: Nakli note sirf colour photocopy ya aam printing se ban jaata hai aur pakadna mushkil hota hai.
cards.myth: Note ko haath mein ragadne par agar thoda rang chhute to wo nakli hai.
cards.reality: Asli Intaglio printing mein gehri ink use hoti hai, isliye naye note ko safed kagaz par tez ragadne se halka rang utar sakta hai—iska matlab nakli nahi hota; asli pehchan Tilt Colour Shift, Watermark aur Raised Print hai!

cards.title: Petrol Pump par 'Zero' Dekhne ke Baad bhi Kam Petrol? Density Meter aur Nozzle Physics
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki meter 0.00 dekh liya to petrol poora hi milega—par 'Density' number aur pipe mein ruka petrol kaise kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Sirf meter par 0.00 dekhna kaafi hai, ya fir 'subah thand mein petrol bharwane se double mileage milta hai'.
cards.myth: Dopahar ko dhoop mein petrol bharwane se aadha petrol ud jaata hai.
cards.reality: Petrol zameen ke neeche underground insulated tanks mein store hota hai jahan temperature din-raat lagbhag constant rehta hai—farq 0.1% se bhi kam hota hai.

cards.title: LPG Gas Cylinder mein Kam Gas aur Expiry Date Code (A/B/C/D-26): Delivery ke Time 10-Second Check
cards.hook: Har gas cylinder ke upar handle ke paas 'B-26' ya 'D-28' likha hota hai—90% gharon ko pata hi nahi ki ye cylinder ki Expiry Date (Testing Date) hoti hai!
cards.illusion: Agar gas cylinder ke muh par plastic ki seal lagi hai, to usmein poori 14.2 kg gas hogi aur cylinder bilkul safe hoga.
cards.myth: Cylinder mein gas ke sath paani bhar dete hain aur last mein paani nikalta hai.
cards.reality: LPG cylinder mein pressure se gas LIQUID roop mein rehti hai (hilane par paani jaisi chhalakti hai)—ye paani nahi, liquid gas (Propane-Butane) hi hoti hai!

cards.title: LED Bulb ka Watt vs Lumen Scam aur Phone Camera se 'Sasta Driver Flicker' Pakadne ka Trick
cards.hook: Bazaar mein ₹40 wala '15W LED Bulb' ₹130 wale branded 9W bulb se bhi kam roshni deta hai aur aankh mein sir dard karta hai—aapke phone ka camera isse 2 second mein pakad sakta hai!
cards.illusion: Bulb par jitne zyada 'Watt (W)' likhe honge, wo kamre mein utni hi zyada roshni dega.
cards.myth: Bulb kharab hone par sirf ek LED chip jal kar kaali hoti hai—sabhi LED ek hi brightness deti hain.
cards.reality: LED chips ke sath Driver IC, Heat Sink aur Lumen rating sab kuch tay karti hain ki roshni aankh ke liye sukhad rahegi ya thakayegi.

cards.title: Asli Leather vs Rexine (PU/PVC): 1 Saal mein Joota-Bag Chhil Kyun Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: ₹2,000 ka jacket ya ₹1,200 ka handbag 'Pure Leather' bolkar kharida, par 8 mahine mein uski upari parat papdi bankar jhadne lagi—ye kaun sa vigyan hai?
cards.illusion: Jo bag/jacket mulaayam, chikna aur chamde jaisa dikh raha hai aur uspe 'Genuine Leather' likha hai, wo asli chamda hoga.
cards.myth: 'Genuine Leather' tag ka matlab sabse top-quality asli chamda hota hai.
cards.reality: Industry mein 'Genuine Leather' aksar sabse sasti split/bonded layer ko kehte hain; sabse mazboot leather 'Full-Grain' ya 'Top-Grain' hota hai.

cards.title: Asli Resham (Pure Silk) vs 'Art Silk' (Polyester): Ek Dhaage ke Burn Test ka Vigyan
cards.hook: ₹1,500 ki 'Pure Banarasi/Kanjivaram Silk' saree aur ₹10,000 ki asli silk mein aankhon se farq nahi dikhta—par sirf ek chhote dhaage ko aag dikhakar 3 second mein sach kaise pata chalta hai?
cards.illusion: Dukaandar bolte hain ye 'Art Silk' ya 'Semi-Silk' bhi asli resham ki hi ek variety hai, bas thodi halki hai.
cards.myth: 'Art Silk' matlab artisan ke haath ka bana asli resham hota hai.
cards.reality: Art Silk ka full form 'Artificial Silk' hai—yani synthetic rayon ya polyester, ismein 0% asli resham hota hai!

cards.title: 100% Cotton vs Polyester Kapde: Garmi mein Polyester Mein Ghamoriyan aur Badbu Kyun Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein 'Cotton-feel' bolkar sasta Polyester T-shirt/kurti bech di jaati hai—use pehan kar 1 ghante dhoop mein nikalte hi chipchipahat aur paseene ki tez badbu kyun aati hai?
cards.illusion: Jo kapda chhoone mein mulayam aur bina iron ke sidha rehta hai, wo garmiyon ke liye best cotton hai.
cards.myth: Bina press kiye sidhi rehne wali shirt ya bedsheet sabse best quality ka pure cotton hota hai.
cards.reality: 100% pure cotton mein silwatein padna uski asli pehchan hai—bilkul wrinkle-free aur chamakdaar kapde mein aksar polyester mix hota hai.

cards.title: Asli Pashmina / Oon (Wool) vs Sasta Acrylic Shawl: Static Current aur Burn Test
cards.hook: ₹400 wale 'Kashmiri Pashmina' shawl ko pehan kar jab aap utarti hain to chat-chat ki aawaz (current/spark) aati hai—par asli oon kabhi current nahi maarta!
cards.illusion: Har mulayam aur garam dikhne wala winter shawl ya sweater natural oon (wool) ya Pashmina ka hota hai.
cards.myth: Angoothi (ring) se nikal jaane wala har mulayam shawl asli Pashmina hota hai.
cards.reality: Aajkal patla machine-made Viscose/Semi-synthetic shawl bhi angoothi se aaram se nikal jaata hai—ring test ab purana ho chuka hai, asli pehchan Burn Test aur GI Tag hai.

cards.title: Furniture mein Asli Sheesham/Sagwan vs MDF/Particle Board: Paani Padte hi Furniture Phool Kyun Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Online ₹15,000 mein chamakdaar 'Wooden Wardrobe' ya TV unit liya, par chai girte hi ya baarish mein wo sookhe biscuit ki tarah phool kar toot gaya—andar kya tha?
cards.illusion: Furniture ke upar lakdi ke reshe (wood grain) dikh rahe hain, isliye wo poori tarah mazboot lakdi ka bana hai.
cards.myth: 'Engineered Wood' ka matlab aam lakdi se zyada mazboot aur water-resistant modern lakdi hota hai.
cards.reality: Furniture marketing mein 'Engineered Wood' ka matlab aksar sasta Particle Board ya MDF (lakdi ka burada + glue) hota hai jo paani aur bhari load nahi jhel sakta.

cards.title: Naye Paint ki Mehak aur Saste Paint mein 'Lead' (सीसा): Bachchon ke Dimaag par Asar
cards.hook: Diwali par ghar mein naya paint karwane ke baad jo meethi-teekhi khushbu aati hai, wo taazgi nahi balki 'VOC' aur 'Lead' chemicals ki bhaap ho sakti hai!
cards.illusion: Naye paint ki tez mehak ghar ke naye-pan aur achi quality ke oil/enamel paint ki nishani hai.
cards.myth: Oil-based Enamel paint ki tez mehak matlab wo zyada mazboot aur high-quality hai.
cards.reality: Tez mehak sirf high-VOC solvents (turpentine/mineral spirits) ki nishani hai—aajkal water-based Zero-VOC emulsions zyada safe aur lambe tikau aate hain.

cards.title: Deewar par 'Waterproof Paint' Lagane ke Baad bhi Papdi Kyun Phoolti Hai? (Osmotic Pressure)
cards.hook: Seelan (dampness) chhupane ke liye mehenga waterproof paint lagwaya, par 3 mahine mein uspar phaphole (bubbles) ban kar poori papdi phat gayi—kyun?
cards.illusion: Agar deewar par andar se mehenga waterproof paint ya putty lagwa dein, to bahar se aane wali seelan ruk jayegi.
cards.myth: Dabbe par 'Waterproof' likha putty aur paint lagane se deewar ki saari seelan hamesha ke liye ruk jaati hai.
cards.reality: Agar paani peeche se aa raha hai to rubber-like waterproof paint ulta gubbare ban kar jaldi phat jaata hai—pehle leakage ka rasta band karna zaroori hai.

cards.title: ₹200 ka Roadside Helmet vs ISI Helmet: Beech ka 'Thermocol' (EPS Foam) Jaan Kaise Bachata Hai?
cards.hook: Challan se bachne ke liye log ₹200 ka halka helmet pehan lete hain, par kya aap jaante hain ki asli helmet mein aapka sir plastic se nahi balki 'Thermocol' jaisi parat se bachta hai?
cards.illusion: Helmet bas upar se sakht plastic ka hona chahiye aur sar par tika rahe to police challan aur chot dono se bacha lega.
cards.myth: Garmi mein khule muuh wala sasta half-cap helmet kaafi hai, full-face ki zaroorat nahi.
cards.reality: Accident stats dikhate hain ki 35% se zyada chot thodi (chin) aur chehre par lagti hai—Full-Face ISI helmet hi poori suraksha deta hai.

cards.title: ₹100 wale Saste Kaale Chashme: Dhoop mein Aankhon ko Zyada Nuksan Kyun Pahunchate Hain?
cards.hook: Bina chashme ke dhoop mein rehne se zyada khatarnak hai ₹100 ka bina UV protection wala kaala chashma pehanna—is mein aankhon ki kaun si biology kaam karti hai?
cards.illusion: Kaala chashma dhoop ki roshni kam kar raha hai, isliye wo aankhon ko dhoop aur UV kirnon se bhi bacha raha hoga.
cards.myth: Jitna gehra kaala chashma hoga, dhoop ki UV rays se utni hi zyada suraksha milegi.
cards.reality: UV protection rang ke gehre-pan se nahi, balki lens ke andar maujood transparent UV-absorbing material se aata hai—bina rang ka clear Polycarbonate chashma bhi 100% UV rok sakta hai!

cards.title: 'Blue-Cut' Chashme ka Sach: Kya Phone ki Blue Light Aankh Kharab Karti Hai ya Marketing Myth Hai?
cards.hook: Optical shops ₹1,500 extra lekar 'Blue-Cut Coating' lagwati hain ki phone ki neeli roshni aankh kharab kar degi—par duniya ki sabse badi eye research ispar kya kehti hai?
cards.illusion: Mobile/Laptop ki blue light aankhon mein digital eye strain aur andhapan laati hai, aur Blue-Cut chashma pehanne se aankh bilkul thakegi nahi.
cards.myth: Blue-Cut chashma phone ki radiation rok kar aankhon ka number badhne se rokta hai.
cards.reality: Clinical trials mein sabit ho chuka hai ki Blue-Cut glasses na to eye strain kam karte hain aur na hi myopia (number badhna) rokte hain—sahi lighting, distance aur 20-20-20 breaks hi asli upay hain.

cards.title: Car/Bike Tyre ki Expiry Date (4-Digit DOT Code) aur 'Nitrogen Hawa' ka Sach
cards.hook: Naya dikhne wala tyre bhi agar godam mein 5 saal se pada hai to highway par phat sakta hai! Tyre ke kinare chhape 4 numbers uski asli umar kaise batate hain?
cards.illusion: Naye tyre par gahri gotti (treads) dikh rahi hain to wo bilkul naya hai, aur tyre mein 'Nitrogen' bharwane se tyre kabhi nahi phat-ta.
cards.myth: Jab tak tyre ki gotti (treads) dikh rahi hai, tyre 10-12 saal tak bilkul safe hai.
cards.reality: Rubber 5-6 saal ke baad chemical oxidation se sakht aur kamzor ho jaata hai—kam chali gadi ke tyres ko bhi 6 saal ke baad regular check/change karna zaroori hai.

cards.title: Bike/Car mein Nakli 'Recycled Engine Oil': Kaale Jale Tel ko Filter Karke Kaise Bechte Hain?
cards.hook: Local mechanic ke paas branded ₹450 wala engine oil ₹220 mein kaise mil jaata hai? Purane jale hue kaale engine oil ko acid se saaf karke nayi bottle mein bharne ka khel!
cards.illusion: Bottle par reputed brand/Shell/Motul ka sticker aur seal lagi hai, aur tel dekhne mein peela-golden hai, isliye wo bilkul asli hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak naya tel peela aur saaf dikh raha hai, wo engine ke liye theek kaam karega.
cards.reality: Acid se saaf kiya gaya recycled tel bhi peela dikhta hai par usmein heat-resistance aur anti-wear additives bilkul nahi hote.

cards.title: Ghar Banwate Waqt Cement ki '3-Month Expiry' Rule: Purana Cement Kamzor Kyun Pad Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Aapne mehenga Grade-53 cement kharida, par agar wo bori dukaan ke godam mein 4-5 mahine purani padi thi to aapke ghar ke pillar aur chhat 20% se 40% tak kamzor ho sakte hain!
cards.illusion: Cement toh patthar ka powder hai—jab tak bori mein dhele (lumps) nahi bane aur wo powder hai, wo kabhi expire nahi hota.
cards.myth: Cement ke dhele (lumps) ko fawde se pees kar powder bana lene se cement fir se sahi kaam karta hai.
cards.reality: Dhela banne ka matlab us cement ka paani ke sath reaction pehle hi ho chuka hai—peesne par wo sirf mitti/raakh jaisa filler bachta hai, usmein pakad ki taakat nahi rehti!

cards.title: Ghar ke Sariye (TMT Bars) mein 'Fe-500D' vs Sasta Scrap Iron: Bhukamp mein Ghar Kaise Bachta Hai?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein sariye pe '500' likha dekhkar sab ek jaise lagte hain—par ek sasta scrap-iron sariya bhukamp mein glass ki tarah toot jaata hai jabki asli 'Fe-500D' rassi ki tarah mud kar ghar bacha leta hai!
cards.illusion: Jo sariya jitna sakht aur mudne mein tight ho, wo ghar ke liye utna hi mazboot hota hai.
cards.myth: Sariya jitna sakht aur kadak hoga, ghar utna hi mazboot hoga.
cards.reality: Bahut zyada sakht (brittle) sariya bhukamp ke jhatke par bina mude toot jaata hai—asli mazbooti Strength + Ductility ('D' grade) ke balance mein hoti hai.

cards.title: Ghar ki Tiles: Ceramic vs Vitrified (Porosity Test) — Tile Pe Daag Kyun Jam Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Naye ghar ke floor par 6 mahine mein hi haldi ya chai ka daag hamesha ke liye jam gaya? Tile ke peeche sirf 2 boond paani daal kar aap quality pehchan sakti thin!
cards.illusion: Jo tile upar se jitni chamakdaar aur chikni dikhe, wo utni hi mazboot aur waterproof hoti hai.
cards.myth: Floor aur Wall dono ke liye sabse chamakdaar glossy tile hi best hoti hai.
cards.reality: Bathroom aur balcony floor par glossy tile paani padte hi barf jaisi phisalan ban jaati hai—wahan hamesha Matte / Anti-skid tile lagani chahiye.

cards.title: Normal Sheesha (Glass) vs Toughened Glass: Dining Table ya Shower Glass Chhote Daanon mein Kyun Toot-ta Hai?
cards.hook: Car ki side window ya achchi dining table ka sheesha tootne par bade chaku jaise tukde nahi bante, balki makke ke daanon jaisa choor-choor ho jaata hai—is mein kaun sa physics hai?
cards.illusion: Mota sheesha (10mm-12mm) apne aap mein safe hota hai, chahe wo normal glass ho ya toughened.
cards.myth: Toughened glass kabhi toot-ta hi nahi, isliye use gas chulhe par bina dhyan ke use kar sakte hain.
cards.reality: Toughened glass 4-5x mazboot hota hai par uske edges kamzor hote hain aur bahut tez local heat (jaise chulhe par badi batti/tandoor rakhna) se thermal shock mein toot sakta hai.

cards.title: Stainless Steel 304 (Food Grade) vs Sasta 202 Steel: Steel ke Bartan mein Zang Kyun Lagta Hai?
cards.hook: Bartan par 'Stainless Steel' likha tha, par 6 mahine mein hi namak-nimbu lagte hi bartan mein zang ke chhote gaddhe (pitting) pad gaye—ye Steel 202 vs 304 ka khel hai!
cards.illusion: Har chamakdaar steel ka bartan ek hi hota hai, aur agar uspar chumbak (magnet) na chipke to wo 100% best 304 steel hai.
cards.myth: Jis steel par chumbak na chipke wo 100% pure aur best quality 304 steel hai.
cards.reality: Sasta 202 steel aur bahut se aluminium alloys bhi non-magnetic hote hain—aur tri-ply bartan ka neeche wala 430 steel induction ke liye jaan-bujhkar magnetic hota hai!

cards.title: Asli Peetal (Brass) vs Peetal ki Polish Wala Loha: Pooja ki Murti aur Bartan Kaise Pahchanein?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein sasti peetal ki murtiyan aur diyas bikte hain jo 2 mahine mein kaale zang se phool jaate hain—kyunki andar loha ya zinc tha, upar sirf peetal ka paint tha!
cards.illusion: Murti ka rang peela-sunahra hai aur wajan mein bhari lag rahi hai, to wo thos peetal (Brass) ki hi hogi.
cards.myth: Bhari murtiyan hamesha thos peetal ki hi hoti hain.
cards.reality: Hollow (khokhli) peetal ya lohe ki murti ke andar POP, mitti ya sasta lead bhar kar wajan aasani se badhaya jaata hai.

cards.title: Asli Moti (Real Pearl) vs Plastic/Glass Moti: Daant par Ragadne ka 2-Second Test
cards.hook: Chamakdaar moti ki maala asli seepee (oyster) se nikli hai ya ₹50 ke plastic ke daane hain—jewellers sirf apne daant par halka sa ragad kar 2 second mein kaise bata dete hain?
cards.illusion: Jo moti jitne zyada ekdum gol, chikne aur ek saman chamakdaar hon, wo sabse mehenge aur asli moti hote hain.
cards.myth: Asli moti aag mein jalane par bilkul nahi jalta.
cards.reality: Asli moti Calcium Carbonate + organic Conchiolin protein se banta hai—aag mein jalane par asli moti bhi kharab/kaala aur chatak sakta hai! Kabhi fire test na karein.

cards.title: Saste Perfume aur Attar mein Methanol & Phthalates: Skin par Lagane se Kaale Daag Kyun Padte Hain?
cards.hook: Roadside ₹100 wale duplicate branded perfume ko gale ya kalai par chhidakte hi thandak lagti hai, par baad mein khujli aur skin kaali kyun pad jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Mehenga perfume aur ₹150 wala duplicate perfume dono mein khushbu lagbhag ek jaisi hai, bas brand ke naam ka paisa hai.
cards.myth: Jo perfume kapdon par din bhar tika rahe, wo hamesha sabse pure aur safe hota hai.
cards.reality: Bahut zyada der tikne wali tez synthetic khushbu mein aksar high-dose chemical fixatives (Phthalates) hote hain—hamesha certified brands hi chunein.

cards.title: Band Kamre mein Agarbatti aur Dhoop Jalana: PM2.5 Dhuan aur Cigarette Jaisa Asar?
cards.hook: Subah-shaam pooja mein agarbatti aur dhoop jalana har ghar ki parampara hai—par band AC/window wale kamre mein 4 agarbatti jalane se hawa ki quality kitni gir jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Agarbatti mein chandan aur phoolon ki khushbu hoti hai, isliye iska dhuan kamre ki hawa ko shuddh aur healthy banata hai.
cards.myth: Agarbatti ka dhuan band kamre mein rakhne se hawa ke saare bacteria mar jaate hain.
cards.reality: Khushbu aati zaroor hai, par band kamre mein charcoal/wood smoke ke PM2.5 particles fefadon ko cigarette ke passive smoke jaisa nuksan pahunchate hain—ventilation zaroori hai.

cards.title: Machhar Wali Coil (Kachhua Chhaap) Band Kamre mein Jalana: Ek Raat mein Kitni Cigarette Jitna Dhuan?
cards.hook: Machhar bhagane ke liye har ghar mein green/black mosquito coil raat bhar band kamre mein chhod di jaati hai—par uske box par likhi warning kya kehti hai?
cards.illusion: Coil mein bas thodi si machhar bhagane ki dawa hai aur uska dhuan insanon ke liye bilkul be-asar hai.
cards.myth: Harbal/Neem likhi mosquito coil ka dhuan fefadon ke liye bilkul safe hota hai.
cards.reality: Kisi bhi coil ko 8 ghante sulagane ke liye wood-dust/charcoal base jalana padta hai, jiska PM2.5 dhuan fefadon ko irritate karta hi hai.

cards.title: Car ke Radiator mein Coolant ki Jagah Saada Paani Daalne ka Nuksan (Boiling & Rust Science)
cards.hook: Raste mein car garam hui to mechanic ne kaha 'paani daal do chal jayegi'—par hamesha sirf paani chalaane se ₹30,000 ka engine kyun kharab ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Coolant bas hara/laal rang ka mehenga paani hai—paani bhi wahi thanda karne ka kaam karta hai.
cards.myth: Garmi wale shehron mein jahan barf nahi girti, wahan coolant ki koi zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.reality: Garmi mein coolant aur zyada zaroori hota hai kyunki wo paani ka boiling point 100°C se badha kar ~125°C karta hai aur zang rokta hai!

cards.title: E20 Petrol (20% Ethanol Mix): Mileage Thoda Kam Kyun Hota Hai aur Baarish mein Kya Dhyan Rakhein?
cards.hook: Ab petrol pump par milne wale petrol mein 20% tak Ethanol (ganne se bana alcohol) mila hota hai—iska gadi ke mileage aur purani bikes par kya vigyanik asar padta hai?
cards.illusion: Ethanol milane se petrol sasta aur mileage double ho jaata hai, ya fir 'Ethanol se har gadi ka engine turant kharab ho jaata hai'.
cards.myth: E20 petrol dalwate hi har purani gadi ka engine 10 din mein seize ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Engine seize nahi hota—ARAI testing mein purani gadiyon mein bas rubber hoses/gaskets ka thoda jaldi ghisna aur 3-6% mileage drop dekha gaya hai.

cards.title: RO Service mein ₹400 ki Nakli Membrane aur Carbon Filter: Paani Saaf Nahi, Sirf TDS Check ka Khel!
cards.hook: RO service wala ₹1,500 bolkar chupke se ₹300 ki local membrane daal jaata hai—wo paani ke bacteria aur chemicals rokti bhi hai ya sirf bypass karti hai?
cards.illusion: Service wale ne naye white filters lagaye aur TDS meter par number kam dikha diya, to RO bilkul sahi kaam kar raha hai.
cards.myth: RO ke sabhi filters 3 saal tak bina badle aaram se chalte hain.
cards.reality: Sediment aur Carbon filter 6-12 mahine mein bhar jaate hain—carbon filter na badalne par paani ka chlorine ₹2,000 ki asli RO membrane ko bhi jala deta hai!
