cards.title: Digital Tarazu (Weighing Scale) mein Remote Chip aur Khokhle Baant ka Scam
cards.hook: Sabzi mandi, raddi ya ration dukaan par aapki aankh ke samne digital kaante par '1.000 kg' dikhta hai, par ghar aakar wajan 850g nikalta hai—ye jaadu kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Digital kaanta toh computer hai—uspar '1.000 kg' likha aa gaya matlab wajan 100% sahi hai.
cards.myth: Digital display wala kaanta kabhi galat nahi ho sakta, sirf purane dandi-tarazu mein gadbad hoti thi.
cards.reality: Digital kaanton mein calibration setting aur hidden remote chip se 1 button dabakar wajan 10-25% kam-zyada kiya ja sakta hai.

cards.title: ₹250 mein '1TB / 2TB Pendrive' Scam: Controller Chip Jhoothi Size Kaise Dikhati Hai?
cards.hook: Online ya station par ₹300 mein '1TB Pendrive' kharidi, laptop mein lagane par sachmuch 1000 GB dikh bhi raha hai—par 10 GB data daalte hi saari photos aur videos gayab kyun ho jaati hain?
cards.illusion: Laptop ke 'My Computer / This PC' mein drive ka size 1TB dikh raha hai, isliye usmein sachmuch 1TB jagah hai.
cards.myth: Agar Windows Properties mein '990 GB Free' dikh raha hai, to pendrive bilkul asli hai.
cards.reality: Windows sirf controller chip ki reported table padhta hai—hacked chip Windows aur Android dono ko aasani se jhootha size dikha sakti hai.

cards.title: ATM Slip aur Shopping Bill ki Ink Gayab Kyun Ho Jaati Hai? Thermal Paper mein BPA/BPS ka Sach
cards.hook: Supermarket ka bill ya ATM ki slip 2 mahine baad bilkul safed ho jaati hai—kyunki uspe ink nahi, heat-sensitive chemical powder laga hota hai jo aapke haathon mein lag sakta hai!
cards.illusion: Billing machine ke andar sasti ink hoti hai jo waqt ke sath udd jaati hai.
cards.myth: ATM aur shopping slips par aam ink print hoti hai jo purani hone par udti hai.
cards.reality: Unmein koi ink nahi hoti—kagaz par hi BPA/BPS aur leuco-dye ki heat-sensitive coating hoti hai.

cards.title: Ghar, Gaadi aur Office ka Fire Extinguisher: Green Needle aur Powder Jam Hone ka Sach
cards.hook: Office ya apartment mein laal aag bujhane wala cylinder laga hai—par aag lagne par jab pin kheenchi to usmein se kuch nikla hi nahi! Aisa kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Jab tak cylinder ke upar laga meter hara (Green) zone mein hai, cylinder 100% kaam karega.
cards.myth: Har tarah ki aag par ek balti paani daal dene se aag bujh jaati hai.
cards.reality: Cooking oil ki aag aur Bijli (short-circuit) ki aag par paani daalna jaanlewa ho sakta hai—oil par metal dhakkan/baking soda/fire blanket aur bijli par main switch off + ABC/CO2 extinguisher hi use karein.

cards.title: Sona Girvi / Exchange Karwate Waqt: Kasauti Patthar, Acid Test aur Melt Loss ka Asli Ganit
cards.hook: Purana sona bechte ya gold loan lete waqt jeweller 'Kasauti Patthar' par ghiste hain ya pighlane mein '4% loss' kaat-te hain—kahan asli vigyan hai aur kahan thagi?
cards.illusion: Kasauti patthar aur tezab se sona check kar liya to purity pakki ho gayi, aur sona pighlane mein 5% sona hawa mein udd jaata hai.
cards.myth: Sona pighlane par 5% se 10% sona bhaap bankar hawa mein udd jaata hai.
cards.reality: Sone ka boiling point ~2,970°C hota hai aur melting ~1,064°C—melting mein sona hawa mein nahi udta! Sirf mail aur sasta solder (tanka) alag hota hai.

cards.title: Chhat ki Paani ki Tanki: Kaali Tanki vs Safed Tanki — Kai (Algae) Aur Garmi ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Chhat par kaali tanki rakhein ya safed? Kaali tanki mein garmi mein paani khaul jaata hai, par safed sasti tanki mein hari kaai (algae) kyun lag jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Safed tanki dhoop mein paani thanda rakhti hai isliye sabse achchi hoti hai, aur kaali tanki gandi hoti hai.
cards.myth: Kaali tanki sabse mazboot aur healthy hoti hai.
cards.reality: Single-layer sasti kaali tanki aksar recycled scrap plastic se banti hai aur paani ko bahut zyada garam karti hai—3-layer/4-layer white-outer virgin tanki best hoti hai.

cards.title: Dry Cleaning Bina Paani ke Kapde Kaise Saaf Karti Hai? Plastic Cover Mein Rakhne ka Khatra
cards.hook: Mehengi silk saree ya coat dry cleaning se aane par uspar plastic ki panni chadhi hoti hai aur ek tez chemical mehak aati hai—par wo paani nahi to kya lagaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Dry cleaning mein kapde par bas bhaap (steam) maarkar sukha diya jaata hai aur plastic cover mein almirah mein rakh dena best hai.
cards.myth: Dry cleaner wali plastic thaili mein rakhne se kapde saalon tak fresh aur keedon se bache rehte hain.
cards.reality: Plastic thaili chemical fumes aur moisture ko andar band kar leti hai—store karne ke liye hamesha breathable cotton/muslin cloth cover best hota hai.

cards.title: Asli Rudraksha aur Chandan (Sandalwood) mein Plastic/Glue Milawat: Paani & Scratch Test Fail Kyun?
cards.hook: Mele ya online ₹500 mein 'Ek-Mukhi Rudraksha' aur 'Pure Mysore Chandan' milta hai—par lakdi ke burade aur glue se nakli daane kaise banaye jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Rudraksha paani mein doob jaaye to 100% asli hai, aur Chandan mein tez khushbu aa rahi hai to wo shuddh hai.
cards.myth: Paani mein doobne wala har rudraksha 100% asli aur tairne wala nakli hota hai.
cards.reality: Doobne-tairne ka talluq sirf density aur andar ki nami/hawa se hai—loha ya resin bhar kar koi bhi nakli rudraksha paani mein duboya ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Sona Kharidte Waqt Making Charges aur Wastage ka Billing Jaal: 22K par 24K Rate Lagana!
cards.hook: 22K Gold ₹70,000/10g par lene gaye, par final bill ₹85,000 bana—jeweller ne 'Wastage (Chheejan)' aur '24K rate on 22K' laga kar kitna extra chuna lagaya?
cards.illusion: Jeweller ne sasta ₹400/gram making charge bol diya matlab bill bilkul kam aur imaandar bana hai.
cards.myth: Har jeweller 22K gahne ka bhav 24K gold rate par hi lagata hai aur wo standard niyam hai.
cards.reality: Honest jewellers 22K (916) ka alag sasta rate lagate hain—24K rate par 22K bechna chhupa hua extra charge hai.

cards.title: Kundan aur Polki Jewellery mein 'Laakh (Wax)' ka Wajan: ₹3 Lakh ke Set mein Asli Sona Sirf 10 Gram!
cards.hook: Shadi ke liye 50 gram ka bhari Kundan/Polki gold necklace kharida, par bechne par jeweller bola 'Ismein toh sirf 15 gram sona hai, baaki laakh (wax) aur kachcha sheesha hai!' Ye kaise?
cards.illusion: 50 gram ka Kundan-Polki haar tol kar liya hai to poora 50 gram 22K gold hi hai.
cards.myth: Hallmark laga hua Kundan/Polki necklace poore wajan ke hisab se 22K sona hota hai.
cards.reality: BIS Hallmark sirf usmein lage GOLD ki purity (e.g. 22K916) batata hai—andar bhari Laakh (wax) aur Stones ka wajan alag hota hai!

cards.title: White Gold aur Rose Gold ka Raaz: White Gold 2 Saal mein Peela Kyun Padta Hai? (Rhodium & Nickel)
cards.hook: Mehengi '18K White Gold' diamond ring 1–2 saal mein neeche se halki peeli dikhne lagti hai, aur kuch logon ko kaan-ungli mein khujli kyun hoti hai?
cards.illusion: White Gold kudrati taur par chandi/platinum jaisa chamakdaar safed hota hai aur uska rang kabhi nahi badalta.
cards.myth: White Gold 2 saal mein halka peela pad gaya matlab jeweller ne chandi ya peetal par polish kar ke dhokha diya.
cards.reality: Asli White Gold ke andar bhi 75% peela sona hota hai—upari Rhodium polish ghisne par halki peeli jhalak aana normal hai aur 10 min mein re-plate ho jaati hai.

cards.title: Lab-Grown Diamond (CVD) vs Natural Heera: Dono 100% Asli Heere Hain, Par Resale Price ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: ₹1 Lakh ka Natural Diamond ab ₹25,000 mein 'Lab-Grown Diamond' ke naam par mil raha hai—kya ye nakli glass (AD) hai, ya bilkul asli heera? Aur resale ke waqt kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Lab-Grown Diamond bhi American Diamond (CZ) jaisa nakli patthar hai, ya fir Natural Diamond jitna hi resale value deta hai.
cards.myth: Lab-Grown Diamond kuch saal baad American Diamond (CZ) ki tarah dhundhla aur scratched ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Lab-Grown Diamond bhi pure Carbon crystal (Hardness 10) hai—wo zindagi bhar kabhi dhundhla ya scratch nahi hota; sirf uski market supply zyada hone se resale price kam hoti hai.

cards.title: Panna (Emerald) aur Manik (Ruby) Ratna Scam: Dararon mein 'Glass Filling' aur Rang ka Khel!
cards.hook: Jyotish ya shauk ke liye ₹15,000 ka 'Natural Panna / Manik' liya—par kuch mahine baad uski chamak aur rang udan-chhu ho gaya! Stones mein Glass-Filling aur Oil-Dyeing kaise hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Asli patthar ka ratna ekdum kaanch jaisa saaf, bina kisi daag-darar ke aur sasta mil gaya matlab bhagya khul gaya.
cards.myth: Asli Panna (Emerald) andar se bilkul ekdum saaf paani ki tarah spotless hona chahiye.
cards.reality: Bina inclusions wala spotless natural emerald karodon mein ek hota hai—99% saste spotless 'Panna' synthetic glass/hydrothermal stones hote hain.

cards.title: Platinum (PT 950) vs White Gold: Sone se Sasta Hone par Bhi Platinum Jewellery Mehengi Kyun?
cards.hook: Aajkal Platinum ka raw rate sone (Gold) ke aadhe se bhi kam hai (~₹2,800/g vs Gold ₹7,500/g), phir bhi showroom mein Platinum ki ek chhoti ring ₹40,000 ki kyun bikti hai?
cards.illusion: Platinum hamesha sone se 2 guna mehengi dhatu hai, isliye Platinum ring kharidna sone se zyada accha investment hai.
cards.myth: Platinum duniya ki sabse mehengi dhatu hai aur uska bhav hamesha Gold se double hota hai.
cards.reality: Raw Platinum ka rate pichle kai saalon se Gold ke aadhe se bhi kam hai—platinum jewellery high density aur high making/branding charges ki wajah se mehengi milti hai.

cards.title: '1-Gram Gold' aur 'Anti-Tarnish Waterproof Jewellery' Kaali Kyun Padti Hai? Paseene ka Acid Science!
cards.hook: ₹1,500 ka '1-Gram Gold Haar' ya 'Anti-Tarnish Chain' 3 baar pehanne ke baad hi kaali-hari pad gayi—jabki kisi ke haath par wahi chain 2 saal chamakti rehti hai! Aakhir kyun?
cards.illusion: '1-Gram Gold' gahne mein andar 1 gram sona bhara hota hai aur 'Anti-Tarnish' ka matlab wo kabhi kaala nahi padega.
cards.myth: '1-Gram Gold' jewellery mein 1 gram pure sona lagta hai aur sone ki tarah kabhi bhi kaali nahi padti.
cards.reality: Ye sirf ek marketing naam hai—ismien micro-micron electroplating hoti hai jo paseene aur perfume se ghis sakti hai.

cards.title: Steel par Magnet Test ka Ulta Myth: 304 vs 202 vs 430 Steel mein Kaun Non-Magnetic Hai?
cards.hook: Bartan ya Railing ka steel check karne ke liye log jeb se chumbak (magnet) nikaal kar chipkate hain—par kya sasta zang khane wala 202 steel bhi Non-Magnetic hota hai?
cards.illusion: Jis steel par magnet na chipke wo 100% pure 304 surgical-grade stainless steel hai, aur jispar magnet chipke wo nakli loha hai.
cards.myth: Magnet na chipakna 304 Stainless Steel ki 100% guarantee hai.
cards.reality: Sasta 202 aur 201 steel bhi non-magnetic hota hai, aur asli Induction 430 steel magnetic hota hai—isliye sirf magnet test kafi nahi hai.

cards.title: Tri-Ply Steel Bartan vs Sasta 'Capsule Bottom': Kadhai Beech se Jalne aur Phoolne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: ₹800 wali 'Heavy Bottom' steel kadhai mein niche ek alag plate chipki hoti hai jo 1 saal mein phool kar aawaz karne lagti hai—jabki ₹2,500 wali Tri-Ply kadhai mein aisa kyun nahi hota?
cards.illusion: Jis bhi steel kadhai ke tale par moti steel ki plate lagi dikhe wo Tri-Ply cookware hi hoti hai.
cards.myth: Tri-Ply bartan mein Aluminium beech mein hone se aluminium khane mein ghul jaata hai.
cards.reality: Aluminium core poori tarah do Stainless Steel paraton ke beech band hota hai—khane se sirf 304 Steel hi touch hota hai, 0% aluminium contact!

cards.title: Duplicate Pressure Cooker aur Safety Valve: ₹500 Saste Cooker ke Phatne ka Physics!
cards.hook: Mele ya footpath se ₹500 ka sasta bina-ISI pressure cooker ya ₹20 ki duplicate Rubber/Safety Valve lagwane par rasoi mein cooker blast kyun hote hain?
cards.illusion: Pressure cooker toh bas bhaap rokne ka dabba hai, sasta aur branded sab ek hi tarah kaam karte hain.
cards.myth: Sabhi ₹20 wale safety valves aur rubber rings ek hi metal/rubber ki hoti hain, brand lena paisa waste hai.
cards.reality: Duplicate safety valves ka melting alloy galat hota hai aur high pressure par fuse hi nahi hote—jisse cooker phat sakta hai!

cards.title: Gas Stove ka Peela Burner: Asli Brass (Pital) hai ya Sasta Peela Paint Kiya Lohe/Cast-Iron ka Burner?
cards.hook: Naya gas chulha kharidte waqt dukandar chamakdaar peela burner dikha kar '100% Pure Brass Burner' bolkar bech deta hai—par 3 mahine mein wahi peela rang chhil kar neeche se kaala loha aur zang kyun nikalta hai?
cards.illusion: Har chamakdaar peele/sunehre rang ka gas burner asli Pital (Brass) ka hota hai.
cards.myth: Chulhe ke bartan kaale hone ki wajah sirf kharab LPG gas cylinder hota hai.
cards.reality: 90% baar bartan kaale hone ki wajah burner ke chhedon ka mail se band hona ya kharab burner mixing tube (jisse peeli incomplete flame aati hai) hota hai!

cards.title: Gas Chulhe ka Kaala Plastic Pipe vs Orange 'Suraksha Steel-Mesh' Pipe: 5 Saal Expiry Rule!
cards.hook: Ghar ke gas cylinder aur chulhe ke beech laga pipe log 15 saal tak nahi badalte—aur kai gharon mein ab bhi sasta kaala/neela plastic pipe laga hai jise chuha 2 minute mein kaat sakta hai!
cards.illusion: Gas ka pipe jab tak phat kar gas na chhode tab tak use badalne ki koi zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.myth: Kaala ya hara mota PVC pipe bhi bilkul Suraksha pipe jaisa hi mazboot hota hai.
cards.reality: Normal PVC/rubber pipes mein steel wire jaali nahi hoti—wo chuhe se turant kat jaate hain aur LPG chemicals se andar se crack ho jaate hain.

cards.title: Gas Cylinder Leak Check ke Liye Matchstick Jalana Khatarnak! Sabun ke Jhaag (Soap Foam) ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Naya cylinder lagate hi kuch log leak check karne ke liye regulator ke paas machis ki teeli ya lighter jala kar dekhte hain—ye jaanlewa galti kaise rocket fire bana sakti hai, aur sahi test kya hai?
cards.illusion: Naye cylinder mein thodi gas smell aa rahi hai to machis jala kar dekh lete hain ki gas kahan se nikal rahi hai.
cards.myth: Cylinder ki smell aane par pankha ya exhaust fan ka switch dabakar chala dena chahiye taaki gas bahar nikle.
cards.reality: Switch ON/OFF karte waqt andar chhoti si bijli ki chingari (spark) nikalti hai jo bhari LPG gas mein aag laga sakti hai! Pehle khidki-darwaze haath se kholein, bijli ke switches bilkul na chhooyein!

cards.title: ₹200 ka Machhar Maarne Wala Racket 2 Mahine mein Dead Kyun? Sasti Lead-Acid vs Lithium Battery Scam!
cards.hook: Sadak ya dukaan se ₹180–₹250 wala rechargeable mosquito racket kharidne ke 60 din baad hi uski charging 2 minute bhi nahi tikti—jabki ₹400 wala branded racket 3 saal kaise chalta hai?
cards.illusion: Saare machhar maarne wale rackets ek hi battery aur circuit se bante hain, sasta lena samajhdari hai.
cards.myth: Mosquito racket ko raat bhar 8–10 ghante charge karne par hi usmein full power aati hai.
cards.reality: Saste rackets mein auto-cutoff nahi hota—2–3 ghante se zyada charge par rakhne se sasti battery overcharge hokar aur jaldi mar jaati hai.

cards.title: ₹150 ke Extension Board par Heater, Press ya Kettle Chalana: Patla Wire Pighal kar Aag Lagane ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Sardiyon mein hum ₹150 wale extension board mein Room Heater ya Electric Kettle laga dete hain—par kuch minute mein hi plug garam hokar pighal kyun jaata hai aur shart-circuit aag kaise lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Har 3-pin extension board mein jab plug fit ho jaata hai, to usmein koi bhi bijli ka saman chalaya jaa sakta hai.
cards.myth: Extension board mein 2000W wala plug fit ho raha hai aur red switch ON hai to koi dikkat nahi.
cards.reality: Saste boards par 'Max 2500W' sirf jhootha print hota hai—andar ke patle wire aur brass strips 1000W+ par pighal kar aag laga sakte hain.

cards.title: Duplicate MCB aur Switch Scam: Short Circuit par Trip Na Hone se Ghar mein Aag Kyun Lagti Hai?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein bade brand (reputed BIS-marked electrical brands) ke naam aur bilkul same box mein aadhe daam par duplicate MCB bikti hai—par jab ghar mein short circuit hota hai to wo trip hi nahi hoti!
cards.illusion: Dukaan par MCB par bade brand ka naam aur ISI mark chhapa hai, to wo bilkul asli aur safe hi hogi.
cards.myth: Agar baar-baar MCB gir rahi hai to uski jagah badi 32A ya 40A ki MCB lagwa dene se samasya khatam ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Badi MCB lagane se tripping band nahi hoti—ulta fault aane par wire pighal kar aag lag jayegi par MCB bijli nahi kategi! Fault check karwana zaroori hai.

cards.title: Patle Wire par AC ya Submersible Motor Chalana: 'Voltage Drop' se Motor Jalne aur Bill Badhne ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Makaan banwate waqt saste contractor ne AC aur Submersible pump ke liye 1.5 sq mm ka patla wire daal diya—ab motor baar-baar garam hokar jal rahi hai aur voltage 180V dikhata hai! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Wire toh bijli pahunchane ka rasta hai—jab tak wire toota nahi, patle aur mote wire mein bijli ek barabar hi jaati hai.
cards.myth: 1.5 sq mm wire par bhi 1.5 Ton AC aur Geyser ek saath aaram se chal sakta hai jab tak wire naya hai.
cards.reality: 1.5 sq mm ki safe capacity ~12–14A hoti hai—AC + Geyser chalane par wire overheat hokar concealed pipe mein aag laga sakta hai.

cards.title: Saste 'Square Wave' Inverter par Pankhe ki 'Hummm' Aawaz aur Fridge/TV Jalna: Pure Sine Wave ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Light jaate hi jab inverter chalu hota hai, to ghar ke pankhe aur tubelight mein se 'hummm / bhinn...' ki ajeeb aawaz aane lagti hai aur Wi-Fi/TV restart hone lagta hai—ye kis inverter ki galti hai?
cards.illusion: Saare ghar ke inverters bijli jaane par ek hi jaisi 220V bijli dete hain, sasta Square Wave aur mehenga Sine Wave ek hi hai.
cards.myth: 'Digital Inverter' likha hai matlab wo Pure Sine Wave hi hota hai.
cards.reality: Kai brands saste Square-Wave models par 'Digital / Microprocessor Inverter' likh dete hain—hamesha exact shabd **'Pure Sine Wave'** padh kar hi kharidein.

cards.title: Sasti Local Car / Inverter Battery Scam: Purana Recycled Lead aur Kam Plates se 6 Mahine mein Dead!
cards.hook: ₹14,000 ki branded inverter battery ke saamne local market mein ₹7,500 mein 'Heavy Duty 150Ah' battery mil jaati hai—par 8 mahine mein hi wo sirf 20 minute backup dene lagti hai! Andar kya khel hota hai?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par 150Ah likha hai aur wajan bhi bhari hai, to local assembled battery bhi branded battery jitni hi chalegi.
cards.myth: '60 Months Warranty' likhi hai matlab 5 saal ke andar kabhi bhi kharab hui to 100% free nayi battery milegi.
cards.reality: Aksar pehle 24 ya 36 mahine hi 100% Free Replacement hote hain—baaki mahine Pro-Rata (discount) hote hain jismein aapko aadhe se zyada naya paisa dena padta hai!

cards.title: ₹10 Wala Zinc-Carbon Cell vs ₹40 Wala Alkaline Cell: BP Machine aur Remote mein Kaun Kab Lagayein?
cards.hook: TV Remote, Wall Clock aur Digital BP Machine mein log ₹10 wale saste lal/neele cell daal dete hain—par BP Machine mein saste cell daalne par machine 3 din mein error dekar leak kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Saare AA aur AAA pencil cells andar se ek hi bijli (1.5V) dete hain, sasta ₹10 wala cell lagana hamesha samajhdari hai.
cards.myth: ₹10 wala cell aur ₹40 wala Alkaline cell dono 1.5V ke hain isliye dono bilkul ek hi jitni der chalte hain.
cards.reality: High-drain devices (BP machine, toys, motor) mein Alkaline cell Zinc-Carbon se 5–7 guna zyada chalta hai aur leakage kam karta hai.

cards.title: RO Salesman ka 'Electrolysis Kala Paani' Jhootha Demo Scam: Ghar ke Nal ka Paani Zeherila Kaise Dikhate Hain?
cards.hook: Ghar par RO bechne aaye salesman ne do glass mein paani liya—RO paani saaf raha par aapke nal ke paani mein bijli ki rod daalte hi wo kaala-hara keechad ban gaya! Is jadoo ka vigyan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Electrolysis test mein nal ka paani kaala-bhoora ho gaya matlab usmein zeherila kachra aur gandagi bhari hai, aur RO paani bilkul pure hai.
cards.myth: Electrolysis rod se paani kaala-hara hona saboot hai ki nal ke paani mein bacteria aur poison bhara hai.
cards.reality: Wo kaala-hara rang paani ke normal minerals ki wajah se machine ki lohe/aluminium rod ke ghulne (oxidation) se banta hai—ye bacteria ya zeher test nahi karta!

cards.title: Train aur Bus Station par Nakli Packaged Water Bottle Scam: Bina Seal Tode Dhokha Kaise Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Train khidki se ₹20 ki thandi bottle li, dhakkan par plastic seal bhi intact thi—par pite hi paani mein tap water jaisa ajeeb swad aaya! Band bottle mein ganda paani kaise bhar dete hain?
cards.illusion: Jab tak bottle ke dhakkan ki plastic ring seal band hai aur bottle thandi hai, andar ka paani 100% factory seal-pack hi hai.
cards.myth: Bottle bilkul barf jaisi thandi aur band dikh rahi hai to station par wo 100% asli company ki hi hogi.
cards.reality: Duplicate lookalike aur refilled bottles ko bhi ice-box mein thanda karke becha jaata hai—spelling, ISI mark aur cap-snap check zaroori hai.

cards.title: ₹1,200 wale 'First-Copy' Branded Running Shoes: Nakli Sole se Edi aur Ghutne mein Dard Kyun?
cards.hook: ₹8,000 wale Nike/Adidas shoes bilkul same design mein ₹1,200 mein 'First Copy / 7A Quality' bolkar mil jaate hain—par 1 mahina chalte hi edi (heel) aur kamar mein dard kyun shuru hota hai?
cards.illusion: First-copy shoes dekhne mein 100% original jaise hain, to chalne-daudne mein bhi bilkul wahi aaram denge.
cards.myth: First-copy/7A shoes original factory se hi bina tax ke chori se aate hain isliye quality 100% wahi hoti hai.
cards.reality: '7A/First Copy' ek wholesale marketing term hai—ye local sweatshops mein saste recycled plastic soles aur low-grade glue se bante hain.

cards.title: Sasta 'Orthopedic Memory Foam' Gadda 6 Mahine mein Beech se Kyun Dhas Jaata Hai? (Foam Density Scam)
cards.hook: Online ₹6,000 mein '10-Year Warranty Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress' kharida—par 8 mahine mein hi beech mein gaddha pad gaya aur kamar dard badh gaya! Memory foam mein kaun sa number chhupaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Jis gadde par 'Orthopedic' aur 'Memory Foam' likha ho, wo 10 saal tak kamar ko sahi rakhega aur kabhi nahi dhasega.
cards.myth: Jitna zyada naram (soft) ya jitna zyada patthar jaisa sakht gadda ho, kamar dard ke liye utna hi best hai.
cards.reality: Bahut naram gadde mein kamar dhas jaati hai aur bahut patthar-jaisi sakht satah par kandhe-kamar par dabav padta hai—**Medium-Firm** high-density support spine ke liye best hota hai.

cards.title: Natural Latex vs Synthetic Foam vs Coir Gadda: '100% Natural Latex' mein Rubber Milawat Kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Thandak aur kamar ke liye log ₹35,000 ka '100% Natural Latex Mattress' le aate hain—par saste ₹12,000 wale 'Latex' mein sirf 20% latex aur 80% petrol-foam (SBR) kaise nikalta hai?
cards.illusion: Jis bhi gadde par 'Natural Latex' likha ho aur usmein gol chhed (pin-cores) bane hon, wo 100% ped ke doodh (rubber sap) se bana hota hai.
cards.myth: Har chhed-wale (pin-core) white foam ko '100% Natural Latex' kehte hain.
cards.reality: Synthetic SBR latex aur yahan tak ki saste PU foam mein bhi machine se gol pin-core chhed bana diye jaate hain—bina GOLS/ECO-Institut certification ke 100% natural nahi maana jaa sakta.

cards.title: Sasta Takiya (Pillow) 2 Mahine mein Chapta Kyun Ho Jaata Hai? Recycled Katran vs Microfiber
cards.hook: Sadak ya sale se ₹150 wala fluffy takiya laaye the—par 1 mahine mein hi wo patthar jaisa sakht aur chapta ho kar gardan mein dard dene laga! Andar kya bhara hota hai?
cards.illusion: Naya takiya dekhne mein phoola hua aur naram hai, matlab andar shuddh ruyi ya achcha fiber bhara hai.
cards.myth: Ek baar takiya kharid liya to usse 8–10 saal tak bina badle chalaya jaa sakta hai.
cards.reality: 2 saal mein ek unwashed takiye ka wajan paseene, dead skin aur dust-mite waste se badh jaata hai aur uska neck support khatam ho jaata hai.

cards.title: Bedsheet mein '1000 Thread Count' ka Marketing Scam: Multi-Ply Polyester se Garmi Kyun Lagti Hai?
cards.hook: Online ₹600 mein '1000 TC Luxury Pure Cotton Bedsheet' kharidi—par uspar sote hi peeth par garmi, paseena aur bijli ke jhatke (static) kyun lagte hain?
cards.illusion: Jitna bada Thread Count (TC) number (jaise 800 TC ya 1000 TC) likha hoga, bedsheet utni hi zyada soft aur pure cotton ki hogi.
cards.myth: 'Glace Cotton' ek special silky aur thandi variety ka pure cotton hota hai.
cards.reality: Glace Cotton aur Micro-Cotton sirf marketing terms hain—ye 100% synthetic polyester/poly-blend hota hai jo garmi rokta hai.

cards.title: Naya Fluffy Towel Paani Kyun Nahi Sokhta? GSM Weight, Silicone Coating aur Polyester Mix!
cards.hook: Mehenga naya hotel-jaisa mota towel kharid kar nahane ke baad pochha, to sharir ka paani towel mein sokhne ke bajaye bas skin par idhar-udhar phisal raha hai! Aisa kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada mota, chamakdaar aur makkhan jaisa naram towel dukaan mein lagega, wo utna hi zyada paani sokhega.
cards.myth: Microfiber bath towel 100% cotton towel se zyada healthy aur luxury hota hai.
cards.reality: Microfiber (80% Polyester + 20% Polyamide) hair-drying aur car/glass saaf karne mein accha hai kyunki jaldi sukhta hai, par daily body drying mein 100% Cotton ki natural feel aur breathability alag hoti hai.

cards.title: Stretchable Jeans 4 Wash mein Dheeli Kyun Pad Jaati Hai? Elastane aur Garam Paani ka Science!
cards.hook: ₹2,000 ki fitting wali stretchable jeans kharidi thi, par kuch wash aur dhoop ke baad hi ghutno aur kamar se bori jaisi dheeli pad gayi—kaun sa elastic dhaaga toot gaya?
cards.illusion: Har jeans mein 2% stretch hamesha waisa hi rehta hai, bas zyada pehanne se thodi loose hoti hai.
cards.myth: Jeans ko har pehanne ke baad garam paani aur fabric softener se dhona usse soft aur fit rakhta hai.
cards.reality: Garam paani aur softener elastane fibers ko tod kar jeans ko hamesha ke liye dheela aur wavy kar dete hain.

cards.title: ₹700 mein '100% Pure Linen Shirt' ka Dhokha: Asli Linen vs Sasta Cotton-Slub aur Polyester!
cards.hook: Garmiyon mein thandak ke liye log ₹600–₹800 mein 'Pure Linen' kurta/shirt kharid lete hain—par asli Linen to ₹2,000+ ka aata hai! Saste 'Linen' mein kaun sa kapda chhupa hota hai?
cards.illusion: Jis kapde mein moti-patli lines (slub texture) dikh rahi hon aur tag par 'Linen' likha ho, wo asli Linen hi hota hai.
cards.myth: Wrinkle-free rehne wala 'Pure Linen' hi sabse achchi aur mehengi quality ka linen hota hai.
cards.reality: Pure Flax Linen ka kudrati gun hi wrinkle hona hai—agar 'Linen' bilkul wrinkle-free hai to usmein Polyester ya chemical resin mila hai!

cards.title: Naya Waterproof Raincoat Silai se Paani Kyun Tapakne Lagta Hai? 'Seam Sealing Tape' ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Baarish mein ₹1,500 ka waterproof jacket/raincoat pehan kar nikle, par 15 minute baad kandhon aur bagal se kapde andar se geelay ho gaye—kapda waterproof tha to paani andar kahan se aaya?
cards.illusion: Agar raincoat ka kapda PVC/Polyester waterproof hai, to baarish ka paani kisi bhi halat mein andar nahi aa sakta.
cards.myth: Agar kapda paani nahi sokhta (Water-repellent DWR spray hai), to wo poori baarish mein bhi waterproof rahega.
cards.reality: DWR sirf upari boondein phislane ki coating hoti hai jo kuch washes mein utar jaati hai—asli waterproofing ke liye andar membrane/PVC aur **Seam Sealing Tape** zaroori hoti hai.

cards.title: Naye Ghar ka 'Sagwan Polish' Darwaza: Andar Asli Lakdi hai ya Khokhla Pine/Cardboard Flush Door?
cards.hook: Builder ya carpenter ne ghar mein ₹12,000 ka chamakdaar Sagwan (Teak) jaisa main door lagaya—par 1 saal baad darwaza geela hokar neeche se phool gaya aur lagne par khokhla bajta hai! Andar kya hai?
cards.illusion: Darwaze ke upar sundar Sagwan ki nash (wood grain) dikh rahi hai aur polish chamak rahi hai, matlab ye poora solid Teak lakdi ka bana hai.
cards.myth: Bathroom ke wooden door par waterproof paint/varnish kar dene se wo kabhi paani se nahi phoolta.
cards.reality: Darwaze ke bilkul neeche aur handle ke chhed se nami andar chali jaati hai—bathroom ke liye WPC/FRP hi permanent solution hai.

cards.title: Kitchen Cabinets mein MR Plywood vs BWP (710 Grade): 1 Saal mein Almari Phoolne ka Asli Raaz!
cards.hook: Modular kitchen banwate waqt carpenter ne 'Waterproof Ply' bol kar sasta Commercial (MR) plywood laga diya—ab sink ke neeche poori almari 1 saal mein hi papdi bankar phool gayi! IS-710 ka sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Har achche brand ka Plywood waterproof hota hai, upar Laminate (Sunmica) lagne ke baad andar paani nahi jaata.
cards.myth: Plywood par Sunmica (Laminate) chipka dene ke baad andar MR ply ho ya BWP, koi farq nahi padta.
cards.reality: Nami aur paani Sunmica ke jodon, screw holes aur kinaron se andar ghusta hai—MR ply phool jaata hai jabki BWP 710 nahi phoolta.

cards.title: Kaale Granite par Wax aur Black Dye Polish ka Dhokha: Kitchen Slab par Nimbu-Haldi se Daag Kyun?
cards.hook: Kitchen platform ke liye chamakdaar jet-black 'Galaxy/Black Granite' lagwaya tha—par 2 mahine mein pochha lagate hi wo bhoora/grey pad gaya aur ruyi par kaala rang aa raha hai! Ye kaun sa scam hai?
cards.illusion: Patthar ki dukaan par jitna gehra kaala aur chamakdaar granite dikhta hai, wo utna hi asli natural black granite hai.
cards.myth: Granite ek patthar hai isliye uspe kabhi rang ya polish ka fraud ho hi nahi sakta.
cards.reality: Stone yards mein saste grey granite par chemical black dye aur wax coating lagana ek bahut common scam hai—Acetone test turant pakad leta hai.

cards.title: Italian Marble ka Raaz: Chhed-Dararon mein 'Epoxy Resin' aur Haldi-Nimbu se Ghalne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: ₹400/sq ft ka mehenga Italian Marble ghar mein lagwaya—par 1 boond nimbu ya harpic girte hi chamak gayab ho gayi aur neeche se patthar kachcha kyun dikhne laga?
cards.illusion: Mehenga Italian Marble Granite se bhi zyada mazboot aur stain-proof hota hai isliye kitchen aur bathroom ke liye sabse best hai.
cards.myth: Italian Marble ₹400–₹800/sq ft aata hai isliye wo Granite se zyada sakht aur kitchen ke liye best hota hai.
cards.reality: Italian Marble Granite se naram, zyada porous aur acid-sensitive hota hai—kitchen counter ke liye Granite hi sabse mazboot hota hai!

cards.title: Chamakdaar Chrome Nal (Tap) 6 Mahine mein Toot kar Safed Powder Kyun Banta Hai? (Brass vs Zinc Alloy)
cards.hook: ₹250 wala chamakdaar heavy bathroom nal kharida tha—par 6 mahine baad hi uska handle haath mein toot kar aa gaya aur andar se safed-grey mitti jaisa powder nikla! Andar kaun si sasti dhatu thi?
cards.illusion: Jo bhi bathroom nal chandi jaisa chamakdaar aur bhari hai, wo andar se mazboot pital (Brass) ya steel ka hi hota hai.
cards.myth: Bhari aur chandi jaisa chamakne wala har metal nal solid steel ya pital ka hota hai.
cards.reality: Zinc Alloy bhi bhari hota hai aur chrome plating se bilkul steel/brass jaisa chamakta hai—par khare paani mein kuch mahine mein andar se gal kar toot jaata hai.

cards.title: Bathroom ki Tiles par Tezaab (Hydrochloric Acid) Daalne se Chamak aur Grout Galne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Khare paani ke safed dhabbe saaf karne ke liye log bathroom mein ₹30 wali tezaab ki bottle udel dete hain—par kuch mahine baad tiles ka glaze gayab hokar khurdura aur cement kyun nikal aata hai?
cards.illusion: Bathroom mein tezaab (Acid) daalne se tiles bilkul chamakdaar aur bacteria-free saaf ho jaati hain.
cards.myth: Harpic aur Bleach (Ala) ko ek sath mila kar dhone se double safai hoti hai.
cards.reality: Harpic (Hydrochloric acid) + Bleach (Sodium Hypochlorite) milte hi **Chlorine Gas** banate hain jo hospital emergencies ka ek bada kaaran hai!

cards.title: Geyser ke Garam Paani mein Thande Paani Wala uPVC Pipe Lagana: Deewar ke Andar Pipe Pighalne ka Risk!
cards.hook: Makaan banwate waqt plumber ne geyser aur bathroom ke andar sab jagah sasta safed uPVC pipe daba diya—par 60°C garam paani chalte hi pipe naram pad kar joint se leak kyun karne lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Safed uPVC aur cream CPVC dono ek hi plastic pipes hain, sasta uPVC pipe geyser mein bhi aaram se chal jaata hai.
cards.myth: Mota uPVC (Schedule 40/80) pipe bhi geyser ke garam paani ke liye CPVC jitna hi safe hai.
cards.reality: Mota hone se uPVC ka chemical melting/softening point nahi badalta—60°C+ geyser temperature ke liye sirf CPVC (93°C rated) hi safe hai.

cards.title: Chhat ki Paani Tanki: '7-Layer / 10-Layer Tank' ka Jhooth vs Virgin Food-Grade LLDPE!
cards.hook: Market mein ₹4/litre mein '5-Layer / 7-Layer Anti-Bacterial Tank' bik rahi hai—par chhat par 45°C dhoop mein ye 3 saal mein hi papdi bankar crack kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Tanki par jitni zyada layers (5, 7, 10 layer) likhi hongi, wo utni hi mazboot aur paani ko thanda rakhne wali hogi.
cards.myth: 7-Layer ya 10-Layer tanki 3-Layer branded tanki se double mazboot hoti hai.
cards.reality: Layers ka number sirf ek marketing gimmick hai—asli mazbooti Virgin LLDPE, wall thickness (weight per 1000L ~38–42 kg) aur UV protection se aati hai.

cards.title: Laal Eent (Red Brick) vs Fly-Ash Grey Eent: Deewar par Safed Namak (Shora) aur Seelan ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Makaan banwate waqt log ab bhi paramparik Laal Eent lagwate hain—par 2 saal baad niche ki deewaron par safed namak (Shora) ugal kar poora paint kyun gir jaata hai, aur Fly-Ash brick mein kya farq hai?
cards.illusion: Laal mitti ki eent hamesha sabse mazboot hoti hai, jabki grey Fly-Ash eent sirf sasti rakh se bani kamzor eent hai.
cards.myth: Grey Fly-Ash eent sirf sasti rakh hoti hai aur 10 saal mein gal kar gir jaati hai.
cards.reality: Properly cured IS 12894 Fly-Ash bricks mein cement pozzolanic reaction se samay ke sath strength aur badhti hai aur unmein shora/seelan bhi kam hota hai.

cards.title: Makaan ki Baalu (Ret/Sand) mein Mitti Milawat: 1 Glass Paani Test se Lenter Kamzor Hone se Bachayein!
cards.hook: Chhat ka lenter dalwate waqt trolley mein aayi baalu mein agar 15% mitti ya chikni gaad mili ho, to sabse mehenga cement aur sariya bhi kamzor pad jaata hai! 10-minute ka bottle test kya hai?
cards.illusion: Nadi se aayi peeli ya kaali baalu sab ek jaisi hoti hai, usmein thodi mitti rehne se cement aur zyada chipakta hai.
cards.myth: Thodi chikni mitti wali baalu cement ke sath milkar zyada chikna aur mazboot plaster banati hai.
cards.reality: Chikni mitti (clay/silt) cement aur sand ke beech ka bond tod deti hai—mazboot plaster aur concrete ke liye silt-free washed sand hi zaroori hai.

cards.title: Deewar par Putty Papdi Bankar Kyun Girta Hai? Chalk-POP Putty vs White-Cement Wall Putty!
cards.hook: Diwali par naya paint karwaya tha, par 6 mahine mein hi deewar ki putty aur paint chhilke bankar girne lage—mistry ne sasta POP/Chalk putty lagaya ya geeli deewar par putty kar di?
cards.illusion: Har safed wall putty ek hi hoti hai aur putty lagane se deewar ki seelan hamesha ke liye band ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Deewar par 2 coat putty aur mehnga waterproof paint kar dene se deewar ki seelan andar hi dab jaati hai.
cards.reality: Paani ka pressure putty aur paint dono ko phula kar gira deta hai—seelan ko pehle leakage source ya breathable crystalline waterproofing se rokna padta hai.

cards.title: Khidki ki Machhar Jaali: Nylon/Velcro vs Fiberglass vs Stainless Steel 304 — Dhoop mein Kaun Tut-ti Hai?
cards.hook: Online ₹250 wali Velcro machhar jaali lagwayi thi, par 1 garmi ki tez dhoop mein hi wo haath lagate hi ruyi jaisi phat gayi! Khidki ke liye kaun si jaali best hai?
cards.illusion: Saari mosquito nets (Nylon, Fiberglass, Steel) ek hi tarah bas machhar rokti hain, sasti Velcro jaali hi best hai.
cards.myth: Kaali powder-coated steel mesh kamre mein zyada andhera aur garmi kar deti hai, silver steel zyada saaf dikhta hai.
cards.reality: Ulta hota hai! Kaali mesh roshni ko reflect nahi karti isliye bahar ka view aankhon ko bilkul invisible (crystal clear) dikhta hai, jabki silver mesh dhoop mein chamak kar view block karti hai.

cards.title: Bathroom ka Sheesha (Mirror) Kinaron se Kaala Kyun Padta Hai? 'Copper-Free Mirror' ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Naya ₹2,500 ka bathroom mirror lagwaya tha, par 1 saal mein hi uske kinaron par kaale-bhooray gande dhabbe (Desilvering) aa gaye—mirror kaise banta hai aur kaunsa sheesha kaala nahi padta?
cards.illusion: Bathroom ka sheesha sasta ho ya mehenga, bhaap aur paani se saare sheeshe 1–2 saal mein kinaron se kaale pad hi jaate hain.
cards.myth: Sheeshe ke peeche kaala daag sirf upar se paani lagne se lagta hai aur glass cleaner se ghis kar saaf ho sakta hai.
cards.reality: Wo kaala daag sheeshe ke PEECHE ki silver coating galne (oxidation) se hota hai—upar se ghiskar kabhi saaf nahi ho sakta.

cards.title: Ghar ka Taala (Padlock): Sasta Zinc Taala Ek Hathode mein Kyun Toot-ta Hai? Hardened Steel Shackle!
cards.hook: Ghar ya dukaan par lagane ke liye ₹150 ka bhari chamakdaar taala le aaye—par chor ne sirf ek pechkas/hathode se 5 second mein tod diya! Asli surakshit taale ki pehchan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Jo taala dekhne mein bada aur haath mein bhari ho, use todna namumkin hota hai.
cards.myth: Bada aur bhari taala lagane se use koi cutter ya hathoda tod nahi sakta.
cards.reality: Bade saste taalon mein Zinc body aur naram mild-steel shackle hota hai jo 10 second mein kat jaata hai—size se zyada Hardened Shackle aur Double-Ball Locking zaroori hai.

cards.title: Car ke Sheeshon par Black Tint Film vs Clear Heat-Rejection Film: Supreme Court ka VLT Kanoon!
cards.hook: May-June ki 45°C garmi mein car ko thanda rakhne ke liye log kaali 'Sun Control Film' lagwa lete hain aur ₹1,000 challan katwate hain—par bilkul paani jaisi saaf (Clear) UV/IR film garmi kaise rokti hai?
cards.illusion: Sirf gehri kaali (dark black) film hi garmi aur dhoop ko car ke andar aane se rok sakti hai.
cards.myth: Agar kaali film mein 50% visibility likhi hai to traffic police challan nahi kaat sakti.
cards.reality: Supreme Court ke aadesh ke baad kisi bhi dark aftermarket film par kai states mein zero-tolerance challan hota hai—sirf factory-manufactured VLT-compliant glass hi har jagah 100% valid hai.

cards.title: ₹25,000 ki Car 'Ceramic Coating' vs ₹500 Wax: Kya Ceramic Sachmuch 'Scratch-Proof' Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Car showroom aur detailing shops par ₹25,000–₹40,000 ki '9H Ceramic Coating' bechte waqt kehte hain 'Ispar chaabi se bhi scratch nahi padega aur kabhi dhona nahi padega'—asli chemistry kya hai?
cards.illusion: 9H Ceramic Coating lagwane ke baad car ke paint par patthar, brush ya chaabi se kabhi scratch nahi padta.
cards.myth: 9H Ceramic Coating karwane ke baad car scratch-proof aur dhool-proof ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: 2-micron ceramic coating sirf gloss aur easy wash deti hai—ye key scratches, stone chips ya gande dhool wale kapde se hone wale swirls nahi rok sakti.

cards.title: Bike ki Chain par Jala Hua Engine Oil Lagana: Saste Jugaad se Chain aur O-Ring Rubber Kaise Sadte Hain?
cards.hook: Service ya petrol pump par log bike/bullet ki chain par ₹20 mein purana kaala jala engine oil daal dete hain—par kuch mahine mein hi chain awaaz kar ke dheeli kyun pad jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Kaala purana engine oil chain ko bilkul free chikna kar deta hai aur mehenge chain lube spray ki koi zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: Mechanic ke paas bacha hua kaala engine oil ya chain ko petrol se dhona sabse best maintenance hai.
cards.reality: Burnt oil mein metal grit aur acids hote hain aur petrol O-ring rubber ko kha jaata hai—dono chain ki life aadhi kar dete hain.

cards.title: Normal Bike/Car mein Mehenga '95-Octane Power Petrol' Bharwana: Mileage Badhta Hai ya Paise Waste?
cards.hook: Petrol pump wale bhaiya bolte hain 'Sir ₹108 wala High-Octane (95) Petrol bharwao, engine tez bhagega aur 5 km zyada mileage milega!' Kya normal commuter bike, scooter ya hatchback mein mehenga petrol kuch fayda karta hai?
cards.illusion: Mehenga High-Octane Power Petrol har gaadi aur scooter ka mileage aur pickup badha deta hai.
cards.myth: 95-Octane Power Petrol zyada shuddh hota hai aur aam commuter scooter/bike ko 15% zyada mileage deta hai.
cards.reality: High-octane petrol mein zyada energy nahi hoti—wo sirf high-compression/turbo engines mein knocking rokne ke liye hota hai.

cards.title: Roz DC Fast Charging se EV Car/Scooter Battery Jaldi Kyun Ghis-ti Hai? Home Slow AC ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Highway ke tez DC Fast Charger par EV 40 minute mein charge ho jaati hai, par roz-roz fast charger use karne par 3 saal mein battery ki range 15% kam kyun ho sakti hai?
cards.illusion: EV bani hi fast charging ke liye hai, isliye ghar par charge karne aur roz DC fast charger lagane mein battery par ek hi asar padta hai.
cards.myth: Public DC Fast Charger use karne se EV battery 1 saal mein hi kharab hokar badalni padti hai.
cards.reality: Liquid-cooled modern EV batteries kabhi-kabhar ya trips par DC fast charging aaram se jhel leti hain—sirf rozana exclusively DC fast charging se bach kar ghar par slow AC charge karna best hota hai.

cards.title: Sasta ₹80 wala Green Car Coolant: Asli Ethylene Glycol Nahi, Sirf Paani + Hara Rang! Radiator Galna
cards.hook: Highway dhabe ya local dukan par ₹80 mein 1 litre hara 'Car Coolant' milta hai—par usse radiator mein dalte hi kuch mahino mein engine garam hokar radiator mein zang aur keechad kaise jam jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har hari ya laal rang ki coolant bottle car ke radiator ko thanda rakhne ke liye ek hi chemical se banti hai.
cards.myth: Har hara coolant ek hi hota hai aur garmiyon mein uski jagah saaf RO paani bhar dena bilkul barabar hai.
cards.reality: Plain water 100°C par ubal kar bhaap bana deta hai aur aluminium radiator ko zang lagata hai—genuine glycol coolant 125°C+ boiling point aur rust protection deta hai.

cards.title: Dhoop mein Khadi Car mein Hanging Gel/Liquid Perfume: Plastic Pighalna aur VOCs Saans mein Jaana!
cards.hook: Car ke AC vent par laga mehenga liquid perfume tapak kar dashboard ka plastic jala deta hai—aur garmiyon mein dhoop mein khadi car mein ye perfumes hawa mein kya chhodte hain?
cards.illusion: Car air fresheners sirf phoolon ki taazgi dete hain aur AC vent par lagana bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Car AC se aane wali badbu ko mehenga liquid vent perfume lagakar hamesha ke liye theek kiya jaa sakta hai.
cards.reality: Badbu AC coil par jame fungus/dhool aur gande cabin filter se aati hai—perfume sirf badbu ko dhabta hai aur liquid leak dashboard jala sakta hai.

cards.title: Car/Bike ka Brake Fluid Kabhi Na Badalne ka Khatra: Paani Sokh kar Brake Fail Hone ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Car ya scooter ka engine oil har saal badalte hain, par 5–6 saal tak Brake Fluid (DOT 3 / DOT 4) koi nahi badalta—aur pahadon se utarte waqt brake pedal achanak floor mein kyun dhas jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Brake oil dabbe mein kam nahi hua aur kaala nahi dikh raha, to usse zindagi bhar badalne ki koi zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: Brake fluid khatam nahi hota isliye jab tak level Max par hai, badalne ki zaroorat nahi.
cards.reality: Brake fluid leak na bhi ho tab bhi 2 saal mein hawa ki nami sokh kar boiling point kho deta hai aur andar se rusting shuru kar deta hai.

cards.title: Car Wiper Blade 1 Monsoon mein Line Kyun Chhodta Hai? Dhoop se Rubber Sakht Hona aur Clean Trick!
cards.hook: Baarish aate hi car ke wiper chalane par sheesha saaf hone ke bajaye dhundhli lines aur 'charr-charr' shor karne lagta hai—naye ₹2,000 wiper lagwane se pehle 1-minute ki asli wajah jaan lein!
cards.illusion: Wiper blade jab tak toot kar latak na jaaye, tab tak wo glass saaf karta rehta hai.
cards.myth: Wiper washer tank mein ghar ka Shampoo, Surf ya Colin bhar dena bilkul safe aur best hota hai.
cards.reality: Shampoo/Detergent mein namak aur chemicals hote hain jo rubber wiper blade ko sakht karte hain, washer pump ko jam karte hain aur car ke paint par daag chhod sakte hain.

cards.title: Tubeless Tyre Puncture: Sasti 'Dori (String Plug)' vs Asli 'Mushroom Patch' — Highway par Blast Risk!
cards.hook: Highway ya shehar mein tubeless tyre puncture hone par roadside mechanic ₹50 mein ek chipchipi bhoori 'dori/strip' ghusa deta hai—par tyres ki companies is dori ko sirf temporary kyun maanti hain?
cards.illusion: Roadside ₹50 wala dori-plug (string plug) bilkul permanent aur highway speed ke liye 100% safe hai.
cards.myth: Tubeless tyre mein 5–6 jagah bhi dori plug lagane ya sidewall patch karne se tyre bilkul naya jaisa safe rehta hai.
cards.reality: Sidewall repair kabhi safe nahi hota, aur har dori plug steel belts ko nuksan aur moisture corrosion ka rasta deta hai—highway cars ke liye Mushroom patch best hai.

cards.title: Normal Car/Bike Headlight mein Tez White LED Bulb Lagana: Samne Wale ko Andha aur Baarish mein Zero Visibility!
cards.hook: Raat ko highway par samne se aati cars ki itni teekhi safed LED roshni aankhon mein chubhti hai ki 3 second kuch dikhta hi nahi—par wo LED lagane wale khud bhi baarish/kohre mein andhe kyun ho jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Purane peele Halogen bulb ko hata kar ₹2,500 ka 100W-150W White LED bulb laga lene se sadak double saaf dikhne lagti hai.
cards.myth: 6500K barf-jaisi safed LED light baarish aur kohre mein bhi peele halogen se zyada door tak dikhati hai.
cards.reality: Physics (Rayleigh Scattering) ke hisab se blue-white 6500K roshni fog aur rain mein sabse zyada scatter hokar glare parda banati hai—4300K Warm/Yellow roshni geeli sadak aur fog mein sabse clear dikhati hai.

cards.title: Local Car/Bike Service Scam: 'Original Box' mein ₹80 wala Duplicate Oil aur Air Filter Chipkana!
cards.hook: Car/bike ki service local workshop par saste mein karayi—mechanic ne 'OEM Genuine' ka box dikha kar filter badal diya, par 2,000 km baad engine kharab kaise ho gaya?
cards.illusion: Mechanic ne company ke logo wale sealed dabbe se filter nikaala hai, to wo 100% genuine spare part hi hai.
cards.myth: Authorized company service centre ke alawa bahar kabhi asli spare parts milte hi nahi, ya local mechanic jo box dikhaye wahi asli hota hai.
cards.reality: Aajkal har company ke official MGP/OEM retail counters bahar bhi hain jahan se aap khud 100% genuine QR-verified parts kharid kar kisi bhi acche mechanic se lagwa sakte hain.

cards.title: Chhat par Solar Panel Scam: Sasta 'Polycrystalline' vs 'Mono-PERC/TOPCon' aur Fake Watt Sticker!
cards.hook: Chhat par ₹15,000 mein '500W Solar Panel' lagwaya tha, par dopahar 12 baje bhi battery ko sirf 150W–200W mil raha hai! Local vendors purane ya fake sticker panels kaise chipkate hain?
cards.illusion: Solar panel par bada '400W / 500W' sticker laga hai aur neela chamakdaar dikh raha hai, matlab wo poori 500W bijli banayega.
cards.myth: Neela Polycrystalline panel Bharat ki garmi mein Mono-PERC kaale panel se zyada accha chalta hai.
cards.reality: Mono-PERC aur N-Type TOPCon ka temperature coefficient behtar hota hai—yani tez garmi aur halke badal dono mein ye Polycrystalline se zyada bijli dete hain.

cards.title: Chhat ka Solar Geyser 2 Saal mein Garam Paani Kyun Band Kar Deta Hai? Hard Water mein ETC Glass vs FPC!
cards.hook: Sardiyon mein bijli bachane ke liye chhat par sasta ₹18,000 wala kaanch ke pipes wala Solar Water Heater lagwaya—par 2 saal mein hi uski pipes mein safed papdi jam kar paani thanda aane laga!
cards.illusion: Saare solar water heaters har shehar ke borewell ya municipal paani mein ek hi tarah 15 saal garam paani dete hain.
cards.myth: Kaanch ke pipes wala ETC solar heater har paani aur pressure pump ke sath bina maintenance 15 saal chalta hai.
cards.reality: High-TDS borewell water ETC glass tubes mein tezi se calcium scale jamata hai aur pressure pump bina heat-pipe ke glass tubes tod sakta hai.

cards.title: Purana 75W Pankha vs 28W BLDC Fan: Bijli Bill Mein Sachmuch Kitni Bachat aur Remote/PCB Kharab Hone ka Sach?
cards.hook: Har koi bol raha hai 'Purane pankhe hata kar BLDC Fan lagao, bijli bill aadha ho jayega!' Par kya ek BLDC pankha sachmuch ₹1,500/saal bachata hai—aur agar uska remote/PCB kharab ho jaaye to kya hoga?
cards.illusion: BLDC pankha bas ek mehenga remote wala shauk ka pankha hai, bijli toh dono barabar hi khate hain.
cards.myth: BLDC pankhe bijli toh bachate hain par purane 75W pankhe jitni tez hawa nahi dete.
cards.reality: Aajkal ke 5-star 28W–32W BLDC fans 225–240 CMM air delivery dete hain jo purane 75W fans (210–230 CMM) ke barabar ya unse zyada tez hawa dete hain.

cards.title: AC Kharidne mein '100% Copper Coil' ka Dhokha: Aluminium Condenser par Sunehra Paint aur Gas Leak!
cards.hook: ₹28,000 mein '1.5 Ton 100% Copper AC' kharida—par 2 garmi baad hi indoor/outdoor coil leak ho gayi aur technician bola 'Ye toh Aluminium coil hai, uspe sirf copper rang ka paint tha!'
cards.illusion: AC ke dabbe par 'Copper' likha hai aur pipe peele-laal dikh rahe hain, matlab andar-bahar dono coils pure copper ki hain.
cards.myth: AC mein har saal garmiyon se pehle gas top-up karwana normal maintenance hota hai.
cards.reality: AC ek band sealed system hai—gas KABHI kharch nahi hoti! Agar gas kam hui hai to uska matlab 100% kahin leak hai—pehle Nitrogen pressure se leak dhoondh kar weld karwayein, tabhi gas bharwayein!

cards.title: 1.5 Ton AC ke Naam par '0.8 Ton' ka Khel: Rated Cooling Capacity (Watts) aur Convertible Mode ka Sach!
cards.hook: Online sale mein ₹26,000 mein '1.5 Ton 5-in-1 Convertible AC' kharida—par may ki dopahar mein wo kamra thanda hi nahi kar paa raha! Spec sheet par 'Cooling Capacity 4500W vs 5200W' ka kya jhol hota hai?
cards.illusion: Har '1.5 Ton' likhe hue AC ki thandak karne ki taakat ek barabar (1.5 Ton) hoti hai.
cards.myth: AC ko 16°C par set karne se kamra 24°C ke mukable double tezi se thanda hota hai.
cards.reality: AC ke muh se hamesha ek hi thandi hawa aati hai—16°C sirf compressor ko bina ruke der tak chalata hai aur bijli bill badhata hai!

cards.title: 'Stabilizer-Free Operation' wale Fridge, TV aur Inverter AC mein Alag Stabilizer Kab Lagana Zaroori Hai?
cards.hook: Naye Inverter AC aur Fridge par bada sticker laga hota hai 'Stabilizer Free Operation (130V–290V)'—phir bhi dukandar ₹3,500 ka alag Stabilizer bech deta hai! Sachmuch kab zaroori hai aur kab paise ki barbadi?
cards.illusion: Ya toh stabilizer kabhi lagana hi nahi chahiye, ya har fridge/TV/AC par mehenga stabilizer lagwana mandatory hai.
cards.myth: 'Stabilizer-Free Operation' ka matlab hai ki appliance 440V jhatke ya aasmani bijli mein bhi kabhi nahi jalega.
cards.reality: Built-in range sirf ~135V–290V ke beech kaam karti hai—300V+ neutral fault surge aur frequent rapid power cuts se bachane ke liye cut-off guard ya stabilizer zaroori hota hai.

cards.title: Bathroom Geyser ka Tank 3 Saal mein Leak Kyun Hota Hai? Magnesium Anode Rod aur Glass-Lined Tank!
cards.hook: ₹8,000 ka storage geyser 3 saal mein hi neeche se paani tapkane laga aur body mein current aane laga—jabki kuch geyser 10 saal chalte hain! Khare paani mein kaun si ek rod geyser ko bachati hai?
cards.illusion: Geyser ka tank andar se steel ka hai isliye wo kabhi zang nahi khata aur kisi service ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.myth: Geyser ka tank andar se Stainless Steel ka hota hai isliye khare paani mein bhi kabhi zang nahi lagta.
cards.reality: High temperature aur chloride salts normal steel weld joints ko bhi corrode kar dete hain—isliye Glass-lined tank aur sacrificial Magnesium Anode Rod zaroori hoti hai.

cards.title: ₹1,500 wale '750W Mixer Grinder' Scam: Aluminium Winding Motor ka Garam Hokar Jalna!
cards.hook: Mele ya online ₹1,500 mein '750W Heavy Duty Mixer Grinder' kharida—par idli-dosa batter ya haldi piste hi 2 minute mein jale hue plastic ki badbu aane lagi aur motor phook gayi! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par '750 Watts Heavy Duty' likha hai, matlab ye mixer haldi-masala aur dosa batter aaram se pees dega.
cards.myth: Mixer ke neeche ka Red Reset Button kharab hone par dabaya jaata hai aur uska matlab motor kharab ho gayi.
cards.reality: Wo Overload Protector safety switch hai—motor zyada garam hone par wo khud jump karke motor ko jalne se bachata hai! 5 minute thanda hone ke baad use dabakar wapas chalu kar sakti hain.

cards.title: ₹1,400 wale Saste Induction Chulhe Jaldi Kyun Phoonkte Hain? Aluminium Coil aur Patla IGBT!
cards.hook: Student hostel ya ghar ke liye ₹1,400 ka sasta Induction cooktop liya tha—par 4 mahine mein hi 'E0 / E3 Error' dekar chulha phoonk gaya aur repair ₹1,000 maangi! Andar kya sasta lagate hain?
cards.illusion: Saare 2000W induction chulhe ek hi tarah bartan garam karte hain, sasta aur branded sab ek hi hai.
cards.myth: Kaam khatam hote hi seedhe board ka main switch band kar dene se bijli bachti hai aur chulha jaldi thanda hota hai.
cards.reality: Main switch turant kaatne se cooling fan ruk jaata hai aur andar 100°C+ garam IGBT heat soak se jaldi phoonk jaata hai!

cards.title: Air Fryer Basket ki Non-Stick Coating Chhilna: Teflon (PTFE) vs Ceramic vs Stainless Steel Truth!
cards.hook: Healthy oil-free khane ke liye ₹6,000 ka Air Fryer liya tha—par 1 saal mein uski kaali jaali aur basket chhilne lagi aur chipchipi ho gayi! Kya ab usmein pakana safe hai?
cards.illusion: Air fryer ki non-stick basket bahut hard hoti hai, usse normal steel juna ya dishwasher mein bhi dho sakte hain.
cards.myth: Air fryer ka basket 'Granite / Scratch-proof' likha hai isliye uspar steel juna ya chammach chalaya jaa sakta hai.
cards.reality: Almost sabhi non-stick coatings metal chimte aur abrasive scrubbers se scratch hoti hain—sirf silicone/wooden tongs aur soft sponge hi use karein.

cards.title: ₹200 wali 'Stainless Steel Bottle' mein Lohe jaisi Badbu aur Zang: 201 vs 304 Grade ka Sach!
cards.hook: Plastic chhod kar ₹200–₹250 mein chamakdaar Steel ki paani bottle kharidi—par usmein paani rakhte hi lohe jaisi badbu (metallic taste) aati hai aur andar tale par zang ke daag dikhte hain! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Har steel ki bottle ek hi 'Stainless Steel' se banti hai, bas bade thermos brands ka paisa lete hain.
cards.myth: Stainless steel bottle hai matlab usmein kisi bhi tarah ka zang ya chemical reaction kabhi nahi ho sakta.
cards.reality: Saste 201/202 grades mein Nickel kam hone ki wajah se khatti cheezein aur khara paani welding joint par rusting aur metallic leaching kar sakte hain.

cards.title: ₹400 wale 'Hot & Cold Thermos Flask' mein 2 Ghante mein Chai Thandi Kyun? Foam vs Real Vacuum!
cards.hook: Mele ya online ₹400 mein '24 Hours Hot & Cold' wali steel thermos bottle kharidi—par garam chai bharne ke 5 minute baad bahar se bottle khud garam ho gayi aur 2 ghante mein chai thandi! Andar kya scam hai?
cards.illusion: Har double-wall dikhne wali steel bottle andar se 'Vacuum Insulated' hoti hai aur 24 ghante garam rakhti hai.
cards.myth: Har double-wall stainless steel bottle bina vacuum ke bhi 12 ghante chai garam rakhti hai.
cards.reality: Bina true vacuum ke (sirf hawa ya foam hone par) heat conduction/convection se 2–4 ghante mein hi temperature barabar ho jaata hai.

cards.title: Plastic Lunch Box aur Bottle ke Neeche Chhapa Triangle Number (1, 3, 5, 7): Garam Khane Mein Kaun Safe?
cards.hook: Har plastic tiffin, dabbe aur paani bottle ke neeche teen teeron wale triangle mein 1, 2, 4, 5 ya 7 likha hota hai—par garam sabzi-dal ya microwave ke liye sirf #5 (PP) hi safe kyun hai?
cards.illusion: Saare 'Food-Grade / BPA-Free' plastic dabbe ek hi hote hain, unmein garam khana ya microwave garam kar sakte hain.
cards.myth: Triangle ke andar likha number (1 se 7) batata hai ki us plastic bottle ko kitni baar reuse kar sakte hain.
cards.reality: Wo number reuse count nahi, balki plastic ke **chemical type (Polymer Code)** ko batata hai—jaise 5 = Polypropylene (heat-safe), 1 = PET (cold only), 6 = Polystyrene.

cards.title: Shaadi-Party wali Melamine Plates mein Garma-Garam Dal aur Microwave: Formaldehyde Leaching ka Sach!
cards.hook: Mehmanon ke liye chamakdaar unbreakable 'Melamine / Bone-China Look' dinner set har ghar mein hota hai—par khaulti dal-sambar daalne ya microwave karne par ye plates safe hain ya zeher chhodti hain?
cards.illusion: Melamine ke unbreakable bartan ceramic jaisi hi safe hote hain aur unmein khaulta khana aur microwave dono chalte hain.
cards.myth: Opalware (reputed brand / Corelle) bhi ek tarah ka melamine plastic hi hota hai.
cards.reality: Nahi! Opalware asal mein **Toughened Glass (Kaanch)** hota hai jo zero chemical chhodta hai aur 100% microwave-safe hai—jabki Melamine ek thermoset plastic resin hai!

cards.title: Plastic Chopping Board par Chhuri Chalana: Sabzi ke Sath Karodon Microplastics Khaane ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Chikna white plastic chopping board dekhne mein saaf aur hygienic lagta hai—par roz tamatar-pyaz kaatne se chhuri us plastic ko bareek chheel kar aapki sabzi mein kya mila rahi hai?
cards.illusion: Plastic chopping board lakdi se zyada saaf-suthra aur bacteria-free hota hai.
cards.myth: Marble ya Toughened Glass ka chopping board sabse clean aur best hota hai.
cards.reality: Glass aur patthar par kaatne se aapki mehengi kitchen chhuriyan 1 hafte mein hi bilkul blunt (bekar) ho jaati hain aur haath phisalne ka khatra rehta hai!

cards.title: 'Granite / Marble / Diamond Coated' Pan Asal mein Sirf Rang-Biranga Teflon (PTFE) Kaise Hota Hai!
cards.hook: Kaale Teflon se dar kar log ₹1,800 ka safed chhitkidaar 'Natural Granite / Marble Coated Frypan' kharid laate hain—par kya usmein sachmuch patthar hota hai, ya andar wahi Teflon chhupa hai?
cards.illusion: 'Granite' ya 'Marble Stone' coated tawa 100% patthar ka bana hai aur usmein koi Teflon/PTFE chemical nahi hota.
cards.myth: 'PFOA-Free Granite Coated' pan mein bilkul bhi Teflon (PTFE) nahi hota.
cards.reality: PFOA sirf purana ek manufacturing chemical tha jo hat gaya—almost sabhi 'Granite/Marble' coated pans ab bhi PTFE (Teflon) se hi bante hain!

cards.title: Naya Cast Iron (Loha) Tawa 2 Din mein Laal Zang Kyun Pakadta Hai? Oil Seasoning ka Kitchen Vigyan!
cards.hook: Non-stick chhod kar healthy 'Cast Iron Dosa Tawa / Kadhai' kharida—par pehli baar dhokar rakhte hi poora tawa laal zang se bhar gaya aur dosa chipakne laga! Isse Non-Stick kaise banate hain?
cards.illusion: Cast Iron tawa karab/nakli loha hai isliye dhone par zang lag gaya, ya uspar har roz sabun se ragad kar saaf karna chahiye.
cards.myth: Cast Iron tawa ko kabhi bhi paani ya bartan-sabun se nahi dhona chahiye.
cards.reality: Halka dishwash liquid aur soft brush use kar sakte hain—bas turant gas par poora sukhakar 2 boond tel lagana zaroori hai!

cards.title: Pital aur Taambe ke Bartan mein Khatti Kadhi-Dahi Pakana: 'Kalai (Tin)' Na Hone par Food Poisoning!
cards.hook: Purani parampara aur health ke naam par log Pital (Brass) ki patili mein dahi-kadhi ya Taambe ke jug mein nimbu paani rakh dete hain—par bina 'Kalai' ke ye bartan ulti-dast kyun kara dete hain?
cards.illusion: Pital, Kansa aur Taamba shuddh ayurvedic bartan hain isliye unmein koi bhi khana ya juice banaya aur rakha jaa sakta hai.
cards.myth: Taambe ke lota/bottle mein subah ka garam nimbu-shahad paani rakh kar peene se double fayda hota hai.
cards.reality: Nimbu ka Citric Acid taambe se react kar ke Copper Citrate banata hai jo pet aur liver ke liye zeherila ho sakta hai—nimbu hamesha glass ya steel mein hi milayein!

cards.title: Kaali Chamakdaar 'Mitti ki Handi' mein Kaale Dye aur Lead Glaze ka Khatra: Asli Lal Mitti Pehchan!
cards.hook: Aajkal bazaar mein chamakdaar Jet-Black 'Mitti ki Handi / Kadhai' bik rahi hai—par kuch handiyon ko geela karne par haath par kaala rang chhoot-ta hai! Asli unglazed Terracotta vs Painted Handi kya hai?
cards.illusion: Har kaali ya chamakdaar mitti ki handi bilkul shuddh prakritik kumhar ki mitti se bani aur sehatmand hoti hai.
cards.myth: Kaali chamakdaar handi mitti se bani har handi se zyada pure aur hygienic hoti hai.
cards.reality: Bina authentication ke sasti kaali chamakdaar handiyon par kaala dye/varnish laga ho sakta hai—natural unglazed matiyali terracotta sabse safe aur authentic hoti hai.

cards.title: Bacchon ka ₹500 wala School Bag 2 Mahine mein Zip aur Kandhe se Kyun Phat-ta Hai? (Denier & Spine Weight)
cards.hook: Naye session mein ₹500–₹700 ka cartoon-print school bag kharida, par 60 din mein hi uski chain (zip) toot gayi aur strap silai se ukhad gaya—jabki achcha bag 3 saal kaise chalta hai?
cards.illusion: Sabhi school bags ek hi nylon/polyester kapde aur zipper se bante hain, bas cartoon print dekh kar le lena chahiye.
cards.myth: Wheels (Trolley) wale school bags har bacche ke liye sabse best hote hain.
cards.reality: Trolley bag ka metal handle khud 1.5–2 kg bhari hota hai—jab baccha use seedhiyon par uthata hai to reedh par zyada bojh padta hai! Seedhiyon wale schools mein lightweight padded backpack hi behtar hai.

cards.title: ₹150 wala Chhata Pehli Tez Hawa mein Ulta Hokar Toot Kyun Jaata Hai? Tin Ribs vs Fiberglass!
cards.hook: Monsoon ki pehli tez baarish aur hawa mein ₹150 wala folding chhata 'khatt' se ulta ho kar tedha toot jaata hai—jabki achcha chhata ulta hone par bhi bina toote wapas seedha kaise ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Sabhi chhate hawa aane par toot hi jaate hain, isliye baarish mein sasta ₹150 wala chhata lena hi samajhdari hai.
cards.myth: 5-fold mini pocket umbrella aur heavy steel-frame bada umbrella ek hi jitne windproof hote hain.
cards.reality: Jitne zyada folds (joints), chhata utna hi kamzor hota hai—roz ki tez baarish ke liye 2-fold ya straight fiberglass-rib umbrella best hoti hai.

cards.title: Flight/Train mein Sasta Hard-Shell Suitcase 1 Safar mein Kyun Phat-ta Hai? ABS vs Polycarbonate vs PP!
cards.hook: ₹1,800 ka chamakdaar Hard-Shell Trolley Bag kharida tha, par airport par conveyor belt se utarte hi uska kona phat kar toot gaya! Kaunsa hard-shell plastic patakne par bhi nahi toot-ta?
cards.illusion: Saare hard-shell trolley bags ek hi mazboot plastic ke bante hain—jo jitna hard dikhe utna zyada mazboot.
cards.myth: Jitna zyada sakht aur patthar jaisa rigid plastic hoga, check-in luggage utna hi zyada mazboot hoga.
cards.reality: Impact physics mein **Flexibility = Strength**! Rigid ABS plastic jhatke par toot-ta hai, jabki flexible PP aur PC dab kar wapas shape mein aa jaate hain.

cards.title: ₹3,000 wali Sasti 'Ergonomic Chair' ka Hydraulic 4 Mahine mein Neeche Kyun Baith Jaata Hai? Class 3/4 Gas Lift!
cards.hook: Work-from-home aur padhai ke liye ₹3,000 ki chamakdaar mesh office chair online mangwayi—par 4 mahine mein hi wo baithte hi dheere-dheere neeche dhasne lagi aur peeth dard hone laga! Andar kaun sa purza sasta hota hai?
cards.illusion: Saari hydraulic revolving chairs ek hi jaise gas cylinder aur base se banti hain, ₹3,000 aur ₹8,000 mein bas brand ka farq hai.
cards.myth: Chair mein hydraulic kharab ho jaaye to poori chair kachre mein phenkni padti hai.
cards.reality: Hydraulic Gas Lift Cylinder ek standard universal size (50mm/28mm) ka alag part hota hai jo ₹350–₹500 mein online mil jaata hai aur ek hathode-oil se 10 minute mein khud badla jaa sakta hai!

cards.title: ₹400 wale 5-Blade Razor Cartridge Scam vs ₹100 Brass Safety Razor: Ingrown Hair aur Chehre par Daane Kyun?
cards.hook: TV ads dekh kar log ₹1,200 mein 4-pack '5-Blade Turbo Razor Cartridges' le aate hain—par ek toh 4 blades ke baad bhi daane (razor bumps) nikalte hain, aur har saal ₹3,000+ blades par kharch hota hai! Asli vigyan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Jitne zyada blades (3, 5, 6 blades) honge, shave utni hi zyada smooth aur skin-safe hogi.
cards.myth: Single-blade safety razor se hamesha chehra kat jaata hai aur 5-blade cartridge se bilkul cut nahi lagta.
cards.reality: Safety razor ko sirf uske apne wajan se bina dabaye (30° angle par) chalaya jaata hai—2–3 din ki practice ke baad wo 5-blade se zyada gentle, clean aur zero-bump shave deta hai.

cards.title: ₹15 wale Saste Toothbrush se Masoodhon se Khoon Kyun Aata Hai? 'End-Rounded Soft Bristles' ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Har mahine daant saaf karne ke liye log 'Hard' ya ₹15 wala sasta local toothbrush le aate hain—par kuch mahine baad masoodhe neeche khisakne (Gum Recession) aur thanda-garam lagne ki bimari kyun shuru hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada sakht (Hard/Medium) brush se zor laga kar ghisenge, daant utne hi zyada safed aur saaf honge.
cards.myth: Medium ya Hard brush se zor laga kar ghisne se daanton ka peelaapan jaldi saaf hota hai.
cards.reality: Zor se ghisne se upar ka safed Enamel ghis jaata hai aur andar ka peela Dentin dikhne lagta hai—yani daant aur zyada peele aur sensitive ho jaate hain!

cards.title: Bathroom mein Tanga Plastic Bath Loofah: Skin Saaf Karne Wala Sponge Bacteria ka Ghar Kyun Banta Hai?
cards.hook: Nahane ke liye log mahinon tak wahi rang-biranga jaalidar Plastic Loofah bathroom mein taange rakhte hain—par dermatologists ke mutabik uske geelay jaliyon mein kya ug raha hota hai aur peeth par daane kyun nikalte hain?
cards.illusion: Loofah mein roz sabun lagta hai isliye wo hamesha saaf aur bacteria-free rehta hai.
cards.myth: Loofah par roz body wash aur sabun lagane se uske andar ke saare keetanu mar jaate hain.
cards.reality: Sabun sirf upari dirt hatata hai—geeli nylon mesh ki gehraiyon mein dead skin par bacteria aur fungus badhte rehte hain.

cards.title: Saste Synthetic Sanitary Pads mein Plastic Top-Sheet aur Khushbu: Rash, Chheelan aur Infection ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Har mahine periods ke dauran kai mahilaon ko pad pehanne se rashes, jalan aur fungal khujli hoti hai—kya ye normal hai, ya pad ke upari Plastic Net aur Scented Chemicals ki galti hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada 'Dry-Net Plastic', 'Extra Fresh Perfume' aur chamakdaar safed pad hoga, wo utna hi hygienic aur rash-free hoga.
cards.myth: '12-Hour XL Dry-Net' pad pehan kar subah se raat tak ek hi pad mein rehna bilkul safe hai.
cards.reality: Leakage na hona hygiene ki guarantee nahi hai—4–6 ghante ke baad paseena aur blood bacterial growth aur rash ka kaaran bante hain.

cards.title: Saste Khule/Loose Baby Diapers ka Khatra: Recycled Gel, Leakage aur Bacchon ko Diaper Rash Kyun?
cards.hook: Bazaar mein ₹5/piece ke hisab se khule (loose) ya saste unnamed packets mein baby diapers bikte hain—par unhe pehnate hi bacche ko laal rash aur geeli sheet par ruyi-gel kyun nikal aata hai?
cards.illusion: Saare baby diapers ek hi company ki factory ke bache hue asli maal hote hain, saste khule diapers lene mein koi nuksan nahi.
cards.myth: Khule (loose) ₹5 wale diapers bade brands ke factory 'export surplus' hote hain aur bilkul same safe hote hain.
cards.reality: Aksar ye defective/rejected batches, unhygienic godown stock ya low-SAP recycled fluff wale local diapers hote hain jinpar koi accountability nahi hoti.

cards.title: Surf (Detergent) Kapdon ko 'Zyada Safed' Kaise Dikhata Hai? 'Optical Brightener' ka UV Aankh-Jaadu!
cards.hook: Detergent TV ad mein dikhate hain ki ek dhoop mein shirt pehle se bhi zyada chamakdaar safed ho gayi—par kya surf sachmuch mail saaf karta hai ya kapde par ek invisible neeli UV dye chhod jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Safed shirt dhone par pehle se zyada chamakne lagi matlab uske andar ka 100% mail aur daag nikal gaya.
cards.myth: Jis detergent mein zyada jhaag (foam) aur mutthi mein garmi aaye, wahi sabse achcha kapde dhota hai.
cards.reality: Zyada jhaag aur garmi saste foaming agents (SLS) aur washing soda se aati hai—front-load machines aur dark kapdon ke liye kam-jhaag wala enzyme liquid best hota hai!

cards.title: Front-Load Washing Machine mein Sasta Surf Powder Daalne se Drum aur 'Spider Bracket' Galne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: ₹35,000 ki Front-Load Washing Machine 3 saal mein hi zor se thak-thak aawaz kar ke band ho gayi—technician ne drum khola to andar safed cement jaisa keechad aur Aluminium Spider Bracket gala mila! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Front-load machine mein bhi normal sasta ₹60/kg wala handwash surf powder aaram se daal sakte hain.
cards.myth: Kapde zyada gande hon to washing machine mein 2–3 katori surf bhar kar daalne se zyada saaf hote hain.
cards.reality: Excess detergent kam paani wali machine mein dhul nahi paata—wo wapas kapdon mein chipak kar kapde sakht karta hai aur machine ke drum ko sada deta hai!

cards.title: Gym Kapdon aur Towels par Fabric Softener (Comfort) Lagana: Paseene ki Badbu Lock Hone ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Khushbu ke liye log har dhulai mein Comfort/Fabric Conditioner daal dete hain—par kuch mahine baad Gym T-shirts aur Towels mein paseene ki badbu pakki bas jaati hai aur towel paani kyun nahi sokhta?
cards.illusion: Fabric Conditioner har kapde ko zyada saaf, naram aur hamesha ke liye khushbudar banata hai.
cards.myth: Har wash mein Fabric Softener daalne se kapde zyada hygienic aur washing machine bhi saaf rehti hai.
cards.reality: Fabric softener ki waxy parat machine ki pipes mein jam kar 'Scrud' (kaala fungus keechad) banati hai aur towels/activewear ko kharab karti hai.

cards.title: Almirah aur Washbasin mein Safed 'Naphthalene Balls': Bacchon aur G6PD Blood ke Liye Chhupa Zeher!
cards.hook: Kambal, kapde aur bathroom sink mein log bhar-bhar kar safed Naphthalene (Phenyl/Damar) ki goliyan daal dete hain—par kuch log unhe kapur samajhte hain aur chhote bacchon ke kapdon mein ye jaanlewa kaise ban sakti hain?
cards.illusion: Safed Naphthalene balls bas kapur jaisi meethi khushbu wali keeda-bhagao goliyan hain aur bacchon ke kapdon mein rakhna bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Safed Naphthalene balls aur Pooja wala Kapur (Camphor) ek hi natural cheez hain.
cards.reality: Dono bilkul alag hain—Natural Kapur ped (Cinnamomum camphora) se banta hai jabki Naphthalene ek coal-tar/petroleum pesticide hai jo blood cells tod sakta hai!

cards.title: Ghar ke Pochhe mein Sasta 'Milky White Phenyl': Doodh jaisa Rang Pine Oil se Hai ya Toxic Phenol-Creosote?
cards.hook: Market mein ₹40/litre mein doodh jaisa gaadha 'White Phenyl' aur ₹60 mein 'Black Phenyl' bikta hai—par kya sasta white phenyl sachmuch keetanu maarta hai, ya sirf paani + sasti khushbu hota hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada doodh jaisa safed aur tez mehak wala phenyl hoga, wo farsh ke 99.9% bacteria utna hi achche se maarta hai.
cards.myth: Ghar ke poore farsh par roz tez Black Phenyl ya Harpic-jaisa tezaab lagane se hi ghar bimariyon se bachta hai.
cards.reality: Ghar koi ICU nahi hai—rozana saaf paani + mild soap mechanical safai se hi 90%+ dirt/germs hat jaate hain; tez phenols roz lagana saans aur bacchon/pets ke liye nuksandeh hai.

cards.title: Spray Room Freshener aur Automatic Dispenser: Badbu Khatam Nahi Karte, Phephdon ko Bimar Kyun Karte Hain?
cards.hook: Band kamre aur bathroom mein automatic 'Every 15-Minute Spray' room freshener lagane se kamra mehkta to hai—par kuch logon ko subah chheenk, sir dard aur asthma trigger kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Room freshener hawa ki gandi badbu aur germs ko khatam kar ke hawa ko bilkul fresh bana deta hai.
cards.myth: Bathroom mein laga 'Every 15 Minute' automatic room spray hawa ke bacteria aur badbu ko destroy karta hai.
cards.reality: Wo sirf gas propellant aur synthetic fragrance chhod kar badbu ko mask karta hai—band jagah mein ye indoor air pollution badhata hai.

cards.title: Kitchen Slab par 'Lakshman Rekha' Chalk Khichna: Sabzi-Roti aur Bacchon ke Haath par Pesticide Poisoning!
cards.hook: Raat ko kitchen ke gas stove aur slab par cockroaches bhagane ke liye log safed 'Lakshman Rekha' chalk ki lines khich dete hain—par subah usi slab par sabji kaatne ya roti belne par kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Lakshman Rekha bas ek normal chalk hai jo sirf keedon ko dor rakhta hai, insaanon ke liye bilkul harmless hai.
cards.myth: Kitchen slab par chalk khichne ke baad subah sirf sukhe kapde se jhaad dene se saara chemical hatt jaata hai.
cards.reality: Pyrethroid dust kapde se aur zyada fail kar bareek kanon mein pores mein chipak jaata hai—khana pakane ki jagah par chalk khichna hi galat hai.

cards.title: Chuhon ki Dawai aur Glue Trap: Ghar ke Bacchon aur Pets ke Liye 'Zinc Phosphide' / 'Bromadiolone' Warning!
cards.hook: Ghar mein chuha aane par log biscuit par chuhon ki kaali dawai (Ratol) ya zeherili tikki kone mein rakh dete hain—par agar galti se ghar ka baccha ya pet dog use chhoo le, to 10 minute mein kya emergency hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Chuhon ki dawai bas chhote se kone mein rakhi hai, usse ghar ke logon ya pets ko koi khatra nahi.
cards.myth: Biscuit par Zinc Phosphide lagane se chuha turant darwaze ke bahar jaakar mar jaata hai.
cards.reality: Chuha aksar ghar ke bed, sofa ya kitchen cabinet ke piche jaakar marta hai aur sadta hai—aur biscuit par laga zeher bacchon/pets ke liye behad khatarnak hai.

cards.title: ₹50 wali Diwali Jhalar ke Wire Chhootne par Current Kyun Lagta Hai? Uninsulated Iron Wire vs Copper!
cards.hook: Diwali par ₹50 mein 20-meter ki chamakdaar LED Jhalar (Rice Lights) kharid kar balcony ki lohe ki railing par lapet di—par geeli baarish ya chhootne par poore grill mein current kaise fail jaata hai?
cards.illusion: LED lights toh kam bijli khati hain isliye ₹50 wali jhalar bhi bilkul safe hoti hai, usmein current nahi lagta.
cards.myth: LED lights sirf 3V par chalti hain isliye jhalar ke wire ko geelay haath se pakadne par bhi current nahi lagta.
cards.reality: Sasti 2-pin jhalar mein saari LEDs series mein judi hoti hain aur poore wire mein **220V–300V DC** behta hai jo jaanlewa jhatka de sakta hai!

cards.title: 'Green Crackers' ke Dabbe par Nakli Hara Sticker Scam: CSIR-NEERI QR Code Verify Karna!
cards.hook: Bazaar mein har patakhe ke dabbe par ek hara '100% Green Cracker' sticker chipka hota hai—par andar wahi zeherila Barium aur tez dhuan nikalta hai! Asli Green Cracker 5 second mein kaise check karein?
cards.illusion: Patakhe ke dabbe par hara 'Green Crackers' logo chhapa hai, matlab wo CSIR-NEERI certified eco-friendly patakha hai.
cards.myth: 'Green Cracker' se bilkul zero dhuan aur zero pollution hota hai isliye band kamre/balcony mein bhi jala sakte hain.
cards.reality: Green Crackers sirf ~30% kam PM dust aur zero Barium chhodte hain—dhuan phir bhi hota hai, isliye hamesha khuli hawa mein aur asthma/pets ka dhyan rakh kar hi chalayein.

cards.title: Chamakdaar Saste Holi Gulal aur Pakke Rang mein Kaanch ka Choora, Lead aur Engine Oil: Ghar par Test!
cards.hook: Holi par ₹20 mein chamakdaar neela, kaala, silver aur laal gulal bikta hai—par chehre par lagate hi aankhon mein jalan, skin par chhilan aur 7 din tak na chhootne wala zeher kahan se aata hai?
cards.illusion: Sookha Holi Gulal toh sirf maida/ararot aur phoolon ka rang hota hai, usmein koi khatarnak chemical nahi hota.
cards.myth: Chamakdaar (Sparkling) gulal mein sirf food-grade abhrak/chamki hoti hai jo skin aur aankhon ke liye safe hai.
cards.reality: Saste chamakdaar gulal mein bareek pisa hua mica aur silica/glass dust hota hai jo aankh mein padte hi cornea ko scratch kar sakta hai!

cards.title: Pooja ke Pital-Taambe ke Bartan 'Pitambari/Tezaab' se Jaldi Kaale Kyun Padte Hain? Imli-Nimbu Vigyan!
cards.hook: Pooja ki thali aur taambe ka lota chemical powder/liquid se saaf karte hi 1 minute mein chamak jaata hai—par 3 din baad hi wahi bartan pehle se double tezi se kaala aur daagdaar kyun pad jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Tez acid-based chemical cleaners pital aur taambe ko sabse lambe samay tak chamakdaar rakhte hain.
cards.myth: Har chamakdaar acid cleaner pital-taambe ko andar se mazboot aur lambe samay tak saaf rakhta hai.
cards.reality: Strong mineral acids metal ki surface ko etch (khurdura) kar dete hain, jisse hawa aur nami mein bartan pehle se jaldi oxidize hokar kaala padta hai.

cards.title: Pooja ka Sasta Kapur (Camphor): Jalne par Kaala Dhuan aur Katori mein Mom Kyun Chhodta Hai? (Bhimseni vs Paraffin)
cards.hook: Aarti karte waqt ₹20 ki dabbi wala gol kapur jalane par poore mandir ki chhat kaali ho jaati hai aur katori mein pighla hua mom jaisa kachra bach jaata hai! Asli kapur mein kya milaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har safed kapur ki goli ya tikiya ped se bana shuddh kapur hi hoti hai.
cards.myth: Har kapur jalne par katori mein thoda mom aur kaala dhuan chhodta hi hai.
cards.reality: Pure Camphor sublime/burn hokar zero wax chhodta hai—pighla hua mom hamesha saste Paraffin Wax ki milawat ka saboot hai!

cards.title: Pooja ke Ready-Made 'Pure Ghee Diya Batti' mein Vanaspati Dalda aur Paraffin Wax ka Scam!
cards.hook: Bazaar mein ₹100 ke dabbe mein 50 ready-made '100% Shuddh Desi Ghee Batti' milti hain—par usse jalate hi katori mein mombatti jaisa mom aur vanaspati ki badbu kyun aati hai?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par '100% Pure Cow Ghee Pooja Diya' likha hai aur jami hui peeli tikiya dikh rahi hai, to wo shuddh desi ghee ki hi batti hai.
cards.myth: Dabbe par 'Not for Edible Use' likha hone ka matlab hai ki wo shuddh desi ghee hai bas thoda purana hai.
cards.reality: Aksar companies legal pakad (FSSAI food laws!) se bachne ke liye wax aur synthetic fat milakar uspar 'Pooja Use / Non-Edible' likh kar 'Pure Ghee' label laga deti hain!

cards.title: Courier Bhejne par 1 kg ke Box ka Bill 4 kg ka Kyun Banta Hai? 'Volumetric Weight' Formula!
cards.hook: Bhaiya ko rakhi, kapde ya halka saman courier karne gaye—tarazu par box ka wajan sirf 1.2 kg aaya, par courier wale ne ₹800 bolte hue kaha 'Iska wajan 4 kg hai!' Ye kaun sa ganit hai?
cards.illusion: Courier ka paisa hamesha sirf tarazu par tule asli wajan (Dead Weight in kg) ke hisab se hi lagta hai.
cards.myth: Courier agent ne tarazu par 1 kg dikhne ke baad 4 kg ka bill bana kar seedha cheating ki hai.
cards.reality: Volumetric weight international aur Indian courier industry ka standard rule hai—sirf box ka size chhota rakh kar aur India Post check kar ke aap apna bill bacha sakte hain.

cards.title: Packers & Movers ka ₹4,000 Quote Ghar Pahunch kar ₹18,000 Kaise Banta Hai? Fake Agarwals & Transit Traps!
cards.hook: Shahar badalne par search engine se mile 'Agarwal Packers' naam wale agent ne ₹4,500 mein poora saman bhejne ka promise kiya—par truck aadhe raste pahunchte hi saman rok kar ₹19,000 maangne laga! Is extortion se kaise bachein?
cards.illusion: search engine search ke top par aane wale bade naam aur sasta phone quote wale Packers & Movers bilkul bharosemand hote hain.
cards.myth: search engine par sabse upar jo number dikhe aur jo bada brand naam bole, wo 100% asli company hi hoti hai.
cards.reality: Scammers fake ads chalakar bade packers ke naam se numbers lagate hain—hamesha official domain, GSTIN aur physical office address cross-check karein.

cards.title: Kiraye ke Ghar mein '11-Month Agreement' Kyun aur Security Deposit Wapas Na Milne se Bachne ke 4 Rules!
cards.hook: Makan malik kehte hain '11 mahine ka rent agreement banega'—aur ghar chhodte waqt painting aur damage ke naam par aapka poora ₹30,000 Security Deposit kaat lete hain! Kanoon aur smart checklist kya hai?
cards.illusion: Rent agreement 11 mahine ka sirf isliye hota hai ki kirayedar ko 11 mahine mein bhagaya jaa sake, aur makan chhodte waqt poora paint karwana kirayedar ki zimmedari hoti hai.
cards.myth: 11-month rent agreement kanoon ki nazar mein invalid hota hai aur court mein nahi chalta.
cards.reality: 11-month written agreement 100% legal aur valid contract hota hai—bas 12 mahine se kam hone ke kaaran uska compulsory Sub-Registrar registration zaroori nahi hota.

cards.title: Sone-Chandi aur Kirana ki Dukaan par Digital Tarazu: 'Level Bubble', 'Pankhe ki Hawa' aur 'Zero Error' Check!
cards.hook: Aajkal har dukaan par digital tarazu (weighing scale) hai, to log sochte hain ab kam tolne ka chance hi nahi—par pankhe ki tez hawa ya tedhe table par rakha tarazu aapka sona aur kirana kaise kam tol deta hai?
cards.illusion: Digital machine par '0.000' likha hai aur upar kaanch ka box laga hai, matlab machine hamesha 100% sahi wajan hi dikhayegi.
cards.myth: Digital electronic tarazu kabhi galat wajan nahi dikha sakta, sirf purane batte-wale tarazu mein hi chori hoti thi.
cards.reality: Digital scales mein Tare setting, tilt/leveling, wind draft aur hidden calibration switches se bhi kam/zyada tola jaa sakta hai—isliye zero, seal aur level check zaroori hai.

cards.title: Petrol Pump par '₹110 ya ₹210 ka Petrol Bharwao, ₹100 mein Chip Hoti Hai' Myth ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: social media forwards par message ghoomta hai ki '₹100, ₹200 ya ₹500 ka petrol mat bharwao, ₹110 ya ₹215 ka bharwao kyunki machine mein ₹100 par chip set hoti hai!' Kya ye sach hai, ya asli dhokha kahin aur hota hai?
cards.illusion: ₹100 ya ₹500 bolne par machine 10% kam petrol deti hai, jabki ₹110 ya ₹215 bolne par poora 100% petrol milta hai.
cards.myth: ₹100, ₹500 ya ₹1,000 ki jagah ₹110, ₹520 ya ₹1,010 ka petrol bharwane se machine cheating nahi kar paati.
