cards.reality: Calibration flow meter har amount par ek hi tarah kaam karta hai—₹110 bolne se kisi tarah ki chip bypass nahi hoti; dhyan rakhna (0.00 watch + no distraction) hi asli suraksha hai.

cards.title: Car mein CNG Cylinder ki 3-Saal Hydrotesting: Testing Plate Nahi Dekhi to Phatne ka Khatra!
cards.hook: CNG car wale mileage dekh kar khush rehte hain, par diggi mein 200 Bar pressure par rakhe CNG tank ki har 3 saal mein Hydrotesting na karwane par pump par blast kyun hote hain?
cards.illusion: CNG cylinder toh moti lohe ki tanki hai, ek baar gaadi mein lag gaya to 15 saal bina kisi check ke chalta hai.
cards.myth: Company-fitted (OEM) CNG cylinder ki 15 saal tak kabhi hydrotesting karwane ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.reality: Company-fitted ho ya retrofitted, PESO niyamon ke mutabik har CNG cylinder ki har 3 saal mein hydrotesting zaroori hai!

cards.title: Car Seatbelt Alarm Band Karne ke Liye ₹50 ka Fake Buckle Lagana: Airbag se Gardan Tutne ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Car ki 'beep-beep' seatbelt aawaz band karne ke liye log ₹50–₹100 ka metal clip (Fake Buckle Stopper) kharid kar laga dete hain—par bina seatbelt lagaye Airbag khulne par 300 km/h ki speed se kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Shehar mein 40 km/h par car chalate waqt seatbelt ki zaroorat nahi aur fake clip lagane par airbag toh khul hi jayega.
cards.myth: Airbag hote hue seatbelt lagane ki koi zaroorat nahi hoti, airbag khud sab bacha leta hai.
cards.reality: Airbag ko 'SRS (Supplemental Restraint System)' kaha jaata hai—wo sirf Seatbelt ke SATH kaam karne ke liye bana hai; bina belt ke airbag ulta jaanlewa chot de sakta hai!

cards.title: Garmiyon mein 55°C Car ke Sheeshe par Lithium-Battery Dashcam Phatne ka Risk: Supercapacitor Dashcam!
cards.hook: Car mein suraksha ke liye ₹3,000 ka sasta Dashcam lagwaya—par May-June ki dhoop mein park ki hui car mein uski battery phool kar sheesha ya camera kyun kharab kar deti hai?
cards.illusion: Har car dashcam ek hi tarah kaam karta hai, saste Lithium-ion battery wale dashcam mein battery backup zyada accha hai.
cards.myth: Lithium-ion battery wala dashcam behtar hai kyunki wo car band hone ke baad bhi 2 ghante recording karta rehta hai.
cards.reality: Dashcam ki chhoti 200mAh battery sirf 2 minute chalti hai aur dhoop mein phool kar kharab ho jaati hai—parking recording ke liye supercapacitor dashcam ko car fusebox hardwire kit se joda jaata hai!

cards.title: Nayi Cars ki Diggi mein Chhota/Patla Spare Tyre ('Space Saver') Kyun Aata Hai? 80 km/h Limit Warning!
cards.hook: ₹12 Lakh ki nayi car ke baaki 4 tyres bade 16-inch alloys hain, par diggi mein nikla spare tyre ek chhota-patla 15-inch kaala 'stepney' hai! Kya ispar 120 km/h par highway chalana khatarnak hai?
cards.illusion: Company ne jo spare tyre diggi mein diya hai uspar lagatar mahinon tak aur 120 km/h speed par aaram se car chala sakte hain.
cards.myth: Agar car mein peeche ek size chhota tyre laga rahe to usse sirf look kharab hota hai, gaadi chalane mein koi fark nahi padta.
cards.reality: Alag rolling diameter aur patli tread width car ke ABS, Traction Control, Braking balance aur Gearbox differential par bura asar daalti hai.

cards.title: Helmet ke Kaale Sheeshe aur Scratched Visor se Raat ki Roshni Bikharna: Clear Polycarbonate & Pinlock!
cards.hook: Raat ko bike chalate waqt samne se aati car ki headlight helmet ke sheeshe (visor) par padte hi taare jaise bikhar jaati hai aur kuch dikhta hi nahi—kya galti aankhon ki hai ya visor ki?
cards.illusion: Helmet ka kaala (smoked) visor ya purana scratched sheesha thoda pochh kar raat mein bhi aaram se chala sakte hain.
cards.myth: Kaale visor se raat ko bhi saamne ki tez LED headlights kam chubhti hain isliye raat ko behtar dikhta hai.
cards.reality: Dark tint sabhi roshni (sadak, gaddhe, bina light wale pedal/cycle) ko 70% kaala kar deta hai—raat ko dark visor lagana blindfolded chalane jaisa khatarnak hai!

cards.title: Accident mein Helmet Sar se Udh Kyun Jaata Hai? Chin-Strap Buckle, D-Ring aur Sizing Rule!
cards.hook: Sadak haadson mein aksar dekhte hain ki bike rider ne ISI helmet pehna tha, phir bhi takkar hote hi helmet sar se 20 feet door ja gira! Helmet sar par kyun nahi ruka?
cards.illusion: Sar par helmet rakh kar chalana kaafi hai, neeche ka patta (Chin Strap) band na karne ya dheela rakhne se koi farq nahi padta.
cards.myth: Agar helmet ek baar accident mein zameen par gir kar bacha le aur usmein bahar se koi crack na dikhe, to use aage bhi use kar sakte hain.
cards.reality: Andar ka **EPS Thermocol Foam** ek hi takkar mein dab kar pichak jaata hai aur dobara jhatka nahi jhel sakta—heavy impact ke baad helmet turant replace karna zaroori hai!

cards.title: Highway par 4 Ghante Car AC 'Recirculation Mode' par Rakhna: CO2 Badhkar Driver ko Neend Kyun Aati Hai?
cards.hook: Lambi highway drive par AC thanda rakhne ke liye hum hamesha 'Inside Air Recirculation' button ON rakhte hain—par 2 ghante baad hi car mein baithe sabhi logon ko aalas, bhari sar aur neend kyun aane lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Car ka AC taazi oxygen banata hai isliye sheeshe band kar ke recirculation mode mein 6 ghante drive karna bilkul fresh rehta hai.
cards.myth: Car AC band sheeshon ke andar bahar se oxygen khinch kar constant oxygen level rakhta hai.
cards.reality: Recirculation mode bahar ki hawa poori tarah band kar deta hai—sirf thodi leakage ke alawa nayi oxygen nahi aati aur cabin mein CO2 tezi se badhti hai!

cards.title: Nayi Car lete waqt Showroom ka ₹5,000 'Teflon + Underbody Anti-Rust Coating' Upsell Scam!
cards.hook: Nayi car delivery par salesman bolta hai 'Sir ₹6,000 mein Teflon Coating aur Underbody Anti-Rust zaroor karwa lo warna nayi car pe zang lag jayega!' Kya nayi factory car mein pehle se ye sab hota hai?
cards.illusion: Nayi car factory se bina rust protection aur bina clear coat ke aati hai, isliye showroom ka ₹6,000 package zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Showroom mein ₹5,000 ki Teflon coating na karwane par nayi car ka paint 1 saal mein ud jaata hai.
cards.reality: Factory paint ke upar pehle se hi baked UV-resistant Clear Coat hota hai—showroom 'Teflon' sirf ek overpriced wax polish hai.

cards.title: Jooton aur Jackets par 'Waterproof Spray' Chhidakna: 'Forever Chemicals' (PFAS) aur Band Kamre ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Baarish mein naye white sneakers bachane ke liye log ₹600 ka 'Hydrophobic Waterproof Shoe Spray' kharid kar kamre ke andar chhidak dete hain—par ye spray kis chemical se banta hai?
cards.illusion: Shoe waterproofing spray bas ek harmless silicon ya wax mist hai, use bedroom mein bhi aaram se spray kar sakte hain.
cards.myth: Shoe waterproof spray sirf jooton ke upar girtā hai, hawa mein saans ke zariye koi nuksan nahi karta.
cards.reality: Pressurized aerosol mist phephdon ki sabse chhoti naliyon (alveoli) tak pahunch kar temporary lung inflammation kar sakta hai—hamesha open outdoors mein hi use karein.

cards.title: 'Genuine Leather Belt' ₹300 mein 3 Mahine mein Kyun Phat-ti Hai? Bonded Leather vs Full-Grain Leather!
cards.hook: Mall ya footpath se '100% Genuine Leather' stamp wali belt/wallet ₹350 mein kharida—par 3 mahine mein hi uspar dararein pad kar chhilke utarne lage! 'Genuine Leather' shabd ka sabse bada legal trick kya hai?
cards.illusion: Jis belt ya bag par 'Genuine Leather' likha ho, wo sabse top quality ka majboot chamda hota hai jo 10 saal chalta hai.
cards.myth: 'Genuine Leather' ka matlab 100% pure top-quality leather hota hai.
cards.reality: Leather hierarchy mein sabse upar **Full-Grain**, phir **Top-Grain**, aur sabse neeche **Genuine / Split / Bonded Leather** aata hai—'Genuine' aksar marketing trap hai!

cards.title: ₹1,500 ka Sweater 2 Baar Pehante hi 'Roye / Goli (Pilling)' se Kyun Bhar Jaata Hai? Acrylic vs Wool!
cards.hook: Sardiyon mein naya soft sweater ya cardigan ₹1,500 mein liya tha—par 2 baar pehanne par hi bagal aur bazuon par chhoti-chhoti goliyaan (lint balls/roye) jam kar purana dikhne laga! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Naya sweater jitna zyada ruyi jaisa naram (fluffy) aur halki-mulayam feel wala hoga, wo utna hi pure oon (wool) ka bana hoga.
cards.myth: Agar mehenge sweater par roye (pilling) aa gaye, to uska matlab wo 100% nakli ya bekar wool hai.
cards.reality: Duniya ke sabse mehenge Cashmere aur Merino wool par bhi shuruat mein thode loose surface fibers pill ho sakte hain—farq ye hai ki asli wool ke roye 1–2 baar lint remover se hatane ke baad ruk jaate hain, jabki saste Acrylic ke roye hamesha bante rehte hain!

cards.title: Sardiyon ke 'Thermal Inner' mein Paseene se Thand Kyun Lagti Hai? Cotton vs Merino/Polyester Thermal!
cards.hook: Thand se bachne ke liye log heavy '100% Cotton Thermal' ya sasta plastic inner pehan lete hain—par thoda chalte hi paseena aane par sharir barf jaisa thanda kyun pad jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Thermal jitna mota aur 100% pure cotton ka hoga, sardi mein utna hi zyada garam aur comfortable rakhega.
cards.myth: Bahut mote 2-3 cotton sweater ek ke upar ek pehanne se hawa aur sardi nahi lagti.
cards.reality: Ooni sweaters mein hawa aar-paar nikal jaati hai—2 mote sweaters ke bajaye 1 patla thermal + 1 sweater + upar ek patli **Windproof Jacket** 3 guna zyada garam rakhti hai!

cards.title: Polyester Dry-Fit Kapde Dhone par Paani mein Lakhon Microfibers: Skin aur Paani par Asar!
cards.hook: Gym aur rozana pehanne ke liye aaj har koi 100% Polyester 'Dry-Fit' T-shirt aur trackpants pehanta hai—par washing machine ke ek hi wash mein usse kitne lakh plastic microfibers nikalte hain?
cards.illusion: Polyester aur Nylon Dry-Fit kapde bas ek normal kapda hain jo dhone par kuch nahi chhodte.
cards.myth: Microplastics sirf plastic bottles aur polythene bags se hi paani aur khane mein aate hain.
cards.reality: Duniya ke primary microplastics ka lagbhag 35% hissa sirf synthetic kapdon (Polyester, Nylon, Acrylic) ki washing se hi paani mein jaata hai!

cards.title: Safed Canvas/Mesh Shoes Dhokar Dhoop mein Sukhane par Peela Daag Kyun Padta Hai? Tissue-Wrap Vigyan!
cards.hook: Mehnat se safed sneakers dho kar chamka kar dhoop mein sukhaye, par sookhte hi unpar gande peele-bhooray nishan (Yellowing) ubhar aaye! Ye kaise aur isse rokne ka simple Tissue-Paper hack kya hai?
cards.illusion: Safed jooton ko surf/bleach se dho kar tez dhoop mein sukhane se wo zyada safed aur chamakdaar hote hain.
cards.myth: Safed kapde ya jooton ko zyada safed karne ke liye Bleach (Ala) aur tez dhoop best hai.
cards.reality: Chlorine bleach aur tez UV dhoop rubber soles aur synthetic mesh ke adhesives ke sath react kar ke permanent peela daag (yellowing) bana dete hain!

cards.title: Banarasi aur Kanjivaram Saree mein 'Pure Zari' ke Daam par 'Tested Plastic Zari' Scam!
cards.hook: Shaadi ke liye ₹35,000 ki 'Pure Silver Zari Kanjivaram/Banarasi Saree' li—par 2 saal mein hi uska sunehra zari kaala pad kar plastic jaisa chhilne laga! Asli Pure Zari vs Tested Zari kaise pehchanein?
cards.illusion: Har mehengi ₹15,000–₹40,000 ki Banarasi ya Kanjivaram saree mein laga chamakdaar sunehra zari asli chandi-sone ka hi hota hai.
cards.myth: Har ₹20,000 ki Kanjivaram ya Banarasi saree mein asli chandi-sone ki pure zari hi lagi hoti hai.
cards.reality: Aajkal ₹10,000–₹30,000 ki zyadaatar sarees mein Copper-based Tested Zari hoti hai—asli 100% Pure Silver-Gold Zari sarees ki keemat aksar ₹45,000–₹50,000 se shuru hoti hai.

cards.title: ₹12,000 ki 'Handloom Pure Silk Saree' Powerloom Machine ki Nikalna: Silk Mark & Handloom Mark Check!
cards.hook: Bunkar aur haath-kargha (Handloom) ke naam par ₹12,000 ki Banarasi/Chanderi/Tussar saree li—par ghar aakar pata chala ki wo ₹1,500 ki machine-made Powerloom saree hai! Farq kaise pehchanein?
cards.illusion: Dukandar ne bola 'Ye asli bunkar ki haath se bani pure silk saree hai' aur tag laga hai, to wo Handloom Pure Silk hi hogi.
cards.myth: 'Pure Silk' sticker laga hai matlab saree 100% handloom bunkar ne hi banayi hai.
cards.reality: Pure Silk powerloom machine par bhi banta hai—aur kai saste shops bina Silk Mark ke Art-Silk (Rayon/Polyester) par khud ke 'Pure Silk' tag chhap dete hain!

cards.title: Kashmiri Pashmina Shawl ke Naam par Powerloom Viscose Scam: GI Tag, Ring Test Myth aur Asli Pehchan!
cards.hook: ₹1,500–₹3,000 mein '100% Pure Kashmiri Pashmina' bolkar shawl bikti hai jo ek chhoti anguthi (Ring) se bhi aar-paar nikal jaati hai! Kya Ring Test asli Pashmina ki pehchan hai?
cards.illusion: Jo shawl ek finger ring (anguthi) ke andar se aar-paar nikal jaaye, wo 100% asli Kashmiri Pashmina hai.
cards.myth: Anguthi (Finger Ring) se aar-paar nikal jaana Pure Pashmina ki 100% pakki kasauti hai.
cards.reality: Patla machine-made Viscose/Polyester/Modal bhi anguthi se aaram se nikal jaata hai—ye myth sirf tourists ko thagne ke liye istemal hota hai!

cards.title: 'Gold Vermeil' aur '925 Silver Gold-Plated' Jewellery: Sasta Brass vs Asli 925 Chandi pe Sona!
cards.hook: Aajkal online ₹2,500–₹5,000 mein 'Gold Vermeil / 925 Silver Gold-Plated' earrings aur chains khoob bik rahi hain—par kya sabhi 925 gold-plated items mein chandi hoti hai ya gold polish jaldi utar jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Jis jewellery par '925 Gold-Plated' likha ho usmein sone ki moti parat hoti hai jo kabhi nahi ghisti.
cards.myth: 925 Silver Gold-Plated jewellery mein upar laga sona itna hota hai ki bechne par gold ka bhi daam wapas milta hai.
cards.reality: 2.5 micron gold plating ka wajan sirf kuch milligrams hota hai—resale mein sirf andar ki 925 chandi ka hi value count hota hai.

cards.title: Chandi ke Ganesh-Lakshmi aur Pooja Chowki: Andar Laakh (Wax) aur Lohe-Tambe ki Plate Bhari Hona!
cards.hook: Dhanteras/Diwali par 100 gram ki chamakdaar Chandi ki Murti ya Singhasan tol kar kharida—par jab kuch saal baad badalne gaye to andar se 70 gram mitti, wax aur copper plate nikli! Ye scam kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Chandi ki murti ya bartan tarazu par 100 gram tula hai aur upar '999 Pure Silver' likha hai, to poora 100 gram chandi hi hai.
cards.myth: Murti ke neeche '999 Silver' ya 'Pure Silver' chhapa hai matlab poori murti ka wajan 99.9% chandi ka hai.
cards.reality: Wo stamp sirf bahari patli foil ki purity ka ho sakta hai—andar lac/resin bhara hona electroformed idols mein bahut common hai jab tak bill par 'Solid / Net Silver Weight' na likha ho!

cards.title: Chandi ki Payal aur Bichhiya mein 50%–65% 'Tanka' Milawat: Exchange par 40% Katoti Kyun Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Bahurani ke liye 92.5% ya 80% chandi bolkar Payal aur Kamarbandh kharida tha—par kuch saal baad exchange karne par jeweller bola 'Ismein toh sirf 55% chandi hai, baaki tanka (solder) hai!' Kyun?
cards.illusion: Chandi ki payal bhi 925 sterling ya 80% pure chandi ki hoti hai aur bechne par 90% paisa wapas mil jaata hai.
cards.myth: Chandi ki har payal 90%–92.5% shuddh chandi ki hoti hai.
cards.reality: Bina hallmark ke local markets mein 50%–70% purity wali payals bhi 'Asli Chandi' bolkar bechi jaati hain—hamesha BIS Silver Hallmark aur written purity check karein.

cards.title: Diamond Showroom Scam: 'VVS-EF' ke Daam par 'SI2-IJ' Halka Peela-Daagi Heera Bechna!
cards.hook: ₹80,000 ki diamond ring kharidte waqt showroom wale bolte hain 'Bilkul crystal-clear top-grade heera hai'—par ghar ki roshni mein wo dhundhla aur halka peela kyun lagta hai? Diamond ke 4C codes ka jaal kya hai?
cards.illusion: Showroom ki tez yellow-white LED lights mein jo diamond chamak raha hai, wo VVS-EF best quality ka hi diamond hai.
cards.myth: Carat weight aur VVS Clarity hi heere ko chamakdaar banati hai.
cards.reality: Heere ki 80% chamak (Fire & Brilliance) uske **Cut Grade (Angles & Symmetry)** se aati hai—ek Excellent-Cut SI1 heera ek Poor-Cut VVS1 heere se double chamakta hai!

cards.title: Airport, Mall aur Cinema Hall mein ₹20 ki Bottle ₹70 mein Bechna: 'Dual MRP' Kanoon aur Aapka Haq!
cards.hook: Bahar ₹20 mein milne wali paani ki bottle ya cold drink Airport/Multiplex mein ₹60–₹80 ki milti hai aur uspe MRP bhi ₹70 chhapa hota hai! Kya ek hi product par alag-alag MRP chhapna kanooni hai?
cards.illusion: Airport, stadium ya cinema hall mein jagah mehengi hone ke kaaran wo ₹20 MRP wali bottle ko bhi ₹70 mein bech sakte hain.
cards.myth: Dukandar refrigerator/electricity ka kharch bol kar ₹20 MRP wali bottle ₹25 mein kanooni taur par bech sakta hai.
cards.reality: Over-the-counter retail sale mein MRP mein sabhi taxes aur cooling/storage margins shamil hote hain—MRP se ₹1 bhi zyada lena Legal Metrology Act ke tahat jurm hai!

cards.title: Restaurant Bill mein Zabardasti 10% 'Service Charge' Jodna: CCPA Kanoon aur Tip ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: Parivaar ke sath ₹2,000 ka khana khaya, par final bill mein GST ke sath-sath ₹200 'Service Charge (10%)' aur uspar bhi GST laga mila! Kya restaurant wale ye charge zabardasti le sakte hain?
cards.illusion: Restaurant ke bill mein chhap kar aaya 'Service Charge 10%' ek sarkari tax hai aur usse dena kanooni taur par zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Menu ke neeche '10% Service Charge Extra' chhapa hone ke baad customer use hatane ko nahi bol sakta.
cards.reality: CCPA guidelines saaf kehti hain ki menu mein likh kar bhi mandatory default Service Charge lena unfair trade practice hai—ye hamesha customer ki marzi par nirbhar karta hai!

cards.title: Online Sale mein '70% OFF ₹4,999 -> ₹1,499' ka Jhooth: Fake MRP Inflation & Price History Check!
cards.hook: Badi Diwali/Prime Sale mein ek ₹1,400 ka mixer ya jacket 'MRP ₹5,999 — 75% OFF -> ₹1,499' dikha kar becha ja raha hai aur timer chal raha hai 'Sale ends in 2 hrs!' Asli daam kya tha?
cards.illusion: Sale mein 70%–80% discount mil raha hai, matlab ₹5,000 ki cheez aaj ₹1,499 mein sasti mil rahi hai.
cards.myth: Online shopping apps par 'Sale Ends in 00:45:00' timer aur '75% OFF' asli limited-time factory loss discount hota hai.
cards.reality: Wo countdown timer har page refresh par dubara shuru ho jaata hai aur inflated MRP par '75% OFF' rozana ki normal price chhupane ka ek Dark Pattern hai!

cards.title: Ticket/Order Checkout par Chupke se '₹99 Protection / Charity / Convenience Fee': Online Dark Patterns!
cards.hook: Flight, movie ya food delivery book karte waqt ₹500 dikha kar checkout ke aakhiri step par ₹680 ka bill ban jaata hai—aur bina pooche ₹49 'Travel Insurance / Feed-a-Child / Free-Cancellation' tick laga milta hai! Ye kya hai?
cards.illusion: Checkout screen par jo bhi charges aur ticked boxes pehle se lage hote hain, wo booking ke liye zaroori charges hote hain.
cards.myth: Online app par jo box pehle se green tick hokar aaya hai wo compulsory hota hai aur hatane par booking cancel ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Wo mostly paid optional add-ons (insurance, tip, priority delivery, protection plans) hote hain jo basket sneaking se jode jaate hain—aap unhe aaram se untick kar sakti hain!

cards.title: ₹20,000 ke TV/Fridge par ₹4,000 ki '3-Year Extended Warranty': Chhupe Exclusions aur Asli Sach!
cards.hook: Electronics store ya online checkout par ₹20,000 ka TV/Washing Machine lete waqt wo ₹3,500 ki '3-Year Extended Warranty' chipka dete hain—par TV kharab hone par 'Panel/Physical/Voltage Excluded' bol kar mana kyun kar dete hain?
cards.illusion: Third-party Extended Warranty lene ka matlab hai ki agle 3–4 saal koi bhi kharabi aane par company bina 1 rupaya liye free repair kar degi.
cards.myth: Bina Extended Warranty liye 1 saal baad Fridge ka compressor ya Washing Machine ki motor kharab ho gayi to poora paisa khud dena padega.
cards.reality: Almost sabhi branded Fridges, ACs aur Washing Machines ke **Compressor aur Inverter Motor par pehle se hi 5 se 10 saal ki Free Manufacturer Warranty** aati hai!

cards.title: ₹200 wali Sasti Solar Garden/Street Light 2 Mahine mein Band Kyun? Fake Lumens aur Ni-Cd Cell!
cards.hook: Online ₹250 mein 'Heavy 100 LED Solar Motion Sensor Wall Light' kharidi—pehle 15 din mast jali, par 2 mahine mein hi sirf 10 minute jal kar band ho jaati hai! Andar kaun sa sasta jugaad hai?
cards.illusion: Solar wall light ek baar chhat ya garden mein laga di to 5 saal tak free roshni deti rahegi.
cards.myth: Light par jitni zyada LEDs (e.g. 100 LED vs 20 LED) hongi, wo utni hi zyada tej roshni degi.
cards.reality: 100 sasti tiny 0.05W SMD LEDs se zyada tej roshni 10 acchi 0.5W high-lumen LEDs aur badi LiFePO4 battery deti hai.

cards.title: Rechargeable Emergency LED Torch mein Wajan Badhane ke Liye Lohe ka Tukda aur Nakli Battery Scam!
cards.hook: Mele ya sadak se ₹250 ki bhari 'Long-Range 50-Hour Emergency Torch' kharidi—par 15 din mein hi band ho gayi! Khulwane par andar se Lohe ki Patti ya Cement bhari chhoti cell kaise nikalti hai?
cards.illusion: Emergency torch aur lantern haath mein bhari hai aur dabbe par '5000mAh / 24 Hours' likha hai, matlab andar badi mazboot battery hai.
cards.myth: Bhari emergency light matlab uske andar badi aur lambi chalne wali heavy battery lagi hai.
cards.reality: Counterfeiters wajan badhane ke liye steel plates, cement-filled fake cells ya sasti Lead-Acid bricks daal dete hain—asli Lithium battery lightweight par high-capacity hoti hai!

cards.title: ₹250 wala 'Spike Guard Extension Board' Surge Rokta Hai ya Sirf Naam ka Board Hai? MOV & Joule Rating!
cards.hook: Mehenge Laptop, Wi-Fi Router aur LED TV ko lightning/voltage surge se bachane ke liye ₹250 ka 'Spike Guard' extension board le aaye—par kya uske andar surge rokne wala purza hota bhi hai?
cards.illusion: Har 4-socket extension board jismein red switch aur fuse laga ho, wo computer aur TV ko high-voltage surge se bacha leta hai.
cards.myth: Extension board mein chhota sa glass Fuse laga hai matlab wo bijli ke jhatke (Surge) ko rok dega.
cards.reality: Normal fuse sirf lambe overload ko rokta hai—microsecond wale tez voltage spikes ko sirf **MOV (Metal Oxide Varistor)** hi rok sakta hai, aur ek fuse usse pehle PC/TV jalne se nahi bacha paata!

cards.title: Deewar ke Switchboard mein Laga Built-in USB Port 24 Ghante Garam Kyun Rehta Hai? Fire & Vampire Power!
cards.hook: Naye ghar ke switchboard mein seedhe phone charge karne wale Built-in USB Ports lagwaye the—par bina phone lagaye bhi wo socket halka garam rehta hai aur kuch mahine mein band kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Deewar ke board mein built-in USB port hona sabse modern, fast aur bijli bachane wala feature hai.
cards.myth: Deewar ka USB port jab tak phone nahi laga ho tab tak zero bijli khata hai aur bilkul thanda rehta hai.
cards.reality: Bina alag switch ke wo mini-transformer 24x7 live 220V par rehta hai, standby power khata hai aur enclosed box mein heat banata rehta hai.

cards.title: Fridge, Washing Machine aur Laptop ki Metal Body mein Halka 'Jhanjhanahat' Current: Earthing Test!
cards.hook: Nange pair farsh par khade hokar Fridge ka door, Washing Machine ya metallic Laptop chhootē hi ungli mein halka 'karr-karr' jhanjhanahat current lagta hai! Kya ye chhoti baat hai ya bade haadse ki ghanti?
cards.illusion: Metallic laptop, fridge ya mixer mein thoda sa halka current aana toh normal baat hai, chappal pehan kar chhoona kaafi hai.
cards.myth: Ghar mein har kamre mein MCB lagi hui hai, isliye kisi ko bijli ka current lagne par MCB turant trip ho jayegi.
cards.reality: MCB sirf taaron ko aag/short-circuit se bachati hai—insaan ko 50mA current hi maar sakta hai jispar MCB trip nahi hoti! Insaan ki jaan sirf **30mA RCCB + Earthing** bachati hai!

cards.title: Bijli Bill Zyada Aane par 'Meter Tez Chal Raha Hai' ka Shakk: Ghar par 5-Minute 1000W Kettle Test!
cards.hook: Is mahine bijli ka bill ₹2,000 zyada aa gaya to har kisi ko lagta hai 'Naya Digital/Smart Meter tez bhaag raha hai!' Par meter sahi hai ya kahin ghar mein chhupi bijli leak ho rahi hai, 5 minute mein kaise jaanchein?
cards.illusion: Naye digital/smart bijli meters purane ghumne wale meters se tez chalte hain aur bina bijli jalaye bhi bill badha dete hain.
cards.myth: Naye Smart Meters bina bijli chalaye bhi apni internal display ki wajah se mahine ke 50 units bill mein jod dete hain.
cards.reality: Smart meter ki apni power consumption electricity board ki side se aati hai, customer ke bill mein count nahi hoti—bill badhne ki wajah aksar slab jump, stuck geyser/fridge ya AC load hota hai.

cards.title: Ghar ke Borewell/Tullu Pump mein Sasta Local Pump Lene se 3 Guna Bijli Bill aur Winding Jalna!
cards.hook: Chhat par paani chadhane ke liye ₹2,500 ka sasta local Tullu/Monoblock pump lagwaya—par 6 mahine mein hi wo garam hokar jaam ho gaya aur ₹9,000 wale branded BEE 5-Star pump se double bijli kyun khata hai?
cards.illusion: Paani ki motor toh bas 0.5 HP ya 1 HP ki hoti hai, sasta local pump aur branded BEE Star pump dono ek hi bijli khate hain.
cards.myth: 0.5 HP motor har company ki exact 373 Watt bijli hi leti hai, star rating sirf dikhawa hai.
cards.reality: 0.5 HP uski *output power* ka naam hai—sasti low-efficiency motor 373W paani phenkne ke liye 700W+ bijli kheenchti hai jabki high-efficiency BEE 5-Star pump bahut kam time mein tank bhar kar 40% bijli bachata hai!

cards.title: Gas Chulhe ka Toughened Glass Top Achanak 'Dhamm' se Phat Kyun Jaata Hai? Bati/Tandoor aur Thermal Shock!
cards.hook: Rasoi mein khana banate waqt ₹6,000 wale stylish Glass-Top Gas Stove ka sheesha achanak chote-chote tukdon mein dhamake se toot gaya! Toughened glass bina kisi patthar lage khud kyun phat-ta hai?
cards.illusion: Toughened glass gas chulhe par chahe baati-maker rakho, chhote stand par tandoor rakho, ya thanda paani chhidko—wo kabhi nahi toot-ta.
cards.myth: Toughened Glass gas chulha fireproof aur unbreakable hota hai, chahe jitni tez garmi ho kabhi nahi toot-ta.
cards.reality: Toughened glass normal impact jhelta hai par extreme localized downward heat (tandoor/bati cooker) aur rapid hot-to-cold thermal shock se achanak bikhar sakta hai!

cards.title: Kitchen Chimney mein 'Auto-Clean Filterless' ka Marketing Hype vs Asli Suction & Ducting ka Sach!
cards.hook: ₹18,000 ki 'Filterless Auto-Clean 1500 m³/hr' chimney lagwayi thi, par tadka lagate hi poore ghar mein chhaunk ki mirchi aur dhuan fail jaata hai! Chimney dhuan kyun nahi kheench rahi?
cards.illusion: '1500 m³/hr Filterless Auto-Clean' likha hai matlab chimney poora tadka apne aap saaf kar legi aur kabhi haath se saaf nahi karni padegi.
cards.myth: 'Auto-Clean Chimney' lagwane ke baad kabhi bhi chimney ko haath se saaf karne ya oil tray khali karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.reality: Auto-clean heat coil sirf fan blades ka thoda tel pighla kar neeche tray mein girata hai—oil collector cup har 15 din mein khali karna aur bahari body/baffle saaf karna phir bhi zaroori hai!

cards.title: RO ka Reject Waste Paani Paudhon mein Daalna: Kya Paudhe Sachmuch Sookh Jaate Hain? (TDS Rule)
cards.hook: Paani bachane ke liye har ghar mein RO ke reject pipe se nikalne wala paani balti mein bhar kar paudhon mein daal dete hain—par kuch hafton baad gamla ke paudhe peele pad kar mar kyun jaate hain?
cards.illusion: RO ka reject paani bilkul nal ke paani jaisa hi safe hai, isliye usse kisi bhi gamle ke paudhe mein daalna bilkul sahi hai.
cards.myth: RO ka reject paani ganda/naali ka paani hota hai isliye usse kisi bhi kaam mein nahi liya jaa sakta.
cards.reality: Reject paani sediment aur carbon filter se saaf hokar hi aata hai—usmein sirf dissolved minerals/salts zyada hote hain, isliye toilet flush, mopping aur pre-wash ke liye bilkul clean aur best hai!

cards.title: Desert Cooler mein 'Honeycomb Pad' vs 'Ghas (Wood Wool) Pad': Khare Paani mein Kaun 1 Season mein Jam Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Naya sleek Desert Cooler kharida jismein moti brown 'Honeycomb Cooling Pad' lagi thi—par 1 hi garmi mein wo patthar jaisi safed-jam ho kar hawa rokne lagi! Sasti Ghas (Wood Wool) vs Honeycomb mein kaun best hai?
cards.illusion: Honeycomb cooling pad ek baar kharidne par 5 saal bina badle chalti hai aur har paani mein wood wool se zyada thandak deti hai.
cards.myth: Cooler chalate waqt kamre ki saari khidkiyan-darwaze band kar dene se thandak kamre ke andar band rehti hai.
cards.reality: Band kamre mein humidity 80%–90% pahunchte hi paani bhaap banna band kar deta hai aur cooler thanda karne ke bajaye garam chipchipi hawa phenkne lagta hai!

cards.title: Saste ₹2,500 wale 'Ionic Air Purifier' se Dhool Saaf Nahi Hoti, Ulta Phephdon ke Liye Ozone Gas Banti Hai!
cards.hook: November ke smog aur AQI 400+ mein online ₹2,000–₹3,000 mein chhote 'Bina Filter Wale Ionic Air Purifier' bikte hain—kya wo sachmuch PM2.5 saaf karte hain, ya silent Ozone gas chhodte hain?
cards.illusion: Bina filter wale 'Ionizer / Plasma' air purifier sabse best hote hain kyunki unmein kabhi mehenga HEPA filter nahi badalna padta.
cards.myth: HEPA filter ko paani aur surf se dho kar sukhane se wo phir se naya ho jaata hai aur badalna nahi padta.
cards.reality: Paani se dhone par HEPA ke microscopic glass/polypropylene fibers chipak kar toot jaate hain aur uski PM2.5 pakadne ki taakat khatam ho jaati hai—sirf bahari plastic pre-filter hi dhoya jaata hai!

cards.title: Ultrasonic Humidifier mein Nal ka Paani Daalne se Kamre mein Safed Dhool aur Bacteria Udna!
cards.hook: Sardiyon ke heater/AC ki sookhi hawa se bachne ke liye kamre mein Ultrasonic Cool-Mist Humidifier chalaya—par 3 din mein TV, laptop aur furniture par safed powder jam gaya aur khansi badh gayi! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Humidifier mein koi bhi saaf nal ya filter paani daal kar raat bhar chalana bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Humidifier mein paani bhaap bankar udta hai isliye uske andar ke minerals aur bacteria neeche tank mein hi reh jaate hain.
cards.reality: Sirf *Evaporative / Steam* humidifiers minerals ko neeche chhodte hain—*Ultrasonic* cool-mist humidifiers poore paani + minerals + bacteria ko seedhe hawa mein aerosol bana kar uda dete hain!

cards.title: ₹300 wale Saste PVC Yoga Mat par Paseene mein Pair Phisalna aur Ghutne Dard: PVC vs TPE/Rubber!
cards.hook: Yoga aur exercise shuru karne ke liye ₹300 ka mota rang-biranga Foam Yoga Mat kharida—par Suryanamaskar karte hi haath-pair phisalne lage aur kuch din mein mat ka bhoora-choora farsh par jhadne laga! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Har 6mm–10mm mota yoga mat ek hi hota hai, sasta foam mat toh zyada naram aur aaramdayak hota hai.
cards.myth: Jitna zyada mota (10mm–15mm) yoga mat hoga, ghutnon aur balance ke liye utna hi achcha rahega.
cards.reality: Bahut mote squishy 12mm mats (jo sirf floor pilates/ab crunches ke liye hote hain) mein khade hokar balance wale yoga poses karne par pair instability se moch aa sakti hai—Yoga ke liye 4–6mm best hai!

cards.title: Home Treadmill mein '4.0 HP Peak' ke Naam par 1.5 HP Motor Scam: 6 Mahine mein Motor aur Belt Jalna!
cards.hook: Ghar par daudne ke liye online ₹18,000 mein '4.0 HP Peak Motor Treadmill' kharidi—par 3 mahine walking-jogging karte hi motor garam hokar band ho gayi aur repair ₹7,000 maangi! 'Peak HP vs Continuous HP' kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Treadmill par bada-bada '4.0 HP Motor' likha hai to wo gym ki tarah ghar par roz 1 ghanta daudne par bhi kabhi garam nahi hogi.
cards.myth: Treadmill ke belt ko kabhi oil dene ki zaroorat nahi hoti aur peak 4.0 HP matlab gym-level motor hai.
cards.reality: Peak HP sirf 1-second maximum stall reading hai (marketing trick!), aur bina Silicone oil ke belt-deck friction motor ko jaldi jala deta hai.

cards.title: Half-Face (Open) Helmet Pehanne ka Khatra: 35% Bike Accidents mein Jabda aur Thoddi Tootne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Garmi aur aaram ke liye 60% scooter-bike riders aage se khula 'Half-Face / Open-Face Helmet' pehante hain—par crash data ke mutabik bike se girne par sar ka kaun sa hissa sabse zyada zameen se takrata hai?
cards.illusion: Bas khopdi ke upar wala hissa cover rehna chahiye, thoddi aur chehre ke saamne helmet ke guard ki koi zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: Scooter sirf 35–40 km/h par market mein chalane ke liye half-face ya open helmet bilkul kaafi aur safe hai.
cards.reality: 30–35 km/h ki speed bhi jabda todne aur severe facial trauma ke liye kafi hai—city slow speeds par hi sabse zyada chin-bar impacts hote hain!

cards.title: Tyre ki Side mein Ganth (Bulge / Bubble) Nikalna: Andar ke Taar Toot Chuke Hain, Kabhi Bhi Phat Sakta Hai!
cards.hook: Gaddhe (pothole) mein zor se car/bike padne ke baad tyre ki side deewar par ek chhota sa Gola/Phoda (Sidewall Bulge) ubhar aaya hai—tyre mein hawa kam nahi hui to kya isse chalana safe hai?
cards.illusion: Tyre mein jab tak hawa ruk rahi hai aur tread naya hai, side mein nikli chhoti si ganth (bubble) se koi khatra nahi hota.
cards.myth: Sidewall ke andar ek mota rubber patch ya tube daal dene se bulge wale tyre ko aaram se chalaya jaa sakta hai.
cards.reality: Tube ya patch toote hue structural casing cords ko wapas nahi jod sakta—sidewall bulge wala tyre kabhi bhi aur kahin bhi phat sakta hai!

cards.title: Petrol Pump par ₹100 mein 'Nitrogen Air' Bharwana: Normal Hawa mein Pehle se 78% Nitrogen Hoti Hai!
cards.hook: Tyre shops aur petrol pumps par ₹50–₹150 lekar 'Green Cap + 100% Nitrogen' bharte hain aur bolte hain 'Isse tyre thanda rahega, puncture nahi hoga aur mileage 10% badhega!' Kya ye sach hai ya mehenga marketing hype?
cards.illusion: Normal hawa mein sirf oxygen hoti hai jo tyre ko phodti hai, jabki Nitrogen dalwane se tyre kabhi garam ya puncture nahi hota.
cards.myth: Nitrogen wale tyre mein agar normal hawa mix ho jaaye to chemical reaction se tyre garam hokar phat sakta hai.
cards.reality: Normal hawa mein pehle se 78% Nitrogen hoti hai—Nitrogen aur normal air mix karne par koi reaction nahi hota aur 100% safe hai!

cards.title: Saste 'Glass Lunch Box / Bowl' Microwave aur Freezer mein Phat Kyun Jaate Hain? Soda-Lime vs Borosilicate!
cards.hook: Plastic chhod kar ₹250 ka chamakdaar Glass Lunch Box ya Baking Bowl kharida—par fridge se nikaal kar seedhe microwave/oven mein rakhte hi wo 'katt' se do tukde ho gaya! Kaunsa glass microwave-safe hota hai?
cards.illusion: Har transparent kaanch ka dabba ya bowl microwave aur oven mein garam karne ke liye safe hota hai.
cards.myth: Achar ya Jam wali khali kaanch ki shishi mein garam ghee ya ubalta tel daal kar store kar sakte hain.
cards.reality: Achar-Jam jars saste Soda-Lime glass ke hote hain—garam ghee ya khaulta tel dalte hi wo thermal shock se phat sakte hain! Pehle thanda hone dein ya Borosilicate jar use karein.

cards.title: Garam Tamatar-Nimbu Sabzi ya Paratha Aluminium Foil mein Ghanton Lapetna: Metal Leaching ka Sach!
cards.hook: Office aur school tiffin mein hum roz garam roti, paratha aur nimbu-tamatar wali sabzi chamakdaar Aluminium Foil mein lapet dete hain—par kuch ghante baad foil par kaale chhed (pinholes) aur khane mein metallic reaction kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Aluminium foil mein garam aur khatti-namkeen har tarah ka khana lapetna ya usmein bake karna 100% harmless hai.
cards.myth: Aluminium foil ki shiny side vs dull side mein se ek side toxic hoti hai aur sirf ek side khane ko chhooni chahiye.
cards.reality: Dono sides ek hi aluminium se bani hoti hain (manufacturing rolling mein 2 sheets ek sath hone se ek taraf shiny aur doosri dull ho jaati hai)—dono sides par acidic/hot food reaction barabar hota hai!

cards.title: Bazaar mein Khule Saste Cling Film (PVC) ko Garam Khane ya Microwave par Lagane se Phthalates Pighalna!
cards.hook: Katta hua tarbooz, paneer ya garam sabzi ka bowl dhakne ke liye patli transparent Cling Wrap plastic film use karte hain—par kya uske sath bowl ko seedhe Microwave mein rakhna safe hai?
cards.illusion: Patli transparent plastic Cling Wrap sirf khana fresh rakhne ki panni hai, use bowl par laga kar microwave mein bhi garam kar sakte hain.
cards.myth: Jab tak Cling Wrap pighal kar toot na jaaye, tab tak usse garam khane ko dhak kar rakhne mein koi chemical nahi nikalta.
cards.reality: Fatty aur warm foods (oil, butter, cheese, meat) bina plastic pighle bhi PVC plasticizers ko tezi se khud mein sokh (migrate) lete hain!

cards.title: Dukaan par 'Paper Cup' mein Khaulti Chai Peena: 15 Minute mein 25,000 Microplastics Sharir mein!
cards.hook: Plastic cups ban hone ke baad har chai tapri, train aur office mein 'Eco-Friendly Paper Cups' mein garam chai milti hai—par paper cup geela hokar pighalta kyun nahi? Andar kya chipka hota hai?
cards.illusion: Paper Cup 100% kagaz ka bana hota hai isliye usmein khaulti chai peena bilkul natural aur plastic-free hai.
cards.myth: Paper cups 100% kagaz ke hote hain aur kachre mein 2 din mein mitti ban jaate hain.
cards.reality: Almost sabhi disposable paper cups ke andar LDPE plastic lamination hoti hai—na wo aasani se recycle hote hain aur na garam chai mein plastic-free hote hain!

cards.title: Sheesham/Teak Furniture mein 'Safed Kinari (Sapwood)' Lagane se 1 Saal mein Ghun (Powder) Girna!
cards.hook: ₹40,000 ka '100% Solid Sheesham Wood Bed / Sofa' kharida—par 1 saal baad hi lakdi mein chhote-chhote gol chhed ho gaye aur neeche safed aata jaisa powder (Wood Borer) girne laga! Kaun si lakdi kharab hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Agar bed/sofa solid Sheesham ya Sagwan (Teak) ka hai, to usmein kabhi ghun ya keeda nahi lagta.
cards.myth: Sheesham ya Sagwan lakdi mein kabhi ghun (wood borer) lag hi nahi sakta, sirf aam lakdi mein lagta hai.
cards.reality: Sheesham aur Sagwan ka bhi bahari safed hissa (Sapwood) starch se bhara hota hai aur agar treat na kiya jaaye to usmein bhi 1 saal mein ghun lag jaata hai!

cards.title: Online ₹8,000 ki Sasti 'Engineered Wood Almari' Monsoon mein Jhol Kyun Kha Jaati Hai? Particle Board vs HDHMR!
cards.hook: Online shopping apps par ₹7,500–₹10,000 mein stylish 'Engineered Wood Wardrobe / TV Unit' bikti hai—par 1 hi baarish mein uska darwaza jhuk jaata hai aur screws bhur-bhure ho kar nikal aate hain! Andar kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: 'Engineered Wood' ka matlab hai lakdi se bhi zyada mazboot modern factory board jo kabhi kharab nahi hota.
cards.myth: 'Engineered Wood' hamesha ek hi high-tech waterproof material hota hai.
cards.reality: 'Engineered Wood' ek umbrella term hai jismein sabse kamzor ₹50/sq ft Particle Board se lekar mazboot HDHMR aur Marine Plywood sab aate hain—hamesha exact type poochh kar lein!

cards.title: Kadhai ke Tel mein Aag Lagne par Paani Daalna Maut ka Khel! Steam Explosion vs Metal Lid / Fire Blanket
cards.hook: Puri ya pakode talte waqt agar kadhai ke garam tel mein aag lag jaaye, to 90% log ghabra kar ek glass **Paani** daal dete hain—par paani dalte hi poori rasoi mein 6 feet uncha aag ka gola kyun phat-ta hai?
cards.illusion: Har tarah ki aag ko bujhane ka sabse tez aur asaan tarika uspar ek balti ya glass paani daalna hai.
cards.myth: Tel ki aag par aata (wheat flour) ya geela towel daal kar aag bujhayi jaa sakti hai.
cards.reality: Aata dhool bankar hawa mein dust-explosion kar sakta hai, aur geela towel tel mein paani chhod kar fire flare kar sakta hai—sirf **Dry Metal Lid** ya **Fiberglass Fire Blanket** hi safe hai!

cards.title: '7 Din mein Gora' Karne Wali Herbal Cream mein Chhupe Steroids aur Mercury ka Khatra
cards.hook: Parlour ya local medical store se li ₹150 wali cream 1 hafte mein chehra bilkul chamka deti hai—par jaise hi cream lagana band karti hain, chehra laal, kaala aur baal-daar kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Cream par 'Ayurvedic / Herbal / Natural Glow' likha hai aur chehra 5 din mein saaf ho gaya, matlab ye bahut asardar dawa hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak cream lagane se chehra saaf dikh raha hai, koi nuksan nahi ho raha.
cards.reality: Steroid andar hi andar skin ko patla aur nason ko kamzor kar raha hota hai—ek din cream kaam karna band kar degi aur chehra gambhir taur par bigad sakta hai.

cards.title: Daad-Khujli mein 'Betnovate / Panderm' Lagane ka Khatra: Infection Theek Nahi, 10 Guna Failta Hai!
cards.hook: Kamar ya jaanghon mein daad-khujli (Fungal Infection) hone par log medical store se ₹30 ki '4-in-1' steroid cream le aate hain—par 2 hafte baad daad aur bada ho kar wapas kyun aata hai?
cards.illusion: Cream lagate hi 2 din mein khujli aur laali gayab ho gayi, matlab infection theek ho raha hai.
cards.myth: 3-4 dawaiyon ke mix wali combination cream sabse tez aur achcha ilaj karti hai.
cards.reality: Fungal infection mein combination steroid cream sabse bada zeher hai—ye infection ko dawa-resistant bana deti hai.

cards.title: Sunscreen ka 'SPF 30 vs SPF 50 vs SPF 100' Ganit: Double Suraksha Nahi, Sirf 1% ka Farq!
cards.hook: Log ₹400 wale SPF 30 ko chhod kar ₹1,000 ka 'SPF 100' kharid lete hain—par kya SPF 100 aapko 3 guna zyada bachata hai? Science ka ganit bilkul alag hai!
cards.illusion: SPF 60 matlab SPF 30 se double protection, aur SPF 100 matlab 100% dhoop se suraksha.
cards.myth: SPF 50 lagane se 50 ghante aur SPF 100 lagane se 100% dhoop ruk jaati hai.
cards.reality: SPF 30 = 97%, SPF 50 = 98% block—aur har sunscreen paseene aur tel se 2-3 ghante mein hat jaati hai, isliye dhoop mein re-apply karna zaroori hota hai.

cards.title: Sunscreen Kitni Lagayein? Ek Boond Lagane se SPF 50 bhi SPF 5 Ban Jaata Hai (Two-Finger Rule)
cards.hook: Mehengi SPF 50 sunscreen lagane ke baad bhi chehre par tanning aur jhaiyan (melasma) kyun nahi rukti? Kyunki 90% log zaroorat ka sirf ek-chauthai (25%) hissa lagate hain!
cards.illusion: Chawal ke daane ya chhoti boond barabar sunscreen poore chehre par mal lena kaafi hota hai.
cards.myth: Thodi si sunscreen lagakar upar se SPF 15 wala foundation lagane se dono jud kar SPF 65 ban jaate hain.
cards.reality: SPF numbers kabhi aapas mein judte (add) nahi hain! Protection hamesha sabse zyada lagaye gaye layer ke barabar hi rehti hai.

cards.title: 'Sulfate-Free' Shampoo aur Zyada Jhaag (Foam) ka Sach: Jhaag Safai Nahi Karta!
cards.hook: Jis shampoo ya facewash mein sabse zyada jhaag (foam) banta hai, log use sabse behtar maante hain—par kya jhaag sachmuch mail saaf karta hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada jhaag banega, baal aur chehra utna hi zyada saaf hoga; aur 'Sulfate' har insaan ke liye zeher hai.
cards.myth: Sulfate-free shampoo lagane se baal jhadna 100% band ho jaata hai aur Sulfates se cancer hota hai.
cards.reality: Na to SLS se cancer sabit hua hai aur na hi shampoo badalne se andarooni hair fall (hormones/iron deficiency) rukta hai—shampoo sirf scalp saaf karne ke liye hota hai.

cards.title: Anti-Dandruff Shampoo Laga Kar Turant Dhone se Rusi (Dandruff) Kyun Nahi Jaati? (5-Minute Contact Rule)
cards.hook: Mehenga medicated anti-dandruff shampoo lagane ke baad bhi rusi wapas aa jaati hai—kyunki aap use aam shampoo ki tarah 20 second mein dho deti hain!
cards.illusion: Anti-dandruff shampoo bas baalon mein lagao, jhaag banao aur turant paani daal kar dho lo to rusi khatam ho jayegi.
cards.myth: Dandruff scalp ki khushki (dryness) se hota hai, isliye raat bhar khoob tel lagana sabse achcha ilaj hai.
cards.reality: Dandruff zyada tel aur Malassezia fungus se hota hai—raat bhar tel lagane se fungus aur tezi se badhta hai!

cards.title: 'Hair Fall Control' Tel aur Shampoo ka Sach: Kya Upar Lagane se Naye Baal Ugte Hain?
cards.hook: ₹600 ka onion/bhringraj shampoo aur anti-hairfall tel lagane ke baad bhi kanghi mein baal kyun aate rehte hain? Baal ki jad (follicle) kahan hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Naya hair oil ya shampoo lagane se 15 din mein baal jhadna band ho jaata hai aur taklepan par naye baal ug aate hain.
cards.myth: Roz raat ko sar mein khoob tel bhigo kar rakhne se naye baal ugte hain.
cards.reality: Tel baal ko conditioning aur smoothness deta hai, par wo chamdi ke andar jaakar dead follicle ko zinda nahi karta; zaroorat se zyada tel ulta dandruff/folliculitis badha sakta hai.

cards.title: 'Natural Black Mehndi' aur Hair Dye mein PPD Chemical: Maathe par Sujan aur Kaale Daag Kyun?
cards.hook: Packet par bade aksharon mein '100% Natural Kali Mehndi' likha hota hai—par asli mehndi sirf laal-orange rang deti hai! Kaala rang aata kahan se hai?
cards.illusion: Kaali mehndi ya herbal hair colour sirf mehndi, amla aur shikakai se bana hai, isliye ismein koi tez chemical nahi hai.
cards.myth: Herbal / Ammonia-free likha hai to hair colour mein koi bhi nuksandeh chemical nahi hai.
cards.reality: 'Ammonia-free' ka matlab sirf ammonia nahi hai—usmein ab bhi PPD ya PTD jaise tez colouring chemicals maujood hote hain!

cards.title: Market ka Chamakdaar Hara 'Aloe Vera Gel' vs Asli Paudhe ka Gel: Rang aur Fragrance ka Sach
cards.hook: Ghar mein aloe vera ka patta kaatne par andar se bilkul paani jaisa safed (transparent) gel nikalta hai—fir market ke dabbe mein '100% Pure' likha gel chamakdaar hara kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Aloe vera ka patta hara hota hai, isliye uska pure gel bhi hara aur khushbudaar hona chahiye.
cards.myth: Market wala hara aloe vera gel patton ka ras pees kar banaya jaata hai isliye hara hota hai.
cards.reality: Asli aloe vera ka inner gel bilkul paani jaisa transparent hota hai; market gels mein hara rang artificial dye (CI dyes) se daala jaata hai.

cards.title: Face Scrub mein Akhrot (Walnut) ke Chhilke: Chehra Saaf Hota Hai ya Skin par Baarik Chot (Micro-Tears)?
cards.hook: Dardare walnut/apricot face scrub se ragad kar chehra dhone par skin turant soft lagti hai—par agle din chehra zyada kaala aur pimples-prone kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna khurdara (grainy) scrub hoga aur jitna zor se ragdenge, chehre ke saare blackheads aur mail utni hi jaldi saaf honge.
cards.myth: Chehra ragad-ragad kar scrub karne se blackheads aur tan hamesha ke liye saaf ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Indian skin tone par zyada ragadne (friction) se melanin badhta hai—jisse tan hatne ke bajaye aur gehra kaala-pan (melasma/PIH) aa sakta hai!

cards.title: Vitamin C Serum ka Rang Peela/Bhoora Padna: Kya Kharab Serum Chehra Kaala Karta Hai?
cards.hook: ₹700 ki mehengi Vitamin C serum ki bottle shuru mein bilkul safed/halki peeli thi, par 2 mahine baad chai jaisi bhoori (brown) ho gayi—ise lagana safe hai ya bekaar?
cards.illusion: Serum toh expiry date ke andar hai, bas thoda rang gehra hua hai—lagane mein koi dikkat nahi.
cards.myth: Jab tak bottle par likhi Expiry Date nahi aayi, serum bilkul 100% asardar rehta hai.
cards.reality: Expiry date 'unopened' bottle ki hoti hai—Vitamin C jaisi sensitive cheez bottle khulne (PAO — Period After Opening) ke 3 mahine mein oxygen se kharab ho sakti hai!

cards.title: Lip Balm ki 'Aadat' aur Petroleum Jelly ka Science: Kya Petroleum Jelly Nami Deti Hai ya Band Karti Hai?
cards.hook: Baar-baar lip balm lagane par bhi hothon ki papdi nahi jaati, aur sookhe hothon par sidhe Petroleum Jelly lagane se kuch nahi hota—kya lip balm mein 'adat dalne wala' chemical hota hai?
cards.illusion: Plain Petroleum Jelly sookhi skin aur hothon mein paani (moisture) bharti hai, aur lip balm mein aadat dalne wala chemical hota hai.
cards.myth: Lip balm mein koi nashila/habit-forming chemical hota hai jisse hothon ko uski aadat lag jaati hai.
cards.reality: Koi addiction chemical nahi hota—bas saste balms mein maujood Menthol/Fragrance hothon ko dry karta hai, jisse baar-baar lagana padta hai.

cards.title: Deodorant vs Antiperspirant: Paseene mein Badbu Nahi Hoti—Fir Badbu Kahan se Aati Hai?
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki paseena hi badbudar hota hai, par vigyan kehta hai taaza paseena bilkul paani ki tarah BINA BADBU ke hota hai! Fir underarms se smell kaise aati hai?
cards.illusion: Paseena gandi cheez hai aur Deo lagane se paseena aana band ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Paseene mein hi badbu hoti hai, isliye upar se perfume chhidakna kaafi hai.
cards.reality: Taaza paseena 100% odourless hota hai; badbu skin ke bacteria aur paseene ke milne se banti hai—isliye bacteria aur moisture control zaroori hai.

cards.title: Talcum Powder aur Bachchon mein Saans ki Dikkat: Talc vs Cornstarch ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Nahane ke baad bachche ke poore sharir aur diaper area mein safed talcum powder chhidakne ki aadat hai—par duniya bhar ki badi companiyan ab Talc chhod kar Cornstarch kyun apna rahi hain?
cards.illusion: Baby talcum powder itna mulayam aur khushbudaar hai ki bachche ke liye bilkul safe aur zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Baby powder lagaye bina bachche ko ghamoriyan aur diaper rash ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Ulta geela hone par powder diaper ke andar gundi jaisa chipak kar skin ragadta hai—Zinc Oxide barrier cream aur hawa lagwana kahin behtar hai.

cards.title: Antibacterial Soap vs Normal Sabun: 20 Second Haath Ragadne mein Asli Vigyan Kya Hai?
cards.hook: '99.9% Germs Protection' wale mehenge antibacterial soaps aam sabun se kitne alag hain? Aur US FDA ne inke kai chemicals par ban kyun lagaya?
cards.illusion: Normal sabun sirf dhool saaf karta hai, bacteria aur virus maarne ke liye 'Antibacterial' sabun hi zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Aam sabun sirf mail saaf karta hai, bacteria sirf 'Germ-Protection' wale sabun se hi marte hain.
cards.reality: CDC aur FDA saaf kehte hain ki aam sabun aur paani se 20 second haath dhona utna hi effective hai jitna koi bhi antibacterial consumer soap!

cards.title: Detergent Powder mein 'Neela Dana' (Optical Brightener): Kapde Saaf Hote Hain ya Aankhon ko Dhokha?
cards.hook: Washing powder mein chhote-chhote neele aur laal daane dekhkar lagta hai ki inmein koi khaas stain-remover taakat hai—par ye bas light ka ek jadoo hai!
cards.illusion: Detergent ke neele daane kapde ka mail jad se kaat kar use bilkul naya safed bana dete hain.
cards.myth: Detergent mein jitne zyada rang-birange neele daane honge, utna hi zyada daag saaf hoga.
cards.reality: Rangeen daane aksar visual marketing aur optical brighteners hote hain—asli daag safai Enzymes (Protease/Lipase) aur sahi paani temperature se hoti hai.

cards.title: Fabric Conditioner (Comfort) Lagane se Toliya (Towel) Paani Sokhna Band Kyun Kar Deta Hai?
cards.hook: Kapdon mein khushbu aur naram-pan ke liye aap har wash mein Fabric Softener daalti hain—par kuch mahine baad naye towel se sharir poonchhne par paani hi nahi sookhta!
cards.illusion: Fabric conditioner har tarah ke kapde ko achcha aur zyada kaamgar banata hai.
cards.myth: Fabric conditioner toliye ko zyada saaf aur hygienic banata hai.
cards.reality: Fabric conditioner koi cleaner nahi hai—ye sirf coating aur khushbu chhodta hai, jo toliye ki paani sokhne ki taakat kam kar deta hai.

cards.title: Toothpaste Tube ke Niche Colour Patti (Green/Black/Red/Blue) ka Viral Jhooth aur Asli Sach!
cards.hook: social media forwards par saalon se chal raha hai ki toothpaste ke niche Hara rang matlab '100% Natural' aur Kaala matlab 'Pure Chemical'—par factory mein us patti ka asli kaam kya hai?
cards.illusion: Green mark wala toothpaste Ayurvedic/natural hota hai, Blue mein medicine hoti hai aur Red/Black mein khatarnak chemicals hote hain.
cards.myth: Toothpaste ke niche Green = Natural, Blue = Natural + Medicine, Red = Chemical, Black = Pure Chemical.
cards.reality: Ye 100% fake social media forwards myth hai! Ye sirf packaging cutting machine ke sensor 'Eye Marks' hote hain.

cards.title: Charcoal Toothpaste & Whitening Powder: Daant Safed Hote Hain ya Enamel Ghis Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Kaale Charcoal paste se 1 hafte mein daant chamakne ka vaada—par kuch mahine baad thanda-garam paani lagne lagta hai aur daant aur zyada peele kyun dikhte hain?
cards.illusion: Activated charcoal daanton ke andar se saara peela-pan kheench kar unhe moti jaisa safed bana deta hai.
cards.myth: Activated Charcoal toothpaste roz lagane se daant hamesha ke liye film stars jaise safed ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Charcoal sirf upari daag ghis kar hatata hai—roz use karne se safed enamel patla hokar daant aur peele aur sensitive ho jaate hain.

cards.title: Brush Karne ke Turant Baad Kulla (Rinse) Kyun Nahi Karna Chahiye? Aur Bachchon ka Paste
cards.hook: 99% log brush karne ke turant baad paani se kulla karte hain ya mouthwash karte hain—par dentists kehte hain 'Spit, Don't Rinse'! Aisa kyun?
cards.illusion: Brush karne ke baad munh ko khoob paani se dhona aur turant mouthwash karna daanton ke liye sabse achcha hai.
cards.myth: Toothpaste ka jhaag pet mein chala jaaye ya munh mein thoda reh jaaye to zeher ban jaata hai.
cards.reality: Sirf thook dene ke baad daanton par bachi micro-layer fluoride adults ke liye bilkul safe hoti hai aur NHS/ADA dwara cavities rokne ke liye recommended hai.

cards.title: Dard ki Goli (Ibuprofen / Paracetamol Combo / Diclofenac) Roz Lene se Pet mein Chhala aur Kidney Kharab Kyun?
cards.hook: Ghutne, kamar ya sir dard ke liye log roz medical store se bina parchi ke 'Dard ki Goli' kha lete hain—par yeh goli dard rokne ke sath pet aur kidney ki raksha parat kaise kaat deti hai?
cards.illusion: Ek chhoti si painkiller goli lene mein kya harj hai, dard toh turant band ho jaata hai!
cards.myth: Jab tak dard ki goli gas ke capsule (Pantoprazole) ke sath kha rahe hain, kidney par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.reality: Gas ka capsule sirf pet ke tezaab ko kam karke ulcer se thoda bacha sakta hai—wo KIDNEY ko painkiller ke nuksan se BILKUL nahi bacha sakta!

cards.title: Paracetamol ka Chhupa Overdose: Bukhar, Sardi aur Dard ki Goliyon mein Ek hi Salt!
cards.hook: Bukhar ke liye 650mg Paracetamol li, sardi ke liye multi-symptom cold tablet li, aur badan dard ke liye Ibuprofen+Paracetamol combo li—bina jaane aapne ek hi baar mein 3 goliyon se Liver par triple Paracetamol daal diya!
cards.illusion: Teeno goliyon ke naam aur company alag hain aur ek sardi ki hai, ek dard ki aur ek bukhar ki—to sath lene mein koi dikkat nahi.
cards.myth: Paracetamol itni safe dawa hai ki din mein 6-8 goliyan bhi kha sakte hain.
cards.reality: Sahi dose mein Paracetamol sabse safe hai, par limit (4g/day adult) paar karte hi yeh liver toxicity ka duniya mein sabse bada medical kaaran ban jaati hai.

cards.title: Antibiotic Course 2 Din mein Band Karna: 'Superbug' Bacteria Kaise Paida Hote Hain?
cards.hook: Doctor ne 5 din ki Antibiotic likhi thi, par 2 din mein bukhar utar gaya aur aapne bachi 3 din ki goliyan bacha kar rakh lein—ye bachat aapke sharir mein kya khatarnak training karti hai?
cards.illusion: Jab tabiyat 2 din mein bilkul theek ho gayi hai, to bachi hui tez antibiotic khaa kar sharir mein 'garmi' kyun badhayein?
cards.myth: Bina course poora kiye aadhi antibiotic chhod dene se sharir kam chemical se bachta hai.
cards.reality: Aadha course chhodne se kamzor bacteria mar jaate hain aur sabse khatarnak bacteria zinda bach kar dugni taakat se failte hain.

cards.title: Viral Sardi-Zukam mein Azithromycin Khana: Antibiotic Virus par 0% Kaam Kyun Karti Hai?
cards.hook: Gala kharab, naak behna aur halka bukhar hote hi log Azithromycin 500mg ki 3 goliyan kha lete hain—par vigyan kehta hai ye virus ko chhooti tak nahi, ulta pet kharab karti hai!
cards.illusion: Azithromycin khane se sardi-jukam aur gale ki kharash 3 din mein jaldi theek ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Har bukhar aur gale ki kharash mein Azithromycin lene se bimari jaldi dab jaati hai.
cards.reality: WHO ke mutabik Antibiotics sirf bacteria par kaam karti hain—viral sardi-zukam ya flu par inka 0% asar hota hai.

cards.title: Gas ka Capsule (PPI / Pantoprazole + Domperidone) Mahino Tak Khali Pet Khana: Vitamin B12 Gayab aur 'Acid Rebound'
cards.hook: Subah uthte hi bina doctor ke roz 1 gas ki goli (Pantoprazole/Omeprazole) khana bahut aam ho gaya hai—par pet ka acid saalon tak band rakhne se haddiyan aur dimaag par kya asar padta hai?
cards.illusion: Gas/acidity ki goli toh bilkul halki aur harmless hoti hai, ise zindagi bhar roz subah khali pet le sakte hain.
cards.myth: Gas ki goli ek tarah ki vitamin jaisi hai, roz khane se kuch nahi hota.
cards.reality: PPIs powerful acid-blocking drugs hain—saalon tak bina wajah roz khane se B12, Iron, Calcium ki kami aur rebound acidity hoti hai.

cards.title: Vitamin D ki Goli Paani ke Sath Khali Pet Lene se Kyun Be-Asar Ho Jaati Hai?
cards.hook: Mehengi Vitamin D3 ki 60,000 IU goli hafton khane ke baad bhi test mein level nahi badha? Shayad aap use subah khali pet sirf paani se nigal rahi thin!
cards.illusion: Har vitamin ki goli subah khali pet ek glass paani ke sath lene par sabse achche se kaam karti hai.
cards.myth: Subah 6-7 baje ki thandi dhoop Vitamin D ke liye sabse best hoti hai aur kamre ke sheeshe ke paas baithne se bhi Vitamin D milta hai.
cards.reality: Window ka sheesha UVB kirnon ko 100% block kar deta hai, aur bahut subah-shaam UVB kam hoti hai—India mein 10 AM–2 PM ke beech 15-20 min khuli dhoop Vitamin D banati hai.

cards.title: Calcium aur Iron ki Goli Ek Sath Kyun Nahi Leni Chahiye? (Pregnancy & Anaemia Tip)
cards.hook: Pregnancy ya kamzori mein doctor Iron aur Calcium dono goliyan likhte hain—par agar dono goliyan ek hi sath nigal lein, to sharir ko Iron milta hi nahi!
cards.illusion: Subah nashte ke baad ek sath Iron, Calcium aur Multivitamin sab kha lena sabse asaan aur time-saving hai.
cards.myth: Iron ki goli taakat ke liye hoti hai isliye doodh ke sath peene se double taakat milti hai.
cards.reality: Doodh ka Calcium aur Casein protein Iron ko khoon mein jaane se rok deta hai—Iron hamesha saade paani ya Vitamin C (nimbu/orange) ke sath lena chahiye.

cards.title: Khansi ka Syrup (Cough Syrup): 4 Saal se Chhote Bachchon ko Bina Doctor ke Kyun Nahi Dena Chahiye?
cards.hook: Bachche ko thodi khansi aate hi log ghar mein rakha bada cough syrup pila dete hain—par chhote bachchon mein ye syrup jaan ke liye khatarnak kyun ho sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Cough syrup toh bas meetha liquid hai—thoda sa bachche ko pilane se raat ko aaram se neend aa jayegi.
cards.myth: Bade logon ka cough syrup aadha chammach bachche ko de dene se kuch nahi hota.
cards.reality: Chhote bachchon ka liver aur nervous system naazuk hota hai—adult cough suppressants aur decongestants unmein severe side effects kar sakte hain.

cards.title: Aankh Laal Hone par Bina Doctor ke Eye Drops Daalna: Steroid Drops Roshni Chheen Sakti Hain!
cards.hook: Aankh mein dhool ya infection se laali aate hi log medical store se ₹30 ki eye drop le aate hain—par agar usmein 'Steroid' hua to wo aankh ka parda gala kar andhapan la sakti hai!
cards.illusion: Har eye drop bas aankh ki gandagi aur laali saaf karne wala thanda paani ya antibiotic hi hoti hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak bottle par print ki hui Expiry Date bachi hai, purani khuli eye drop kabhi bhi aankh mein daal sakte hain.
cards.reality: Khulne ke 28–30 din baad bottle ka preservative asar kho deta hai aur usmein bacteria panap sakte hain—purani khuli drop aankh mein infection daal sakti hai!

cards.title: Sanitary Pads mein Khushbu (Fragrance) aur White Bleach ka Sach: Rashes aur Chhedon ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Pad par 'Fresh Flower Fragrance' aur barf jaisa safed rang dekhkar mahilayein use behtar maanti hain—par wahi khushbu aur plastic top-sheet rashes aur infection kaise badhati hai?
cards.illusion: Khushbudaar (Scented) aur bilkul chamakdaar safed sanitary pad zyada hygienic hota hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak pad poora bhar na jaaye, use 10-12 ghante tak pehne rehne mein koi nuksan nahi hai.
cards.reality: Bacteria aur fungus khoon aur garmi mein har 20 minute mein badhte hain—4-6 ghante mein pad badalna infections rokne ke liye sabse zaroori hai.

cards.title: Baby Diapers mein Jaadui Gel Crystals: Diaper Rash Kyun Hota Hai aur Kab Badalna Chahiye?
cards.hook: Ek diaper 5 baar peshab sokh kar bhi upar se sookha lagta hai—par is 'jaadui gel' ke andar bachche ki skin par Ammonia aur rash kaise banta hai?
cards.illusion: Jab tak diaper bhar kar bhari na ho jaaye aur upar se sookha lag raha hai, bachche ko 8-10 ghante ek hi diaper mein rakh sakte hain.
cards.myth: Baby diaper pehanne se bachche ke pair tedhe (bow legs) ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Diaper se pair tedhe nahi hote—bas sahi size ka diaper pehnayein taaki kinaron se skin na chhile, aur samay par badlein.

cards.title: Baby Oil mein 'Mineral Oil / Paraffin': Natural Tel Nahi, Petroleum ka Byproduct!
cards.hook: Baby oil ki bottle par maa-bachche ki pyari photo hoti hai, par peeche #1 ingredient 'Paraffinum Liquidum' likha hota hai—ye kaun sa tel hai?
cards.illusion: Baby oil mein badam, olive ya nariyal jaisa koi natural poshan wala tel hota hai.
cards.myth: Baby oil 100% phoolon aur badam se nikla natural tel hota hai, ya fir 'Mineral Oil skin ke liye bilkul zeher hai'.
cards.reality: Dono extreme galat hain: Cosmetic-grade Mineral Oil skin ke liye safe moisture-locker hai (zeher nahi), par wo plant-based natural oil nahi hai—agar aapko pure plant oil chahiye to label check karein.

cards.title: Hand Sanitizer Sab Kuch Saaf Nahi Karta! Gandagi, Khane aur Pet ke Virus par Sanitizer Fail Kyun?
cards.hook: Chikne haath (tel/paratha khane ke baad) ya toilet ke baad log sirf 2 boond sanitizer mal kar khana kha lete hain—par vigyan kehta hai aisi haalat mein sanitizer kaam hi nahi karta!
cards.illusion: Pocket sanitizer har jagah sabun-paani se zyada asardar aur 100% germs khatam karne wala hai.
cards.myth: Sanitizer lagane se sabun-paani se zyada safai hoti hai aur har tarah ka virus mar jaata hai.
cards.reality: CDC ke mutabik sabun aur paani hamesha #1 choice hai—sanitizer Norovirus, chemicals, mitti aur chiknai wale haathon par fail ho jaata hai.

cards.title: Kaan Saaf Karne wali Cotton Earbuds: Mail Saaf Hota Hai ya Kaan ke Parde par Jam Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Nahane ke baad roz kaan mein cotton earbud ghumana sabko bada sukoon deta hai—par khud Earbud ke dabbe par likha hota hai 'Do not insert inside ear canal'! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Kaan ka peela mail (earwax) gandagi hai aur use roz cotton bud se nikalna zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Har hafte cotton bud se kaan saaf na karne par mail bhar kar kaan behra ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Kaan khud-ba-khud apna mail bahar nikalta hai—ulta cotton bud daalne se hi mail andar jam kar kaan block hota hai!

cards.title: Expired Dawa Khane par Kya Hota Hai? Zeher Banti Hai ya Sirf Asar Kam Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Raat ko 2 baje tez bukhar ya dard mein ghar mein rakhi 2 mahine expired goli mil gayi—kya expired dawa sachmuch zeher ban jaati hai, ya sirf uski taakat ghat-ti hai?
cards.illusion: Expiry date nikalte hi raat 12 baje ke baad har dawai zeher ban jaati hai (ya fir 1 saal purani bhi chalti hai kuch nahi hota).
cards.myth: Fridge mein dawai rakhne se wo expiry date ke baad bhi 2 saal chalti hai.
cards.reality: Sirf wahi dawaiyan fridge mein rakhein jinpar 'Store in Refrigerator (2-8°C)' likha ho—aam tablets fridge ki nami mein kharab ho sakti hain!

cards.title: Dawai ke Patte par 'Laal Patti' (Red Line) aur 'Rx / Schedule H' ka Asli Matlab
cards.hook: Har antibiotic ya tez dawai ke patte par ek lambi laal line chhapi hoti hai—90% log ise bas design samajh kar bina doctor ke goli kha lete hain!
cards.illusion: Dawai ke patte par laal line bas company ke design ya packaging ka hissa hoti hai.
cards.myth: Chemist dukaan par har roz dawa dete hain, unhe doctor jitna hi pata hota hai.
cards.reality: Pharmacist ka kaam sahi dawa dispense karna hai, bimari diagnose karna nahi—bina test aur physical checkup ke di gayi tez dawa aksar nuksan karti hai.

cards.title: Nakli aur Fail (NSQ) Dawai Kaise Pakdein? Top-300 Brands par QR Code aur CDSCO List
cards.hook: Mehengi BP, Sugar ya Antibiotic dawa khane par bhi asar nahi ho raha? Ho sakta hai wo 'NSQ' (Quality Fail) batch ho ya nakli strip—aapke phone se 5 second mein check kaise ho sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Har bade medical store mein sealed patte mein bikne wali branded dawa 100% asli aur quality-tested hoti hai.
cards.myth: Bade brands ki dawa kabhi nakli ya lab-fail nahi ho sakti.
cards.reality: Nakli banane wale sabse zyada bade aur famous brands ki hi copy banate hain, aur har mahine CDSCO ke NSQ alerts mein kai batches quality-fail paaye jaate hain—isliye bill aur QR check zaroori hai.

cards.title: Whey Protein Powder se Kidney Kharab Hoti Hai ya Nahi? (Asli Science vs Sasta Nakli Dabba Scam)
cards.hook: Maa-baap darte hain ki gym ke protein powder se kidney fail ho jaati hai—par doctors kehte hain asli whey doodh se banta hai, asli khatra toh saste nakli dabbon mein chhupe steroids ka hai!
cards.illusion: Har protein powder ek chemical steroid hota hai jo swasth insaan ki kidney kharab kar deta hai.
cards.myth: Asli Whey Protein khane se swasth insaan ki kidney fail ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Pure whey protein sirf doodh ka protein hai; kidney damage nakli/spiked supplements aur illegal gym steroids ki wajah se hota hai.

cards.title: 'Weight Loss Slimming Tea' aur Fat Burners: Charbi Nahi Ghati, Sirf Pet Saaf Hoke Paani Nikalta Hai!
cards.hook: '7 Din mein 3 Kilo Kam Karein' wali herbal slimming tea peete hi tarazu par wajan kam dikhta hai—par 1 hafte baad wapas utna hi wajan kyun aa jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Slimming tea aur detox drinks sharir ki jami hui charbi (fat) ko pighla kar bahar nikal deti hain.
cards.myth: Din mein 4 baar washroom jaane se sharir ki saari charbi aur toxins dhul kar nikal jaate hain.
cards.reality: Hamara Liver aur Kidney khud sharir ko detox karte hain; slimming tea se sirf paani aur electrolytes ka nuksan hota hai, charbi ka nahi.

cards.title: '100% Herbal Diabetes Cure' Powder mein Chhupi Allopathic Goli! (Hidden Metformin/Glibenclamide Scam)
cards.hook: social media forwards ya baba ke advertise se liya 'Desi Jadi-Booti Churan' khate hi blood sugar 300 se 110 par aa gayi—par jab lab test hua to churan ke andar allopathic sugar ki goli peesi hui nikli!
cards.illusion: Desi/herbal churan ne 5 din mein meri diabetes jad se control kar di aur iska koi side effect nahi hai.
cards.myth: Har 'Ayurvedic / Desi' bolkar bikne wale churan ka koi side effect nahi hota.
cards.reality: Asli Ayurveda surakshit niyamon par chalta hai, par uncertified churan/pudiya mein steroids, heavy metals aur pisi allopathic dawaiyan milane ke kai cases pakde jaate hain.

cards.title: Roz Tez Herbal Kaadha (Giloy / Ashwagandha) Peene ki Aadat: 'Natural' hone par bhi Liver par Asar?
cards.hook: Immunity badhane ke liye log roz subah-shaam 2-2 cup kadwa Giloy-Kalimirch-Dalchini kaadha pite rahe—par kuch logon mein bina sharaab ke bhi Liver (SGPT/SGOT) kaise badh gaya?
cards.illusion: Jadi-booti aur ghar ka kaadha bilkul natural hai, isliye jitna zyada aur roz piyein utna hi fayda hoga.
cards.myth: Natural/Ayurvedic cheezein jitni zyada matra mein li jayein, utni hi immunity badhti hai aur 0% side effect hota hai.
cards.reality: Har active natural compound ko liver process karta hai—excessive aur prolonged dosing se natural herbs bhi liver injury kar sakti hain.

cards.title: Chot ya Moch Aane par Garam Sekai Karein ya Barf Lagayein? (RICE vs Heat Science)
cards.hook: Pair mudne (moch) ya khelte waqt chot lagne par log turant garam paani ki thaili se sekai shuru kar dete hain—par pehle 48 ghante mein garam sekai sujan ko dugna kyun kar deti hai?
cards.illusion: Har tarah ke dard aur sujan mein garam paani ki thaili (Hot Water Bag) se sekai karne se aaram milta hai.
cards.myth: Moch aate hi garam haldi-namak baandh kar tez sekai aur malish karne se moch turant theek ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Taaza moch par tez malish aur garam sekai andar ke phate ligaments ko aur chot pahuncha kar sujan dugni kar deti hai—pehle 48 ghante sirf Ice + Rest + Elevation (pair upar rakhna) karein.

cards.title: Bukhar (Fever) mein Mathey par Barf ka Paani vs Saada Paani: Barf Lagane se Bukhar Aur Kyun Badhta Hai?
cards.hook: Tez bukhar (103°F) hone par log freezer ka thanda barf wala paani lekar patti rakhne lagte hain—par doctors isse mana kyun karte hain?
cards.illusion: Bukhar mein sharir bahut garam hai, isliye jitna thanda barf ka paani lagayenge bukhar utni hi jaldi utrega.
cards.myth: Bukhar mein barf ke paani ki patti rakhne aur 2 moti razai odhne se paseena aakar bukhar utarta hai.
cards.reality: Dono tarike galat hain: moti razai garmi ko andar band karke bukhar aur badhati hai (khaaskar bachchon mein), aur barf kampkapi paida karta hai—halki cotton chadar + normal tap water sponging best hai!

cards.title: ORS ka Asli Vigyan: Cheeni-Namak ka Sahi Anupaat Kyun Zaroori Hai, aur Dast mein Cold Drink/packaged sugary drink Kyun Zeher Hai?
cards.hook: Ulti-dast hone par log ghar mein andaze se cheeni-namak ghol dete hain ya bacche ko 'energy' ke liye packaged sugary drink/Cold Drink pila dete hain—par galat ratio dast ko aur tez kyun kar deta hai?
cards.illusion: Dast mein koi bhi meetha paani, Glucon-D ya mango juice pilane se sharir mein taakat aur paani aa jaata hai.
cards.myth: Dast mein thoda ORS powder ek glass paani mein daal kar rakh lena chahiye aur baaki packet baad ke liye bacha lena chahiye.
cards.reality: Aadha packet gholne par namak aur cheeni alag-alag baith sakte hain jisse ratio bigad jaata hai—hamesha poora 1L packet ek sath 1L bottle mein gholein (ya chhote 200ml wale 4.1g sachet kharidein!).

cards.title: Ghar ki Digital BP Machine Galat Reading Kyun Deti Hai? 4 Vigyanik Galtiyan
cards.hook: Ghar par BP naapne par 150/95 aaya aur doctor ke paas jaate hi 125/80 nikla—kya machine kharab hai, ya baithne ke tarike ne reading 20 point badha di?
cards.illusion: Digital BP machine pe jab chahe tab button dabakar haath pe bandh lo, reading sahi hi aayegi.
cards.myth: Digital BP machine hamesha galat hoti hai, sirf purani pare (mercury) wali machine hi sahi batati hai.
cards.reality: Validated Upper-Arm digital machines (Omron/BPL etc.) sahi posture mein bilkul accurate hoti hain—galti aksar posture, cup size aur bina rest kiye naapne se hoti hai.

cards.title: Smartwatch Heart Rate & Pulse Oximeter: Nail Polish, Mehendi aur Thand mein Galat Reading Kyun?
cards.hook: Ungli par gaadha nail polish ya mehendi lagi ho, ya haath thand se thithure hon—to Oximeter oxygen 88% dikha kar dara deta hai aur Smartwatch table par rakhe-rakhe bhi heartbeat dikhati hai!
cards.illusion: Smartwatch aur ₹500 wala sasta pulse oximeter hospital ki machine jitna hi pakka medical data dete hain.
cards.myth: Smartwatch par ECG aur BP dikh raha hai to BP machine ki koi zaroorat nahi.
cards.reality: Smartwatches bina cuff ke optical estimate lagati hain jo BP ke liye reliable nahi hota—BP ke liye hamesha Upper-Arm Cuff machine hi use karein.

cards.title: Dengue mein Papite ke Patte ka Ras aur Kiwi: Platelets Sachmuch Badhte Hain ya Hydration Asli Hero Hai?
cards.hook: Dengue hote hi log ₹100 mein 1 kiwi aur din mein 3 glass kadwa papite ke patte ka ras pilane lagte hain—par agar ulti shuru ho jaaye to khatra kaise badh jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Papite ke patte ka ras aur kiwi khane se hi dengue mein platelets badhte hain aur jaan bachti hai.
cards.myth: Platelets 50,000 hote hi turant blood/platelet chadhana zaroori hota hai.
cards.reality: WHO guidelines ke mutabik jab tak bleeding na ho, 20,000–30,000 tak bhi bina transfusion sirf fluids aur monitoring se platelets apne aap recover ho jaati hain (decision hamesha doctor lete hain).

cards.title: Contact Lens ko Saade Paani se Dhona: Aankh mein 'Acanthamoeba' Infection ka Khatra
cards.hook: Agar contact lens ka solution khatam ho jaaye, to log raat ko lens ko RO ya tap water mein rakh dete hain—par aankh ke doctors isse sabse badi galti kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: RO ya ubaalkar thanda kiya paani toh bilkul saaf aur peene layak hai, to usmein lens dhone mein kya dikkat hai?
cards.myth: Ubaalkar thanda kiya hua ya bottled water contact lens rakhne ke liye bilkul safe hai.
cards.reality: Saade paani mein na to disinfecting power hoti hai aur na sahi salt balance (osmolarity)—lens phool kar aankh se chipak sakta hai aur Acanthamoeba infection de sakta hai.

cards.title: Menstrual Cup ka Vigyan: Medical-Grade Silicone Safe Kaise Hai aur Boiling/Suction Rule Kya Hai?
cards.hook: Menstrual cup ko lekar mahilaon mein bahut darr aur myths hain—ye andar ghum toh nahi jaata? Aur ise har mahine ubaalna zaroori kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Cup sharir ke andar jaakar khoon ko rok deta hai ya upar pet mein chala jaata hai, ya fir 'koi bhi sasta online cup ek jaisa hota hai'.
cards.myth: Menstrual cup sharir ke andar khoob upar chala jaata hai aur wapas nahi nikalta.
cards.reality: Cervix ka rasta band jaisa hota hai—cup kabhi andar kho nahi sakta, bas pelvic muscles relax karke base ko pinch karne par aaram se bahar aa jaata hai.

cards.title: Liquid Mosquito Vaporizer (All-Out / Good Knight): Band Kamre mein Raat Bhar Lagana Kitna Safe?
cards.hook: Machhar coil se dhuan hota hai isliye log liquid vaporizer laga kar kamre ke darwaze-khidkiyan poori band kar ke so jaate hain—par chhote bachche ke sirhane iska asar kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Liquid vaporizer mein koi dhuan nahi dikhta, isliye isse band AC kamre mein bachchon ke bilkul paas raat bhar chalu rakhna 100% safe hai.
cards.myth: Liquid vaporizer mein sirf neem/phoolon ka tel hota hai aur dawa sirf machhar par asar karti hai.
cards.reality: Liquid mein Transfluthrin/Prallethrin insecticide + hydrocarbon solvent hota hai—ye coil se behtar zaroor hai par band kamre mein ventilation aur distance zaroori hai.

cards.title: Jan Aushadhi ₹5 ki Generic Dawai vs ₹80 ki Branded Dawai: Same Chemical Salt ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: Ek hi Paracetamol ya BP ki goli private company ki ₹80 mein aur Jan Aushadhi Kendra par ₹8 mein milti hai—kya sasti generic dawai kam asar karti hai, ya dono ka formula 100% ek hai?
cards.illusion: Mehengi branded dawai zyada taqatwar aur jaldi asar karti hai, jabki sasti generic dawai halki quality ki hoti hai.
cards.myth: Jan Aushadhi ki ₹8 wali goli mein sirf 50% dawai aur baaki chalk bhara hota hai.
cards.reality: PMBJP Jan Aushadhi dawaiyan WHO-GMP certified factories mein banti hain aur har batch NABL lab testing ke baad hi store par aata hai—keemat kam isliye hai kyunki koi MR marketing ya 30%–50% chemist margin nahi hota!

cards.title: Topical Diclofenac Pain Spray vs Garam Balm: Kya Ye Sirf Thanda-Garam Feel Dete Hain ya Asli Dard Mitate Hain?
cards.hook: Kamar ya ghutne mein dard hone par log din mein 5 baar pain spray ya garam balm malte hain—par kuch ghante baad dard wapas kyun aata hai, aur bina-medical-salt wale balm sirf dimaag ko kaise bhatkate hain?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada jalne-jhanjhanane wala balm ya thanda spray lagayenge, andar ki haddi ya nas utni hi tezi se theek ho rahi hai.
cards.myth: Pain balm lagane ke turant baad garam paani ki thaili se sikai karne par dawai double tezi se andar jaati hai.
cards.reality: FDA ne ispar sakt warning di hai—balm/spray ke upar heating pad lagane se blood flow badhkar serious skin burns aur chemical overdose ho sakta hai!

cards.title: Naak Kholne Wala Spray (Otrivin / Xylometazoline) 5 Din se Zyada Lagane par Naak Hamesha Band Kyun?
cards.hook: Zukam mein 1 spray lagate hi 30 second mein naak khul jaati hai—par 10 din lagatar use karne ke baad jab aap spray band karte hain, to naak pehle se 2 guna zyada band kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Otrivin / Oxymetazoline nasal spray bas ek normal paani-namak drop hai, jise har raat mahinon tak lagana bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Nasal decongestant spray sirf naak mein lagta hai isliye uska koi side effect ya aadat nahi padti.
cards.reality: 5 din se zyada lagatar use karne par 100% rebound swelling (Rhinitis Medicamentosa) hoti hai—har bottle ke packet par khud 'Do not use for more than 5–7 days' likha hota hai!

cards.title: Aankh Laal Hone par 'Chamakdaar Safed Aankh' Drops Lagana: Rebound Redness & Chemical Addiction!
cards.hook: Neend na puri hone ya mobile screen se aankhein laal dikhte hi log chemist se 'Redness-Relief / Whitening Eye Drops' daal lete hain—par kuch din baad aankhein pehle se zyada laal kyun rehne lagti hain?
cards.illusion: Aankh ki laali turant saaf karne wale drops aankhon ki thakan aur dry-eye ko andar se theek karte hain.
cards.myth: Khuli hui eye drop ki bottle uspar likhi 2-saal ki Expiry Date tak fridge mein rakh kar kabhi bhi daali jaa sakti hai.
cards.reality: Seal khulne ke baad hawa aur dropper tip se bacteria andar jaate hain—almost sabhi eye drops khulne ke **28–30 din ke andar** phenk dene chahiye!

cards.title: Kaan Dard mein Garam Sarson-Lehsun Tel Daalna: Kaan ke Parde mein Chhed aur Fungal Infection ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Raat ko kaan mein dard ya khujli hote hi dadi-nani garam sarson ka tel, lehsun ya hydrogen peroxide daalne ko kehti hain—par ENT doctors isse sabse khatarnak galti kyun maante hain?
cards.illusion: Garam sarson-lehsun tel kaan ka dard aur mail (earwax) turant pighla kar bahar nikaal deta hai aur bilkul natural safe nuskha hai.
cards.myth: Garam lehsun wala sarson ka tel har kaan dard aur mail ke liye 100% safe gharelu ilaj hai.
cards.reality: Kitchen oils sterile nahi hote, fungal infections (Otomycosis) badhate hain, aur agar parde mein chhed ho to middle ear mein jakar permanent hearing damage kar sakte hain.

cards.title: Jal Jaane par Toothpaste, Aata, Ghee ya Barf Lagana: Garmi Andar Lock Hona vs 20-Min Running Water!
cards.hook: Rasoi mein garam tawa ya bhaap se haath jalte hi har ghar mein log turant safed Toothpaste, Ghee, Aata ya Barf laga dete hain—par doctors isse burn aur zyada gehra karne wali galti kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Toothpaste mein mint hota hai aur barf thanda hota hai, isliye jalne par lagane se skin turant theek ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Jali hui jagah par safed toothpaste ya aate ka lep lagane se thandak milti hai aur phaphole (blisters) nahi padte.
cards.reality: Mint ki thandak sirf 1 minute ka ehsaas hai—toothpaste mein maujood chalk, fluoride aur detergent garmi ko andar lock kar ke burn ko aur gehra aur infected bana dete hain!

cards.title: Chot Lagne par Seedhe Antiseptic Liquid, Spirit ya Hydrogen Peroxide Daalna: Zakhm Der se Kyun Bharta Hai?
cards.hook: Girne ya chhuri se haath katne par hum sabse pehle dard se chillate hue seedhe raw antiseptic liquid ya Hydrogen Peroxide (jhaag banane wala paani) udel dete hain—par doctors aajkal isse mana kyun karte hain?
cards.illusion: Zakhm par jitna tez jalan aur safed jhaag (fizz) hoga, bacteria utne hi achche se mar kar chot jaldi theek hogi.
cards.myth: Hydrogen Peroxide dalne par jo safed jhaag banta hai wo zakhm ke andar ke keetanu marne ka saboot hai.
cards.reality: Wo jhaag sirf aapke khud ke khoon aur healthy cells mein maujood *Catalase* enzyme se banta hai—hydrogen peroxide healthy healing cells ko nuksan pahunchata hai!

cards.title: Zakhm ko 'Khula Hawa Mein Sukhana' vs Bandage mein Nam Rakhna: Daag (Scar) Kam Kaise Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Chot lagne par bade-buzurg bolte hain 'Patti khol do, hawa lagne se zakhm jaldi sukhega aur khurand (scab) jam jayega!' Par dermatologists zakhm ko dhak kar nam rakhne ko kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Zakhm par hawa lagne se sukha kaala khurand (scab) jamna jaldi theek hone ki nishani hai.
cards.myth: Zakhm ko din bhar band rakhne se usmein sadan (infection) lag jaati hai, isliye khula chhodna zaroori hai.
cards.reality: Saaf dhule hue zakhm ko clean bandage se dhakne se ulta bahar ki dhool aur bacteria se suraksha milti hai aur healing 2x fast hoti hai!

cards.title: Munhase (Pimple) par Raat mein Toothpaste Lagana vs Hydrocolloid Patch: Kaala Daag Kyun Padta Hai?
cards.hook: Shadi ya party se ek raat pehle naak/gaal par pimple nikalte hi log uspar regular toothpaste, nimbu ya baking soda laga dete hain—par subah pimple sookhne ke bajaye skin jal kar kaala dhabba kyun pad jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Pimple par toothpaste ya nimbu lagane se wo raaton-raat sookh kar gayab ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Toothpaste pimple ko sukha kar 1 raat mein gayab karne ka dermatologist-approved hack hai.
cards.reality: Har dermatologist toothpaste ko chehre par lagane se sakt mana karta hai—ye skin barrier ko jala kar pakka kaala daag (hyperpigmentation) bana deta hai!

cards.title: Chehre par Nahane ka Sabun (pH 10) Lagane se Skin Tight aur Dry Kyun Hoti Hai? Acid Mantle pH 5.5!
cards.hook: Nahane wale sabun se chehra dhone ke 5 minute baad gaal ekdum kiche-kiche (squeaky clean/tight) aur dry lagte hain—kya wo 'tight' feel saaf skin ki nishani hai ya skin barrier tootne ki?
cards.illusion: Chehra dhone ke baad jitna zyada kicha-kicha aur oil-free 'squeaky clean' mehsoos ho, face wash utna hi achcha hai.
cards.myth: Chehra dhone ke baad skin bilkul sukhi aur tight ('squeaky clean') lagni chahiye tabhi wo saaf mani jaati hai.
cards.reality: Squeaky-tight feel ka matlab hai aapne skin ki zaroori natural lipids aur acid mantle ko strip kar diya hai—saaf skin mulayam aur hydrated feel honi chahiye!

cards.title: Saste 'Glowing Serum' (AHA/BHA/Retinol) Roz Lagane se Chehra Kaala aur Jala Hua Kyun Dikhta Hai?
