cards.hook: social media videos reels dekh kar log ₹400–₹600 ke laal 'AHA-BHA Chemical Peel' aur 'Retinol' serums le aate hain—par 2 hafte roz lagane ke baad hi chehra laal, kaala aur chhila hua kyun dikhne lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Chemical exfoliants (AHA/BHA) aur Retinol jitni zyada baar aur zyada % mein lagayenge, chehra utni hi jaldi glass-skin jaisa chamak jayega.
cards.myth: Serum lagane par jab chehre par halka jhanjhanahat aur jalan ho, to iska matlab dawai achche se asar kar rahi hai.
cards.reality: Skincare kabhi jalna nahi chahiye! Jalan aur laali skin barrier damage (chemical irritation) ki nishani hai—use turant kam ya band karna chahiye.

cards.title: '20% Niacinamide / 30% Vitamin C' High Percentage Serum Scam: Zyada % matlab Behtar Skin Nahi!
cards.hook: Skincare brands ab '2% vs 5% vs 10% vs 20% Niacinamide' ka number war khel rahe hain—par clinical studies ke hisab se 5% ke baad 15%–20% serum lagane se faayde ke bajaye daane kyun nikalte hain?
cards.illusion: Jitna bada % number bottle par likha hoga (e.g., 10% ya 20% Niacinamide, 25% Vitamin C), wo utni hi tez aur better glow dega.
cards.myth: Agar 5% Niacinamide achcha hai to 20% Niacinamide 4 guna zyada tezi se daag-dhabbe mitayega.
cards.reality: Clinical data 2%–5% par plateau dikhata hai—10%–20% par efficacy 4x nahi hoti, sirf skin irritation aur flushing ka risk badhta hai!

cards.title: ₹2,000 ka 'Marine Collagen Powder & Skin Gummies': Pet mein Jaakar Ye Dal-Roti Amino Acids Kaise Banta Hai?
cards.hook: Wrinkles aur glowing skin ke liye aajkal ₹2,000/dabba 'Marine Collagen Peptides' aur gummies khoob bik rahi hain—par kya khaya hua collagen seedhe gaalon par jaakar chipakta hai, ya pet usse tod deta hai?
cards.illusion: Collagen powder peene se wo seedhe chehre ki skin ke neeche jaakar jhurriyan bhar deta hai.
cards.myth: Collagen gummies aur marine collagen powder seedhe pet se hokar skin ke neeche jam jaata hai.
cards.reality: Pet har protein (chahe collagen ho ya paneer/eggs) ko basic amino acids aur di/tri-peptides mein tod deta hai—sharir phir apni zaroorat aur Vitamin C ki madad se khud collagen banata hai.

cards.title: 'Biotin Hair Gummies' se Baal Ugne ka Hype vs Thyroid aur Heart Blood Test Report Bigadna!
cards.hook: Baal jhadte hi log ₹600 ki meethi '10,000 mcg Biotin Hair Gummies' khane lagte hain—par kya Biotin sachmuch baal ugata hai, aur US FDA ne isse blood test reports bigadne ki warning kyun di hai?
cards.illusion: High-dose Biotin gummies ya tablets khane se har kisi ke jhadte baal ruk jaate hain aur naye baal ug aate hain.
cards.myth: Biotin Vitamin B hai isliye 10,000 mcg roz khane se koi nuksan nahi aur baal double tezi se badhte hain.
cards.reality: Bina deficiency ke high-dose Biotin baal nahi ugata, ulta lab blood tests (Thyroid, Troponin, Hormones) ko galat kar ke dangerous medical misdiagnosis kara sakta hai!

cards.title: Pyaz ka Tel (Onion Oil) vs Rosemary vs Minoxidil: Ganjepon aur Baal Jhadne ka Asli Medical Sach!
cards.hook: TV ads aur social media videos dekh kar log ₹500 ka 'Red Onion Hair Oil' aur 'Rosemary Water' lagate hain—kya pyaz ka tel sachmuch naye baal ugata hai, ya Genetic Hair Loss mein sirf Minoxidil hi kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Pyaz ka tel (Onion Oil) lagane se ganjapan door hokar 1 mahine mein naye ghane baal ug aate hain.
cards.myth: Minoxidil lagane se shuru ke 2 hafte mein baal zyada jhadne lagte hain matlab dawai baal kharab kar rahi hai.
cards.reality: Wo 'Dread Shed' temporary hota hai—kamzor purane baal gir kar unki jagah naye mote baal ugne ke liye jagah banate hain! Beech mein doctor se poochhe bina band nahi karna chahiye.

cards.title: Parlour mein ₹5,000 ka 'Formaldehyde-Free Keratin / Hair Botox': Aankh Jalane Wala Cancer-Risk Dhuan!
cards.hook: Parlour wale bolte hain 'Ye 100% Formaldehyde-Free Keratin/Hair Botox treatment hai'—par jab 230°C flat iron chalate hain, to aankhon se aansoo aur gale mein tez jalan kyun hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Parlour mein jo 'Keratin / Hair Botox' treatment bottle par 'Formaldehyde-Free' likha hota hai, usmein koi toxic gas nahi hoti.
cards.myth: Hair Keratin / Hair Botox salon treatment baalon ko andar se natural protein aur poshan deta hai.
cards.reality: Keratin treatment baal ko poshan nahi deta—wo chemical cross-linking aur 230°C heat press se baalon ke bonds ko plastic ki tarah seedha seal kar deta hai!

cards.title: Geelay ya Silky-Serum Wale Baalon par Straightener Chalane se 'Chhan' Aawaz: Bubble Hair Damage!
cards.hook: Jaldi mein nahane ke baad halke geelay baalon par 210°C Hair Straightener ya Curler lagate hi 'Chhannn...' ki aawaz aur bhaap nikalti hai! Ye baalon ko andar se kaise phod deta hai?
cards.illusion: Halke geelay (damp) baalon par straightener chalane se baal jaldi sookh kar zyada seedhe aur shiny ho jaate hain.
cards.myth: 'Wet-to-Dry' likhe hue hair straighteners geelay baalon par chalana 100% damage-free hota hai.
cards.reality: High heat se geelay baalon ka paani tezi se bhaap banata hi hai—pehle hawa ya cool/medium dryer se poora sukhana hi baalon ko bubble damage se bachata hai.

cards.title: Roz Tight Choti/Bun Bandhne se Maathe ke Paas ke Baal Peeche Kyun Khisak Rahe Hain? Traction Alopecia!
cards.hook: School girls, nurses, gym karne wali auratien aur sikh pagdi/tight bun bandhne walon mein maathe aur kanpati (temples) ke paas ke baal patle ho kar gaayab kyun hone lagte hain?
cards.illusion: Baalon ko tight kheench kar choti ya high ponytail bandhne se baal jaldi lambe aur mazboot hote hain.
cards.myth: Bacchon ke baal roz tight kheench kar choti bandhne se jadon ko exercise milti hai aur baal lambe hote hain.
cards.reality: Lagatar khinchav (traction) se follicles mein sujan aakar baal jad se kamzor ho jaate hain aur permanently gir sakte hain!

cards.title: Underarms Kaala Hone par Nimbu, Baking Soda ya Bleach Lagana: Ragad aur Jalan se Aur Kaalapan Kyun?
cards.hook: Underarms (bagal) ka rang gehra hone par log social media videos dekh kar uspar Nimbu-Baking Soda ragadte hain ya facial Bleach laga lete hain—par 1 mahine mein bagal aur zyada kaali aur khurduri kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Nimbu aur Baking Soda natural bleach hain jo bagal aur ghutne-kohni ke kaalepan ko 7 din mein gora kar dete hain.
cards.myth: Gardan ke peeche aur bagal ka kaalapan sirf nahane mein mail na ragadne ki wajah se hota hai aur nimbu-besan se chhoot jaata hai.
cards.reality: Zyada ragadne aur nimbu-soda lagane se skin aur kaali hoti hai; aur velvety darkening aksar Insulin Resistance / PCOS ka internal medical symptom hota hai!

cards.title: 'Vaginal Tightening / Perfume Intimate Wash' ki Marketing: Khud Saaf Hone Wale Organ mein Infection Kyun?
cards.hook: TV aur social media videos par mahilaon ko daraya jaata hai ki 'Normal paani kafi nahi, rose-jasmine Intimate Wash aur Tightening Gel lagayein!' Par gynaecologists in scented washes se bachne ko kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Vagina ko sabun ya scented intimate wash se andar tak dhona hygiene ke liye zaroori hai aur 'tightening gels' safe hote hain.
cards.myth: Rozana aromatic 'Intimate Wash' lagane se vaginal badbu aur safed paani aana hamesha ke liye band ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Thoda saaf white/clear discharge bilkul healthy aur natural hota hai! Scented wash use karne se natural pH aur bacteria bigad kar ulta badbu aur infection badhate hain.

cards.title: Pink 'Women's Razor' ₹250 vs Blue 'Men's Razor' ₹120: Same Blade par Double Daam ('Pink Tax' Scam)!
cards.hook: Bazaar mein auraton wala gulabi razor ₹250 ka bikta hai aur mardon wala neela bilkul wahi 3-blade razor ₹110 ka—kya pink razor mein koi alag magic blade hota hai ya sirf rang ka double paisa liya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Women's pink razors mahilaon ki soft skin ke liye alag special sharp technology se bante hain, isliye mehenge hote hain.
cards.myth: Men's razors mahilaon ke haath-pair ke liye bahut hard aur skin katne wale hote hain.
cards.reality: Dono mein same stainless steel blades aur angles hote hain—actually men's razors to rozana chehre ki sensitive skin aur sakht baalon ke liye zyada precise bane hote hain!

cards.title: Kaale Honth Gulabi Karne Wale Lip Balms aur Sugar Scrubs: 'Lip-Licking Eczema' aur Sun Damage!
cards.hook: Honthon ka rang gehra hone par log ₹400 ke 'Pink Lip Lightening Balm' aur Coffee-Sugar Scrub roz ragadte hain—par honth gulabi hone ke bajaye aur zyada phat kar kaale kyun padte hain?
cards.illusion: Honthon par roz chini-nimbu scrub ragadne aur gulabi tint balm lagane se kaale honth hamesha ke liye gulabi ho jaate hain.
cards.myth: Honthon par chini, shahad aur nimbu ragadne se dead skin hat kar honth permanent pink ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Honthon ki patli skin par chini ke tez kinare aur nimbu ka acid micro-cuts aur inflammation karke pigmentation (kaalapan) aur badha sakte hain.

cards.title: Baar-Baar Nail Polish aur Acetone Lagane se Nakhun Peela aur Tootne Kyun Lagte Hain?
cards.hook: Har hafte naya dark nail paint aur ₹30 wala remover lagane ke baad nakhun kaagaz ki tarah patle hokar peele padne aur beech se phatne (peeling) lagte hain! Nakhun ko saans lene ki zaroorat hoti hai kya?
cards.illusion: Nakhun bejaan haddi jaise hain—unpar lagatar dark nail polish aur gel manicure rakhne se koi nuksan nahi hota.
cards.myth: Nakhunon ko 'saans lene' ki zaroorat hoti hai aur parlour mein cuticles kaatne se nakhun lambe badhte hain.
cards.reality: Nakhun ko oxygen khoon se milti hai, hawa se nahi—par polish-free break moisture aur chemical recovery ke liye zaroori hota hai, aur cuticles kaatne se bacteria/fungus andar ghus jaata hai!

cards.title: Parlour/Mall mein 'Fish Spa' aur Edi ki Chamdi Blade se Chhilwana: Fungal aur Hepatitis Infection Risk!
cards.hook: Malls aur salons mein log ₹300 dekar 'Fish Spa' tank mein pair daalte hain ya pedicure mein edi ki moti chamdi razor blade se chhilwate hain—par health agencies in dono se darne ko kyun kehti hain?
cards.illusion: Fish Spa aur salon mein edi ki dead skin blade se chhilwana bilkul clean aur harmless pampering hai.
cards.myth: Fish Spa tank mein laga UV filter saare bacteria aur fungus ko 100% maar deta hai.
cards.reality: Water filter machhliyon ke muh aur fish waste mein chupe bacteria/fungi ko turant destroy nahi kar sakta—CDC ne fish spa ko diabetic aur cut-skin logon ke liye unsafe bataya hai.

cards.title: ₹500 wale Online 'LED Teeth Whitening Kit' aur Strips: Enamel Jhanjhanahat aur Masoodhe Jalne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Mohtaj hokar log online ₹499 ke 'Teeth Whitening Pens, Strips aur Blue LED Mouthpiece' mangwate hain—par 3 din lagate hi daanton mein bijli jaisi jhanjhanahat aur masoodhe safed jal kyun jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Online saste Blue-LED teeth whitening kits aur whitening strips 100% dentist-grade aur enamel-safe hote hain.
cards.myth: Neeli LED light lagane wale ₹500 ke home kit mein light bina kisi chemical ke daant safed karti hai.
cards.reality: Wo sasti blue LED sirf ek dikhawa hoti hai—asli kaam uske sath diya gel karta hai, aur saste kits mein acidic Sodium Chlorite enamel ko damage kar sakta hai.

cards.title: Roz Alcohol-Wala Tez Mouthwash Karne se Ulta Munh Sukhna aur Badbu Badhna: Oral Microbiome!
cards.hook: Taaza saans ke liye log roz din mein 2 baar tez blue/green Alcohol-based Mouthwash (Listerine style) se kulla karte hain—par kuch hafton baad munh zyada dry aur subah badbu double kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Tez jalan wala alcohol mouthwash munh ke 99.9% badbu wale bacteria maar kar saans ko sabse fresh rakhta hai.
cards.myth: Brush aur Floss karne ke bajaye roz 30 second mouthwash se kulla karna bilkul barabar safai deta hai.
cards.reality: Mouthwash daanton par chipke sticky plaque (biofilm) ko nahi hata sakta—wo sirf physical brushing aur flossing se hi hat-ta hai!

cards.title: Steel ke Jeebh-Chhilne (Tongue Cleaner) se Roz Zor-Zor se Jeebh Ragadna: Taste Buds aur Micro-Cuts!
cards.hook: Subah brush ke baad log steel/brass ke patle patti-wale Tongue Cleaner ko dono haathon se pakad kar itna zor se jeebh par ragadte hain ki khoon tak aa jaata hai—kya safed jeebh ko roz chhilna sahi hai?
cards.illusion: Jeebh par jitna zor se steel patti ragad kar gulabi-laal karein, munh utna hi saaf aur bacteria-free hota hai.
cards.myth: Jeebh tab tak steel patti se ragadni chahiye jab tak wo bilkul chamakdaar laal na dikhne lage.
cards.reality: Halka sa safed-gulabi rang normal papillae ki wajah se hota hai—lal karne ke chakkar mein zor se chhilna jeebh par micro-wounds banata hai.

cards.title: Subah Munh mein Nariyal Tel Ghumane ('Oil Pulling') se Daanton ka Keeda (Cavity) Theek Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Social media par har influencer bolta hai ki subah 15 minute Nariyal ya Til ka tel munh mein ghumane ('Oil Pulling') se daanton ke keede (cavities), masoodhon aur poori body ke toxins bahar nikal jaate hain! Vigyan kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Oil Pulling karne se daanton mein laga keeda (tooth decay) bhar kar theek ho jaata hai aur toothpaste-brush ki zaroorat nahi rehti.
cards.myth: Oil pulling karne se sharir ke saare khoon ke toxins safed tel mein nikal aate hain aur cavities khud bhar jaati hain.
cards.reality: Tel thookne par safed isliye dikhta hai kyunki wo munh ke thook (saliva) ke sath milkar **Emulsion** banata hai—wo toxins nahi hain, aur na hi koi tel daant ki cavity bhar sakta hai!

cards.title: Har Roz Antibacterial/Antiseptic Soap se Nahane par Skin ka Good Microbiome Marna aur Khujli!
cards.hook: Doctors aur TV ads ke dar se log ghar mein rozana nahane ke liye tez '99.9% Germ-Kill' antibacterial sabun aur body wash lagate hain—par winter/summer mein sharir par rukhapan aur khujli kyun badh jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Antibacterial soap rozana lagane se normal sabun ke mukable zyada bimariyon se bachav hota hai.
cards.myth: Garmi-baarish mein infection se bachne ke liye poore parivaar ko roz dawai-wale antibacterial sabun se hi nahana chahiye.
cards.reality: US FDA ki review ke mutabik aam gharon mein OTC antibacterial soaps plain soap se behtar bimari nahi rokte—ulta skin dry aur irritated kar sakte hain.

cards.title: 'Sunscreen Spray & Stick' ka Viral Trend: Chehre par 20% Coverage bhi Nahi Milti!
cards.hook: Haath ganda na ho isliye log ₹700 ka 'Sunscreen Spray' ya 'Sunscreen Stick' kharid kar 2 second chehre par pher lete hain—par phir bhi dhoop mein tanning aur sunburn kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Sunscreen stick ko ek baar chehre par ghumane ya 3 second spray maarne se poora SPF 50 protection mil jaata hai.
cards.myth: Sunscreen spray se chehre par 2 second spray karna cream lagane se zyada even aur full SPF 50 protection deta hai.
cards.reality: Hawa mein aadha spray ud jaata hai aur uneven boondein girti hain—jab tak haath se ragad kar thick layer na banayein, protection aadhe se bhi kam rehti hai!

cards.title: Machhar Cream Odomos (DEET) vs Natural Citronella: Chhote Bacchon par Kaun Kitni Der Safe Hai?
cards.hook: Dengue aur Malaria ke mausam mein bacchon ko machhar se bachane ke liye cream, roll-on ya herbal patches lagate hain—par 6 mahine ke bacche par DEET cream lagana safe hai ya kapdon wale Citronella dots?
cards.illusion: Har '100% Natural Herbal' citronella patch/spray bachchon ko 12 ghante dengue machharon se bacha leta hai.
cards.myth: Citronella/Lemongrass wale '100% Natural' wristbands aur stickers 12 ghante poori body ko machharon se bachate hain.
cards.reality: Clinical trials mein herbal wristbands aur small patches sirf kuch inch aur 30–60 minute tak hi kuch asar dikhate hain—Dengue ke din-wale machharon par wo bharosemand nahi hain.

cards.title: 2 Saal se Chhote Bacche ke Seene/Naak par Camphor/Menthol Vapor Balm Lagana: Saans Rukne aur Jhatke (Seizure) ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Chhote bacche ko sardi-zukam hote hi maa-daadi uske naak aur seene par Camphor-Menthol Vapor/Headache Balm mal deti hain—par 2 saal se kam umar ke bacchon ke dabbe par 'Do Not Use Under 2 Years' warning kyun likhi hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Camphor-menthol balms aur Kapoor balms bilkul mild herbal malham hain, unhe newborn ya 1 saal ke bacche ke naak par bhi aaram se laga sakte hain.
cards.myth: Chhote bacche ke naak ke andar ya garam paani mein Karvol/Camphor capsule daal kar sunghana sabse safe ilaj hai.
cards.reality: Studies (Wake Forest Univ) ne dikhaya ki infant airways mein menthol/camphor mucus badha kar saans rok sakta hai—saline drops aur plain bhaap hi safe hai!

cards.title: Nebulizer Mask mein Nal ka Paani ya Vapor Balm Daalna: Phephdon ke Liye Gambhir Infection ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Khansi-zukam mein ghar ke Nebulizer machine ke cup mein log bhalai ke liye normal Nal ka Paani, RO water, ya Camphor/Menthol balm daal dete hain—par doctors isse seedhe phephdon mein infection bhejne wali galti kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Steam steamer aur Nebulizer dono ek hi bhaap dene wali machine hain, isliye nebulizer cup mein bhi sada paani ya vapor balm daal sakte hain.
cards.myth: Ubaal kar thanda kiya hua paani ya RO paani nebulizer machine mein daalna bilkul sterile aur safe hota hai.
cards.reality: Ghar mein ubla/RO paani isotonic (0.9% salt balance) nahi hota aur puri tarah sterile nahi rehta—plain water phephdon mein airway irritation (bronchospasm) aur infection kar sakta hai!

cards.title: Sugar Machine (Glucometer) Galat Reading Kyun Deti Hai? Ungli Dabana aur Khuli Strip Expiry!
cards.hook: Ghar ki Glucometer machine mein ek hi ungli par 2 minute ke andar sugar kabhi 140 aur kabhi 185 dikhati hai! Kya machine kharab hai, ya aapki blood nikaalne ki 3 galtiyan reading bigaad rahi hain?
cards.illusion: Glucometer machine ekdam lab jaisi 100% pakki reading deti hai aur khuli hui test strips 2 saal tak chalti hain.
cards.myth: Glucometer aur Hospital Pathology Lab ki report bilkul ek hi number (1–2 point ke andar) aani chahiye.
cards.reality: Glucometer ungli ke capillary whole blood se aur lab baaju ki nas (venous plasma) se naapti hai—khane ke baad 10%–15% ka farq bilkul normal aur ISO-accepted hota hai.

cards.title: Kaanch ka Para (Mercury) Thermometer Tootne par Jhadu/Vacuum Chalana Zeher Failana Hai!
cards.hook: Ghar mein purana chandi-jaisa chamakne wala Mercury Thermometer gir kar toot jaaye, to 90% log jhadu ya vacuum cleaner se kaanch aur para saaf kar dete hain—ye kamre ki hawa ko zeherila kaise banata hai?
cards.illusion: Toote hue thermometer ke para (Mercury) ko jhadu, kapde ya vacuum cleaner se saaf kar ke dustbin mein phenk dena bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Kaanch ka Mercury thermometer digital thermometer se zyada accurate hota hai aur para haath se chhoone par kuch nahi hota.
cards.reality: Digital thermometers ±0.1°C accurate hote hain aur bina toote saalon chalte hain—jabki ek toota mercury thermometer poore ghar ki hawa aur drain ko zeherila kar deta hai!

cards.title: Thande Haath, Dark Nail Polish aur Mehendi par Pulse Oximeter 85% Galat Oxygen Kyun Dikhata Hai?
cards.hook: Bukhar ya saans ki dikkat mein ghar wale turant ungli par Pulse Oximeter lagate hain—par 86% reading dekh kar hospital bhaagne se pehle ye jaan lein ki thandi ungli aur nail polish machine ko kaise bewaqoof banate hain!
cards.illusion: Oximeter par agar 88%–90% SpO2 dikha raha hai, to patient ka oxygen 100% dangerous level par gir chuka hai.
cards.myth: Pulse Oximeter mein kisi bhi ungli par lagate hi pehle 2 second mein jo number aaye wahi final hota hai.
cards.reality: Oximeter ko pulse wave pakad kar stabilize hone mein 20–45 second lagte hain—pehle 5 second ki reading aksar upar-neeche hoti hai!

cards.title: Adult 'Multivitamin, Hair & Sleep Gummies': Meethi Toffee mein 10% Dose aur 3x Daam ka Jaal!
cards.hook: Goliyan nigalne se bachne ke liye aajkal har koi ₹500–₹800 ke chamakdaar dabbe wali 'Multivitamin / Ashwagandha / Kids Gummies' kharid raha hai—par inmein sugar kitni aur asli vitamins kitne hote hain?
cards.illusion: Vitamin Gummies aur Pharmacy Multivitamin tablets mein bilkul ek barabar taakat hoti hai, bas gummies khane mein tasty lagti hain.
cards.myth: 'Sugar-Free' Multivitamin gummies mein bhi normal tablets jitni hi poori daily taakat aur sabhi minerals hote hain.
cards.reality: Gummy ke chhote size aur taste limit ki wajah se usmein Calcium, Magnesium, Iron aur Omega-3 ki poori daily dose kabhi fit nahi ho sakti—wo aksar sirf candy + kuch micro-vitamins hoti hain!

cards.title: Online Saste '100% Pure Shilajit / Ashwagandha' mein Heavy Metals (Lead/Arsenic) aur Liver Injury Risk!
cards.hook: Gym, taakat aur stress ke liye aaj har youth ₹400–₹800 ka online 'Pure Himalayan Shilajit Resin' ya 'Ashwagandha' kha raha hai—par bina lab report wale herbal supplements se Liver injury (DILI) ke cases kyun badh rahe hain?
cards.illusion: Ashwagandha aur Shilajit 100% natural jadibooti hain isliye jitni chahein aur jis bhi brand ki chahein bina check kiye kha sakte hain.
cards.myth: Garam paani mein ghul jaana aur chammach par aag se na jalna Pure Shilajit aur 100% heavy-metal-free hone ki pakki guarantee hai.
cards.reality: Sasta bitumen, gum aur heavy-metal salts bhi garam paani mein ghul kar tar ban sakte hain—Lead, Arsenic aur Mercury sirf NABL ICP-MS lab test mein hi pakde jaate hain!

cards.title: 'Weight Loss Apple Cider Vinegar Shots' Khali Pet Peena: Daant ka Enamel aur Acid Reflux Damage!
cards.hook: Wazan ghatane ke liye log subah khali pet bina paani milaye ya thode paani mein Apple Cider Vinegar (ACV) ke shots peete hain—par 2 mahine mein daanton mein thanda-garam aur seene mein jalan kyun shuru hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Apple Cider Vinegar (ACV) subah khali pet peene se charbi pighal kar mahine mein 5 kg wazan kam ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Roz subah khali pet garam paani mein Apple Cider Vinegar peene se pet ki charbi pighal jaati hai.
cards.reality: Harvard Health ke mutabik ACV koi fat-burner nahi hai—ye sirf khane se pehle lene par halka fullness aur mild post-meal glucose control de sakta hai; weight loss sirf calorie deficit aur exercise se hota hai.

cards.title: Neend ke Liye Roz 5–10mg 'Melatonin Sleep Gummies' Khana: Natural Sleep Hormone aur High Dose Warning!
cards.hook: Raat ko mobile chalane ke baad neend nahi aati, to log bina doctor ke rozana ₹500 wali '5mg–10mg Melatonin Sleep Gummies' khane lagte hain—par kuch hafton baad bina goli ke neend bilkul band kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Melatonin sirf ek natural herbal vitamin hai jo jitni chahein rozana khakar bina side-effect neend laa sakte hain.
cards.myth: 5mg–10mg Melatonin gummies bilkul non-hormonal herbal candy hain aur roz khane se bacchon ko bhi koi nuksan nahi.
cards.reality: Melatonin ek active hormone hai aur 5–10mg natural physiological level se 10–30 guna zyada hai—AASM ne isse chronic insomnia aur bina doctor ke bacchon mein use karne ke khilaf warning di hai.

cards.title: Gym mein 'Dry Scooping Pre-Workout' aur 300mg Caffeine: Dhadkan Tez aur Heart Risk!
cards.hook: Gym ke naye ladke TikTok/Reels dekh kar paani mein ghole bina seedhe 1 chammach 'Pre-Workout Powder' munh mein daal kar nigal lete hain ('Dry Scooping')—ye trend gym mein heart emergencies kyun kara raha hai?
cards.illusion: Dry scooping se pre-workout turant khoon mein ghul kar gym mein double taakat aur weight uthane ki power deta hai.
cards.myth: Pre-workout lene par jo chehre aur haathon mein chubhan/khujli (tingling) hoti hai wo khoon tez daudne aur muscle badhne ki nishani hai.
cards.reality: Wo chubhan sirf **Beta-Alanine** amino acid ka ek harmless skin nerve reaction (paresthesia) hai—iska strength ya pump se koi lena-dena nahi hai!

cards.title: 'Creatine Powder' se Kidney Kharab Hoti Hai aur Baal Jhadte Hain? Sports Science ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: Gym jaane wale ladkon ko ghar wale 'Creatine' khane par daant-te hain ki 'Kidney fail ho jayegi aur ganje ho jaoge!' Par duniya ke sabse zyada researched supplement par sports doctors kya kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Creatine ek nakli steroid hai jo kidney kharab kar ke permanent hair loss kar deta hai.
cards.myth: Creatine lena bilkul Steroids lene jaisa hai aur lene se sharir mein sirf bekaar paani bhar jaata hai.
cards.reality: Creatine koi hormone/steroid nahi hai—ye muscle cells ke andar energy (ATP) aur intracellular water badha kar real workout strength aur recovery deta hai.

cards.title: Patle Ladkon ke Liye ₹2,000 ka 'Weight / Mass Gainer': 75% Sasta Maltodextrin Sugar aur Sirf Tond!
cards.hook: Wazan aur muscles badhane ke liye patle ladke ₹2,200 ka 3kg 'Mega Mass Gainer' dabba kharid laate hain—par 2 mahine mein haath-pair wahi rehte hain aur sirf pet par charbi (tond) kyun nikal aati hai?
cards.illusion: Mass Gainer ke bade 3kg dabbe mein bhar-bhar kar mehenga muscle-building protein hota hai jo wazan badhata hai.
cards.myth: Patle sharir wale logon ka wazan sirf 'Mass Gainer' powder peene se hi badh sakta hai, ghar ke khane se nahi.
cards.reality: Wazan sirf calorie surplus se badhta hai—Oats, Peanut Butter, Bananas, Ghee aur Dal-Paneer se bana ghar ka shake Mass Gainer ke Maltodextrin se 10 guna behtar aur sasta hai!

cards.title: Gym mein ₹1,500 ka BCAA Powder Pina: Jab Roz Dal-Paneer, Eggs ya Whey Kha Rahe Ho to Zero Fayda!
cards.hook: Gym trainers naye ladkon ko ₹1,500–₹2,000 ka neon-orange 'BCAA Intra-Workout' powder bechte hain ki workout ke beech mein peene se muscle turant banegi! Kya BCAA sachmuch kuch karta hai?
cards.illusion: Workout ke beech mein pani mein rang-biranga BCAA powder ghol kar peene se muscles double tezi se grow hoti hain.
cards.myth: Workout ke beech mein agar BCAA nahi piya to sharir apni hi muscles ko tod kar energy bana leta hai.
cards.reality: Agar aapne workout se 1–2 ghante pehle normal protein+carb meal liya hai, to workout ke dauran khoon mein pehle se amino acids maujood rehte hain—BCAA peene ki koi zaroorat nahi!

cards.title: Raat ko Talwon par Lagane Wale 'Detox Foot Pads' Subah Kaale-Bhooray Kyun Ho Jaate Hain? Paseena Reaction!
cards.hook: Online ₹400 ke 'Bamboo Detox Foot Pads' aate hain jinhe raat ko pair ke talwe par chipka kar sone par subah poora pad kaale-bhooray gande keechad se bhar jaata hai—kya ye sachmuch sharir ka zeher nikaalte hain?
cards.illusion: Subah pad par dikhne wala kaala-bhoora chipchipa keechad sharir ke andar se nikle hue toxins aur heavy metals hain.
cards.myth: Lagatar 15 din foot pad lagane ke baad jab pad safed nikalne lage, to samjho sharir 100% detox ho gaya.
cards.reality: Pad jab tak geela/paseene ke contact mein aayega, wood vinegar powder hamesha kaala-bhoora hi hoga—ye sirf ek chemistry parlor trick hai!

cards.title: 'Magnetic Bracelet / Copper Kada' Pehanne se BP aur Ghutno ka Gathiya (Arthritis) Theek Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Mehenge ₹1,500–₹3,000 ke 'Bio-Magnetic Copper Bracelets' aur 'Energy Rings' beche jaate hain ye bolkar ki isse khoon saaf hota hai, BP control hota hai aur ghutnon ka gathiya mit-ta hai! Science kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Kalai par magnetic ya copper kada pehanne se khoon ka iron magnet se kheench kar BP aur joint pain theek ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Kalai par copper kada pehanne ke baad jo hara nishan padta hai wo sharir ke andar se nikle hue gathiye ke toxins hain.
cards.reality: Wo sirf aapke paseene aur hawa ki nami se taambe (Copper) par laga hara zang (Copper Carbonate/Chloride) hai—aap usse nimbu se saaf karenge to khud dekh lengi!

cards.title: ₹2 Lakh ki 'Alkaline Kangen Water Machine': Pet ka HCl Acid 1 Second mein pH 2 Kar Deta Hai!
cards.hook: MLM agents aur YouTubers ₹1.5–₹3 Lakh ki 'Alkaline Ionizer Water Machine' bechte hain ye bolkar ki 'pH 9.5 paani peene se cancer, diabetes aur acidity jad se khatam ho jaati hai!' Shareer ka vigyan kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Alkaline pH 9.5 paani peene se khoon ka pH alkaline ho jaata hai aur cancer cells mar jaati hain.
cards.myth: Acidic body mein cancer ugta hai isliye ₹2 Lakh ki machine se pH 9.5 paani peene se khoon alkaline ho kar cancer rokta hai.
cards.reality: Cancer cells khud apna aas-paas ka mahol acidic banati hain, acidic khane/paani se cancer nahi hota—aur aapke khoon ka pH 7.35–7.45 hamesha lungs aur kidneys control karti hain, paani nahi!

cards.title: '₹499 mein 90 Full-Body Blood Tests': Zaroorat se Zyada Panic Tests aur False Positives ka Jaal!
cards.hook: Har mahine phone par message aata hai '₹499 mein 90 Full-Body Checkup Tests Free Home Collection!' Par 90 tests karwane par bina kisi bimari ke 5–6 numbers laal kyun aate hain aur ₹10,000 ki aur dawaiyan kyun shuru ho jaati hain?
cards.illusion: Har saal 90–100 blood tests aur Vitamin/Tumor markers wala package karwana sabse achchi preventive healthcare hai.
cards.myth: Har healthy insaan ko har saal cancer pakadne ke liye full-body CT scan aur tumor marker blood package karwana chahiye.
cards.reality: Bina symptoms ya doctor advice ke random Tumor Markers (CEA/CA-125) mein false positives bahut zyada hote hain aur unnecessary radiation/biopsy ka khatra badhate hain.

cards.title: Chemist Dukaan par Parchi ka Ek Hi Salt 3x Mehenge Brand mein Dena: Salt Name Padhna Seekhein!
cards.hook: Doctor ne parchi par dawai likhi—chemist bola 'Ye company nahi hai, doosri same company de raha hoon' aur ₹40 ki jagah ₹180 ka patta thama diya! Chemist par khud Salt aur Price kaise check karein?
cards.illusion: Chemist jo 'substitute' dawai deta hai wo hamesha usi daam aur exact same composition ki hoti hai.
cards.myth: Chemist ne 'same kaam karne wali' bol kar jo doosri strip di hai, uske andar hamesha exact wahi dawai aur daam hota hai.
cards.reality: Kai baar chemists high-margin trade-generic brands ya alag salt combinations (e.g., plain Paracetamol ki jagah Paracetamol+Diclofenac) de dete hain—hamesha exact salt + mg check karna zaroori hai!

cards.title: Insulin, Vaccines aur Probiotics ko Bina 2–8°C Fridge ke Rakhna: Garmi mein 'Dead Dawai' Lene ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Diabetes ke liye Insulin pen ya bacche ka Probiotic/Vaccine courier/local store se laye—par agar dukaan wale ne usse light jaane par garmi mein bahar rakha tha, to kya wo Insulin sugar kam karega?
cards.illusion: Insulin ya Probiotic bottle jab tak saaf dikh rahi hai aur expiry bachi hai, wo 40°C garmi mein bhi 100% kaam karti hai.
cards.myth: Agar Insulin fridge ke freezer mein galti se jam jaaye, to pighla kar dobara use kiya jaa sakta hai.
cards.reality: Ek baar barf ban kar jamne par Insulin ka protein crystal toot kar hamesha ke liye kharab ho jaata hai—pighla kar lagane par wo bilkul kaam nahi karega!

cards.title: Allergy-Zukam ki Goli Cetirizine Khakar Din bhar Neend Kyun Aati Hai? Non-Drowsy Options!
cards.hook: Subah chheenk, khujli ya skin allergy par chemist se ₹5 ki Cetirizine ya sedating antihistamine (Pheniramine) kha kar office/car drive karne nikal gaye—par dopahar bhar aankhein band kyun hoti rehti hain?
cards.illusion: Allergy ki har goli ek hi jaisi hoti hai aur sabhi goliyan thodi neend laati hi hain.
cards.myth: Jab tak allergy ki goli se neend na aaye, tab tak wo dawai allergy par kaam nahi karti.
cards.reality: Neend aana sirf ek purana unwanted side effect hai—modern non-drowsy antihistamines dimaag ko sulaye bina utni hi achchi allergy relief deti hain!

cards.title: Dard/Bukhar mein Ibuprofen-Paracetamol Combo + Paracetamol Ek Sath Khana: Anjaane mein 'Double Paracetamol' Liver Overdose!
cards.hook: Bukhar aur badan dard na utarne par log subah Paracetamol 650mg aur 2 ghante baad ek Ibuprofen+Paracetamol combo (ya combo painkiller / combo painkiller / Cold Tablet) aur kha lete hain—par kya aap jaante hain in sab mein ek hi salt chhupa hota hai?
cards.illusion: Paracetamol 650mg, Ibuprofen+Paracetamol combo, caffeine-combination headache tablet, cold-flu combo tablet aur Zerodol-P sab alag-alag kaam karne wali dawaiyan hain isliye sath khane mein koi dikkat nahi.
cards.myth: Paracetamol 650mg sirf bukhar ki goli hai aur cold-flu combo tablet sirf zukam ki—dono mein koi same dawai nahi hoti.
cards.reality: Almost sabhi multi-symptom cold aur pain combo tablets (cold-flu combo tablet, D'Cold, Ibuprofen+Paracetamol combo, combo painkiller, Zerodol-P) mein pehle se 325mg–500mg Paracetamol hota hai!

cards.title: Bacchon ke Bukhar mein Nimesulide (Nimesulide / Nimulid) Dena: 12 Saal se Kam Bacchon mein Banned Kyun?
cards.hook: Bukhar jaldi utarne ke liye kai chhote medical stores aaj bhi bacchon ya badon ko ₹10 wali 'Nimesulide / Nimesulide' goli de dete hain—par Bharat sarkar ne 12 saal se kam bacchon mein isse ban kyun kiya hai?
cards.illusion: Nimesulide (Nimesulide) bukhar ko Paracetamol se double tezi se utarti hai isliye bacchon ko dena sabse achcha hai.
cards.myth: Agar Paracetamol se bukhar 102°F se 98°F na aaye, to turant Nimesulide (Nimesulide) ya Meftal khila kar bukhar zero kar dena chahiye.
cards.reality: Bukhar mein dawai ka kaam sirf bacche ko comfortable karna (1–2°F kam karna) hota hai—tez temperature crash karane wali Nimesulide bacchon mein banned aur unsafe hai!

cards.title: Har Gale ki Khichkhich par 'Azithromycin 500' 3-Din Course Khana: Resistance aur Heart Rhythm Risk!
cards.hook: Gala kharab hote hi log chemist se 'Azee 500 (Azithromycin)' ki 3-goli wali strip le aate hain—par 85% gale ke dard virus se hote hain jahan Azithromycin 0% kaam karti hai, aur kya risk badhata hai?
cards.illusion: Azithromycin 500mg bas 3 din ki chhoti mild goli hai jo har zukam, khansi aur gale ke dard ko jhat se theek kar deti hai.
cards.myth: Azithromycin 3 din mein gala isliye theek kar deti hai kyunki wo viral aur bacterial dono ko maarti hai.
cards.reality: Azithromycin kisi bhi virus ko nahi maarti—3 din mein aapka immune system khud viral ko hara deta hai aur credit bekaar khayi gayi antibiotic ko mil jaata hai!

cards.title: Gas ki Har Goli mein 'Pantoprazole-D / Rabeprazole-D' (Domperidone) Khana: Roz Lene par Heart Rhythm Risk!
cards.hook: Acidity ya gas hote hi log subah khali pet plain Pantoprazole ke bajaye 'Pantoprazole-D / Rabeprazole-D / Omeprazole-D' khane lagte hain—par unmein chhupa 'D' (Domperidone) kya karta hai aur Europe mein ispar itni sakhti kyun hai?
cards.illusion: Domperidone-PPI combo aur plain Pantoprazole ek hi acidity ki goli hain, balki 'D' wali capsule zyada achchi aur harmless hoti hai.
cards.myth: Domperidone-PPI combo aur plain Pantoprazole bilkul ek hi cheez hain, bas PPI+Domperidone capsule zyada fast aur strong gas capsule hai.
cards.reality: PPI+Domperidone capsule mein ek extra drug **Domperidone** hota hai jiska kaam ulti-matli rokna hai aur jispar heart safety limits lagi hui hain—har acidity mein iski zaroorat nahi hoti!

cards.title: Purani Mashhoor Gas Goli 'Ranitidine / Zinetac / Rantac' par NLEM Ban: NDMA Risk aur Safe Alternative!
cards.hook: Pichle 30 saal se har ghar mein gas aur acidity ke liye ₹1 wali gulabi-safed 'Rantac / Zinetac (Ranitidine)' goli rakhi hoti thi—par US FDA aur Bharat ke NLEM list se ye kyun hatayi gayi?
cards.illusion: Rantac aur Zinetac sadiyon se chalne wali sabse safe aur harmless gas ki goliyan hain.
cards.myth: Ranitidine sirf ek batch mein kharab hui thi, ab nayi wali Rantac/Aciloc mein NDMA kabhi nahi banta.
cards.reality: FDA tests ne dikhaya ki NDMA Ranitidine ke khud ke chemical molecule ke garmi/samay mein tootne se banta hai—isliye poori duniya mein uski jagah Famotidine use hoti hai!

cards.title: Roz Khane ke Baad 'Antacid Fruit Salt' ya Meetha Soda Peena: High BP aur Kidney Walon ke Liye Namak Bomb!
cards.hook: Thoda sa pet bhari lagte hi log '6 Second mein Kaam Shuru!' wala Fruit Salt packet ya Baking Soda paani mein ghol kar pi lete hain—par High BP aur Kidney patients ke liye ye namak ka jhatka kaise banta hai?
cards.illusion: Antacid Fruit Salt bas nimbu-paani jaisa ek harmless fruit salt hai, isse din mein 2–3 baar peene mein koi nuksan nahi.
cards.myth: Antacid Fruit Salt 'Fruit Salt' hai isliye usmein koi namak (Sodium) nahi hota aur High BP wale patients roz pi sakte hain.
cards.reality: 'Fruit Salt' sirf ek brand naam hai—andar main ingredient **Sodium Bicarbonate** hota hai jismein 1 hi chammach mein lagbhag 1/3rd din bhar ka Sodium bhara hota hai!

cards.title: Roz Raat ko 'Kayam Churna / Senna' Khane se Aanton ki Aadat Bigadna: Isabgol vs Stimulant Laxatives!
cards.hook: Pet saaf na hone par ghar ke buzurg roz raat ko garam paani ke sath 1 chammach 'Kayam Churna / Pet Safa / Dulcolax' lete hain—par kuch mahine baad bina churna ke pet saaf hona band kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Ayurvedic pet-safa churnas bilkul natural jadibooti hain isliye unhe zindagi bhar roz raat ko lena safe hai.
cards.myth: Ayurvedic pet-safa churna roz khane se kabhi aadat nahi padti kyunki wo 100% jadibooti se bante hain.
cards.reality: Sanay (Senna) natural paudha zaroor hai par usmein tez **Sennosides** hote hain jo roz lene par aanton ki natural movement ko sust (dependent) bana dete hain!

cards.title: Neend ki Goli (Alprazolam / Zolfresh) Bina Doctor ke Roz Khana: Memory Loss aur Addiction Trap!
cards.hook: Raat ko neend na aane par kai log ghar mein rakhi Alprax (Alprazolam), Restyl ya Zolfresh goli mahinon tak khate rehte hain—par kuch mahine baad bina goli ke neend bilkul ud jaati hai aur yaad-dasht kamzor kyun hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Neend ki goli khakar 7 ghante so lena bilkul natural gehri neend lene jaisa hi healthy hai.
cards.myth: 0.25mg Alprax ek bahut chhoti harmless goli hai jise buzurgon ko roz neend ke liye dena bilkul safe hai.
cards.reality: 60+ age mein 0.25mg Alprazolam bhi balance bigaad kar falls/fractures aur memory confusion ka bada risk ban sakti hai—Beers Criteria mein ise elderly mein avoid karne ko kaha gaya hai!

cards.title: 'Heart Attack se Bachne ke Liye' Bina Doctor ke Roz Aspirin/Aspirin Khana: Stomach & Brain Bleeding Risk!
cards.hook: 45 ki umar hote hi kai log doston ke kehne par 'khoon patla rakhne aur heart attack rokne ke liye' rozana ₹1 wali Aspirin 75 (Low-dose Aspirin) khane lagte hain—par medical guidelines ne ab isse mana kyun kar diya hai?
cards.illusion: 40–45 saal ke baad har kisi ko heart attack se bachne ke liye roz 1 chhoti Aspirin (Aspirin) khani chahiye.
cards.myth: 45 ki umar ke baad har insaan ko khoon patla rakhne ke liye roz ek baby aspirin (Aspirin 75) khani hi chahiye.
cards.reality: Major trials (ASPREE, ASCEND, ARRIVE) ke baad AHA aur USPSTF ne healthy adults mein bina heart disease ke daily preventive Aspirin band karwa di hai kyunki bleeding ka khatra fayde se zyada hota hai!

cards.title: 'Cholesterol ki Goli (Atorvastatin) Liver Kharab Karti Hai' Myth: social media forwards Dar vs Heart Attack Suraksha!
cards.hook: social media forwards videos dekh kar high-risk heart/diabetes patients apni 'Atorvastatin / Rosuvastatin' ki goli is dar se band kar dete hain ki 'Cholesterol ke liye goli zindagi bhar liver kharab kar degi!' Asli science kya hai?
cards.illusion: Cholesterol ki dawai (Statins) sirf Pharma companies ka scam hai aur 100% logon ka liver aur muscles kharab kar deti hai.
cards.myth: Ek baar Cholesterol report normal aa jaaye, to Statin goli band kar deni chahiye.
cards.reality: Cholesterol report goli ke kaam karne ki wajah se hi normal aayi hai—high heart-risk patients mein goli band karte hi 2 hafte mein LDL wapas badh jaata hai aur plaque stabilization khatam ho jaata hai!

cards.title: Thyroid ki Goli Subah Chai, Doodh ya Iron-Calcium ke Sath Nigalna: Poori Dawai Bekar Kyun Jaati Hai?
cards.hook: Roz subah Thyronorm/Eltroxin khane ke bawajood 6 mahine baad TSH badha hua aata hai—kya galti dawai ki dose ki hai, ya 10 minute baad pi gayi adrak wali chai aur breakfast ki?
cards.illusion: Thyroid ki goli khane ke 5–10 minute baad chai/coffee ya nashta kar lene se dawai par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.myth: Thyroid ki goli khane ke 10 minute baad bina chini ki black coffee ya doodh wali chai pi sakte hain.
cards.reality: Studies ne dikhaya hai ki coffee aur doodh (calcium) dono hi 30 minute ke andar lene par Levothyroxine ka absorption kaafi kam kar dete hain—45–60 min gap zaroori hai!

cards.title: Doodh ya Calcium ke Sath Antibiotic (Doxycycline / Ciprofloxacin) Lena: 70% Dawai Bekar Kyun Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Ghar wale dawai khate waqt 'taakat ke liye' goli ko ek glass garam doodh ya dahi ke sath nigalwa dete hain—par kuch khaas Antibiotics doodh ke sath pet mein jaakar patthar bankar bekaar kaise ho jaati hain?
cards.illusion: Har dawai ko garam doodh ke sath khane se pet ki garmi nahi lagti aur dawai double taakat se kaam karti hai.
cards.myth: Antibiotic goli bahut 'garam' hoti hai isliye usse hamesha ek glass doodh ke sath hi nigalna chahiye.
cards.reality: Doodh pet ko thanda karne ke bajaye Tetracycline aur Fluoroquinolone antibiotics ke sath chipak kar unka 50%–80% asar khatam kar deta hai—saada paani aur halka khana (non-dairy) best hai!

cards.title: BP aur Cholesterol Dawaiyon ke Sath Chakotra / Grapefruit Juice Peena: Dangerous Drug Overdose!
cards.hook: Bimari mein log phalon ka juice (khaaskar Chakotra/Grapefruit ya Pomelo) bahut healthy samajh kar dawai ke sath pite hain—par kuch BP, Cholesterol aur Heart dawaiyon ke sath ye 1 glass juice 5 goliyon ke barabar zeher kaise ban jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har citrus fruit juice (Chakotra, Santra, Mosambi) kisi bhi dawai ke sath peena hamesha healthy aur safe hota hai.
cards.myth: Agar dawai subah aur Grapefruit juice shaam ko piyein to koi interaction nahi hota.
cards.reality: Grapefruit ka enzyme-blocking asar 24 se 72 ghante tak rehta hai—isliye sirf 4 ghante ka gap rakhne se bhi interaction nahi rukta!

cards.title: 'SR / XR / EC' Likhi Lambi Goli ko Tod kar ya Pees kar Khana: 12 Ghante ki Dawai 1 Second mein Release!
cards.hook: Buzurgon ko badi goli nigalne mein mushkil ho, to ghar wale dawai ko aadha tod kar ya chammach se pees kar de dete hain—par kuch goliyon par likha 'SR / XR / CR / EC' todne par jaanlewa overdose kaise ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Har tablet ko aadha tod kar ya pees kar khane se wahi dawai bas aasani se gale ke neeche utar jaati hai.
cards.myth: 500mg SR goli ko beech se aadha tod kar khane se thik 250mg ki taakat milti hai.
cards.reality: SR/XR coat toot-te hi slow-release mechanism destroy ho jaata hai aur bachi hui 250mg ek hi baar mein tez jhatke ke sath khoon mein release ho sakti hai!

cards.title: Bacche ko Dawai Kitchen ke Chammach se Pilana: 2.5 ml vs 10 ml Overdose Error!
cards.hook: Doctor ne likha '1 Teaspoon (5 ml) Syrup'—aur ghar par log rasoi ke kisi bhi chammach se naap kar pila dete hain! Par kya aap jaante hain kitchen ke chammach 2 ml se 12 ml tak alag hote hain aur Overdose/Underdose kara dete hain?
cards.illusion: Har ghar ka chhota chai wala chammach (teaspoon) thik 5 ml ka hi hota hai.
cards.myth: Paracetamol Drops aur Paracetamol Syrup bas alag packaging hain, dono mein 5 ml pilana ek hi baat hai.
cards.reality: Drops behad gaadhe (100 mg/ml) hote hain aur Syrup patla (120–250 mg per 5ml) hota hai—galti se drops 5 ml pila dene par bacche ko khatarnak overdose ho jaata hai!

cards.title: Bacchon ke Dast (Diarrhoea) mein Sirf ORS Nahi, 14-Din Zinc Syrup + Zero Antibiotics Rule!
cards.hook: Bacche ko loose motions shuru hote hi log chemist se 'Ofloxacin-Metronidazole (Oflox-M / Norflox-TZ)' antibiotic syrup laakar pila dete hain—par WHO/IAP 80% cases mein antibiotics mana kar ke sirf ORS + Zinc kyun bolti hai?
cards.illusion: Har bacche ke dast rokne ke liye turant teekha peela Antibiotic syrup pilana aur doodh-khana band karna zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Dast aate hi bacche ka doodh aur khana poori tarah band kar ke sirf sookha chawal ya antibiotic dena chahiye.
cards.reality: Dast mein pet ko energy aur repair ke liye Maa ka doodh aur soft ghar ka khana (dahi-khichdi-kela) bilkul chahiye hota hai—bhookha rakhne se baccha kamzor aur dehydrated hota hai!

cards.title: Daant Nikalte Waqt Bacche ke Masoodhon par 'Benzocaine / Teething Gel' Lagana: Oxygen-Blocking Risk!
cards.hook: 6–8 mahine ke bacche ke daant nikalte waqt masoodhon mein khujli aur rone par log chemist se sunn karne wala 'Teething Gel' ya homeopathic Belladonna tablets kharid laate hain—par US FDA ne inpar ban-level warning kyun di hai?
cards.illusion: Masoodhon ko sunn karne wala Teething Gel daant nikalte bacche ke liye 100% safe aur aaramdayak hota hai.
cards.myth: Daant nikalne se bacchon ko 102°F–103°F tez bukhar aur khooni dast aate hain, isliye doctor ko dikhane ki zaroorat nahi.
cards.reality: Teething se sirf halka temperature (~99.5°F–100°F) aur laar (drooling) aa sakti hai—100.4°F+ tez bukhar, dast ya ulti hamesha kisi **Infection** ka sanket hota hai, doctor ko zaroor dikhayein!

cards.title: Navjaat Bacche ko Har Rone par 'Gripe Water' ya Ghutti Pilana: Sugar/Sodium aur 6-Month Rule!
cards.hook: 2 mahine ka baccha shaam ko roye, to maa-daadi turant 1 chammach 'Gripe Water' ya 'Janam Ghutti' pila deti hain—par Pediatricians 6 mahine se chhote bacchon mein isse mana kyun karte hain?
cards.illusion: Gripe Water aur Ghutti 100% natural bachchon ki gas ki dawai hai jo 15 din ke navjaat ko bhi roz pilani chahiye.
cards.myth: Garmiyon mein 2 mahine ke bacche ko doodh ke sath thoda paani aur roz Gripe Water pilana zaroori hota hai.
cards.reality: Maa ke doodh mein 88% paani pehle se hota hai—45°C garmi mein bhi pehle 6 mahine tak bacche ko alag se paani ya gripe water ki bilkul zaroorat nahi hoti!

cards.title: Pregnancy mein Anti-Aging Retinol Cream aur High Vitamin-A Supplements Lene ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Pregnancy mein chehre par jhaaiyan (Melasma) aur pimples badhne par mahilayein apni purani 'Retinol Night Cream' ya 'Acne Tablet' lagati rehti hain—par Vitamin A ke ye forms garbh mein pal rahe shishu ke liye khatarnak kyun hain?
cards.illusion: Skincare creams toh sirf chehre ke upar lagti hain isliye pregnancy mein bhi koi bhi anti-aging ya acne cream lagana bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Anti-aging Retinol serum aur acne cream sirf chehre par lagti hai, wo garbh tak bilkul nahi pahunch sakti.
cards.reality: Oral Isotretinoin sabse bada khatra hai, par topical Retinoids bhi systemic absorption aur precaution ki wajah se pregnancy mein globally avoided hain—safe substitutes (Azelaic acid/Niacinamide) available hain!

cards.title: I-Pill / Unwanted-72 ko Regular Birth Control ki Tarah Har Mahine Khana: Hormonal Chaos & Failure!
cards.hook: Condom/regular birth control ke bajaye kai couples mahine mein 2–3 baar ₹100 wali 'I-Pill / Unwanted-72' kha lete hain—par ye goli sirf 'Emergency' kyun kehlaati hai aur roz khane par kya bigaadti hai?
cards.illusion: I-Pill ek normal family planning pill hai jise har mahine 2–3 baar khane se koi dikkat nahi hoti.
cards.myth: I-Pill har baar khane par 100% pregnancy rok deti hai aur aage chalkar hamesha ke liye baanjhpan (infertility) kar deti hai.
cards.reality: Dono baatein galat hain: (1) I-Pill hamesha 100% nahi rokti (agar ovulation ho chuka ho to fail ho sakti hai!), aur (2) Ye permanent infertility nahi karti, bas baar-baar khane par periods ke hormones ko temporary gadbad kar deti hai!

cards.title: Shaadi-Pooja ke Liye Bina Doctor ke Period Rokne ki Goli (Primolut-N) Khana: Blood Clot aur Heavy Bleeding Risk!
cards.hook: Ghar mein shaadi, pooja ya vacation aate hi mahilayein chemist se bina poochhe ₹60 wali 'Period Rokne ki Goli' (Norethisterone / Primolut-N) kha leti hain—par isse baad mein itni heavy bleeding aur clot ka khatra kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Primolut-N (Period delay pill) bas ek chhoti haram-free goli hai jo har shaadi/holiday par bina doctor ke kha sakte hain.
cards.myth: Period delay pills har hafte-mahine khane se bhi koi hormonal side effect ya blood clot risk nahi hota.
cards.reality: High-dose Norethisterone sharir mein partial estrogen/progestin metabolization se clotting risk aur cycle disruption badha sakti hai—isliye ye sirf doctor ki salah se rare occasion par hi leni chahiye.

cards.title: ₹1,500 ki 'PCOS Cure Herbal Tea' vs Asli Root Cause: Insulin Resistance, Sleep aur Strength Training!
cards.hook: Periods irregular hone par mahilayein online ₹1,200–₹2,000 ki 'Spearmint-Shatavari PCOS Detox Tea / Gummies' kharid leti hain—par bina Insulin aur Lifestyle fix kiye PCOS theek kyun nahi hota?
cards.illusion: Sirf ₹1,500 ki 'PCOS Herbal Tea' ya 'Period-Care Gummies' peene se 30 din mein PCOS jad se khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: PCOS sirf mote (overweight) logon ko hota hai aur 'PCOS Cure Tea' 1 mahine mein cysts hamesha ke liye mita deti hai.
cards.reality: Lean (patli) mahilaon ko bhi Insulin-driven PCOS hota hai; aur PCOS ek metabolic-hormonal condition hai jise lifestyle + medical care se manage kiya jaata hai, kisi ₹1,500 ki magic tea se nahi!

cards.title: Peshab mein Jalan (UTI) Hone par Sirf Cranberry Juice aur Paani par Rukna: Kidney Infection ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Peshab mein tez jalan aur baar-baar jaane ki dikkat hote hi log chemist se ₹400 ka meetha Cranberry Juice ya Citralka syrup pi kar 5 din ghar par baith jaate hain—par bukhar aur kamar dard shuru kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Cranberry juice ya Alkaline syrup (Citralka) peene se peshab ka bacterial infection (UTI) poori tarah theek ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Roz 1 glass Cranberry Juice ya Citralka syrup pee lene se active UTI bina antibiotic ke 100% theek ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Active bacterial UTI mein cranberry juice ya alkaline syrup bacteria ko nahi maar sakte—sahi doctor-prescribed antibiotic ke bina infection kidney tak pahunch sakta hai!

cards.title: 'Kidney Stone mein Beer Peene se Pathri Nikal Jaati Hai' Myth: Dehydration aur Uric Acid Badhna!
cards.hook: Kidney mein 5mm ki pathri (stone) pata chalte hi dost salah dete hain 'Shaam ko 2 bottle thandi Beer pi lo, subah pathri bahar aa jayegi!' Par Urologists isse pathri aur badhane wali salah kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Beer peene se bahut peshab aata hai isliye kidney ki pathri pressure se bahar nikal jaati hai.
cards.myth: Beer aur Kulthi dal/patthar-chatta har size ki kidney stone ko 7 din mein pighla kar nikaal dete hain.
cards.reality: Beer dehydration aur uric acid badhati hai, aur 6mm–10mm+ pathri sirf liquids se pighalti nahi—uske liye Urologist ki dawai ya laser/shockwave procedure zaroori hota hai!

cards.title: Bawasir (Piles) mein Sadak-Chhaap Hakim/Clinic ke 'Tezaab Injection': Permanent Rectal Damage ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Bawasir (Piles), Fissure ya Bhagandar mein sharm ke maare log hospital ke bajaye sadak kinare ke '100% Guarantee Bina Operation Kshar-Sutra/Hakim Clinic' chale jaate hain—par wahan lagne wale saste injections se nali band kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Highway aur railway station ke paas lagne wale 'Bawasir 1-Day Injection Clinics' saste aur bina side-effect wale ayurvedic ilaj karte hain.
cards.myth: Bawasir ka matlab hamesha bada operation hi hota hai, isliye chhup kar sasta roadside injection lagwana behtar hai.
cards.reality: Early piles aur fissures ka 70%–80% ilaj sirf fiber, hydration, sitz bath aur targeted ointment se bina kisi operation ya injection ke ho jaata hai!

cards.title: Saanp Kaatne par Rassi Bandhna, Blade se Kaatna ya Munh se Chusna: 2x Tez Zehr aur Haath Katne ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Gaon-dehat ya trekking par saanp kaat-te hi log turant haath-pair par rassi kas kar bandh dete hain, blade se cheera lagate hain ya jhaad-phoonk karwate hain—par WHO aur doctors isse maut bulane wali galti kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Rassi (tourniquet) kas kar bandhne aur blade se kaat kar khoon nikaalne se saanp ka zeher dil tak nahi pahunchta.
cards.myth: Saanp kaatne par agar nishan aur dard nahi hai, ya saanp raat mein bina dikhe kaat le, to zeher nahi chadh sakta.
cards.reality: Common Krait (sabse zeherila Bharatiya saanp!) ke kaatne par na ke barabar dard aur sujan hoti hai—subah pet dard, gala atakna aur aankh band hona iske lakshan hote hain; har suspect bite mein hospital jaana zaroori hai!

cards.title: Kutte/Billi ke Kaatne par Haldi-Mirchi Bandhna: 100% Jaanlewa Rabies se Sirf 15-Min Soap Wash + Vaccine!
cards.hook: Gali ke ya paltu kutte/billi ke daant ya nakhun lagne par log chot par laal mirchi, chuna ya haldi baandh dete hain aur 'chhota kharoch' samajh kar vaccine nahi lagwate—par Rabies ka ek baar lakshan aane par kya koi dawai bacha sakti hai?
cards.illusion: Sirf khoon nikalne wale gehre kutte ke kaatne par hi vaccine lagti hai, chhoti kharoch ya mirchi-haldi baandh dene se Rabies nahi hota.
cards.myth: Chhote pille (puppy) ke kaatne ya sirf nakhun lagne se Rabies nahi hota, aur pet mein 14 bade injection lagte hain.
cards.reality: Puppies bhi Rabies faila sakte hain aur 14 pet ke injections 20 saal pehle band ho chuke hain! Ab sirf baaju/thigh mein 4–5 chhoti painless doses (0, 3, 7, 14/28) lagti hain jo Govt hospitals mein free milti hain!

cards.title: Loo (Heatstroke) Lagne par Sharir par Alcohol/Spirit Malna ya Barf ke Tab mein Daalna: Sahi Cooling Tarika!
cards.hook: May-June ki 46°C garmi mein Loo lag kar koi behosh ho jaaye (104°F+ bukhar, sukhi skin), to log sar par barf rakh dete hain ya haath-pair par spirit/pyaz malte hain—medical science mein sabse tez aur safe cooling kya hai?
cards.illusion: Heatstroke mein bukhar ki Paracetamol goli khila dena aur body par rubbing alcohol malna sabse tez thandak deta hai.
cards.myth: Loo lag kar tez bukhar (104°F) chadhne par sabse pehle Paracetamol aur pyaz/kairi ka ras pilana chahiye.
cards.reality: Heatstroke mein Paracetamol kaam nahi karti aur behosh/confused insaan ko kuch bhi pilana choking kara sakta hai—bahar se geela paani + pankha + cold packs (gardan/bagal/groin) hi emergency ilaj hai!

cards.title: Nakseer (Naak se Khoon) Aane par Sar Peeche Jhukana Galat Kyun Hai? Aage Jhuka kar 10-Min Pinch!
cards.hook: Garmiyon mein naak se khoon (Nakseer) behne par har school aur ghar mein sar ko peeche ki taraf jhuka kar thanda paani daalte hain—par ENT doctors sar ko AAGE jhukane ko kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Naak se khoon aane par sar ko peeche aasman ki taraf jhukane se khoon behna turant ruk jaata hai.
cards.myth: Nakseer aane par zameen par seedhe peeth ke bal let kar sar peeche latka dena chahiye.
cards.reality: Letne aur sar peeche karne se khoon gale aur saans ki nali mein jaata hai—hamesha seedhe baith kar halka **AAGE (Forward)** jhukna chahiye!

cards.title: Behosh Hone par Naak par Joota/Pyaz Sunghana ya Zabardasti Paani Pilana: Choking Risk vs Legs-Up!
cards.hook: Dhoop ya kamzori se koi chakkar kha kar behosh ho jaaye, to bheed turant unhe utha kar bithane lagti hai, naak par purana joota/pyaz sunghati hai aur munh mein paani daalti hai—ye jaanlewa kaise ho sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Behosh insaan ko turant utha kar bithana, munh mein paani pilana aur joota-pyaz sunghana hosh mein laane ka sabse tez tarika hai.
cards.myth: Mirgi (Seizure) ya Behoshi mein naak par chappal, chamde ka joota ya pyaz sunghane aur munh mein chammach dalne se turant hosh aata hai.
cards.reality: Chappal/pyaz sunghane ka koi medical asar nahi hota—aur Mirgi (fits) mein munh ke andar chammach/ungli daalne se daant toot kar saans ki nali mein phans sakte hain! Mirgi mein sirf karwat par lita kar sir ke neeche naram kapda rakhein.

cards.title: 'Seene mein Jalan Sirf Gas Hai' Bol kar Fruit Salt Pi kar Sona: Silent Heart Attack Golden Hour Miss Hona!
cards.hook: Raat ke 11 baje chhati ke beech mein bharipan, paseena aur jalan hui—par 'raat ko chhole-kulche khaye the, gas hogi' bol kar Fruit Salt pi kar so gaye! Har saal Bharat mein hazaron Heart Attacks 'Gas' samajhne ki wajah se fatal kyun hote hain?
cards.illusion: Seene ke beech mein jalan aur dakar aana hamesha sirf pet ki acidity/gas hota hai, heart attack mein hamesha bayein (left) taraf teekha sui jaisa dard hota hai.
cards.myth: Agar Antacid Fruit Salt ya liquid antacid peene aur dakar aane se thodi rahat lag rahi hai, to wo 100% sirf gas hi hai, heart attack nahi ho sakta.
cards.reality: Kai baar heart attack ke patients ko bhi Antacid Fruit Salt/antacid peene ya dakar aane se 10 minute ke liye halka placebo relief mehsoos ho sakta hai—isliye symptoms aur risk dekh kar **ECG karwana hi ekmatra pakka saboot** hai!

cards.title: Cardiac Arrest mein 'Haath-Pair Malna / Paani Chhidakna' Chhod kar Hands-Only CPR Kaise Bachata Hai Jaan!
cards.hook: Ghar, gym ya station par agar koi achanak gir jaaye aur saans-nabz na chale (Cardiac Arrest), to log haath-pair ke talwe malne ya chammach se paani pilane lagte hain—jabki 4 minute ke andar Hands-Only CPR kaise jaan bacha sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Cardiac arrest mein aam insaan bina munh-se-munh saans diye ya bina doctor ke kuch nahi kar sakta—sirf talwe malna aur paani chhidakna kaafi hai.
cards.myth: Bina munh-se-munh saans (Mouth-to-Mouth) diye sirf chhati dabane se CPR kaam nahi karta, aur pasli tootne ke dar se dheere dabana chahiye.
cards.reality: Untrained bystanders ke liye **Hands-Only CPR (sirf chhati dabana)** utna hi effective hota hai kyunki khoon mein pehle se kuch minute ki oxygen hoti hai! Aur hard & fast (~2 inch) dabana hi dil tak khoon pahunchata hai.

cards.title: Khana Gale mein Phansne par 'Sar par Thapki' aur 'Paani Pilana': Heimlich Maneuver ka Jaan-Bachao Vigyan!
cards.hook: Khana khate waqt agar kisi ke gale mein roti, moongfali ya bacche ke munh mein chana/sikka phans jaaye aur wo bol ya khans na paaye—to log sar par thapki maar kar paani pilate hain! Ye kyun jaanlewa galti hai?
cards.illusion: Gale mein khana phansne par sar ke upar thapki maarne aur ek ghoont paani pilane se khana neeche utar jaata hai.
cards.myth: Kisi ke gale mein kuch phans jaaye to sar par 3 baar thapki maarne aur paani pilane se turant nikal jaata hai.
cards.reality: Sar par thapki ek andhvishwas hai aur paani pilana choking wale insaan ka dum aur tez ghot deta hai—sirf forceful cough ya Heimlich abdominal thrusts hi air-pressure se tukda bahar nikaalte hain!

cards.title: Lakwa (Brain Stroke) ke Pehle 4.5 Ghante ('Golden Window'): B.E.F.A.S.T. Symptoms Pehchanne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Subah uthte hi agar buzurg ka chehra ek taraf tedha lage, ek haath kamzor ho, ya boli ladkhadaye—to log 'Thand lag gayi / BP badh gaya, ghar par tel malish karo' bol kar 6 ghante gawa dete hain! Ye 4.5 ghante zindagi kaise badal sakte hain?
cards.illusion: Haath-pair sunn hone ya boli ladkhadane par ghar mein 4–5 ghante aaram aur malish kar ke dekhna chahiye ki shayad apne aap theek ho jaaye.
cards.myth: Lakwa (Stroke) aane par haath-pair mein sarson-tel ki malish karne aur ghar par BP ki 2 goli ya Aspirin dene se theek ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Malish se brain ka clot nahi khulta, aur bina CT Scan ke BP turant girane ya Aspirin dene se brain mein khoon ki kami ya bleeding aur badh sakti hai!

cards.title: Roz Sar Dard par OTC Headache Tablets Khana: 'Medication Overuse Headache' ka Ulta Chakkar!
cards.hook: Aadhe sar dard (Migraine) ya tension headache ke liye log mahine mein 15–20 din ₹1 wali caffeine-painkiller combos ya Aspirin Ibuprofen+Paracetamol combo kha lete hain—par dawai khane se sar dard aur zyada roz kyun hone lagta hai?
cards.illusion: OTC Headache Tablets roz kha kar sar dard dabate rehna bilkul safe hai aur isse dawai ki aadat nahi padti.
cards.myth: Maathe aur aankhon ke paas dard ke sath naak bhari lage to wo hamesha Sinus infection hi hota hai.
cards.reality: Clinical studies mein khud ko 'Sinus Headache' batane wale 80%+ logon ko asal mein **Migraine** hota hai (bina kisi bacterial sinus infection ke)!

cards.title: Bistar par Karwat Lete hi Chakkar (BPPV Vertigo): Cervical Collar aur Roz Stugeron Khana Galat Kyun?
cards.hook: Subah bistar se uthte ya karwat badalte hi 30 second ke liye poora kamra gol ghoomne lagta hai! Log ise 'Gardan ka Cervical' samajh kar Collar bandh lete hain aur mahinon Stugeron/Vertin khate hain—asli ilaj kya hai?
cards.illusion: Karwat badalne par kamra ghoomna hamesha gardan ki haddi (Cervical) ki wajah se hota hai aur soft collar + vertigo ki goli hi iska ilaj hai.
cards.myth: Chakkar aane par roz Stugeron/Vertin ki goli kha kar aur gardan par belt bandh kar hi zindagi chalani padti hai.
cards.reality: Sabse common vertigo (BPPV) ek mechanical crystal problem hai jo 5-minute ke Epley maneuver se theek hoti hai—roz suppressant goliyan khane se dimaag ki natural balance recovery ruk jaati hai!

cards.title: Ghutne ke Dard mein ₹1,500 ki Glucosamine-Collagen Goliyan vs Leg Muscle Strength aur Weight Loss!
cards.hook: 50 ki umar mein ghutne (Knee Osteoarthritis) mein dard shuru hote hi log ₹1,500–₹2,500/month ki 'Cartilage Banane Wali Glucosamine / Chondroitin / Undenatured Collagen' goliyan khane lagte hain—par Orthopedic doctors kehte kya hain?
cards.illusion: Glucosamine aur Collagen tablets khane se ghutne ke andar ki ghisi hui gaddi (cartilage) phir se ug aati hai.
cards.myth: Ghutne mein dard shuru ho jaaye to chalna aur leg exercise bilkul band kar deni chahiye warna haddi aur ghis jayegi.
cards.reality: Ulta hota hai! Inactivity se thigh muscles sukad jaati hain aur haddi par seedha dabav badhta hai—gentle muscle-strengthening aur flat walking cartilage ko poshan deti hai!

cards.title: Calcium Carbonate Goli Khali Pet Khana: Gas, Kabz aur Kidney Stone Risk vs Calcium Citrate!
cards.hook: Haddiyon ke liye mahilayein aur buzurg subah khali pet 'Shelcal / Calcium 500mg' goli kha lete hain—par pet mein gas-kabz hone lagti hai aur dawai poori sokhi bhi nahi jaati! Calcium kaun sa aur kab khayein?
cards.illusion: Saari Calcium tablets ek hi hoti hain aur unhe subah khali pet khane se haddiyan sabse zyada mazboot hoti hain.
cards.myth: Doodh-dahi roz khane ke baad bhi 50 ki umar mein roz 1,000–1,500mg Calcium ki goliyan alag se khana zaroori hai.
cards.reality: Food calcium (dahi, doodh, ragi, paneer, til) sabse safe hota hai—jab diet se poora ho raha ho to extra high-dose calcium tablets lena kidney stones ka risk badha sakta hai!

cards.title: Iron ki Goli Khate Waqt Chai-Coffee Peena (0% Absorption!) aur Kaali Potty se Darna!
cards.hook: Khoon ki kami (Anemia) mein mahilayein roz Iron tablet khati hain, par 3 mahine baad bhi Hemoglobin 8 se 9 hi rehta hai aur potty kaali aane se log dawai band kar dete hain! Iske piche ka science kya hai?
cards.illusion: Iron ki goli chahe chai ke sath khao ya doodh ke sath, pet mein sab ek hi tarah khoon banati hai—aur kaali potty aana matlab dawai nuksan kar rahi hai.
cards.myth: Iron ki goli subah garam doodh ke sath khane se pet mein garmi nahi hoti aur khoon jaldi badhta hai.
cards.reality: Doodh ka Calcium pet mein Iron ke absorption ko 50%–60% block kar deta hai—Iron hamesha **Nimbu-paani / Vitamin C** ke sath aur doodh/chai se 2 ghante door lena chahiye!

cards.title: Vitamin D3 60,000 IU Sachet Hafte ki Jagah Roz Khane se Kidney Failure (Hypercalcemia) ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Thakan aur haddi dard mein log chemist se '60,000 IU Vitamin D3' ka chhota capsule/sachet le aate hain—par kai log 'Once a Week' padhe bina usse **ROZ** 15–30 din kha kar ICU mein kyun pahunch jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Vitamin D toh bas ek taakat ka vitamin hai, zyada khane se baaki peshab mein nikal jaata hai.
cards.myth: Bharat mein sabko Vitamin D ki kami hoti hai isliye 60,000 IU ki goli har kisi ko roz khani chahiye.
cards.reality: 60,000 IU ek high-potency weekly therapeutic dose hai—roz khane par kuch hi hafton mein jaanlewa Hypercalcemia aur Kidney injury ho sakti hai!

cards.title: Chehre par Raat mein Hara 'Evion 400' Vitamin-E Capsule Phor kar Lagana: Fungal Acne aur Pores Clog!
cards.hook: social media videos beauty hacks dekh kar log ₹35 wali hari 'Evion 400' Vitamin-E capsule ko sui se phor kar seedhe chehre aur aankhon ke neeche mal lete hain—par 1 hafte mein hi gaalon par chhote-chhote daane aur milia kyun nikal aate hain?
cards.illusion: Evion 400 capsule ka tel pure Vitamin E hai jo har kisi ke chehre ko raaton-raat glowing aur wrinkle-free bana deta hai.
cards.myth: Evion 400 capsule ka tel dark circles aur pimples ke daag 7 din mein jad se khatam kar deta hai.
cards.reality: Dark circles genetics, thin skin, allergy ya neend ki kami se hote hain—gaadha oral Vitamin E tel unhe nahi mitata, ulta milia aur breakouts kar sakta hai.

cards.title: Sardiyon ki Sookhi Hawa mein Sirf Glycerin + Gulabjal Lagana: Skin se Ulta Paani Kheench Lena!
cards.hook: Sardiyon mein haath-chehra mulayam rakhne ke liye dadi-nani Glycerin aur Gulabjal mila kar lagati hain—par agar kamre mein heater chal raha ho ya hawa bilkul sukhi ho, to sirf Glycerin lagane se skin aur zyada dry kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Glycerin + Gulabjal har mausam mein skin ko 100% naram aur hydrated rakhta hai, upar kisi cream ki zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: 100% Pure bina-paani milayi Glycerin seedhe haath-honthon par lagane se 5 guna zyada fayda hota hai.
cards.reality: Undiluted 100% Glycerin behad sticky hoti hai aur dry hawa mein skin ki nichli layer se paani kheench kar ulta dehydration aur irritation kar sakti hai—hamesha dilute + seal karein!

cards.title: Palkon (Eyelashes) par Arandi ka Tel (Castor Oil) Lagana: Aankh mein Guhanjani (Stye) Kyun Nikalti Hai?
cards.hook: Lambi ghani palkon ke liye log raat mein sone se pehle Castor Oil (Arandi ka Tel) ya Petroleum Jelly palkon ki jad par laga lete hain—par subah aankhon mein dhundhlapan aur laal phoda (Stye/Guhanjani) kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Castor Oil palkon par lagane se naye baal turant ugate hain aur aankhon ko koi nuksan nahi hota.
cards.myth: Castor oil lagane se 15 din mein palkon aur eyebrows ke naye baal 2x tezi se ug aate hain.
cards.reality: Koi clinical trial sabit nahi karta ki Castor oil naye follicles ugaata hai—ye sirf maujooda baalon par shine chadhata hai aur aankh ki oil glands ko block kar ke Stye (guhanjani) ka khatra badha sakta hai.

cards.title: Viral 'Fermented Rice Water' Roz Baalon mein Lagana: Baal Silky ke Bajaye Jhadu Jaise Sakht Kyun?
cards.hook: Korean/social media videos hair hacks dekh kar log chawal bhigoya paani (Fermented Rice Water) har wash mein baalon par daalte hain—par kuch hafton baad baal chamakne ke bajaye rassi jaisa sakht aur beech se tootne kyun lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Rice Water 100% natural ghar ka nuskha hai isliye har wash mein aur har tarah ke baalon mein jitna chahein lagane se sirf fayda hi hota hai.
cards.myth: Chawal ke paani ko 3–4 din garmi mein sadakar (ferment kar ke) roz baalon mein lagakar sone se baal ghutnon tak lambe ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Na koi human trial rice water se baal lambe ugane ka saboot deta hai, aur roz lagane par starch-protein buildup aur scalp infection se ulta hair breakage badh sakta hai!

cards.title: Chehre par Nimbu + Baking Soda + Besan Lagana: 'Phytophotodermatitis' aur Skin Jalne ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: Daag-dhabbe aur tanning hatane ke liye ghar mein sabse popular nuskha hai 'Besan + Nimbu + Baking Soda'—par isse lagakar dhoop mein nikalte hi chehre par laal-kaale chhale aur permanent burning kyun hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Nimbu aur Baking Soda rasoi ki natural cheezein hain isliye chehre par lagane se 100% harmless aur natural glow aata hai.
cards.myth: Nimbu + Baking Soda milane se jhaag banta hai matlab dono neutralize hokar safe bleach ban gaye.
cards.reality: Dono ka ratio ghar mein kabhi exact pH 5.5 nahi banta—ya to teekha acid bachta hai ya tez alkaline soda, aur nimbu ke furocoumarins dhoop mein phir bhi burn karte hain!

cards.title: 'Pores Kholne ke Liye' Chehre par Roz Garam Bhaap (Facial Steam) Lena: Melasma aur Red Veins Badhna!
cards.hook: Glowing skin aur blackheads hatane ke liye log roz ₹400 wale facial steamer ke aage 15 minute chehra rakh kar garam bhaap lete hain—par isse gaalon par laali, jhaaiyan (Melasma) aur dryness kyun badh jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Garam bhaap lene se chehre ke band pores khul jaate hain, saari gandagi nikal jaati hai aur jhaaiyan kam hoti hain.
cards.myth: Pehle garam bhaap se pores kholo, phir barf ragad kar pores hamesha ke liye band kar do!
cards.reality: Pores mein koi muscles nahi hoti jo garmi-sardi se khulein ya band hon—bhaap sirf upari sebum ko naram karti hai aur barf sirf temporary sujan kam karti hai; dono ka excess skin barrier bigaadta hai!

cards.title: Direct Barf ka Tukda Chehre par Ragadne se Broken Capillaries aur Ice Burn ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Subah suji aankhon aur pimples par log freezer se seedha **Barf (Ice Cube)** nikaal kar gaalon par ghisne lagte hain—par cold trauma se skin ke andar ki patli nasein kyun toot sakti hain?
cards.illusion: Freezer ka barf direct chehre par ragadna sabse sasta aur 100% safe natural glow aur pore-tightening hack hai.
cards.myth: Aag jalati hai, barf sirf thandak deta hai—isliye barf se skin kabhi jal nahi sakti.
cards.reality: Extreme thandak (-18°C freezer ice) skin cells ka paani jama kar **Ice Burn (Frostnip)** aur broken capillaries kar deti hai—hamesha kapde mein lapet kar hi lagayein!

cards.title: Sheet Mask ko Chehre par Sukhne tak 45 Min Chhod Dena: Reverse Moisture Pull!
cards.hook: ₹100 ka Korean 'Hydrating Sheet Mask' laga kar log movie dekhte hue usse chehre par poora sukhne tak (45–60 minute) chhod dete hain—par sukhne ke baad skin pehle se zyada dry aur tight kyun lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Sheet mask ko jab tak poora sookh kar kagaz na ban jaaye tab tak chehre par lagaye rakhne se zyada serum skin ke andar jaata hai.
cards.myth: Sheet mask laga kar poori raat so jaane se 8 ghante lagatar hydration milta hai.
cards.reality: 20–30 minute mein sheet sukh kar skin ki apni moisture wapas kheench leti hai aur band sheet ke neeche paseena/bacteria trap ho sakte hain!

cards.title: Micellar Water se Makeup Saaf Karne ke Baad Chehra Na Dhona: Surfactant Residue aur Daane!
cards.hook: Bottle par likha hota hai 'No-Rinse Micellar Water'—isliye log raat ko cotton pad se makeup/sunscreen pochh kar bina muh dhoye so jaate hain! Par gaalon par chhote-chhote daane aur dryness kyun aane lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Micellar Water paani jaisa hi hota hai isliye usse chehra pochhne ke baad saade paani/face wash se dhone ki bilkul zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: Micellar Water 'Rosewater/Toner' jaisa hota hai isliye raat bhar chehre par chhod dena achcha hota hai.
cards.reality: Micellar water ek cleanser hai jismein surfactants (detergent molecules) hote hain—sirf emergency travel ko chhod kar ghar par use dhona hi best hai.

cards.title: Walnut aur Apricot Face Scrub se Chehra Ragadna: Smooth Skin ke Bajaye Micro-Tears & Pigmentation!
cards.hook: Blackheads aur dead skin hatane ke liye log dardara 'Walnut / Apricot Shell Scrub' hafte mein 3 baar chehre par ragadte hain—par isse chehra gora hone ke bajaye sanwala aur sensitive kyun pad jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna dardara aur kaddak scrub hoga, utni hi gehrai se chehre ki dead skin aur blackheads saaf honge.
cards.myth: Jab tak scrub se chehra laal aur thoda chhilta hua mehsoos na ho, tab tak mail saaf nahi hota.
cards.reality: Laali aur jalan ka matlab hai skin barrier damage ho raha hai—healthy exfoliation bilkul painless aur bina ragad ke hoti hai!

cards.title: Kaala 'Charcoal Peel-Off Mask' Kheench kar Utaarna: Blackheads Nahi, Skin Barrier aur Baby Hair Ukhhadna!
cards.hook: social media videos ads mein kaala 'Activated Charcoal Peel-Off Mask' lagakar utarne par strip par safed-kaale kante jaise dikhte hain—par kya wo sachmuch blackheads hain ya aapki apni chamdi ki suraksha parat?
cards.illusion: Charcoal peel-off mask ragad kar kheenchne se skin ke saare blackheads jad se bahar nikal aate hain.
cards.myth: Peel-off strip par jitne zyada safed-kaale kante chipak kar nikalte hain, utna hi chehra deep-clean hota hai.
cards.reality: Unmein se 80% aapke normal chehre ke bareek baal (vellus hairs) aur healthy sebum plugs hote hain jo 2 din mein wapas bhar jaate hain—jabki chhila hua skin barrier weeks mein repair hota hai!

cards.title: Naak ke Daane: Blackheads vs Normal 'Sebaceous Filaments' — Nose Strips se Kabhi Band Kyun Nahi Hote?
cards.hook: Naak par har hafte ₹40 wali Nose Strip chipka kar kheenchne ke baad bhi 3 din mein wahi chhote grey/peele dots phir bhar jaate hain! Par kya naak par dikhne wale ye sab dots sachmuch Blackheads hain?
cards.illusion: Naak par dikhne wale sabhi chhote grey-peele dots gande Blackheads hain jinhe dabaa kar ya nose strips se hamesha ke liye nikaala jaa sakta hai.
cards.myth: Nose strips aur blackhead-sucking vacuum machine se naak ke pores hamesha ke liye khali aur invisible ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Sebaceous filaments normal oil channels hain jo har 2–3 din mein refill hote hain—sucking vacuums aur strips sirf capillaries tod kar skin ko sensitive banate hain!

cards.title: 'Deodorant / Roll-On ke Aluminium se Breast Cancer Hota Hai' Myth: Cancer Institutes ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: social media forwards aur beauty reels mein daraya jaata hai ki 'Aluminium wale antiperspirant roll-on lagane se bagal ke raste Breast Cancer aur Alzheimer's hota hai!' Kya ₹800 ke 'Aluminium-Free Deo' ke piche sach hai ya sirf fear-marketing?
cards.illusion: Antiperspirant roll-on mein maujood Aluminium skin mein ghus kar Breast Cancer aur Kidney/Brain disease kar deta hai.
cards.myth: 'Natural Mineral Alum Crystal Deodorant' bilkul 100% Aluminium-free aur alag hota hai.
cards.reality: Natural Crystal Deo (**Potassium Alum / Fitkari**) ka chemical formula hi **KAl(SO4)2** hai—yani usmein khud Aluminium hota hai!

cards.title: Fitkari (Alum) Roz Underarms aur Chehre par Ragadna: Astringent Benefit vs Dryness & Darkening!
cards.hook: Desi reels mein bataya jaata hai ki 'Nahate waqt roz Fitkari (Alum Stone) bagal aur chehre par ragadne se jhurriyan, badbu aur underarm kalapan gayab ho jaata hai!' Par kya roz Fitkari ragadna safe hai?
cards.illusion: Fitkari ek sasti jadui patthar hai jise roz chehre par ragadne se skin tight aur gori ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Fitkari ko paani mein ghol kar roz chehre par lagane se 15 din mein jhurriyan aur daag hamesha ke liye mit jaate hain.
cards.reality: Fitkari sirf temporary surface protein tight (astringent shrink) feel deti hai jo dhote hi khatam ho jaata hai—ye anti-aging ya pigmentation ilaj bilkul nahi hai, ulta skin dry karti hai!

cards.title: 'Hair Removal Cream' (Veet/Anne French) Sensitive Parts par Lagana: Chemical Burn aur Kalapan!
cards.hook: Razor se katne ke dar se mahilayein aur ladke haath-pair, underarms aur private parts par 5-minute wali 'Hair Removal Cream' lagate hain—par kai baar chamdi laal pad kar jal jaati hai aur us jagah hamesha ka kalapan kyun pad jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Aloe Vera aur Rose likhi Hair Removal Creams ek gentle moisturizing lotion jaisi hoti hain jo baal pighla deti hain.
cards.myth: Hair removal cream use karne se baal jad se nikal jaate hain aur naye baal kam aur patle aate hain.
cards.reality: Cream sirf skin ki satah (surface) par baal ko gholti hai—jad andar waise hi rehti hai isliye 2–3 din mein baal bilkul shaving ki tarah wapas ug aate hain!

cards.title: 'Intimate Hygiene Wash' Roz Andar Use Karne se Infection Badhna: Self-Cleaning Microbiome Truth!
cards.hook: TV ads dekha kar mahilayein roz ₹250 wala 'pH-Balanced Intimate Wash' use karti hain—par Gynaecologists sehatmand mahilaon ko har roz intimate wash ya douching karne se mana kyun karti hain?
cards.illusion: Normal saade paani se intimate area saaf nahi hota, infection se bachne ke liye roz perfumed intimate wash zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Healthy rehne aur badbu rokne ke liye andar tak intimate wash ya paani ki dhar (douche) se safai karna zaroori hai.
cards.reality: Douching andar ke protective Lactobacillus bacteria ko dho kar infection (BV aur PID) ka khatra 2x–3x badha deti hai—body andar se khud saaf hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Khushboo wale Gel Sanitary Pads' se Intimate Rashes: 4–6 Hour Change Rule vs Menstrual Cup!
cards.hook: Period ke dino mein 'Ultra-Thin Scented Gel Pads' lagane par mahilaon ko chhilan, rashes aur irritation kyun hota hai—aur 10 ghante tak ek hi pad lagaye rakhne ka asli nuksan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Agar pad bhar na jaaye aur usmein khushboo aa rahi ho, to ek hi pad ko 10–12 ghante tak lagaye rakhna bilkul safe hai.
cards.myth: Tampon ya Menstrual Cup se kunwaripan (virginity) ya fertility par asar padta hai ya wo andar kho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Vaginal canal ek band muscle-tube hai jiske aage cervix behad chhota hota hai—cup ya tampon kabhi pet mein nahi kho sakta, aur na hi iska fertility se koi lena-dena hai!

cards.title: Chhote Bacche par Talcum Powder Udana aur Intimate Area mein Lagana: Lungs aur Talc Risk!
cards.hook: Nahane ke baad har maa navjaat bacche par khushboodar 'Baby Talcum Powder' ka badal uda deti hai, aur bade log garmiyon mein undergarments ke andar lagate hain—par Pediatricians aur WHO Talc se mana kyun karte hain?
cards.illusion: Baby Talcum powder bilkul harmless mitti-khushboo hai jo bacche ke lungs aur intimate skin ke liye 100% safe hai.
cards.myth: Baby Powder ke dabbe par bacche ki photo bani hai matlab usse navjaat ke diaper aur chehre par udana 100% safe hai.
cards.reality: Doctors aur AAP talcum powder (yahan tak ki cornstarch dust bhi agar hawa mein ude!) ko babies par lagane se mana karte hain kyunki chhote lungs ke liye powder particles khatarnak hote hain.

cards.title: Roz Acetone Nail Remover aur Salon 'UV Gel Nails' Karwana: Nakhun Tutna aur UV Aging!
cards.hook: Salon mein ₹1,500 wale 'Gel Nail Extensions' aur roz Acetone remover use karne ke baad apne asli nakhun kagaz jaise patle aur peele pad kar tootne kyun lagte hain?
cards.illusion: UV Gel Nails aur extensions lagwane se asli nakhun andar se mazboot aur healthy rehte hain.
cards.myth: Salon ka LED Nail Lamp UV nahi hota isliye usse haath ki skin par koi rays nahi padti.
cards.reality: Nail curing LED lamps bhi **UVA wavelengths** hi nikaalte hain—isliye AAD nail session se pehle haathon par Sunscreen ya fingerless gloves pehanne ki salah deti hai!

cards.title: Manicure mein Nakhun ki Skin (Cuticles) Katwana: Bacterial & Fungal Paronychia Infection!
cards.hook: Salon mein manicure/pedicure ke dauran log nakhun ke kinare ki patli skin (Cuticle) ko nipper se katwa kar saaf karwate hain—par 3 din baad ungli ke kinare laal sujan aur peep (Paronychia) kyun ban jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Nakhun ke kinare ki extra skin (Cuticle) sirf dead kachra hai jisse salon mein kaat kar nikaal dena hi saaf manicure hai.
cards.myth: Cuticles katwane se nakhun zyada lambe aur tezi se ugate hain.
cards.reality: Cuticle sirf nakhun ki jad (nail matrix) ka darwaza band rakhti hai—usse kaatne se growth tezi se nahi badhti, balki nakhun ki jad infection ke liye khul jaati hai!

cards.title: 'Thandak Dene Wala Menthol/Camphor Lip Balm' Roz Lagane par Honth aur Zyada Kyun Phat-te Hain?
cards.hook: Thandi tingle dene wale medicated/mint lip balms lagane par 10 minute bahut achcha lagta hai—par 1 ghante baad honth pehle se zyada sookh kar papdi chhodne lagte hain aur baar-baar lagane ki lat kyun lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Lip balm lagane par agar honthon mein thandi jhanjhanahat (tingle) ho, to wo dawai wala lip balm honthon ko zyada jaldi theek kar raha hai.
cards.myth: Honthon par thook (saliva) lagane ya papdi kheench kar nikaalne se phate honth jaldi naram ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Thook sookhte waqt bachi-kuchi nami bhi uda le jaata hai aur usmein maujood amylase enzymes honthon ki patli skin ko aur jala kar Lip-Licker's Dermatitis kar dete hain!

cards.title: Viral 'Exfoliating Foot Peel Socks' (Acid Socks): Diabetes Patients ke Liye Pairon mein Ulcer ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Online ₹250 ke 'Baby Foot Peel Masks' (plastic socks) pehanne ke 5 din baad pairon ki poori chamdi saanp ki kenchuli ki tarah utar aati hai! Par Diabetes aur sensitive skin walon ke liye ye khatarnak kyun hai?
cards.illusion: Foot peel socks ek gentle moisturizing mask hai jisse kisi bhi umar aur bimari wale log ghar par pairon ki chamdi utaar sakte hain.
cards.myth: Foot peel sock pehanne ke baad jab poori chamdi saanp ki tarah utar aaye, to matlab saari gandagi aur fungus nikal gaya.
cards.reality: Wo utarne wali layer aam skin cells hain—acid peel fungus (athlete's foot) ko nahi maarta, ulta kachchi skin chhilne se infection aur tez phail sakta hai!

cards.title: Kaan Dard mein Garam Lahsun ka Tel ya Hydrogen Peroxide Daalna: Eardrum Chhed Risk!
cards.hook: Kaan mein dard ya mail (wax) jamne par ghar mein sarson ka tel lahsun paka kar kaan mein daal dete hain, ya chemist se Hydrogen Peroxide laakar dalte hain—par ENT doctors isse kaan ke parde ke liye khatarnak kyun kehte hain?
