cards.illusion: Kaan dard aur mail nikaalne ke liye garam lahsun ka tel ya Hydrogen Peroxide daalna sabse purana aur 100% safe nuskha hai.
cards.myth: Cotton Earbuds roz kaan mein ghumane se kaan ka saara mail saaf ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Earbuds sirf 10% mail bahar nikaalte hain aur 90% mail ko andar parde ke paas dhakel kar patthar jaisi guthli (Cerumen Impaction) bana dete hain!

cards.title: Contact Lens ko Saade Paani se Dhona ya Lagakar Sona: 'Acanthamoeba' Andhapan ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Solution khatam hone par log Contact Lens ko nal ke saade paani ya thook se dho kar pehan lete hain, ya lens lagakar so jaate hain—par aankh mein 'Acanthamoeba Keratitis' naam ka parasite andhapan kaise kar sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Filter/RO ka paani bilkul saaf hota hai isliye kabhi-kabhar contact lens paani se dhone ya pehan kar sone mein koi dikkat nahi.
cards.myth: RO ya packaged peene ka paani bilkul pure hota hai isliye usmein contact lens rakhna solution jaisa hi safe hai.
cards.reality: Drinking water (RO/bottled) sterile aur isotonic (aankh ke anukool) nahi hota—usmein Acanthamoeba aur bacteria reh sakte hain aur wo lens ko aankh se chipka kar cornea chhil deta hai!

cards.title: ₹2,000 ke 'Blue-Cut Computer Glasses' vs Asli Digital Eye Strain: 20-20-20 Rule & Blink Rate!
cards.hook: Laptop aur phone chalane walon ko opticians ₹1,500–₹3,000 ke 'Zero-Power Blue-Light Blocking Glasses' bechte hain—par Cochrane Review (2023) ne inki asaliyat kya batayi aur aankhein thakti kyun hain?
cards.illusion: Screen se nikalne wali 'Blue Light' aankhon ke parde jala deti hai aur Blue-Cut chashma pehanne se computer eye strain bilkul khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Zero-power Blue-Cut chashma pehanne se bacchon aur badon ko kabhi chashme ka number nahi badhta.
cards.reality: Na blue-light glasses chashme ka number (Myopia) rokte hain aur na eye strain—bacchon mein Myopia rokne ke liye **roz 1–2 ghante bahar Sunlight/Outdoor play** sabse bada proven protection hai!

cards.title: 'Andhere mein Padhne aur Chashma Lagane se Aankhon ka Number Aur Badh Jaata Hai' Myth!
cards.hook: Bachpan se ghar wale daant-te hain ki 'Kam roshni mein mat padho warna aankhein kharab ho jayengi!' Aur bade log sochte hain ki 'Chashma lagane se aankhein chashme ki aadi hokar number aur badha leti hain!' Vigyan kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Kam roshni mein padhne aur sahi power ka chashma pehanne se aankhon ki roshni hamesha ke liye kamzor ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Chashma lagane ke bajaye subah ghaas par nange pair chalne aur eye-rotation exercises se -3.0 ka chashma 100% utar jaata hai.
cards.reality: Ghaas par chalna aur eye exercises relaxation ke liye acchi hain, par wo eyeball ke shape (Myopia/Astigmatism) ko badal kar -3.0 ka power zero nahi kar saktin!

cards.title: 'Roz Gajar Khane se Aankhon ka Chashma Utar Jaata Hai' Myth: Night Blindness vs Myopia!
cards.hook: Chashma lagte hi ghar wale roz 1 kilo Gajar aur Gajar ka juice pilana shuru kar dete hain—par kya Gajar sachmuch chashme ka number kam kar sakti hai, ya ye sirf World War II ka ek mashhoor propaganda tha?
cards.illusion: Roz khoob Gajar aur Palak khane se chashme ka -2.0 / -4.0 number theek hokar aankhein 6/6 ho jaati hain.
cards.myth: Gajar kha kar raat ko bhi ullu ki tarah super-vision aa jaati hai aur chashma hamesha ke liye chhoot jaata hai.
cards.reality: Vitamin A sirf *kami* hone par Night Blindness rokta hai—normal healthy insaan mein gajar na super-vision deti hai aur na chashme ka power ghatati hai!

cards.title: Aankhon ko Rosewater ya Triphala Paani se Dhona: Sterile Tears vs Bacterial/Fungal Keratitis!
cards.hook: Aankhon mein jalan ya dhool lagne par log ghar par rakha ₹40 wala Gulabjal ya Triphala bhigoya paani eye-cup mein daal kar aankh dho lete hain—par Ophthalmologists isse aankhon ke liye itna khatarnak kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Gulabjal aur Triphala churna bhigoya paani aankhon ko thandak aur safai dene wale natural eye-drops hain.
cards.myth: Aankh mein chot ya laali aane par Maa ka doodh, Shahad ya Triphala paani daalne se turant infection khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Shahad aur Triphala paani mein fungus/spores aur sugar hoti hai jo aankh mein bacteria-fungus ko tezi se badha kar putli ko sada sakti hai—kabhi bhi home liquids aankh mein na daalein!

cards.title: Tez Bukhar mein Barf ke Paani ki Patti ya Thande Paani se Nahlana: Shivering se Bukhar Aur Badhna!
cards.hook: 103°F bukhar hote hi ghar wale maathe par fridge ke barf wale paani ki pattiyan rakhte hain ya thande paani se nahlane lagte hain—par isse mareez kaampne lagta hai aur bukhar utarne ke bajaye aur tez kyun ho jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada barf jaisa thanda paani bukhar mein lagayenge, sharir utni hi jaldi thanda ho jayega.
cards.myth: Bukhar aane par 3 kambal odha kar paseena nikaalna chahiye, ya maathe par barf rakhni chahiye.
cards.reality: Dono extreme galat hain! Mote kambal sharir ki garmi andar band kar ke bukhar badhate hain (aur infants mein danger hai), jabki barf ka paani shivering se temp badhata hai!

cards.title: Dengue mein Papite ke Patte ka Ras aur Bakri ka Doodh: Platelets vs Asli Jaan-Bachao Hydration!
cards.hook: Dengue hote hi log hospital fluids se zyada ₹500 litre Bakri ka Doodh, Kiwi, aur kadwe Papite ke Patte ke Ras ke piche bhaagte hain—par Dengue mein jaan platelets ki ginti se jaati hai ya Plasma Leakage se?
cards.illusion: Dengue ka ekmatra khatra Platelets ghatna hai, aur Papite ke patte ka ras + Bakri ka doodh pi lene se Dengue 100% theek ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Platelets 50,000 se neeche aate hi khoon chadhana (Platelet Transfusion) zaroori hota hai warna insaan mar jaata hai.
cards.reality: WHO guidelines ke mutabik bina bleeding ke **10,000** tak bhi prophylactic platelet transfusion ki zaroorat nahi hoti—asli monitoring **BP, Urine output aur Hematocrit (PCV)** ki hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Khoon Daan (Blood Donation) Karne se Hamesha ki Kamzori aur Wazan Badhta Hai' Myth!
cards.hook: Emergency mein kisi apne ke liye 1 unit blood dene ki baat aaye, to healthy naujawan bhi is dar se piche hat jaate hain ki 'Khoon dene se zindagi bhar kamzori aa jayegi aur shareer phool jayega!' Asli physiology kya hai?
cards.illusion: 1 unit (350–450 ml) blood donate karne se sharir mein hamesha ke liye khoon ki kami, kamzori aur motapa aa jaata hai.
cards.myth: Khoon daan karne se hamesha ke liye kamar dard, kamzori aur wazan badhne (motapa) ki bimari lag jaati hai.
cards.reality: Blood donation se wazan ya kamzori bilkul nahi badhti—1 donation mein lagbhag 500–650 kcal sirf naye RBCs banane mein kharch hoti hain aur sharir 4–6 hafte mein poora khoon naya bana leta hai!

cards.title: 'Khoon Badhane ke Liye Sirf Chukandar aur Anar Khao' Myth: Real Iron Content & Vitamin-C Secret!
cards.hook: Hemoglobin 9 aate hi ghar wale roz ₹150 ka Anar aur laal Chukandar (Beetroot) ka juice pilate hain—par kya aap jaante hain laal rang ke bawajood Chukandar aur Anar mein Iron behad kam hota hai?
cards.illusion: Chukandar aur Anar ka rang laal khoon jaisa hota hai isliye inmein duniya mein sabse zyada Iron hota hai aur sirf yahi khoon badhate hain.
cards.myth: Har laal cheez (Chukandar, Anar, Laal Angoor, Tamatar) khoon mein sabse zyada Hemoglobin badhati hai.
cards.reality: Phalon-sabziyon ka laal rang plant pigments se hota hai, Iron se nahi—Chana, Soy, Halim, Moringa aur Bajra mein Chukandar/Anar se 5x–15x zyada Iron hota hai!

cards.title: Pure Vegetarian Diet mein Vitamin B12 ki Chhupi Kami: Haath-Pair mein Jhanjhanahat aur Nerve Damage!
cards.hook: Bahut se shakahari (Vegetarians) roz dal-roti, sabzi aur doodh khane ke bawajood haath-pair mein jhanjhanahat (pins & needles), bhoolne ki bimari aur thakan kyun jhelte hain—kya paudhon mein Vitamin B12 hota hi nahi?
cards.illusion: Ghar ka shuddh shakahari khana (roti, dal, hari sabzi, badam, dry fruits) khane se sharir ko saare vitamins mil jaate hain, B12 supplement ki zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: Basi roti, dahi ka paani, ya Palak-Spirulina khane se vegetarians ka Vitamin B12 poora ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Palak mein B12 zero hota hai aur Spirulina mein inactive 'Pseudo-B12' hota hai; dahi/doodh mein B12 hota hai par kai vegetarians aur Metformin/PPI patients mein wo kaafi nahi padta—isliye blood test aur fortified/supplement zaroori ho sakta hai!

cards.title: Bina B12 Check Kiye Sirf Folic Acid Khana: Khoon Badh Jaana Par Nerve Damage Chhup Jaana!
cards.hook: Kamzori aur badhe hue MCV (Megaloblastic Anemia) par kai baar log sirf 'Folic Acid / Iron-Folic' goli shuru kar dete hain—par agar asli kami Vitamin B12 ki thi, to sirf Folic Acid khane se khatarnak 'Masking Trap' kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Anemia mein Folic Acid ek harmless vitamin hai, usse bina B12 test kiye roz khane se sirf fayda hi hota hai.
cards.myth: Agar CBC report mein Hemoglobin badh kar normal aa gaya, to matlab B12 ya Folate ki koi kami ab nahi bachi.
cards.reality: High-dose Folic Acid blood counts ko normal kar sakta hai jabki andar B12 ki kami nason (nerves) ko damage kar rahi hoti hai—isliye B12 alag se check karna zaroori hai!

cards.title: Sasti 'Fish Oil Omega-3' Capsules mein Machhli ki Badbu (Rancid Oil): Heart Fayda vs Oxidation!
cards.hook: Heart aur joints ke liye log online ₹300 mein 100 capsules wali 'Triple Strength Fish Oil' mangwa lete hain—par kholte hi teekhi machhli ki badbu aur 'Fishy Burps' kyun aati hain? Kya wo tel sad (Rancid) chuka hai?
cards.illusion: Fish oil capsules mein machhli jaisi teekhi badbu aana bilkul normal hai kyunki wo samundari machhli se banti hain.
cards.myth: '1000 mg Omega-3 Fish Oil' likhi goli khane se poora 1000 mg Omega-3 mil jaata hai.
cards.reality: Wo 1000 mg kul machhli ka tel hota hai—standard saste capsules mein uske andar asli active **EPA + DHA sirf 300 mg** (30%) hi hota hai!

cards.title: Hair/Nail ke Liye High-Dose Biotin (10,000 mcg) Khana: Heart Attack & Thyroid Blood Reports GALAT Aana!
cards.hook: Baal jhadne par log ₹600 wali '10,000 mcg Biotin Hair Gummies / Tablets' roz khate hain—par US FDA ne ispar emergency warning kyun di hai ki Biotin aapke Heart Attack aur Thyroid ke blood tests ko galat dikha sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Biotin (Vitamin B7) bas baalon ka ek harmless vitamin hai, jitna zyada khayenge baal utne ghane honge aur kisi test par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.myth: Biotin 10,000 mcg khane se kisi bhi tarah ke hair fall (ganjapan/stress shedding) mein 1 mahine mein naye baal ug aate hain.
cards.reality: Clinical reviews mein normal Biotin levels wale logon par extra Biotin se hair growth ka koi strong saboot nahi mila—jabki Thyroid/Heart blood tests gadbad hone ka real risk FDA ne verify kiya hai!

cards.title: 'ACV Fat-Burner Liquid / Gummies' Subah Khali Pet Peena: Daant ka Enamel Galna & Throat Burn!
cards.hook: Wazan ghatane ke liye log subah bina brush kiye 'Apple Cider Vinegar (ACV)' ka shot pi lete hain ya ₹800 ki meethi 'ACV Gummies' chabate hain—par dentist ke clinic mein daanton ki chamak (Enamel) kyun gal rahi hai?
cards.illusion: Apple Cider Vinegar roz subah khali pet peene ya ACV gummies khane se pet ki charbi bina diet-exercise ke pighal jaati hai.
cards.myth: Garam paani + Shahad + ACV subah khali pet peene se bina diet badle pet ki charbi pighal jaati hai.
cards.reality: Shahad mein khud sugar calories hoti hain aur ACV charbi nahi pighlata—calorie deficit, protein-fiber aur chalne-exercise se hi charbi ghat-ti hai!

cards.title: Har Stress/Gym ke Liye Bina Doctor ke High-Dose Ashwagandha Khana: Rare Liver Injury & Thyroid Risk!
cards.hook: Fitness influencers roz 1,200 mg 'KSM-66 Ashwagandha' stress aur testosterone badhane ke liye khane ko kehte hain—par European aur LiverTox reports mein kuch logon ko isse Peeliya (Liver Injury) aur Thyroid kyun bigda?
cards.illusion: Ashwagandha 100% ayurvedic jadibooti hai isliye iska high-dose extract har koi zindagi bhar roz bina side-effect kha sakta hai.
cards.myth: Ashwagandha aur sabhi Ayurvedic extracts bilkul natural hain isliye unse kabhi liver ya thyroid ko nuksan nahi ho sakta.
cards.reality: NIH LiverTox database mein Ashwagandha, Green Tea extract aur high-dose Turmeric-Piperine sabhi ke documented Herb-Induced Liver Injury cases darj hain—'natural' ka matlab side-effect-free nahi hota!

cards.title: Online Sasta 'Pure Pahadi Shilajit' Khana: Bina Heavy-Metal Lab Report ke Lead & Arsenic Risk!
cards.hook: social media videos par ₹499 mein '100% Pure Himalayan Gold Shilajit Resin' becha ja raha hai—par bina proper purification aur batch-wise lab test ke pahadi chattanon se nikle Shilajit mein Lead, Arsenic aur Mercury kaise aa jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Jo Shilajit paani mein ghul kar taar chhode ya aag par pighle, wo 100% shuddh aur heavy-metal-free hota hai.
cards.myth: Shilajit ko garam paani mein gholne par agar wo golden-brown taar chhode, to wo 100% pure aur heavy-metal-free hai.
cards.reality: Paani ya aag wala test sirf tar/sugar milawat check karta hai—Lead, Arsenic aur Mercury jaise zehrile heavy metals bina laboratory machine (ICP-MS) ke dikh hi nahi sakte!

cards.title: 'Immunity ke Liye' Roz Gaadha Giloy Kadha Peena: Autoimmune Hepatitis (Liver Damage) Cases!
cards.hook: COVID ke baad se bahut se gharon mein log roz subah 'Immunity' ke liye gaadha Giloy (Guduchi) ka kadha ya tablets lete rehte hain—par Mumbai aur Delhi ke Liver Doctors ne Giloy overdose se liver failure ke cases kyun report kiye?
cards.illusion: Giloy (Amrita) ko Amrit kaha jaata hai isliye roz subah bina limit ke gaadha Giloy kadha peena 100% safe hai.
cards.myth: Giloy ka naam 'Amrita' hai isliye usse jitna zyada aur roz piyein utni zyada immunity badhti hai, koi nuksan ho hi nahi sakta.
cards.reality: Medical journals (Hepatology / INASL) mein dozens of Giloy-triggered autoimmune liver injury cases documented hain—koi bhi medicinal herb rozana unlimited lene ke liye nahi hoti!

cards.title: High-Dose 'Curcumin + Black Pepper (Piperine)' Capsules Roz Khana: Liver Injury & Gallstone Pain!
cards.hook: Ghar ke khane mein 1/2 chammach haldi toh hum sadiyon se khate hain—par aajkal log joints/immunity ke liye ₹1,200 wali '95% Curcumin + Piperine' capsules roz khate hain! Isse kuch logon ka Liver kharab kyun ho raha hai?
cards.illusion: Haldi hamari rasoi ka masala hai isliye 1000 mg Curcumin + Black Pepper capsules khana bilkul 1/2 chammach haldi khane jaisa hi safe hai.
cards.myth: Haldi toh ghar mein roz khate hain, isliye 1,000 mg Curcumin + Piperine pill khane ka koi side effect ho hi nahi sakta.
cards.reality: TGA Australia aur US DILIN ne 2023 mein high-bioavailability Curcumin + Piperine pills par official **Liver Injury warnings** jaari ki hain—extract pill khane ki haldi se 20x zyada concentrated hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Activated Charcoal Black Lemonade / Pills' Peena: BP, Thyroid aur Birth Control Dawaiyon ko Block Karna!
cards.hook: Cafes mein kaala 'Activated Charcoal Detox Latte/Juice' aur gas ke liye charcoal pills trend mein hain—par ye pet mein jakar aapki zaroori Thyroid, BP aur Birth Control ki goliyon ko bekaar kaise bana deta hai?
cards.illusion: Activated Charcoal sharir ke saare 'bad toxins' ko chumbak ki tarah kheench kar bahar nikaal deta hai aur healthy nutrients aur dawaiyon ko nahi chhedta.
cards.myth: Activated Charcoal sirf bure toxins aur fat ko pehchan kar bahar nikaalta hai, dawai aur vitamins ko nahi.
cards.reality: Charcoal mein koi dimaag nahi hota—ye pet mein aayi har molecule (dawai, vitamins, hormones) ko non-selectively chipka kar bekaar kar deta hai!

cards.title: 'Spirulina Khane se Vegetarians ko Poora Vitamin B12 Mil Jaata Hai' Myth: Pseudo-B12 Sach!
cards.hook: Vegans aur Vegetarians ko Spirulina (neela-hara algae powder) is daawe ke sath becha jaata hai ki 'Ismein meat se zyada Vitamin B12 hai!' Par doctors Spirulina ko B12 source maanne se mana kyun karte hain?
cards.illusion: Spirulina tablets roz khane se shakahari logon ke sharir mein Vitamin B12 ki kami poori tarah door ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Spirulina ek superfood hai jismein duniya ka sabse zyada natural plant-based Vitamin B12 hota hai.
cards.reality: Spirulina ka lagbhag saara B12 **Pseudovitamin B12** (inactive analogue) hota hai jo human cells utilize nahi kar paate—ye B12 deficiency theek nahi kar sakta!

cards.title: Dast ya Garmi mein 'Glucon-D / Fruit Tetra-Pack ORS' vs Asli WHO ORS: 5x Sugar Spike Khatra!
cards.hook: Loose motions ya dhoop se aate hi log ₹20 ka orange 'packaged sugary drink / Electro-Drink Tetra-Pack' ya 'Glucon-D' pila dete hain—par doctors aur Delhi High Court/FSSAI ne fake 'ORS' tetra-packs par sakhti kyun ki?
cards.illusion: Pharmacy par milne wale har tetrapack par agar 'ORS' likha hai to wo dast aur dehydration mein WHO ORS jaisa hi kaam karta hai.
cards.myth: Dast mein namkeen ORS baccha nahi peeta, isliye Glucon-D ya nimbu-soda ya apple-juice drink pila dena bilkul barabar hai.
cards.reality: High sugar aur kam namak dast ko aur tez kar dete hain—asli WHO ORS ka 1:1 sodium-glucose ratio hi aant ko paani sokhne ki taakat deta hai!

cards.title: Gym mein Creatine Lene par Blood Test mein 'High Creatinine' Aana: Kidney Kharab ya Sirf False Alarm?
cards.hook: Gym mein Creatine Monohydrate khane wale ladke jab Kidney Function Test (KFT) karwate hain, to Serum Creatinine 1.4–1.6 aa jaata hai—aur doctor/ghar wale ghabra jaate hain ki 'Kidney fail ho rahi hai!' Asli biochemistry kya hai?
cards.illusion: Creatine powder khane se healthy logon ki kidneys kharab ho jaati hain, aur high Creatinine hamesha Kidney Failure ka saboot hai.
cards.myth: Creatine ek steroid hai jo gym chhodte hi muscles ko charbi mein badal deta hai aur kidneys sada deta hai.
cards.reality: Creatine koi steroid/hormone nahi hai—ye hamari hi muscles (aur meat/fish) mein paaya jaane wala natural amino-acid compound hai, aur healthy kidneys par iska koi damage proven nahi hai!

cards.title: Gym 'Pre-Workout Powder' ke 2 Scoop: 400mg+ Caffeine aur Stimulants se Heart Palpitations!
cards.hook: Workout energy ke liye ladke 'Insane Pump / Explosive Pre-Workout' ka 1–2 scoop paani mein ghol kar pite hain—par chest mein tez dhadkan, chehre mein sui chubhna aur chakkar kyun aane lagte hain?
cards.illusion: Pre-workout powder bas ek protein-vitamin drink hai jo gym mein safe energy deti hai.
cards.myth: Pre-workout mein chehre par khujli aur sui chubhna matlab dawai tezi se fat jala rahi hai aur zyada taakat de rahi hai.
cards.reality: Wo khujli sirf **Beta-Alanine** naam ke amino acid ka ek harmless skin-nerve sensation hai—uska fat loss ya immediate energy se koi lena-dena nahi hai!

cards.title: Gym Trainer ke Kehne par 'Safe Cycle / SARMs / Anabolic Steroids' Lena: Hormone Shut-Down & Heart Risk!
cards.hook: 6 mahine mein bodybuilder jaisi body banane ke liye local gym trainers 'Bas 1 chhota Oral Dianabol / Anavar / SARMs / Testosterone cycle le lo, PCT se sab normal ho jayega!' bolte hain—is dhokhe ki asli keemat kya hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Chhota 8-week oral steroid ya SARMs cycle aur uske baad PCT (Post Cycle Therapy) kar lene se body 100% normal aur risk-free rehti hai.
cards.myth: SARMs steroids nahi hote isliye wo bina kisi side effect ke sirf muscle badhate hain aur natural hormones nahi rokte.
cards.reality: FDA ne warn kiya hai ki SARMs bhi testosterone ko suppress karte hain aur unse life-threatening liver toxicity, heart attack aur stroke ke cases report hue hain!

cards.title: 'Sauna Sweat Belt' Bandh kar Paseena Bahane se Pet ki Charbi Pighalna: Sirf Paani Ghatne ka Dhokha!
cards.hook: TV ads aur online ₹999 mein 'Sweat Slim Belt / Sauna Suit' dikha kar kaha jaata hai ki 'Ise baandh kar 30 min chalo, paseene ke sath pet ki charbi pighal jayegi!' Kya paseena aane ka matlab sachmuch fat loss hota hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada paseena aayega, utni hi zyada charbi pighal kar paseene ke raste bahar niklegi.
cards.myth: AC gym mein workout karne se paseena kam aata hai isliye charbi nahi pighalti—bina AC ke paseena bahana zaroori hai.
cards.reality: Fat burn aapke muscles ke kaam aur calories par depend karta hai, kamre ke temperature par nahi! AC mein aap bina thake zyada achcha aur lamba workout kar sakte hain!

cards.title: 'Roz 200 Pet ke Crunches Karne se Sirf Pet ki Charbi Girti Hai' Myth: Systemic Fat Loss Science!
cards.hook: Tond (Belly Fat) kam karne ke liye log roz subah 200 situps/crunches aur side-bends karte hain—par 3 mahine baad kamar mein dard shuru ho jaata hai aur pet ki charbi wahin ki wahin kyun rehti hai?
cards.illusion: Jis hisse ki exercise (Crunches for Belly, Arm circles for Flabby Arms) roz karenge, wahan ki charbi sabse pehle pighal kar gayab ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Pet par slimming gel laga kar roz 200 crunches karne se sirf tond andar chali jaati hai.
cards.reality: Na koi cream fat burn karti hai aur na crunches upar ki fat layer ko directly pighlate hain—poore sharir ka overall fat % girne par hi pet andar jaata hai!

cards.title: 'Agar Gym ke Agle Din Dard (Soreness) Nahi Hua Toh Workout Bekar Gaya' Myth: DOMS vs Muscle Growth!
cards.hook: Gym beginners aur trainers sochte hain ki jab tak agle din bistar se utha na jaaye aur haath-pair mein tez dard na ho, tab tak muscles nahi ban rahi—par kya Muscle Soreness (DOMS) aur Muscle Growth ek hi cheez hain?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada agle din sharir dukhega, workout utna hi successful aur muscle-building hua hai.
cards.myth: Lactic Acid gym ke 2 din baad tak muscles mein jama rehta hai aur wahi agle din ka dard (DOMS) karta hai.
cards.reality: Workout ke dauran bana Lactate (Lactic acid) exercise khatam hone ke **30–60 minute ke andar poori tarah saaf** ho jaata hai—agle din ka dard DOMS micro-inflammation hota hai, lactic acid nahi!

cards.title: Daudne se Pehle Static Stretching vs Dynamic Warmup: Performance aur Injury Science!
cards.hook: Subah park mein daudne ya gym shuru karne se pehle log 10 minute tak ek hi pose mein pair pakad kar khinchte rehte hain (Static Stretching)—par sports physiologists kehte hain isse speed ghat-ti hai aur injury kyun badhti hai?
cards.illusion: Daudne ya heavy workout se pehle 30–60 second tak thande muscles ko kheench kar (Static Stretch) rakhna injury rokne ka sabse achcha tarika hai.
cards.myth: Bina 10 minute static toe-touch stretch kiye daudne se 100% muscle toot jaati hai.
cards.reality: Bade reviews mein sirf static stretching se injury rukne ka saboot nahi mila—asli protection gradual **Dynamic Warmup** aur muscles ko strong rakhne se milta hai!

cards.title: Bina Cushion ke Chapte Jooton mein Concrete par Daudna: Heel Spur & Plantar Fasciitis!
cards.hook: Subah saste chapte canvas shoes ya chappal pehan kar pakki concrete sadak par daudne se kuch hafton baad subah bistar se pair rakhte hi edi (Heel) mein tez sui jaisa dard kyun uthta hai?
cards.illusion: Nange pair ya saste bilkul patle-flat canvas shoes mein pakki sadak par daudna 'natural' aur pairon ke liye sabse achcha hota hai.
cards.myth: Edi mein X-ray par dikhne wali chhoti haddi ('Heel Spur') hi saare dard ki jad hai jisse operation se katwana padta hai.
cards.reality: 20% bina dard wale healthy logon ke X-ray mein bhi heel spur dikhta hai—asli dard **Plantar Fascia ki sujan aur tight Calf muscles** se hota hai jo 90%+ cases mein bina operation exercises aur cushioning se theek hota hai!

cards.title: ₹600 ki 'Magnetic Acupressure Chappal': Diabetes, BP aur Kidney Theek Hone ka Daawa!
cards.hook: Malls aur sadak kinare ₹500–₹800 mein kante aur chhote magnets wali 'Acupressure Health Slippers' bechi jaati hain—daawa hota hai ki isse Sugar, BP aur Kidney theek ho jaati hai! Asliyat aur Diabetes khatra kya hai?
cards.illusion: Pair ke talwe mein lage chhote magnets aur plastic ke kante khoon saaf kar ke Diabetes, High BP aur Kidney diseases ko theek kar dete hain.
cards.myth: Magnetic chappal ke magnets khoon mein maujood Iron ko kheench kar poore sharir ka blood circulation tezi se badha dete hain.
cards.reality: Khoon ke Hemoglobin mein jo Iron hota hai wo protein ke andar band hokar non-ferromagnetic (chumbak se na chipakne wala!) hota hai—warna MRI machine mein jaate hi har insaan ka khoon phat jaata!

cards.title: ₹1.5 Lakh ki 'Alkaline Water Ionizer Machine': Pet ke pH 2 Acid mein 1 Second mein Neutralize!
cards.hook: MLM agents aur celebs ₹80,000 se ₹3 Lakh ki 'Alkaline Kangen Water Machine' bechte hain—daawa hota hai ki 'pH 9.5 paani peene se Cancer aur Diabetes nahi hota aur khoon alkaline ho jaata hai!' Asli chemistry kya hai?
cards.illusion: pH 9.5 Alkaline paani peene se aapke khoon ka pH badh jaata hai aur cancer cells acidic environment na milne se mar jaate hain.
cards.myth: Alkaline water peene se sharir aur khoon acidic se alkaline ban jaata hai jisse koi bimari nahi lagti.
cards.reality: Aapke lungs (saans) aur kidneys har second khoon ka pH **7.35–7.45** par lock rakhte hain—koi bhi paani ya khana aapke khoon ka pH nahi badal sakta (aur agar badal gaya to wo medical emergency hoti hai)!

cards.title: Raat ko Talwe par Chipkane wale 'Toxin Detox Foot Patches' Subah Kaale Kyun Hote Hain?
cards.hook: Online ₹299 mein bikne wale 'Bamboo Vinegar Foot Detox Patches' raat ko safed chipkao to subah kaale chipchipe nikalte hain! Ads kehte hain 'Ye aapke sharir ke saare zehrile toxins hain!' Iske piche ka science trick kya hai?
cards.illusion: Raat bhar pairon ke talwe par safed patch chipkane se subah jo kaali chipchipi gandagi nikalti hai wo sharir ke heavy metals aur toxins hain.
cards.myth: Lagatar 15 din foot detox patches lagane se patch dheere-dheere safed nikalne lagta hai kyunki saare toxins khatam ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Jab tak aapke pairon mein paseena aata rahega, patch hamesha kaala hi hoga—sirf jab sardi mein pair bilkul sookhe hon to kam paseene ki wajah se halka bhoora rehta hai!

cards.title: 'Ear Candling' (Kaan mein Jalte Mom ke Cone) se Mail Nikalne ka Dhokha: Sirf Candle ka Apna Mom!
cards.hook: Spas aur social media videos par kaan mein ek khokhla mom ka cone lagakar upar se aag jalate hain—aur 10 minute baad cone kaat kar dikhate hain ki 'Dekho kitna peela mail nikal aaya!' Asliyat kya hai?
cards.illusion: Jalte hue Ear Candle mein vacuum banta hai jo kaan ke andar se saara purana mail aur toxins kheench kar bahar nikaal leta hai.
cards.myth: Ear candle ke baad cone kholne par jo peela-bhoora padarth dikhta hai wo kaan se kheencha gaya mail aur fungus hota hai.
cards.reality: Lab tests (jaise *Laryngoscope* study) mein prove hua hai ki wo 100% candle ka khud ka pighla mom aur jala kapda hota hai—kaan mein koi vacuum banta hi nahi!

cards.title: Barber/Quack se 'Gardan Chatkhwana (Neck Cracking)': Vertebral Artery Stroke ka Khatra!
cards.hook: Haircut ke baad barber ya viral 'Bone-Setter' reels mein log gardan ko tez jhatke se mod kar 'KADAAAK!' aawaz nikalwate hain—par Neurologists jhatke se gardan chatkhwane ko Stroke ka karan kyun maante hain?
cards.illusion: Salon ya bone-setter se gardan ko tez jhatke se chatkhwane par nas khul jaati hai aur har tarah ka gardan dard 100% safe tarike se theek ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak gardan ya kamar mein zor se 'Kadaaak!' ki aawaz na aaye, tab tak atak hui haddi ya nas apni jagah par nahi baithti.
cards.reality: Wo 'kuchh/kadaaak' aawaz haddi baithne ki nahi, balki joint ke fluid mein **Nitrogen/CO2 gas ke bulbulon ke phatne (Cavitation)** ki aawaz hoti hai—iska haddi set hone se koi lena-dena nahi hota!

cards.title: Oximeter par Nail Polish, Mehndi ya Thandi Ungli se Galat Low Oxygen (SpO2) Reading!
cards.hook: Saans ki takleef ya bukhar mein ghar par Pulse Oximeter ungli mein lagate hi SpO2 88% dikhane lagta hai aur poora parivaar ghabra jaata hai—par kya aapke nail polish, thande haath, ya hilne se reading jhoothi gir rahi hai?
cards.illusion: Digital Pulse Oximeter ungli mein lagate hi 2 second mein jo number dikhata hai, wo hamesha 100% accurate oxygen level hota hai.
cards.myth: Oximeter mein SpO2 98% aa raha hai matlab lungs bilkul theek hain, chahe saans lene mein kitni bhi dikkat kyun na ho rahi ho.
cards.reality: Oximeter sirf oxygen saturation batata hai—agar kisi ko tez **Saans Phoolna, Seene mein Dard, ya Asthma/CO2 issue** ho to 96% SpO2 par bhi emergency ho sakti hai! Hamesha patient ki halat pehle dekhein.

cards.title: Ghar par Digital BP Machine se Galat Reading: Pair Latkane, Baat Karne aur Wrong Cuff Size se ±20 mmHg Error!
cards.hook: Ghar par digital BP monitor (Omron/Dr. Morepen etc.) par pehli baar BP 152/96 aata hai aur 2 minute baad 128/82! Log machine ko kharab bol dete hain—par asli galti machine ki hai ya baithne ke tarike aur cuff size ki?
cards.illusion: Digital BP machine kharab hoti hai isliye alag readings aati hain; bas kaise bhi baith kar arm par cuff baandh kar button daba do.
cards.myth: Digital BP machine hamesha galat dikhati hai—sirf purane doctor wale paare (Mercury) wali machine hi sahi hoti hai.
cards.reality: Validated automatic Upper-Arm digital monitors (jaise Omron/validated brands) bilkul accurate hote hain aur duniya bhar ke clinics ab mercury hata kar unhi par shift ho chuke hain—galat reading 90% baar galat posture/cuff se aati hai!

cards.title: Fast Charging (67W/120W) se Phone Battery Jaldi Kharab Kyun Hoti Hai? (Heat & Lithium Plating)
cards.hook: Naya phone 20 minute mein 100% charge ho jaata hai—par 1 saal mein hi battery 4 ghante bhi nahi tikti! Kya fast charging zimmedar hai, ya phone ke upar laga mota cover?
cards.illusion: Fast charger phone ki battery ko seedhe phula deta hai, ya fir 'company ka original charger hai to chahe jitni garmi ho battery par 0% asar padega'.
cards.myth: Fast charger use karne se 6 mahine mein hi battery phool kar phat jaati hai.
cards.reality: Original certified fast charger heat control karta hai—battery tabhi kharab hoti hai jab fast charging ke sath high heat (dhoop, cover, gaming) jud jaaye.

cards.title: Phone ko 0% se 100% Charge Karna vs 20%–80% Rule: Rubber Band ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Log aadat se phone ko 1% par laakar 100% full charge karte hain—par battery scientists kehte hain 20% se 80% ke beech rakhne se battery ki umar 2 guna badh jaati hai!
cards.illusion: Har baar phone ko poora 0% khatam karke 100% full charge karne se hi battery ki memory theek rehti hai.
cards.myth: Din mein 2-3 baar thoda-thoda charge karne se battery kharab ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Lithium-ion batteries chhote-chhote partial charges (40%→75%) mein sabse khush aur lambi chalti hain—0% se 100% cycle unhe zyada thakata hai.

cards.title: Raat Bhar Phone Charge pe Lagana: Overcharge Hota Hai ya Takiye ke Niche Aag ka Khatra?
cards.hook: Raat ko 11 baje phone charge par laga kar subah 7 baje nikalne se kya battery phat jaati hai? Ya asli khatra charger aur takiye (pillow) ki garmi se hota hai?
cards.illusion: Raat bhar plug mein lage rehne se phone 100% ke baad bhi bijli bharta rehta hai aur battery burst ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: 100% ke baad 1 ghanta bhi charger laga raha to phone overcharge hokar blast ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Original phones 100% par current cut kar dete hain; blast sirf damaged battery, saste duplicate charger ya bistar ke neeche heat trap hone se hota hai.

cards.title: Geela Phone Chawal mein Daalne (Rice Trick) ka Khatarnak Myth: Sukhta Hai ya Board Sadta Hai?
cards.hook: Phone paani mein girte hi sabse pehle hum usse chawal ke dabbe mein daba dete hain—par smartphone/OS maker aur electronics engineers ab saaf mana karte hain ki 'Chawal mein mat daalo'! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Sukha chawal phone ke andar ka saara paani kheench kar phone ko bilkul bacha leta hai.
cards.myth: Geela phone chawal mein rakhne aur hair dryer se sukhane se 1 ghante mein theek ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Hair dryer phone ke andar ke glue aur rubber seals ko pighla kar paani ko aur andar dhakel deta hai, aur chawal ki starch dhool ports ko jam kar deti hai.

cards.title: Phone mein 'Clear RAM / Recent Apps' Baar-Baar Band Karna: Battery Bachti Hai ya Zyada Kharch Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Har 10 minute mein phone ka square button dabakar saari apps swipe-up karke band karna hamari aadat ban gayi hai—par Android aur smartphone engineers kehte hain isse phone SLOW aur battery ZYADA kharch hoti hai!
cards.illusion: Background mein Messaging App, video platforms khule rehne se wo chupchap battery aur internet khaate rehte hain, isliye unhe baar-baar band karna zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Phone ki RAM jitni zyada khali hogi, phone utna hi tez chalega aur battery bachegi.
cards.reality: Smartphone mein 'Free RAM is wasted RAM' niyam chalta hai—apps RAM mein freeze rehne par battery nahi khatin, balki baar-baar reload karne se battery zyada lagti hai.

cards.title: AC ka '1.5 Ton' Kya Hota Hai? Wajan Nahi, Barf Pighlane ki Garmi ka Vigyan!
cards.hook: 1.5 Ton AC ka wajan toh sirf 35-40 kilo hota hai, fir usse '1.5 Ton (1500 Kilo)' kyun kehte hain? Is mein barf ki silli ka kaun sa purana science chhupa hai?
cards.illusion: Shayad AC ke compressor ka wajan 1.5 ton hota hoga, ya wo 1.5 ton hawa phenkta hoga.
cards.myth: Split AC bahar ki taazi hawa kheench kar kamre mein thanda karke bhejta hai.
cards.reality: Split AC kamre ke ANDAR ki hi hawa ko baar-baar ghumakar thanda karta hai (bahar se 0% hawa aati hai)—isliye thodi der khidki khol kar fresh air aane dena zaroori hai!

cards.title: AC ko 16°C pe Chalane se Kamra Jaldi Thanda Nahi Hota! 24°C Rule aur Bijli Bill ka Ganit
cards.hook: Garmi se aate hi sab log AC ka remote dabakar '16°C' kar dete hain—par AC ki physics kehti hai 16°C par bhi hawa utni hi speed se thandi aayegi jitni 24°C par, bas bill double aayega!
cards.illusion: AC ko 16°C par set karne se uske andar se aur zyada barf jaisi thandi hawa niklegi aur kamra jaldi thanda hoga.
cards.myth: 16°C par set karne se kamra 5 minute mein barf jaisa jaldi thanda ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Cooling speed AC ke Tonnage par depend karti hai, remote ke temperature number par nahi—24°C aur 16°C dono kamre ko shuru mein ek hi speed se thanda karte hain.

cards.title: Inverter AC vs Normal AC: Bijli Kab Bachti Hai aur Kab Inverter AC bhi Full Bill Lata Hai?
cards.hook: ₹10,000 mehenga Inverter AC lagwaya ki bijli bill aadha aayega—par bill fir bhi utna hi aaya! Inverter AC ka compressor kaise kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Inverter AC andar se battery/inverter par chalta hai (bijli jaane par bhi chalega!) aur har haal mein 50% bijli bachata hai.
cards.myth: Inverter AC ghar ke aam inverter/battery par chal jaata hai.
cards.reality: Inverter AC ko chalne ke liye wahi 220V main bijli chahiye—'Inverter' sirf compressor ki motor speed control karne ki technology ka naam hai.

cards.title: Purana Ceiling Fan Dheema Kyun Chalne Lagta Hai? ₹40 ke Capacitor ka Simple Vigyan
cards.hook: 5 saal purana pankha 5 number par bhi 1 number jitni hawa de raha hai—log poora ₹2,500 ka naya pankha kharid lete hain, jabki andar sirf ₹40 ka 'Condenser' sukha hota hai!
cards.illusion: Pankhe ki motor jal gayi ya purani ho gayi hai, isliye ab pankha kabhi tez nahi chalega.
cards.myth: Bada 3.15 µF ya 4 µF ka capacitor lagane se pankha hamesha double tez chalta hai.
cards.reality: Extra bada capacitor motor ko garam karke kuch hafton mein uski copper winding jala deta hai!

cards.title: Induction Chulha Sirf Lohe/Steel par Hi Kyun Chalta Hai, Aluminium/Copper par Nahi? (Eddy Currents)
cards.hook: Induction cooktop par haath rakhne par chulha thanda lagta hai par uspar rakha steel ka patila 10 second mein garam ho jaata hai—aakhir garmi aati kahan se hai?
cards.illusion: Induction chulhe ke sheeshe ke neeche koi invisible heater coil garam hoti hai jo bartan ko garam karti hai.
cards.myth: Induction mein khana pakane se khane mein bijli ka current ya radiation aa jaati hai.
cards.reality: Induction mein magnetic field sirf bartan ke tale ke andar ~1-2 cm tak hi kaam karta hai aur bartan uthate hi khatam ho jaata hai—khane mein koi current ya radiation nahi aati.

cards.title: Fridge, TV aur AC ke liye Stabilizer Kab Zaroori Hai aur Kab Paisa Barbaadi?
cards.hook: Naye fridge par bade aksharon mein 'Stabilizer-Free Operation' likha hota hai—fir bhi dukandar ₹3,000 ka stabilizer chipka dete hain! Sachmuch kab lagwana chahiye?
cards.illusion: Har mehange appliance (Fridge, TV, Washing Machine) ke sath alag se Stabilizer lagwana zaroori hai, warna machine jal jayegi.
cards.myth: Bina stabilizer ke LED TV ya Fridge lagate hi pehle din kharab ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Modern TVs (100V–240V SMPS) aur Stabilizer-free fridges ke andar hi wide-voltage circuit hota hai—sirf heavy fluctuation (300V+ ya <130V) mein stabilizer ki zaroorat padti hai.

cards.title: Geyser ko 24 Ghante ON Rakhna vs Nahane se 15 Min Pehle ON Karna: Standby Heat Loss ka Sach
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki geyser mein auto-cut hota hai isliye 24 ghante switch ON rakhne se extra bijli nahi lagti—par raat bhar geyser garm paani ko garam rakhne mein kitni bijli jala deta hai?
cards.illusion: Geyser ka thermostat ek baar paani garam karke bijli kaat deta hai, isliye use 24 ghante ON rakhne mein koi extra bill nahi aata.
cards.myth: Geyser ko baar-baar ON/OFF karne mein zyada bijli lagti hai, 24 ghante ON rakhne mein kam.
cards.reality: Thermodynamics ka pakka niyam hai: garam cheez rakhne se lagatar heat loss hota hai—sirf nahane se 15 min pehle ON karna hamesha kam bijli khata hai!

cards.title: Fridge ki Rubber Patti (Gasket) Dheeli Hone se Bijli Bill 30% Kyun Badhta Hai? ₹10 Note Test
cards.hook: Fridge din bhar chalta rehta hai, freezer mein moti barf jamti hai aur bijli bill badh gaya hai—sirf ek ₹10 ka note darwaze mein dabakar 5 second mein wajah pakad sakti hain!
cards.illusion: Fridge ka darwaza band dikh raha hai aur andar light band ho jaati hai, to thandak bahar nahi nikal rahi.
cards.myth: Fridge mein jitni zyada barf jamegi, fridge utna hi zyada thanda karega.
cards.reality: Freezer mein moti barf ek 'Kambal' (Insulator) ki tarah thandak ko andar hi rok leti hai—jisse fridge niche thanda nahi kar paata aur bijli double khata hai!

cards.title: Washing Machine mein Zyada Surf (Detergent) Daalne se Kapde Gande Kyun Rehte Hain?
cards.hook: Bahut maile kapdon ke liye log 2 scoop surf bhar kar daal dete hain—par nikalne par kapdon par safed daag aur ajeeb chipchipahat reh jaati hai! Kyun?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada detergent aur jhaag hoga, kapde utne hi zyada chamakdaar aur saaf dhulenge.
cards.myth: Jab tak machine mein khoob jhaag na dikhe, kapde saaf nahi hote.
cards.reality: High-efficiency washing machines low-foam science par chalti hain—zyada jhaag kapdon ko ragadne se rokta hai aur surf/mail kapde par wapas chipka deta hai.

cards.title: Wi-Fi Router Diwar ke Kone / Almirah mein Rakhne se Speed Slow Kyun? (2.4 GHz vs 5 GHz)
cards.hook: 100 Mbps ka fiber internet lagwaya, par bedroom mein jaate hi video buffer hone lagta hai—router ko kahan rakhna chahiye aur 2.4G vs 5G mein kya farq hai?
cards.illusion: Router toh chhota sa box hai—usko TV ke piche ya almirah ke andar chhupa kar rakhne se bhi poore ghar mein barabar speed aayegi.
cards.myth: Router ke antennas ko alag-alag tedha modne ya upar aluminium foil lagane se padosiyon tak full speed aati hai.
cards.reality: Router ki wave antenna ke 90-degree (sideways) failti hai—vertical antenna poore floor par barabar signal bhejta hai (ek antenna horizontal rakh sakte hain agar 2-manzila ghar ho).

cards.title: Mobile Tower aur 5G Radiation ka Sach: Kya Tower se Cancer Hota Hai ya Phone ka SAR Value Asli Hai?
cards.hook: Chhat par mobile tower lagte hi mohalle mein dar fail jaata hai ki '5G radiation se brain tumour aur chidiya mar jayengi'—par WHO aur Physics ispar kya kehti hai?
cards.illusion: 5G aur mobile towers se X-ray aur nuclear bomb jaisi khatarnak radiation nikalti hai jo sharir ka DNA tod deti hai.
cards.myth: 5G waves hawa mein chidiyon ko maar deti hain aur COVID/brain tumour failati hain.
cards.reality: WHO aur ICNIRP ke mutabik 5G non-ionizing radio waves hain (visible light se bhi kam energy wali)—unmein DNA todne ki shamta nahi hoti.

cards.title: Browser ka 'Incognito Mode' (Private Mode) Sab Kuch Nahi Chhupata! Asli Privacy ka Sach
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki Web Browser mein black 'Incognito' tab kholne se wo internet par bilkul gayab (invisible) ho jaate hain—par aapka Wi-Fi, Office aur Telecom company kya-kya dekh sakti hai?
cards.illusion: Incognito mode mein internet chalane se koi bhi—na website, na Wi-Fi malik aur na mobile company—jan sakti hai ki aap kya dekh rahi hain.
cards.myth: Incognito mode on karte hi aap internet par hacker ya ISP se bilkul invisible ho jaate hain.
cards.reality: Incognito sirf aapke device ki browser history aur cookies save hone se rokta hai—aapke ISP, Wi-Fi admin aur websites ko aapki activity ab bhi dikhti hai.

cards.title: Free Public Wi-Fi (Station, Cafe, Airport) par UPI aur NetBanking Kyun Khatarnak Hai?
cards.hook: Railway station ya mall mein 'Free_Airport_WiFi' milte hi log connect karke turant UPI/Bank app khol lete hain—par hacker usi Wi-Fi mein 'Evil Twin' jaal kaise bichhate hain?
cards.illusion: Free Wi-Fi toh bas free internet de raha hai, mere phone mein password laga hai to koi mera data kaise dekh sakta hai?
cards.myth: Jab tak Wi-Fi mein password hai (jaise cafe wale board pe likha hai), wo network 100% safe hai.
cards.reality: Jis Wi-Fi ka password ek board par sabke liye likha hai, uspar baitha koi bhi anjaan vyakti usi network par baaki devices ko target kar sakta hai.

cards.title: Public USB Charging Port (Airport / Train / Mall) se Phone Data Chori: 'Juice Jacking' Kaise Hoti Hai?
cards.hook: Airport ya mall ki deewar par lage USB port mein apna data cable lagakar phone charge karne par kya chupke se aapka phone hack ya photos copy ho sakti hain?
cards.illusion: USB cable deewar mein lagane se toh sirf bijli aati hai—photos aur data sirf laptop mein lagane se jaata hai.
cards.myth: USB port sirf current deta hai, cable se bina app ke kuch nahi ho sakta.
cards.reality: USB cable mein power aur data dono lines ek sath hoti hain—isliye RBI ne bhi public USB ports par savdhani ki advisory jaari ki hai.

cards.title: UPI Fraud ka #1 Niyam: Paise LENE (Receive) ke Liye Kabhi PIN ya QR Scan Nahi Karna Padta!
cards.hook: OLX par purana sofa bechte waqt kharidar ne ₹5,000 bhejne ke liye ek QR code bheja aur kaha 'Scan karke UPI PIN daalo, paise aapke khate mein aa jayenge'—ye kaise kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Jaise paise nikalne ke liye PIN daalna padta hai, shayad bade amount ya OLX payment lene ke liye bhi QR scan kar ke PIN confirm karna padta hoga.
cards.myth: Bade amount ya business account se payment receive karne ke liye PIN daal kar accept karna padta hai.
cards.reality: 100% Jhooth! Chahe ₹1 aaye ya ₹1,00,000—paise receive karne ke liye kabhi PIN nahi dalta; PIN dalte hi paise aapke account se hi jaate hain!

cards.title: Apps ke 'Dark Patterns': ₹1 Free Trial bolkar Har Mahine ₹499 Auto-Debit Kaise Kat Jaata Hai?
cards.hook: Kisi app ne ₹2 ya '7-Day Free Trial' maanga aur aapne UPI PIN daal diya—ab har mahine bina poochhe account se ₹500 kat raha hai aur Cancel button kahin mil hi nahi raha!
cards.illusion: Maine toh sirf ₹2 ka trial liya tha, meri permission ke bina app har mahine ₹500 kaise kaat sakti hai?
cards.myth: Phone se app uninstall kar dene se uska ₹499 monthly subscription apne aap band ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: BILKUL NAHI! App uninstall karne se AutoPay nahi rukta—usse Search/Platform Play Store Subscriptions ya UPI AutoPay / Bank Mandate mein jaakar band karna zaroori hota hai!

cards.title: AI Voice Cloning aur 'Digital Arrest' Scam: Apno ki Aawaz mein Nakli Call Kaise Pakdein?
cards.hook: Aapke bete ya bhai ki bilkul asli aawaz mein call aaya—'Papa accident ho gaya hai, turant ₹30,000 bhejo!' Ya police ki video call par 'Digital Arrest'—is AI scam ka vigyan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Phone par mere apne bete/dost ki bilkul wahi aawaz aur bolne ka tarika aa raha hai, isliye call nakli ho hi nahi sakta.
cards.myth: Police ya CBI ab Messaging App/Skype par hi online 'Digital Arrest' karke case nipatati hai.
cards.reality: PM aur MHA / I4C ne baar-baar saaf kiya hai ki Bharat ke kanoon mein 'Digital Arrest' jaisa kuch hai hi nahi—ye 100% cyber fraud hai!

cards.title: Bina OTP Bataye Khata Khali? '*401# Call Forwarding' aur SIM Swap Fraud ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Delivery boy ne kaha 'Parcel cancel karne ke liye *401* ke baad mera number dial kar do'—aur agle hi pal aapke saare bank OTPs thag ke phone par jaane lage! Ye kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Maine toh koi OTP ya bank password kisi ko bataya hi nahi, sirf ek chhota sa number dial kiya tha—mere bank se paise kaise kat sakte hain?
cards.myth: Jab tak main phone par aaya 6-digit OTP munh se na bolun, mera Messaging App ya Bank koi nahi khol sakta.
cards.reality: Agar aapne galti se Call Forwarding (*401# / **21*) chalu kar di hai, to OTP call seedhe thag ke phone par jaati hai aur bina aapke bataye wo account khol sakta hai!

cards.title: Curved Phone par 'UV Glue' Screen Guard Lagana: Speaker Grill aur Power Button Jam Kyun Hote Hain?
cards.hook: Mehenge curved-screen phone par dukandar liquid glue daal kar UV light se tempered glass chipkata hai—par 2 din baad phone ka speaker phat jaata hai ya button chipak jaata hai!
cards.illusion: UV liquid glass har phone ki screen ke liye sabse mazboot aur bilkul invisible suraksha hai.
cards.myth: UV light wala liquid glass har tarah ke phone ke liye normal tempered glass se zyada safe hota hai.
cards.reality: Flat screens ke liye normal dry tempered glass 100% safe hai—UV liquid glue sirf curved screens ki majboori hai aur ports mein jaane par phone kharab kar sakta hai.

cards.title: Camera mein '108 MP / 200 MP' Scam vs Sensor Size: ₹15,000 ka 108MP Phone ₹70,000 ke 12MP smartphone se Kamzor Kyun?
cards.hook: Dukaan par '108 Megapixel Camera' likha dekhkar sasta phone kharid liya, par raat mein photo bilkul dhundhli aati hai—jabki 12MP ya 48MP wala phone itni shandar photo kaise kheencha hai?
cards.illusion: Jitne zyada Megapixels (108MP > 50MP > 12MP) honge, photo utni hi zyada saaf aur DSLR jaisi aayegi.
cards.myth: 200MP camera wale phone mein 50MP ya 12MP phone se 4 guna zyada saaf photo aati hai.
cards.reality: Photo ki clarity Megapixels se nahi, balki Sensor Size, Lens Quality, OIS aur Image Processing se aati hai.

cards.title: Phone mein 'Dark Mode' Lagane se Battery Kab Bachti Hai aur Kab 0% Farq Padta Hai? (AMOLED vs LCD)
cards.hook: Battery bachane ke liye sab phone mein Dark Mode laga lete hain—par agar aapke phone ki screen LCD hai, to Dark Mode 0% battery bachata hai! Kaise?
cards.illusion: Har phone aur laptop par Dark Mode lagane se battery 30% zyada chalti hai.
cards.myth: Har phone aur TV mein Dark Mode lagane se 50% battery bach jaati hai.
cards.reality: LCD screens mein backlight poori jalti rehti hai isliye Dark Mode battery nahi bachata; AMOLED screens mein hi—aur wo bhi high brightness par—badi bachat hoti hai.

cards.title: Earphones mein Tez Aawaz: Kaan ke Parde Nahi, Andar ke 'Baal' (Hair Cells) Hamesha ke Liye Mar Jaate Hain!
cards.hook: In-ear earphones lagakar full volume par gaane ya reels dekhne se kaan ka parda nahi phat-ta—balki kaan ke andar lage microscopic 'Baal' toot jaate hain jo ZINDAGI BHAR dobara nahi ugte!
cards.illusion: Jab tak kaan mein dard nahi ho raha aur parda theek hai, full volume par earphone sunne se kuch nahi hota.
cards.myth: Jab tak kaan mein dard na ho, full volume sunne se kaan ko koi nuksan nahi hota.
cards.reality: Noise-induced hearing loss bilkul dard-rahit (painless) aur dheere-dheere hota hai—jab tak pata chalta hai tab tak kaan ke hair cells hamesha ke liye mar chuke hote hain!

cards.title: Garmi mein Car/Bike ke Tyre mein Hawa Kam Bharwani Chahiye ya Nahi? (Cold Tyre Pressure Science)
cards.hook: May-June ki 45°C garmi mein log tyre phatne ke dar se 32 PSI ki jagah 26 PSI kam hawa bharwa lete hain—par vigyan kehta hai KAM hawa wala tyre zyada garam hokar jaldi phat-ta hai!
cards.illusion: Garmi mein hawa phailti hai isliye highway par tyre phatne se bachane ke liye pehle se kam hawa rakhni chahiye.
cards.myth: May-June ki garmi mein tyre phatne se bachane ke liye normal se 4-5 PSI kam hawa rakhni chahiye.
cards.reality: Kam hawa se tyre sidewall zyada flex hokar over-heat hoti hai, jo garmi mein tyre phatne ka #1 kaaran hai—hamesha recommended Cold PSI hi rakhein.

cards.title: Car AC Chalane par Kitna Petrol Lagta Hai vs Highway par Sheeshe Kholna? (Aerodynamic Drag)
cards.hook: Petrol bachane ke liye log highway par 90 ki speed mein AC band karke charon sheeshe khol lete hain—par physics kehti hai isse AC se ZYADA petrol kharch hota hai!
cards.illusion: AC band karke sheeshe khol kar chalane se har speed par petrol bachta hai.
cards.myth: Car ka AC chalane se mileage hamesha aadha (50% kam) ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Modern car ACs normal driving mein sirf ~5%–10% fuel lete hain—aur 70+ km/h highway par sheeshe kholna AC se zyada petrol khata hai.

cards.title: LED Bulb Kharidte Waqt 'Watt' Nahi 'Lumens' Dekhein: 9W Bulb Zyada Roshni Kaise De Sakta Hai?
cards.hook: 12W ka sasta local LED bulb 9W branded bulb se kam roshni deta hai aur 6 mahine mein blinking karne lagta hai—bulb ke dabbe par kaun sa number dekhna zaroori hai?
cards.illusion: Bulb ke dabbe par jitne zyada 'Watt' likhe honge, kamre mein utni hi zyada roshni hogi.
cards.myth: Neeli-safed 6500K tubelight sabse healthy hoti hai aur peeli light aankhein kharab karti hai.
cards.reality: Raat ko bedroom mein tez neeli-safed light sleep hormone (Melatonin) ko rok deti hai—padhai/rasoi mein 6500K aur raat ke aaram wale kamre mein 3000K Warm White zyada healthy hai.

cards.title: Ghar ke Inverter Battery mein RO ya Nal ka Paani Daalna vs Distilled Water: Plates Galne ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Inverter ki battery ka paani kam dikhte hi log ₹50 bachane ke liye ghar ke RO ya nal ka paani daal dete hain—par kuch mahine baad ₹15,000 ki battery backup dena kyun band kar deti hai?
cards.illusion: RO ka paani toh bilkul shuddh aur saaf hota hai, to wo battery ke dabbe mein daalne mein bhi bilkul distilled water jaisa hi hai.
cards.myth: RO ka meetha paani aur AC ke drain pipe ka paani battery ke liye 100% distilled water ke barabar hota hai.
cards.reality: RO water mein bhi 30–80 ppm salts hote hain jo plates par jamte hain, aur AC ke coil/pipe se dust aur metal particles aa sakte hain—₹40 ki sealed distilled water bottle sabse safe hai.

cards.title: 10,000 mAh ka Power Bank 5,000 mAh ke Phone ko 2 Baar Charge Kyun Nahi Karta? (Voltage Math)
cards.hook: 10,000 mAh power bank kharida tha ki 5,000 mAh phone 2 baar 100% charge hoga—par 1.3 baar mein hi power bank khali ho jaata hai! Kya company ne dhokha diya?
cards.illusion: 10,000 mAh ÷ 5,000 mAh = 2 poori charging milni hi chahiye, agar kam mili to power bank nakli hai.
cards.myth: 10,000 mAh power bank agar 5,000 mAh ke phone ko poori 2 baar charge na kare to wo kharab hai.
cards.reality: 3.7V se 5V step-up aur heat loss ki wajah se 60%–65% real output (1.2–1.3 full charges) hi physics ke hisab se sahi aur normal hai.

cards.title: 3-Pin Plug ka Upar Wala Pin Lamba aur Mota Kyun Hota Hai? Earthing Wire Jaan Kaise Bachata Hai?
cards.hook: Geyser, Iron (Press), Fridge aur Mixer ke 3-pin plug mein upar wala teesra pin sabse lamba aur mota hota hai—aur log 2-pin socket mein ghusane ke liye usi pin ko tod dete hain ya sasta adapter laga dete hain!
cards.illusion: Teesra mota pin toh bas plug ko mazbooti se pakadne ke liye hota hai—2-pin wale adapter se chalane par bhi machine bilkul waise hi chalti hai.
cards.myth: Ghar mein MCB lagi hai to bijli ka jhatka lagne par MCB apne aap gir kar insaan ko bacha legi.
cards.reality: MCB sirf taaron ko aag/short-circuit se bachati hai—insaan ko current lagne (30mA leakage) se sirf **RCCB / ELCB** aur **Earthing** hi bachati hai!

cards.title: Raat mein White LED Headlight aur High Beam ka Vigyan: Samne Wale ki Aankh Andhi Kyun Hoti Hai aur Kohre mein Peeli Light Behtar Kyun?
cards.hook: Raat ki sadak par samne se aati SUV/bike ki tez safed LED high-beam aankhon ko 3 second ke liye andha kar deti hai—aur wahi tez white LED kohre (fog) mein bekaar kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Jitni zyada safed aur tez aftermarket LED headlight lagwayenge, raat aur kohre mein sadak utni hi saaf dikhegi.
cards.myth: 6000K–8000K ice-white LED lights sabse zyada door tak aur kohre mein best dikhati hain.
cards.reality: High Kelvin white/blue LED baarish, geeli kaali sadak aur kohre mein sabse zyada scatter hokar visibility kam kar deti hai—4300K (halka peela-safed) ya 3000K peela best hota hai.

cards.title: Electric Scooter / EV Battery Safety: Dhoop mein Charge aur Baarish ke Paani ka Asli Rule
cards.hook: Electric scooter chalate hi dhoop se aakar turant charger laga diya ya ghutno tak paani mein chala liya—EV batteries mein aag lagne aur range girne ki asli wajah kya hoti hai?
cards.illusion: EV scooter toh paani aur garmi dono ke liye bana hai, isliye chalte hi garam battery ko turant charge kar sakte hain.
cards.myth: Har electric scooter kabhi bhi garam ho kar apne aap phat sakta hai.
cards.reality: Naye AIS-156 Phase-2 certified batteries mein temperature sensors, thermal fuses aur strong BMS safety hoti hai—sahi charging aur original charger se ye bahut safe hain.

cards.title: Air Purifier mein Asli HEPA Filter vs 'Ionizer / Ozone': AQI 500 mein Kamra Saaf Kaise Hota Hai?
cards.hook: ₹12,000 ka Air Purifier vs ₹2,000 wala 'Plug-in Car/Room Ionizer'—kya bina filter wala sasta ionizer hawa saaf karta hai ya kamre mein Ozone gas chhod kar phephde jalata hai?
cards.illusion: Bina filter wale chhote plug-in ionizers aur UV purifiers bina kharch ke hawa ki saari dhool aur pollution khatam kar dete hain.
cards.myth: Ghar ke andar 2-4 Snake Plant ya Money Plant rakhne se AQI 400 ka smog saaf ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: NASA ke purane plant tests band lab chambers mein the—ek normal ghar ke kamre mein hawa saaf karne ke liye lagbhag 500–1,000 paudhe lagane padenge! Plants khubsurat hain, par winter smog mein sirf True HEPA purifier hi kaam karta hai.

cards.title: Ghar ka Wi-Fi CCTV Camera aur Smart TV Mic: Default Password aur Bedroom Camera Risk
cards.hook: ₹1,500 ka Wi-Fi CCTV camera lagwaya aur phone par live video dekh kar khush ho gaye—par agar default password nahi badla, to koi anjaan insaan aapke ghar ka live video kaise dekh sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Mera CCTV ghar ke Wi-Fi par laga hai aur app par dikh raha hai, isliye koi bahar wala isse dekh hi nahi sakta.
cards.myth: Jab tak main kisi ko apna Wi-Fi password na doon, koi internet se mera CCTV nahi dekh sakta.
cards.reality: Cloud-connected Wi-Fi cameras internet server se judte hain—agar camera app ka password weak/default hai ya 2FA off hai, to bahar se login kiya ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Messaging App par 'Shadi ka Card.apk' ya 'Traffic Challan.apk': PDF dikhne Wali File se Phone Hack Kaise Hota Hai?
cards.hook: Anjaan number se Messaging App par message aaya—'Aapki gaadi ka ₹2,000 Challan kata hai, photo dekhein' ya 'Shadi ka Card'—par wo PDF nahi `.apk` file thi! Ek click mein bank account kaise khali hota hai?
cards.illusion: Messaging App par kisi photo ya shadi ke card jaisi file ko sirf open karke dekhne se phone hack thodi hota hai.
cards.myth: Jaankar dost ke number se Messaging App par file aayi hai to wo bilkul safe hogi.
cards.reality: Malware pehle aapke dost ka Messaging App hack kar ke uske naam se aapke paas wahi `.apk` virus bhejta hai—file ka extension check karna zaroori hai!

cards.title: Search/Platform Search aur Maps par 'Fake Customer Care Number' Scam: Bank/Gas Agency ka Number Kaise Badal Dete Hain?
cards.hook: Bank, Courier, Gas Agency ya Hotel ka customer care number dhoondhne ke liye Search engine par search kiya—par pehla number thag ka nikla aur usne 'Refund' ke bahane ₹25,000 uda liye! Search engine par nakli number kaise aata hai?
cards.illusion: Search/Platform Search aur Online Maps sabse upar jo phone number dikh raha hai, wo us company ka 100% asli official number hota hai.
cards.myth: Search/Platform ke top search result ya 'Sponsored' ad mein aane wala customer care number Search/Platform verify karke hi dalta hai.
cards.reality: Online Maps edits aur search ads ka misuse kar ke thag nakli numbers top par dikha dete hain—isliye number hamesha official app ya card se hi lein.

cards.title: Instant '5-Min Loan Apps' ka Jaal: Sirf ₹3,000 ke Badle Poori Gallery aur Contacts Kaise Chori Hote Hain?
cards.hook: Emergency mein ek anjaan mobile app se 5 minute mein ₹3,000 loan liya—par 7 din mein hi wo ₹6,000 maangne lage aur na dene par saare rishtedaron ko gandi morphed photos bhejne ki dhamki kaise de rahe hain?
cards.illusion: App par aadhar-pan upload kar ke chhota sa loan hi toh liya hai—zyada se zyada late fee lagegi, mere phone ke contacts aur photos unke paas kaise jayenge?
cards.myth: Play Store par milne wali har loan app sarkari/RBI approved aur safe hoti hai.
cards.reality: Kai fake apps chupke se Play Store ya APK links par aa jaati hain—hamesha RBI-registered NBFC naam verify karein aur Contacts/Gallery permission kabhi na dein.

cards.title: Blue-Cut Chashma Pehankar Raat ko Reels Dekhna: Chashma Bacha Lega ya Neend Phir Bhi Kharab Hogi?
cards.hook: ₹1,500 ka 'Blue-Cut Anti-Glare' chashma pehan kar log raat 12 baje tak bistar mein phone chalate hain—par aankhon ke doctors kehte hain chashma aankh bachane se zyada marketing hai, asli dikkat kya hai?
cards.illusion: Blue-cut lenses pehan lene se phone ki screen aankhon ko bilkul thakati nahi aur neend bhi achi aati hai.
cards.myth: Mobile screen ki blue light se aankhon ki roshni hamesha ke liye chali jaati hai, jise sirf blue-cut chashma rok sakta hai.
cards.reality: Dhoop mein phone se 100+ guna zyada blue light hoti hai! Phone se eye strain palak kam jhapkane aur glare se hota hai—jiska ilaaj 20-20-20 rule aur screen breaks hain, chashma nahi.

cards.title: Laptop ko Bistar ya Takiye par Rakhkar Chalana: Fan Jam Hokar Motherboard Jalne ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Raat ko bistar/razai mein godi par laptop rakhkar movie dekhne aur kaam karne se laptop 6 mahine mein slow aur garam hokar band kyun hone lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Laptop ko 'Lap-top' kehte hi isliye hain ki usse godi ya bistar par rakhkar aaram se chalaya jaaye.
cards.myth: Laptop mein fan laga hai to wo bistar ya takiye par bhi apni garmi khud nikal leta hai.
cards.reality: Fan tabhi hawa nikalega jab neeche ke vents se thandi hawa andar jayegi—naram gaddi/takiya vents ko band kar deta hai aur fan mein ruyi bhar deta hai.

cards.title: Chhat par Solar Panel Lagwa Liya par Bijli Kam Kyun Banti Hai? Dhool aur Ek Patte ki Chhaya ka Vigyan
cards.hook: Chhat par 3 kW Solar lagwaya tha ki bill zero aayega—par dhool ki patli parat aur ek cable/ped ki chhaya poore panel ki bijli 30–50% kaise gira deti hai?
cards.illusion: Solar panel lagwa kar bhool jao, baarish mein khud dhul jayega aur thodi si chhaya se sirf 5% farq padta hai.
cards.myth: Dopahar ko chhat par jaakar garm solar panel par paani daalne se panel thanda hokar aur zyada bijli banata hai.
cards.reality: 65°C garam sheeshe par thanda paani daalne se Thermal Shock se sheesha phat/crack sakta hai—safai hamesha subah ya shaam ko thande panel par hi karein!

cards.title: Naya 'Smart Bijli Meter' Lagte hi Bill Zyada Kyun Aata Hai? Tez Chalta Hai ya Purana Meter Dheema Tha?
cards.hook: Ghar mein purana meter hata kar naya Digital Smart Meter lagte hi pehle mahine bijli bill 30% zyada aaya—kya naye smart meters mein gadbad hai ya chhupke se kharch hone wali standby bijli pakdi ja rahi hai?
cards.illusion: Naye Smart Meters jan-boojh kar tez bhaagte hain taaki bijli company zyada bill vasool sake.
cards.myth: Har naya Smart Meter 25-30% zyada units dikhane ke liye program kiya gaya hai.
cards.reality: Meters BIS/CEA Class 1.0 accuracy par test hote hain—bill badhne ki wajah aksar purane slow meter se shift hona, pending arrears, wiring leakage ya sanctioned load exceed hona hota hai (shakk ho to Check Meter lagwa kar verify kar sakte hain).

cards.title: Saste '4K QLED TV' ka Dhokha vs Asli LED/OLED: Set-Top Box par 4K Picture Dhundhli Kyun Dikhti Hai?
cards.hook: ₹18,000 mein '4K QLED Smart TV' kharid liya par ghar par vehicle OEM Play / Dish TV lagate hi chehre dhundhle dikhne lage—TV kharab hai ya DTH signal aur saste panel ka khel?
cards.illusion: Dabbe par '4K QLED' likha hai to sasta TV bhi ₹80,000 wale TV jaisi crystal-clear picture dega aur vehicle OEM Play bhi 4K mein chalega.
cards.myth: Dabbe par '4K QLED' likha hai to wo har normal LED TV se behtar aur saaf hoga.
cards.reality: Bina achchi brightness (Nits), contrast aur upscaling chip ke saste TVs mein 'QLED' sirf ek marketing sticker hota hai.

cards.title: 120Hz Screen vs LTPO Auto-Refresh: Battery Drain aur Aankhon ki Smoothness ka Asli Sach!
cards.hook: Naye phones mein '120Hz Ultra-Smooth Display' bada selling point hai—par 120Hz hamesha ON rakhne par battery 20% jaldi kyun khatam hoti hai aur ₹15,000 vs ₹60,000 phone ke 120Hz mein kya farq hai?
cards.illusion: Har 120Hz phone ek jaisa battery-friendly hota hai aur 120Hz rakhne se battery par koi farq nahi padta.
cards.myth: 120Hz screen ON rakhne se video platforms videos aur OTT/streaming service movies bhi 120fps par chalne lagti hain.
cards.reality: Movies 24fps aur normal videos 30/60fps par shoot hoti hain—120Hz sirf UI scrolling aur compatible games mein dikhta hai!

cards.title: ₹12,000 Phone mein '8GB + 8GB Virtual RAM': Speed Badhti Hai ya Storage Ghis Jaati Hai?
cards.hook: Smartphone ads mein bade aksharon mein '16GB RAM (8GB + 8GB RAM Expansion)' likha hota hai—par kya storage ko RAM banana sachmuch phone ko tezz karta hai ya sirf ek marketing trick hai?
cards.illusion: 8GB + 8GB Virtual RAM on karne se phone bilkul asli 16GB RAM wale flagship phone jitna fast ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: 6GB + 6GB Virtual RAM bilkul asli 12GB RAM ke barabar gaming aur camera speed deta hai.
cards.reality: Storage ki read/write speed asli RAM ke mukable behad slow hoti hai—Virtual RAM sirf background dormant apps rakhne ka jugaad hai, speed aur gaming mein asli RAM ki jagah kabhi nahi le sakti!

cards.title: 5G Network par Phone Garam Hona aur Battery 25% Tez Khatam Hona: NSA 5G vs 4G Auto-Switch!
cards.hook: 5G On karte hi naya phone jeb mein garam hone lagta hai aur shaam tak battery dead ho jaati hai—par jab Wi-Fi par ya 4G par rakho to wahi phone thanda aur 4 ghante zyada chalta hai! Kyun?
cards.illusion: 5G naya network hai isliye wo 4G se kam battery kharch karta hai aur hamesha 5G lock rakhna best hai.
cards.myth: 5G speed fast hai isliye wo files jaldi download kar ke hamesha 4G se kam battery kharch karta hai.
cards.reality: High-frequency 5G bands kam doori tak jaate hain aur NSA dual-radio + weak-signal hunting ki wajah se real-world daily usage mein 5G aksar 15%–30% zyada battery kharch karta hai!

cards.title: 'Battery Health 99% se 95% Gir Gayi' Panic: Lithium Cycle Science & Asli Replace Kab Karein?
cards.hook: smartphone aur naye Android users har hafte Settings mein 'Maximum Battery Capacity %' check kar ke ghabrate rehte hain—par 100% se 90% girna kya kharab battery hai, ya natural chemical aging?
cards.illusion: Agar 6 mahine mein phone ki Battery Health 100% se 94% aa gayi, to battery defective hai aur har hafte % check kar ke phone ko 100% par lock rakhna chahiye.
cards.myth: Phone ko hamesha 40% se 80% ke beech hi rakhne aur kabhi 100% charge na karne se battery kabhi degrade nahi hoti.
cards.reality: 80% limit se aging thodi slow zaroor hoti hai (especially agar phone raat bhar 100% par heat ho), par har battery samay aur temperature ke sath naturally degrade hoti hai—practicality ke liye **Optimized Charging / 80–90% limit** rakhein aur tension mat lein!

cards.title: ₹150 ka Road-Side Local Charger vs Original GaN/PPS Charger: Touch Glitch & IC Damage!
cards.hook: Original charger khone par log station ya roadside dukan se ₹150 wala 'Original Copy Fast Charger' le aate hain—par isse lagate hi phone ki screen apne aap chalne (Ghost Touch) aur charging IC jalne ka khatra kyun?
cards.illusion: Sabhi USB chargers bas 5V bijli dete hain—₹150 wala aur ₹1,500 wala charger bilkul ek hi kaam karte hain.
cards.myth: Train/bus ke bahar ₹150 mein milne wale 'Same Brand Packing' chargers factory surplus original hi hote hain.
cards.reality: Teardown labs mein paya gaya hai ki ₹150 ke copy chargers mein 70% safety components (fuses, capacitors, isolation tape) gayab hote hain—ye counterfeit e-waste aur fire risk hain!

cards.title: Wireless / MagSafe Charging par Phone Zyada Garam Kyun Hota Hai? 30% Energy Loss & Battery Aging!
cards.hook: Table par phone rakh kar charge karne wala 'Wireless Charging / MagSafe Pad' dekhne mein bada cool lagta hai—par ispar phone itna garam kyun hota hai aur battery health jaldi kyun girti hai?
cards.illusion: Wireless charging cable charging se zyada gentle, cool aur battery-friendly hoti hai.
cards.myth: Wireless charging slow hoti hai isliye wo cable fast-charging se hamesha kam garmi paida karti hai.
cards.reality: Slow hone ke bawajood inductive transfer inefficiency ki wajah se wireless charging aksar wired charging se zyada sustained heat phone ke back par banati hai!

cards.title: 'Full 4 Signal Bars' Dikhte Hue bhi Call Drop aur Slow Internet: Signal Bars vs dBm & Tower Congestion!
cards.hook: Phone screen par poore 4/5 Signal Bars dikh rahe hain, phir bhi video buffering rukti nahi aur hello-hello karte hue call cut jaati hai! Kya mobile ke signal bars jhooth bolte hain?
cards.illusion: Phone par full signal bars dikhna matlab network 100% fast aur call-drop-free hona chahiye.
cards.myth: Phone par 4G/5G ke full bars dikh rahe hain phir bhi net slow hai matlab phone ka processor kharab ho gaya hai.
cards.reality: Full bars sirf tower ki physical nazdeeki batate hain—slow speed aksar tower congestion (zyada users) ya low upload signal-to-noise ratio (SINR) se hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Flight Mode On Kar ke Charge Karne se Phone 2x Fast Charge Hota Hai' Myth: 3–5 Min Farq Sach!
cards.hook: Viral tech reels batati hain ki 'Charging karte waqt Airplane Mode ON kar do to phone aadhe time mein 2x tezi se full charge ho jaata hai!' Asli wattage math mein kitna time bachta hai?
cards.illusion: Airplane Mode on karne se phone ki charging speed double (2x) ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Airplane Mode on kar ke charge karne se 60 minute wala phone 30 minute mein full ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Independent stopwatch tests mein Airplane Mode on vs off (dono screen-off mein) sirf **2 se 5 minute** ka farq aata hai—tabhi farq zyada hota hai jab signal bilkul dead zone (0 bars) mein battery pee raha ho!

cards.title: Har 5 Minute mein Apps Swipe-Close Karna: Battery Bachne ke Bajaye Ulta Zyada Kharch Kyun?
cards.hook: Bahut se log din mein 50 baar 'Recent Apps' khol kar Messaging App, Social Media Maps ko upar swipe kar ke band karte hain—par smartphone/OS maker aur Search/Platform ke engineers isse battery aur speed dono ke liye bura kyun batate hain?
cards.illusion: Recent Apps se saari apps ko bar-bar swipe kar ke band karte rehne se RAM khali hoti hai aur battery double chalti hai.
cards.myth: Recent Apps mein 20 apps khuli dikh rahi hain matlab wo sabhi 20 apps peeche lagatar battery aur internet kha rahi hain.
cards.reality: Recent Apps list sirf ek history drawer hai—unmein se 95% apps OS dwara completely freeze/suspend ki jaa chuki hoti hain aur zero CPU leti hain!

cards.title: '100% Free Unlimited VPN' Apps: Aapki Privacy Bachne ke Bajaye Data Selling & Banking Risk!
cards.hook: Blocked sites kholne ya 'Free Wi-Fi suraksha' ke liye log Play Store se 'Super Fast Free VPN' install kar lete hain—par jab aap ₹0 de rahe hain, to wo servers ka laakhon rupaye ka kharch aapke data se kaise nikaalte hain?
cards.illusion: Har Free VPN app aapke internet ko 100% private aur anonymous bana deta hai.
cards.myth: Free VPN chalu karne ke baad police, hackers ya websites kisi bhi tarah aapka kuch bhi track nahi kar saktin.
cards.reality: Browser cookies, Search/Platform/Meta logins, aur phone fingerprinting VPN ke bawajood aapko track karte hain—aur shady free VPN khud hi aapka data log kar ke bech sakta hai!

cards.title: Phone se Chaand ki DSLR-Jaisi Photo: Optical Zoom Physics vs AI Moon Replacement!
cards.hook: ₹25,000–₹1,00,000 ke phones mein 100x Zoom kar ke Chaand (Moon) ki photo kheenchne par achanak craters bilkul saaf dikhne lagte hain—par kya chhota sa phone lens sachmuch 3.84 lakh km door Chaand ke gaddhe dekh raha hai?
cards.illusion: 100x Space Zoom wala smartphone camera bina kisi AI nakal ke optical DSLR ki tarah Chaand ke asli craters capture karta hai.
cards.myth: Smartphone ka 100x Space Zoom ek asli telescope ki tarah Chaand ki satah ko optical magnifier se kheenchta hai.
cards.reality: Smartphone mein max 3x–5x optical zoom hi hota hai; uske aage 30x–100x sirf digital crop + AI texture synthesis hota hai!

cards.title: 'IP68 Waterproof Phone' Swimming Pool aur Baarish mein Le Jaana: Steam, Chlorine & Zero Warranty!
cards.hook: Ads mein phone ko swimming pool mein duba kar video banate dikhate hain—par jab wahi IP68 phone pool ya barish mein kharab ho jaaye, to service center wale 'Liquid Damage — Warranty Void' bol kar ₹20,000 kyun maangte hain?
cards.illusion: IP68 rating ka matlab hai phone 100% Waterproof hai aur usse pool, samundar, aur garam shower mein le jaane par warranty cover rehti hai.
cards.myth: IP68 phone mein agar paani chala jaaye to company free mein warranty mein naya phone ya free repair deti hai.
cards.reality: smartphone/OS maker, smartphone brand, smartphone brand, Search/Platform sabhi ki standard warranty **Liquid/Water Damage ko 100% exclude** karti hai—chahe phone IP68 hi kyun na ho!

cards.title: 'Anti-Spy Privacy Screen Guard' Lagane par Battery Jaldi Khatam Hona aur Aankhon par Zor!
cards.hook: Metro aur office mein bagal wale se screen chhupane ke liye log ₹200 wala kaala 'Privacy Tempered Glass' lagwa lete hain—par isse phone ki brightness half, battery drain aur sar dard kyun badh jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Privacy Screen Guard sirf bagal walon ka view rokta hai, phone chalane wale ke liye screen bilkul normal rehti hai.
cards.myth: Privacy Screen Guard aankhon ko Blue Light aur UV se bachata hai isliye usse aankhon ko aaram milta hai.
cards.reality: Micro-louver plastic stripes screen ko dhundhla aur low-contrast banati hain, jisse aankhein focus karne ke liye aur zyada mehnat karti hain (eye strain badhta hai)!

cards.title: ₹250 ka '1TB Memory Card' aur Fake Class-10 Cards: Phone Slow & Family Photos Corrupt!
cards.hook: Online ya local dukan par ₹250–₹400 mein '1TB / 512GB Ultra High-Speed Memory Card' mil raha hai! Lagane par computer mein '1TB' dikhta bhi hai—par 10GB photos daalte hi saari files gayab aur corrupt kyun ho jaati hain?
cards.illusion: Agar Memory Card ya Pendrive phone/laptop mein insert karne par '512GB / 1TB Free' dikha raha hai, to wo 100% asli storage hai.
cards.myth: Computer 'My Computer / Properties' mein 1,000 GB dikha raha hai matlab us card mein poora 1,000 GB data safe store hoga.
cards.reality: Windows/Phone sirf card ki chip se aayi fake firmware table padhta hai—asli memory sirf tabhi check hoti hai jab poora card write-read test (**H2testw**) pass kare!

cards.title: 'Bluetooth aur Wi-Fi On Chhodne se 30% Battery Khatam Ho Jaati Hai' Myth: BLE 0.5% Truth!
cards.hook: Log har 10 minute mein Bluetooth aur Wi-Fi band karte rehte hain is dar se ki 'Ye dono on rahe to aadhi battery pee jayenge!' Par modern Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) aur Wi-Fi sachmuch kitni battery lete hain?
cards.illusion: Bluetooth aur Wi-Fi icon on rehne se bina kisi device ke jude bhi phone ki 25%–30% battery din bhar mein khatam ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Wi-Fi aur Bluetooth icon upar dikhne ka matlab hai wo poore din 25%–30% battery chuste rehte hain.
cards.reality: Idle Bluetooth (BLE) poore din mein ~1% battery leta hai, aur ghar ke andar Wi-Fi use karne se cellular data ke mukable battery **bachti** hai!

cards.title: OLED Screen par Messaging App/Navigation Keys ke Permanent Daag (Burn-In): Max Brightness & Static UI!
cards.hook: 1–2 saal baad kai OLED/AMOLED phones ki safed screen kholne par upar battery icon ya neeche keyboard/TikTok/Reels ke buttons halka bhoot (ghost image) ki tarah hamesha ke liye chhape dikhne lagte hain! Ye kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Phone ki display par dikhne wale halka chhape hue icons koi software glitch hai jo restart karne se gayab ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: video platforms par '1-Hour Flashing RGB Screen Fixer' video chalane se OLED screen ka burn-in hamesha ke liye mit jaata hai.
cards.reality: Software sirf temporary LCD image-retention mein madad kar sakta hai—asli OLED burn-in dead/aged pixels hote hain jinhe RGB video aur zyada wear kar sakta hai!

cards.title: ₹400 ka 'Anti-Radiation Phone Chip / Sticker': EMF Physics aur Ulta Radiation Badhne ka Sach!
cards.hook: Online aur door-to-door agents ₹400–₹1,200 mein ek chhota golden sticker ('Anti-Radiation Bio-Energetic Chip') bechte hain—daawa hota hai ki 'Isse phone ke peeche chipkane se 99% cancer radiation khatam!' Vigyan kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Phone ke back par chhota sa metal/scalar sticker chipkane se phone ka harmful radiation neutralize hokar zero ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Phone ke piche golden anti-radiation sticker chipkane par Gauss meter / EMF tester mein reading zero ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Salesmen video mein ya to phone ko airplane/idle state mein rakh kar fake meter trick dikhate hain—ek chhota sticker poore phone ke radio transmitter ko zero kar hi nahi sakta (warna phone par call aur internet hi band ho jaata!).

cards.title: Android par '30 Viruses Found! Clean Now' Pop-Ups: Fake Scareware vs Search/Platform Play Protect!
cards.hook: Website kholte hi ya kisi saste app mein achanak alarm bajne lagta hai: 'WARNING! Your Phone Has 29 Viruses — Download Cleaner Now!' Kya aapke phone mein sachmuch 29 virus ghus gaye hain?
cards.illusion: Browser par aane wala laal '30 Viruses Detected' alert aapke phone ki asli security warning hai aur diye gaye Cleaner app se virus saaf ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Android phone mein agar koi alag ₹500 wala Antivirus/Cleaner app na daalein to browser se virus ghus jaata hai.
cards.reality: Search/Platform Play Protect aur Android Sandboxing pehle se built-in hoti hai—sabse bada khatra third-party `.APK` files aur unhi fake 'Cleaner/Antivirus' apps se hi aata hai!

cards.title: 'GB Messaging App / Pink Messaging App' se Deleted Messages Padhna: Account Ban & Banking Spyware!
cards.hook: Blue tick chhupane, 'Delete for Everyone' messages padhne aur theme badalne ke liye log Search/Platform se 'GB Messaging App / FM Messaging App / Pink Messaging App' APK download kar lete hain—par isse poora phone aur bank kaise hack hota hai?
cards.illusion: GB Messaging App sirf official Messaging App ka ek extra-features wala better version hai jise use karne mein koi nuksan nahi.
cards.myth: Mera dost 2 saal se GB Messaging App chala raha hai aur kuch nahi hua matlab ye 100% safe hai.
cards.reality: Silent spyware aur data harvesting dikhai nahi deti jab tak aapka data blackmail/OTP fraud mein use na ho—aur Messaging App ban waves mein har mahine lakhon modded accounts block hote hain!

cards.title: Caller-ID Apps par Aapke Dost ka Ajeeb Naam aur Private Number Kaise Dikh Jaata Hai? Contact Book Upload!
cards.hook: Aapne kabhi Caller-ID Apps download bhi nahi kiya, phir bhi jab aap kisi ko call karte hain to screen par aapka poora naam (ya kisi dost ke phone mein save 'Raju Electrician / Papa' naam) kaise aa jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Caller-ID Apps sirf sarkari SIM company ke database se naam dikhata hai aur mera number tabhi dikhega jab main khud account banaunga.
cards.myth: Agar Caller-ID Apps par green/blue badge ya 'Bank Bank / Cyber Cell' naam dikh raha hai, to call 100% asli sarkari ya bank call hi hai.
cards.reality: Caller-ID Apps names crowdsourced aur editable hote hain—scammers aasani se bank/police naam crowd-tag karwa sakte hain! Asli verification sirf bank ke official back-of-card number par khud call karne se hoti hai.

cards.title: Parking/Table QR Code Scan Karne se Fake Payment Page Khulna: 'Quishing' & URL Preview!
cards.hook: Cafe table par menu dekhne, metro parking par ₹20 dene ya electricity bill bharne ke liye aapne wahan chipka QR code scan kiya—par kisi scammer ne upar apna nakli sticker chipka diya ho to kya hoga?
cards.illusion: QR code bas ek safe shortcut hai—kisi bhi public poster ya dukaan ke bahar lage QR code ko scan karne se sirf sahi website/dukaan par hi jaate hain.
cards.myth: QR code scan karte hi bina PIN aur bina click kiye apne aap bank account khali ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Sirf camera se QR scan karne par paise nahi kat-te—paise tabhi kat-te hain jab aap aage khule fake link par card/OTP/APK daalein ya UPI par galat naam dekhe bina **UPI PIN** enter karein!

cards.title: 'Customer Care Refund ke Liye remote screen-sharing app / remote screen-sharing app Download Karo': Remote Screen Hijack Fraud!
cards.hook: Online order ya KYC problem par aapne Search/Platform se mile customer care number par call kiya—aur saamne wale ne kaha 'Sir refund ke liye Play Store se remote screen-sharing app / QuickSupport / RustDesk app daal kar 9-digit code batayein!' Iske baad kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Screen-sharing app (Remote Screen-Sharing Apps) se saamne wala sirf dekh sakta hai—wo bina mere bataye mera OTP ya bank nahi chala sakta.
cards.myth: Screen sharing par jab tak main khud bol kar OTP na bataun, tab tak hacker OTP nahi dekh sakta.
cards.reality: Screen share chalu hote hi jab phone ke upar SMS notification pop-up hota hai, hacker usse live padh leta hai—aapko bolne ki zaroorat hi nahi padti!

cards.title: 'Aapke Naam ke Parcel mein Drugs/Passport Pakda Gaya hai' IVR Call: Digital Arrest Scam Anatomy!
cards.hook: Subah ek automated call aata hai: 'Your FedEx/DHL parcel from Mumbai to Taiwan has illegal drugs & fake passports—press 1!' Phir Skype/Messaging App video par nakli police vardi mein baith kar 'Digital Arrest' kaise karte hain?
cards.illusion: Police ya CBI/Customs Messaging App ya Skype video call par 'Digital Arrest' kar ke case khatam karne ke liye RBI/Supreme Court verification account mein paise transfer karwati hai.
cards.myth: Video call par vardi mein police officer, peeche police station ka board aur mera sahi Aadhaar number dikh raha hai—ye zaroor asli CBI/Police hai.
cards.reality: Aadhaar/phone data purane leaks se mil jaata hai aur studio set + AI/fake vardi se koi bhi scammer police station bana sakta hai—asli police kabhi Messaging App video par giraftari ya paisa transfer nahi maangti!

cards.title: 'Roz video platforms Video Like Kar ke ₹3,000 Kamayein' Cloud Messaging App Task Scam: Pehle ₹500 Aana Phir Lakhon Doobna!
cards.hook: Messaging App par message aata hai: 'Ghar baithe bas Online Maps reviews ya video platforms videos like kar ke ₹1,500–₹5,000 roz kamayein!' Pehle din sachmuch ₹300–₹800 bank mein aate bhi hain—phir achanak ₹5 Lakh kaise doob jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Jab unhone shuru mein mujhe sachmuch ₹500 UPI kar diye, to matlab ye part-time kaam 100% genuine hai.
cards.myth: Mera ₹50,000 'wrong click' se atka hai, ek baar ₹1 Lakh aur bhej kar poora ₹1.5 Lakh withdraw kar ke chhod dunga.
cards.reality: Wo screen par dikhne wala balance sirf nakli HTML numbers hote hain—jitna aur paisa bhejenge utna hi dubega, wo kabhi withdraw nahi hone dete! Turant ruk kar 1930 par report karein.

cards.title: Messaging App 'SEBI-Registered Guru VIP IPO Group': Fake Trading App par 500% Profit Dikhana!
cards.hook: Social Media ad se aap ek Messaging App 'Stock Market Learning / Institutional IPO Group' mein judte hain—wahan roz log ₹5 Lakh profit ke screenshots dalte hain aur ek khaas app par aapko Upper-Circuit shares aur 100% IPO allotment milne lagta hai! Asliyat kya hai?
cards.illusion: App bilkul Zerodha/Groww jaisa dikhta hai aur mere ₹1 Lakh 2 hafte mein ₹2.8 Lakh ban gaye matlab asli trading profit ho raha hai.
