cards.myth: Mainne ₹20,000 lagaya aur ₹25,000 successfully bank mein withdraw bhi kar liya, matlab ye VIP trading group aur app bilkul asli hai.
cards.reality: Chhote amount withdraw karne dena scammers ki sabse purani trick hai taaki aap lalach mein aakar apna bada ₹5–₹20 Lakh jama kar dein—bada amount kabhi withdraw nahi hota!

cards.title: Registry Paper se Anguthe ka Nishan Chori (AePS Fraud): Aadhaar Biometric Lock Kaise Bachata Hai?
cards.hook: Bina kisi OTP, bina kisi ATM card aur bina kisi link par click kiye kisi ke bank account se ₹10,000–₹10,000 kar ke paise kat jaate hain! Zameen registry ke kagazon se anguthe ki silicone copy banakar hone wala AePS scam kaise rokein?
cards.illusion: Jab tak main apna ATM PIN ya SMS OTP kisi ko na bataun, koi mere bank account se ₹1 bhi nahi nikaal sakta.
cards.myth: Aadhaar Biometric Lock karne se mera UPI, Net Banking, aur Aadhaar OTP kaam karna band kar deta hai.
cards.reality: Biometric Lock sirf aapke **Fingerprint aur Iris scan** ko lock karta hai—aapka **UPI, ATM Card, Net Banking aur Aadhaar SMS OTP** 100% pehle ki tarah chalta rehta hai!

cards.title: ₹500 se Kam Payment ke Liye 'UPI Lite' Bina PIN Safe Hai ya Risky? Wallet Cap & Statement Truth!
cards.hook: Chai, auto aur sabzi wale ko ₹20–₹200 dene ke liye ab apps mein 'UPI Lite — Bina PIN Instant Payment' aa gaya hai! Par bina PIN ke paise bhejne mein kya phone kho jaane par bank khali ho sakta hai?
cards.illusion: UPI Lite ON karne se koi bhi mera phone utha kar mera poora bank account bina PIN ke khali kar sakta hai.
cards.myth: UPI Lite bina PIN ke kaam karta hai matlab usse phone chhu kar koi bhi mere bank ke ₹2 Lakh nikaal sakta hai.
cards.reality: UPI Lite sirf pre-loaded small wallet (max cap ₹5,000, typical ₹500–₹1,000) tak limited hota hai—aapke main bank balance ko haath lagane ke liye hamesha main UPI PIN chahiye!

cards.title: 'Bheed mein Pocket ke Paas Machine Laga kar ₹5,000 Chori' vs NFC Tap-to-Pay Limit & RFID Wallet Myth!
cards.hook: Messaging App videos mein dikhaya jaata hai ki metro/bheed mein chor aapki jeb ke paas ek card-swipe machine laga kar bina PIN ke ₹5,000 chura lete hain—aur ₹1,000 ka 'RFID Blocking Wallet' becha jaata hai! Sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Chor pocket ke paas machine touch kar ke kisi ka bhi bank account aasani se saaf kar sakte hain aur ₹1,000 ka RFID blocking wallet hi ekmatra bachav hai.
cards.myth: Bina ₹1,000 ka special RFID-blocking wallet kharide metro aur bheed mein aapka ATM card bilkul safe nahi reh sakta.
cards.reality: Bank app mein 1 click se Contactless (Tap-to-Pay) OFF kar dene par ₹0 mein NFC signal permanently band ho jaata hai (ya wallet mein sirf ek aluminium foil/2 cards ek sath rakhne se bhi NFC clash ho jaata hai)!

cards.title: Hotel/Airport Wi-Fi par 'Evil Twin' Fake Hotspot: HTTPS Lock aur Mobile Data Switch Rule!
cards.hook: Airport, railway station ya cafe mein 'Free_Airport_WiFi_5G' dikhte hi log bina soche connect kar lete hain—par cyber attackers kaise same naam ka nakli Wi-Fi hotspot banakar aapka data dekhte hain?
cards.illusion: Agar Wi-Fi ka naam 'Airport_Free_WiFi' ya 'Cafe_Guest' likha hai aur password nahi maang raha, to wo wahin ka official safe network hai.
cards.myth: Public Wi-Fi par connect karte hi agar koi 'Sign in with Search/Platform/Social Media' ya 'Update Browser' pop-up aaye, to wo Wi-Fi login ke liye zaroori hota hai.
cards.reality: Real free Wi-Fi kabhi aapka Search/Platform password ya browser APK update nahi maangta—wo 100% Phishing/Malware trap hota hai, turant disconnect karein!

cards.title: 'P@ssw0rd123!' Har Website par Rakhna vs 4-Word Passphrase & Password Manager!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki unka password `Rahul@1995!` bahut strong hai kyunki usmein capital, number aur `@` hai—par phir usi password se 10 websites chala kar saare accounts ek sath hack kyun ho jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Agar ek password mein Capital letter, Number aur Special symbol (@/#) laga kar wahi har jagah rakho, to account kabhi hack nahi ho sakta.
cards.myth: 8-character wala `S@chin99` ek 16-character wale plain `blue-mango-train-lamp` se zyada strong hota hai.
cards.reality: NIST guidelines ke mutabik **Length beats clever symbols**—`S@chin99` jaise predictable 8-char passwords seconds/hours mein crack ho jaate hain, jabki 16–20 character ka random 4-word passphrase unbreakable hota hai!

cards.title: SMS OTP vs Authenticator App / Passkeys: SIM Swap ke Zamane mein Kaun Zyada Safe?
cards.hook: Email aur Social Media log 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) mein sirf SMS OTP laga kar chhod dete hain—par agar kabhi SIM Swap, eSIM fraud ya Call-Forwarding ho jaaye, to Authenticator App / Passkey aapka account kaise bachata hai?
cards.illusion: SMS OTP laga diya matlab duniya ka koi hacker mera Email Inbox ya Social Media nahi khol sakta.
cards.myth: Authenticator app agar phone kho jaaye to main hamesha ke liye apna Email Inbox aur Social Media kho dunga.
cards.reality: Agar aap pehle se **Printed Backup Codes** almirah mein likh kar rakhein ya **Search/Platform Authenticator Cloud Sync / 2nd Device** rakhein, to phone khone par bhi 2 minute mein recovery ho jaati hai!

cards.title: Free 'Coupon Finder / PDF Converter' Web Browser Extensions: Bank Login & History Stealing!
cards.hook: Laptop ke Web Browser browser mein shopping coupons, video downloaders ya free PDF tools ke liye log 10–15 extensions laga lete hain—par 'Read and Change All Data on All Websites' wali permission aapka poora data kaise chura leti hai?
cards.illusion: Web Browser Web Store par milne wali har free extension Search/Platform dwara 100% safe aur checked hoti hai.
cards.myth: Web Browser Web Store par 'Featured' ya 1 Lakh+ downloads dikh rahe hain matlab wo extension kabhi harmful nahi ho sakti.
cards.reality: Hackers aksar 1 Lakh+ users wali clean free extensions ko paise dekar kharid lete hain aur ek silent auto-update se usmein spyware daal dete hain!

cards.title: 'Aapki Pehli Car aur Pet Name Batao' Social Media Quiz: Password Guessing & OSINT Trap!
cards.hook: Social Media/Social Media viral games chalte hain: 'Comment your First School Name, Pet Name, & Birth Month to see your Hero Name!' Par kya aap jaante hain aap khud hackers ko apne Security Questions de rahe hain?
cards.illusion: Social media par cute quizzes aur birthday countdowns post karna bas harmless timepass hai.
cards.myth: Mera profile par crorepati details nahi hain isliye public birthday, school aur family photos dalne se koi nuksan nahi.
cards.reality: Scammers aur AI bots har aam insaan ka public data scrape kar ke targeted UPI/relative-emergency/digital-arrest scams mein use karte hain!

cards.title: Video Call par Boss ya Rishtedar ka Chehra: Real-Time AI Deepfake Pehchanne ke 4 Tricks!
cards.hook: Messaging App Video Call par aapke Boss ya London mein rehne wale cousin ka chehra aur aawaz dikh rahi hai aur wo turant ₹1 Lakh medical emergency ke liye maang rahe hain—par kuch second baad pata chalta hai wo AI Deepfake tha!
cards.illusion: Agar Messaging App Video Call par kisi ka asli chehra bolta hua dikh raha hai aur unki aawaz aa rahi hai, to wo 100% wahi insaan hai.
cards.myth: AI deepfake sirf pehle se record kiye gaye videos mein banta hai, live video call par nahi chal sakta.
cards.reality: Open-source aur commercial real-time face-swap + voice-conversion tools ab laptop GPU par live webcam/Messaging App calls par chal sakte hain—halanki side-profile aur hand-across-face par abhi bhi glitch karte hain!

cards.title: Photo ko 'Messaging App Document' Bhej kar Ghar ka Exact GPS Pata Chalna: EXIF Metadata Sach!
cards.hook: HD quality ke liye log apni ghar ki ya bacche ki photo Messaging App par 'Document' banakar bhejte hain ya OLX/classifieds par daalte hain—par us ek photo ke andar aapke ghar ka exact latitude-longitude aur phone model kaise chhupa hota hai?
cards.illusion: Ek photo file sirf tasveer hoti hai, uske andar ghar ka address ya GPS coordinates nahi ho sakte.
cards.myth: Messaging App par 'Document' banakar photo bhejne se sirf photo clear jaati hai, aur kuch extra info nahi jaati.
cards.reality: Document mode bina kisi modification ke raw file bhejta hai—jismein **Camera EXIF GPS Coordinates, Exact Timestamp, aur Device Model** sab kuch chhupa rehta hai!

cards.title: ₹1,500 ki Smartwatch par Bina Sui ke 'BP aur Blood Sugar' Naapna: Optical Sensor Scam!
cards.hook: Online ₹1,200–₹2,500 ki budget smartwatches ke ads mein dikhaya jaata hai ki 'Kalai par pehno aur bina sui chubhaye Blood Pressure, ECG aur Blood Sugar check karo!' Par US FDA aur doctors ispar warning kyun de rahe hain?
cards.illusion: Smartwatch ke neeche jalne wali hari-laal LED lights bilkul medical machine ki tarah khoon ka BP aur Diabetes Sugar naap leti hain.
cards.myth: Badi company ki ₹5,000–₹40,000 wali smartwatch ab bina sui ke Diabetes ka Blood Sugar check kar deti hai.
cards.reality: 2024 mein US FDA ne confirm kiya ki abhi tak duniya mein ek bhi consumer smartwatch/smart ring non-invasive Blood Glucose measurement ke liye approved ya accurate nahi hai!

cards.title: Band Kamre mein Water Cooler Chalane se Chipchipi Garmi aur Saans Phoolna: Humidity Saturation!
cards.hook: AC ka bill bachane ke liye log darwaza-khidki band kar ke Desert Air Cooler chala dete hain—par 30 minute baad kamre mein thandak ke bajaye chipchipi bhap aur ghutan kyun bhar jaati hai?
cards.illusion: AC ki tarah Air Cooler ko bhi darwaze-khidki poori tarah band kar ke chalane se kamra zyada thanda hota hai.
cards.myth: AC aur Cooler dono mein kamra jitna airtight band hoga utni hi zyada thandak rukegi.
cards.reality: AC band kamre mein chalta hai kyunki wo hawa ki nami sokh kar garmi bahar phenkta hai; Cooler bilkul ulta hawa mein paani milata hai—band kamre mein cooler 20 min mein fail ho kar chipchipi garmi bana deta hai!

cards.title: Barsat (Monsoon) mein AC ko 'Cool Mode' ke Bajaye 'Dry Mode' par Chalana: Chipchipahat aur Bijli Bachat!
cards.hook: July-August ki barsat mein temperature sirf 30°C hota hai par chipchipi garmi se bura haal hota hai—AC ko 18°C Cool Mode par chalane se kamra thanda kachcha thand to ho jaata hai par chipchipa aur mehenga kyun lagta hai?
cards.illusion: AC remote par sirf 'Cool Mode' hi kaam ka hota hai—'Dry Mode' (Water-Drop icon) ka koi khas matlab nahi hota.
cards.myth: Dry Mode mein AC ka compressor band rehta hai isliye wo sirf pankhe ki tarah kaam karta hai.
cards.reality: Dry mode mein compressor intermittent slow cycles par chalta hai taaki thandi coil par hawa ki extra nami condense hokar paani ke pipe se bahar nikal sake!

cards.title: AC Kharidte Waqt '100% Copper Coil' vs Alloy/Aluminium Coil: Gas Leak aur Repair Cost!
cards.hook: ₹3,000 sasta AC bechne ke liye showroom wala 'Micro-Channel Aluminium / Alloy Condenser Coil' ko 'Latest Aerospace Technology' bol kar bech deta hai—par 2 saal baad naale ke paas ya coastal areas mein gas leak aur ₹12,000 ka kharch kyun aata hai?
cards.illusion: Saste AC mein lagi Aluminium ya Alloy coil bhi Copper coil jaisi hi chalti hai aur aasani se repair ho jaati hai.
cards.myth: Salesman kehta hai 'Copper connecting pipe diya hai matlab AC poora Copper hai!'
cards.reality: Connecting pipe copper hone ke bawajood kai saste models mein andar ka **Outdoor Condenser Coil Aluminium/Alloy** ka hota hai—spec sheet mein '100% Copper Condenser & Evaporator' padhna zaroori hai!

cards.title: 'Har Saal AC ki Gas Khatam Ho Jaati Hai, ₹2,500 Bharwao': Sealed Loop Physics vs Real Leak Test!
cards.hook: April aate hi local AC mechanic servicing karne aata hai aur gauge dikha kar bolta hai: 'Bhaiya garmi aa gayi, gas kam ho gayi hai—₹2,500 lagenge top-up kar deta hoon!' Par kya AC ki gas petrol ki tarah kharch hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Gaadi ke petrol ki tarah har saal AC ki cooling gas thodi-thodi use hokar kam ho jaati hai isliye har saal 'Gas Top-Up' karwana padta hai.
cards.myth: Har 12 mahine mein AC ki gas 20%–30% evaporate hokar kam ho jaati hai, jaise gaadi ka engine oil ya petrol.
cards.reality: AC ek band sealed circuit hai—agar koi leak na ho, to gas 10 saal mein 1% bhi kharch nahi hoti! Agar gas kam hui hai to leak fix karna zaroori hai, sirf top-up nahi.

cards.title: 'Microwave ke Khaane mein Radiation aur Cancer Hota Hai' Myth: Non-Ionizing Waves vs Wrong Plastic!
cards.hook: Messaging App par message ghoomta hai ki 'Microwave mein garam kiya khana radioactive aur cancer-causing ho jaata hai aur uske saare vitamins mar jaate hain!' Asli physics aur asli khatra kya hai?
cards.illusion: Microwave oven X-ray ki tarah radioactive radiation chhodta hai jo khaane ko zehrila bana deta hai.
cards.myth: Microwave ke saamne khade rehne se aankhon/pet mein X-ray jaisa radiation lagta hai aur khane mein radiation jama reh jaata hai.
cards.reality: Darwaze ki metal jaali waves ko andar hi rok leti hai aur button band hote hi 0 waves bachti hain—khane mein koi radiation store nahi hota!

cards.title: ₹15,000 ke RO mein 'Copper-Alkaline-Zinc Mineralizer' vs Asli TDS 100–250 & Membrane Science!
cards.hook: RO salesman ghar aakar paani mein TDS meter daal kar darata hai: 'Dekho aapke nal mein 300 TDS hai, 20 TDS wala RO + ₹4,000 ki Copper-Alkaline-B12 Cartridge lagwao!' Asli WHO/BIS paani science kya hai?
cards.illusion: Paani ka TDS jitna zero ke kareeb (10–30 ppm) ho utna shuddh hai, aur ₹4,000 ki 'Copper-Alkaline-Zinc' cartridge usmein saare vitamins bhar deti hai.
cards.myth: Jab tak RO paani ka TDS 15–30 ke beech na aaye, tab tak paani shuddh nahi hota.
cards.reality: BIS IS 10500 ke mutabik 500 mg/L tak TDS acceptable aur ~80–250 mg/L sabse swadisht aur balanced hota hai—20 TDS par paani behad flat aur mineral-less ho jaata hai!

cards.title: Mixer Grinder mein '1000W Peak Power' Sticker vs Real Copper Motor & Overload Trip!
cards.hook: ₹1,800 ke saste mixer grinder par bada sticker laga hota hai '1000W Heavy Duty Turbo Motor!'—par haldi ya dosa batter peeste hi 2 minute mein jalne ki badbu aur dhuan kyun nikalne lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Box par '1000W Power' likha hai matlab uski motor asli 750W branded mixer se zyada taqatwar aur tikau hai.
cards.myth: Mixer ke box par 1000W likha hai to wo 750W wale branded mixer se hamesha zyada mazboot hoga.
cards.reality: Wattage sirf bijli khapat/peak rating hai—motor ki asli jaan **100% Pure Copper Winding**, bearing quality aur continuous torque mein hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Garam Khana Seedhe Fridge mein Rakhne se Fridge Kharab Ho Jaata Hai' Myth: 2-Hour Danger Zone!
cards.hook: Ghar mein hamesha kaha jaata hai ki 'Jab tak dal-sabzi bilkul room temperature par thandi na ho jaaye, fridge mein mat rakhna warna compressor phook jayega!' Par Food Safety agencies ispar kya kehti hain?
cards.illusion: Garam khana fridge mein rakhne se fridge ka compressor jal jaata hai—isliye khane ko 4–5 ghante kitchen counter par thanda karna chahiye.
cards.myth: Halka gunguna khana fridge mein rakhne se fridge ka compressor jal jaata hai aur khana zehrila ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Modern fridges aasani se thode warm food ko cool kar lete hain—ulta **3–4 ghante bahar chhoda hua khana** bacteria se kharab hota hai! Sirf ubalta patila chhote containers mein baant kar thoda steam nikalne ke baad turant andar rakh dein.

cards.title: Front-Load vs Top-Load Washing Machine: Paani, Bijli, Kapdon ki Ghisai aur Detergent Math!
cards.hook: ₹16,000 ki Top-Load aur ₹28,000 ki Front-Load washing machine mein kapde sachmuch alag tarah dhulte hain—aur 'Zyada Detergent' dalne se kapde aur machine dono kharab kyun hote hain?
cards.illusion: Dono machines bilkul same tarah kapde dhoti hain bas Front-Load mehengi dikhave wali hoti hai, aur zyada jhaag matlab zyada saaf kapde.
cards.myth: Front-load aur Top-load mein same ₹60/kg wala hand-wash detergent daal kar chalane se koi farq nahi padta.
cards.reality: High-foam hand-wash powder Front-load ke kam paani mein excessive jhaag banata hai jo sensors, drain pump aur drum bearings ko kharab kar deta hai!

cards.title: ₹1,500 ka Normal 75W Fan vs ₹3,000 ka 30W BLDC Fan: Bijli Bil se Paisa Vasool Math!
cards.hook: Pankha kharidte waqt ₹1,500 bachane ke liye log purana 75-Watt Induction Ceiling Fan le aate hain—par ek ₹3,000 wala BLDC Fan 1 hi saal mein bijli ke bill se apna extra kharch kaise nikaal deta hai?
cards.illusion: Ek chhote se ceiling fan se bijli bill par kya hi farq padta hai—AC aur Geyser hi saara bill laate hain.
cards.myth: BLDC fans kam watt lete hain isliye unki hawa tez nahi hoti aur room thanda nahi hota.
cards.reality: BEE 5-Star BLDC fans high-efficiency copper+permanent-magnet motors use karte hain jo **210–230 CMM (utni hi ya zyada hawa)** sirf 30–35W mein dete hain!

cards.title: TV, Set-Top Box aur Charger Switch Off Na Karne se 'Vampire Power': Kitne Units Chori Hote Hain?
cards.hook: Raat ko sote waqt log TV aur Set-Top Box ko sirf Remote se band kar dete hain (wall switch ON chhod kar) aur Microwave/Laptop chargers plugged chhod dete hain—is 'Vampire Power' se saal mein kitni bijli bekaar jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Remote se TV aur Set-Top Box band karne par wo 0 Watt bijli lete hain, aur khali charger socket mein chhodne se koi meter nahi ghoomta.
cards.myth: Ek khali phone charger wall socket mein laga chhodne se mahine mein ₹500 bijli ka bill badh jaata hai.
cards.reality: Modern switching phone chargers idle mein sirf ~0.1–0.3W (~₹1–₹2/mahina) lete hain—asli bada standby bill **Set-Top Box, Smart TV, Gaming Console, Desktop PC, aur AC standby** se aata hai (par safety/surge ke liye charger bhi off karna accha hai!).

cards.title: ₹150 ka Extension Board vs ₹800 ka Real MOV Surge Protector: Voltage Spike mein Laptop Bachav!
cards.hook: Mehenge Laptop, Gaming PC aur Smart TV ke liye log ₹150 wala gol plastic extension cord kharid lete hain jispar 'Surge Protector' likha hota hai—par baarish ki bijli ya voltage spike mein TV aur Laptop kyun phook jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Har multi-plug extension board jispar 'Power Strip / Spike Guard' likha ho, wo voltage spikes se TV aur Laptop ko bacha leta hai.
cards.myth: ₹200 wale multi-plug extension board mein ek main on/off switch aur fuse laga hai matlab wo bijli kadakne aur high voltage se laptop bacha lega.
cards.reality: Simple switch aur normal fuse high-speed millisecond voltage spikes ko nahi rok sakte—uske liye dedicated **MOVs + Thermal Cutoff + Home Earthing** chahiye!

cards.title: Ghar ke Meter Board mein Sirf MCB Hona Kaafi Nahi: Current Lagne par Jaan Sirf 'RCCB (30mA)' Bachata Hai!
cards.hook: Har ghar ke distribution board mein 6–8 MCBs lage hote hain, isliye log sochte hain 'Hamara ghar 100% shock-proof hai!' Par geyser, washing machine ya cooler se insaan ko current lagne par MCB kyun nahi girta?
cards.illusion: Ghar mein MCB lagi hai matlab kisi ko current lagne par turant bijli trip hokar jaan bach jayegi.
cards.myth: Ghar ke naye meter board mein 10 MCBs aur Earthing lagi hai matlab ab current lagne par automatically light kat jayegi.
cards.reality: MCB sirf taar jalne (16A+) se bachati hai, human electrocution (30–50mA) par MCB kabhi trip nahi hoti—current lagne par jaan sirf **30mA RCCB / RCBO** bachati hai!

cards.title: Geyser ya Fridge ki Body mein Halka Current (Jhatka) Aana: Broken Earthing vs Loose Tester Check!
cards.hook: Fridge ka darwaza ya Washing Machine ki steel body chhute hi ungli mein halka jhatka ('current maar raha hai!') mehsoos hota hai! Log chappal pehan kar kaam chala lete hain—par ye kis bade khatre ka signal hai?
cards.illusion: Fridge ya PC ki body mein halka jhatka aana normal static current hai, chappal pehan kar chhune se koi khatra nahi.
cards.myth: Naye ghar ke walls mein green earthing wire daala hai matlab poore ghar mein earthing kaam kar rahi hai (Earth pit ya pipe check ki zaroorat nahi).
cards.reality: Bahut se flats mein green wire sirf wall box tak hota hai aur neeche ground earth-pit se disconnect ya dry ho chuka hota hai—Multimeter se Phase-Earth (230V) aur Neutral-Earth (<2V) test karwana hi asli proof hai!

cards.title: Ghar ka Inverter Chalne par Pankha 'Hummm' Aawaz Kyun Karta Hai? Square Wave vs Pure Sine Wave!
cards.hook: Light jaate hi inverter chalu hone par ceiling fan tez 'HUUUUUMMM-BUZZ' aawaz karne lagta hai aur motor garam ho jaati hai—par kisi doosre ke ghar mein inverter par pankha bilkul shant chalta hai! Farq kya hai?
cards.illusion: Sabhi home inverters ek hi jaisi AC bijli banate hain—light jaane par pankhe ka buzz karna normal hota hai.
cards.myth: Inverter battery badi aur mehengi lene se pankhon ki humming aawaz band ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Humming battery se nahi, balki Inverter ke output wave shape (**Square vs Pure Sine Wave**) se hoti hai—badi battery sirf backup time badhati hai!

cards.title: 'Naya Smart Electric Meter Purane se 2x Tez Chalta Hai' Myth: Accuracy Testing & Check Meter!
cards.hook: Purana meter badal kar naya Digital Smart Meter lagte hi logon ko lagta hai bill 30%–50% badh gaya aur meter hawa mein daud raha hai! Kya smart meter sachmuch tez chalta hai ya purane meters aur billing ke piche koi aur reason hai?
cards.illusion: Naye digital smart meters ko sarkar ne jaan-boojh kar 2x tez chalne ke liye program kiya hai taaki zyada bill aaye.
cards.myth: Smart meter mein inverter aur capacitor bank lagane se bhi bill nahi rukta kyunki smart meter 'hawa ki bijli' bhi gin leta hai.
cards.reality: Residential single-phase smart meters kWh (Real Active Power) par hi bill banate hain—bas wo pehle ki tarah slow nahi hote aur har unit ko ±1% accuracy se record karte hain!

cards.title: Tyre mein ₹50/Tyre wali 'Nitrogen Gas' vs Free Normal Hawa: 78% Nitrogen Sach!
cards.hook: Petrol pump par hawa bharne wala kehta hai 'Sir garmi mein normal hawa se tyre phat jaata hai, ₹200 mein 100% Nitrogen bharwa lo!' Par kya aap jaante hain sadak ki free hawa mein pehle se kitni Nitrogen hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Nitrogen bharwane se gaadi ka mileage 15% badh jaata hai aur normal hawa bharne par garmi mein tyres phat jaate hain.
cards.myth: Agar gaadi ke tyre mein Nitrogen bhari hai to usmein kabhi normal hawa mix nahi karni chahiye warna tyre kharab ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Normal hawa khud 78% Nitrogen hi hoti hai! Kam pressure par chalne se behtar hai turant normal hawa bharwa kar pressure sahi kar lein—mix karne se 0% nuksan hota hai.

cards.title: Car Dashcam: ₹4,000 ka Ek Chhota Camera Lakhon ke Fake Accident & Police Challan se Kaise Bachata Hai?
cards.hook: Bheed mein koi bike ya pedestrian khud car ke aage kood kar 'Fake Hit & Run / Extortion' kare, ya galat red-light challan aaye—bina Dashcam ke badi gaadi wale ko hi hamesha doshi kyun maan liya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Dashcam bas vlogging ya video platforms videos banane wale drivers ka shauk hai, normal city car mein iski zaroorat nahi.
cards.myth: Car ke windshield par dashcam lagane se battery khali ho jaati hai ya gaadi ki warranty khatam ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: 12V cigarette lighter/USB port se lagne wala dashcam jab car off hoti hai to power band kar deta hai—wire kaate bina plug-in karne par koi warranty void nahi hoti!

cards.title: Subah Gaadi Start kar ke 10 Minute Khade-Khade Garam Karna: Engine Wear & Petrol Waste!
cards.hook: Sardiyon aur garmiyon ki subah log bike/car start kar ke 5–10 minute khadi rakh kar race dete rehte hain ki 'Engine garam ho jaaye!' Par modern Fuel-Injected engines mein ye aadat ulta engine ko ghis kaise deti hai?
cards.illusion: Subah gaadi start kar ke kam se kam 5–10 minute khade-khade garam kiye bina chalana engine ko kharab kar deta hai.
cards.myth: Thand mein agar temperature needle beech mein aane tak 10 minute parking mein khadi na rakhein, to engine seize ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Engine ko chalane (gentle driving) se wo 3x tezi se sahi operating temp par aata hai—10 min idling ulta oil ko dilute kar ke engine ghis-ti hai (khaaskar enclosed garage mein CO poisoning ka khatra alag hai!).

cards.title: Pahad se Utarte Waqt Mileage ke Liye Gaadi 'Neutral' par Daalna: Zero Engine Braking & Brake Fade!
cards.hook: Shimla, Mussoorie ya Ghats se neeche utarte waqt drivers petrol bachane ke liye gear ko 'Neutral (N)' par daal dete hain—par pahadon mein 'Brake Fail' ke zyadatar haadse isi ek galti se kyun hote hain?
cards.illusion: Dhalan par gaadi Neutral mein rakhne se 0% petrol lagta hai aur sirf brakes dabaa kar control karna safe aur economical hai.
cards.myth: Dhalan par Neutral mein gaadi chalane se sabse zyada petrol bachta hai aur engine par load nahi padta.
cards.reality: Neutral mein engine ko idle rakhne ke liye petrol lagta hai jabki Gear-in Coasting (DFCO) mein fuel injection bilkul **ZERO** ho jaata hai—aur Neutral mein brakes jal kar fail hone ka sabse bada khatra hota hai!

cards.title: 'Reserve / Low Fuel Light par Gaadi Chalane se Fuel Pump Jal Jaata Hai' vs Tank Sediment Truth!
cards.hook: Kai log petrol light jalte hi ghabra jaate hain ki 'Abhi 2 km mein fuel pump jal jayega aur tanki ki neeche ki gandagi engine mein chali jayegi!' Asli engineering sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Reserve light jalte hi tank ka petrol khatam ho jaata hai aur tank ke neeche jami mitti turant engine kharab kar deti hai.
cards.myth: Reserve light jalte hi tank ke neeche baithi saari mitti seedhe engine mein chali jaati hai; jabki full tank rakhne par upar ka saaf petrol aata hai.
cards.reality: Fuel pump pickup hamesha tank ki bilkul talhati (bottom) par hi hota hai—isliye full tank mein bhi tel neeche se hi jaata hai aur Fuel Filter usse chhan kar aage bhejta hai! Asli risk sirf pump ka dry hokar garam hona hai.

cards.title: Petrol Pump par '₹105 vs ₹100' aur 'Subah Thandi Hawa mein Zyada Petrol' Myth: Asli Pump Tricks!
cards.hook: Log petrol pump par '₹100 nahi, ₹110 ya ₹520 ka dalna!' bolte hain aur subah 6 baje thande mausam mein tank full karwate hain—kya inse sachmuch zyada petrol milta hai, aur asli pump fraud kaise pakdein?
cards.illusion: ₹100, ₹500, ₹1000 round-figure bolne par machine automatically 10% kam petrol deti hai, jabki ₹520 bolne par 100% poora milta hai.
cards.myth: Subah 6 baje petrol bharwane par 10% zyada petrol milta hai aur ₹100 ke bajaye ₹105 bolne par machine kam nahi de sakti.
cards.reality: Underground fuel tanks ka temperature din bhar lagbhag stable rehta hai (farq <0.2% hota hai), aur preset amount badalne se tampered chip nahi rukti—asli bachav `0.00` watch aur zero-distraction hai!

cards.title: Barsat aur Sardi mein Car ke Sheeshe par Bhaap Jamna: Garam Hawa vs AC Defogger + Fresh Air!
cards.hook: Baarish ya December ki thand mein car chalate hi samne ka sheesha (windshield) andar se safed dhundh se band ho jaata hai! Driver rumal se pochhta rehta hai—par ek button se 5 second mein sheesha crystal clear kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Sardi/baarish mein sheeshe ki bhaap hatane ke liye AC band rakh kar sirf Heater aur Recirculation ON rakhna chahiye.
cards.myth: Sardi mein AC button dabane se hamesha barf jaisi thandi hawa hi aati hai, heater aur AC sath nahi chal sakte.
cards.reality: Car mein **AC button** sirf Dehumidifier Compressor ko chalata hai—jab aap AC ON rakh kar Temp knob ko Red (Warm) par ghumate hain, to **Sookhi + Garam hawa** aati hai jo 5 second mein fog gayab kar deti hai!

cards.title: EV Scooter/Car ka '150 km Certified Range' vs Highway/AC par Sirf 95 km Milna: IDC vs Real World!
cards.hook: Showroom wale EV Scooter par '160 km Range' aur EV Car par '450 km Range' likh kar bechte hain—par jab aap family baitha kar 60–90 km/h par AC chala kar chalate hain, to 100 km aur 280 km mein battery khatam kyun ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: EV brochure par likhi ARAI/IDC range rozana ke normal highway aur AC driving mein bhi bilkul utni hi milti hai.
cards.myth: Petrol car ki tarah EV bhi 100–110 km/h highway cruise par city se zyada mileage/range deti hai.
cards.reality: EVs mein koi multi-speed gearbox nahi hota aur aerodynamic drag 100 km/h par 4x badh jaata hai—isliye EVs **City (40–60 km/h)** mein zyada aur **Fast Highway (100+ km/h)** par kam range deti hain!

cards.title: EV ko 100% Charge kar ke Pahad se Utarne par Regenerative Braking Kaam Band Kyun Karti Hai?
cards.hook: Pahad ki choti (Hill-station hotel) par apni EV Car/Scooter ko 100% full charge kar ke jab aap neeche utarte hain, to achanak 'Regenerative Braking Disabled' likha aata hai aur gaadi tezi se bhaagne lagti hai! Kyun?
cards.illusion: EV mein hamesha 100% full charge kar ke pahad se utarna best hai kyunki regen extra bijli jama kar leta hai.
cards.myth: EV mein regenerative braking jab battery 100% hoti hai tab bhi normal tareeke se kaam karti rehti hai.
cards.reality: Lithium battery 100% full hone par extra regen current nahi le sakti—isliye BMS safety ke liye regen braking ko ya to 0 kar deta hai ya behad kamzor kar deta hai!

cards.title: Bina Seatbelt ke Airbag Khulna & Back Seat par Seatbelt Na Lagana: Newton Physics Crash!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain 'Hamari car mein 6 Airbags hain, aur peeche ki seat par seatbelt lagane ki kya zaroorat hai—aage soft seat hai!' Par bina seatbelt ke airbag khulna goli lagne jaisa kyun ban jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Car mein Airbags lage hain matlab seatbelt lagaye bina bhi crash mein jaan bach jayegi, aur back-seat passengers 100% safe hote hain.
cards.myth: Shehar mein 40–50 km/h par chalte waqt aur peeche ki seat par baithne mein seatbelt ki koi zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.reality: 50 km/h par takkar hone par ek 70 kg ka insaan **2,000+ kg (2 Ton) ke jhatke** se aage uchhalta hai—haathon se khud ko rokna physics ke hisab se impossible hota hai!

cards.title: Chhote Bacche ko Aage Seat par God (Lap) mein Bithana: 300 km/h Airbag Impact Khatra!
cards.hook: Parivaar saath safar karte waqt maa ya pita aage passenger seat par baith kar 2 saal ke bacche ko apni god (lap) mein bitha lete hain—par crash hone par bacche aur airbag ke beech kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Maa ki god mein aage seat par baithna bacche ke liye kisi bhi car seat se zyada safe aur pyara hota hai.
cards.myth: Main car dheere chala raha hoon aur bacche ko dono haathon se kas kar pakda hua hai isliye takkar mein kuch nahi hoga.
cards.reality: 40 km/h ki takkar mein ek 10 kg ka baccha achanak **300 kg ka bhaar** lekar haathon se chhoot jaata hai—insaan ki bahein physics ke 30G crash forces ko nahi rok saktin!

cards.title: Chalti Car ke Sunroof se Bacchon ka Sar Bahar Nikaalna: Sudden Brake & Flying Stone Risk!
cards.hook: Highway ya shehar mein log ₹15 Lakh ki Sunroof car kharid kar bacchon ko chalti car mein sunroof se bahar khada kar dete hain—par traffic police ₹1,000–₹2,000 challan aur doctors isse maut ka khel kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Sunroof banaya hi isliye gaya hai taaki chalti car mein bacche bahar khade hokar hawa aur nazare ka maza le sakein.
cards.myth: 20–30 km/h ki slow speed par sunroof se bacche ko khada karne mein koi khatra nahi hota.
cards.reality: 25 km/h par bhi achanak break lagne par bacche ka sar-chhati metal edge par takrata hai, aur overhead cable wires/flying gravel slow speed par bhi jaanlewa hote hain!

cards.title: ₹300 ka Roadside 'Challan Bachao Helmet' vs ISI/ECE Full-Face Helmet: Chin Impact Stats!
cards.hook: Police challan se bachne ke liye bike/scooty wale ₹250 ka sadak-kinare plastic half-helmet (bina strap lagaye!) pehan lete hain—par crash stats mein 35% impacts thodhi (Chin) par kyun lagte hain?
cards.illusion: Koi bhi ₹300 ka plastic helmet sir par rakh lene se police aur accident dono se poora bachav ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Bhaari aur full-face helmet pehanne se gardan toot jaati hai aur side ka traffic nahi dikhta.
cards.reality: Certified ISI/ECE full-face helmets mein **105°+ peripheral vision** mandatory hota hai aur chin-bar 35% facial/jaw impacts se bachata hai—gardan tootne ka myth studies mein 100% galat sabit ho chuka hai!

cards.title: 'Laptop ko Hamesha Charger par Laga Chhodne se Battery Phool Jaati Hai' Myth vs 80% Conservation Mode!
cards.hook: Office aur ghar mein log din bhar laptop par kaam karte waqt baar-baar charger nikaalte aur lagate hain is dar se ki '100% par plugged chhodne se battery kharab ho jayegi!' Par modern laptops mein kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: 100% charge hone ke baad bhi agar laptop charger mein laga rahe, to bijli battery mein ghus kar usse overcharge kar ke phula deti hai.
cards.myth: Laptop 100% charge hote hi turant charger nikaal kar 20% tak chalana chahiye aur phir lagana chahiye.
cards.reality: Aisa karne se aap har din unnecessary charge cycles kharch karte hain! Desk par **80% Charge Limit ON kar ke plugged rakhna** hi battery ki umar sabse zyada badhata hai.

cards.title: Naye SSD Laptop par 'Disk Defragmenter' Chalana: Speed Nahi Badhti, SSD Ki Umr Ghat-ti Hai!
cards.hook: Purane Windows 7 ke zamane se log laptop slow hote hi C-Drive par 'Disk Defragment' chalate hain—par naye SSD (Solid State Drive) wale laptops mein manual Defrag chalana galti kyun hai?
cards.illusion: Har computer ki drive ko mahine mein ek baar Defragment karne se speed tez hoti hai aur storage saaf rehti hai.
cards.myth: Laptop mein SSD lagi ho ya HDD, mahine mein ek baar manual 'Full Defrag' chalana zaroori hota hai.
cards.reality: SSD mein mechanical arm nahi hota—manual full defrag se speed 0% badhti hai aur flash cells par bekaar write wear padta hai; sirf built-in TRIM kaafi hai!

cards.title: Laptop ko Roz Shut Down Karna vs Sleep Mode mein Bag mein Rakhna: Bag Overheating & Windows S0 Trap!
cards.hook: Office se nikalte waqt log laptop ki screen (lid) band kar ke turant bag mein daal dete hain—par ghar pahunchte hi bag oven jaisa garam aur laptop ki battery 0% kyun milti hai?
cards.illusion: Laptop ki screen band (Sleep Mode) kar ke backpack mein rakhne se laptop poori tarah so jaata hai aur zero garmi banata hai.
cards.myth: Roz laptop Shut Down kar ke start karne se laptop ki battery aur SSD jaldi kharab ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: SSD laptops 8–10 second mein boot hote hain—Hibernate ya Shut Down karne se ulta background bugs clean hote hain aur bag overheating se battery bachti hai!

cards.title: ₹250 vs ₹2,500 'Gold-Plated Oxygen-Free 4K HDMI Cable': Digital 1s & 0s Physics!
cards.hook: TV showroom wale ₹60,000 ka 4K TV bechte waqt ₹2,500 ki '24K Gold-Plated Oxygen-Free Monster HDMI Cable' chipka dete hain ki 'Isse picture quality aur colours double sharp ho jayenge!' Sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Mehengi Gold-Plated HDMI cable lagane se TV ke colours zyada bright, blacks zyada gehre aur aawaz zyada clear aati hai.
cards.myth: 24K Gold-Plated HDMI connectors se 4K TV ka HDR contrast aur Dolby Atmos sound zyada crisp ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Digital signal mein 1 aur 0 agar pahunch rahe hain to ₹300 aur ₹5,000 ki cable ke beech **0.00% picture ya sound difference** hota hai (gold plating sirf coastal areas mein connector zang rokne ke liye hoti hai, jo ₹300 wali cables mein bhi aati hai!).

cards.title: ₹2,500 ke Saste Ink-Cartridge Printer ka Jaal: ₹900 ki 100-Page Cartridge vs Ink-Tank!
cards.hook: Bacchon ke school projects ke liye log ₹2,500–₹3,500 ka sasta Inkjet Cartridge Printer kharid laate hain—par 60 pages print hote hi 'Ink Empty!' aur naye black+colour cartridges ₹1,800 ke kyun padte hain?
cards.illusion: ₹2,800 ka cartridge printer lena sasta padta hai kyunki ghar par mahine mein sirf 20–30 pages hi print karne hote hain.
cards.myth: Saste cartridge printer ko mahine mein 1–2 baar hi use karne par uski ink saalon tak chalti rehti hai.
cards.reality: Liquid cartridge nozzles 2–3 hafte band rehne par hi hawa lag kar sookh jaate hain—agar mahine mein kabhi-kabhar print karna hai to **Monochrome Laser Printer** best hai kyunki dry toner powder kabhi nahi sookhta!

cards.title: Sadak/Office mein Padi Mili Anjaan Pendrive Laptop mein Lagana: Malware & USB Power Surge!
cards.hook: Parking, cafe ya office ke bahar ek chamakti hui 64GB Pendrive padi mili—aapne socha 'Kis ki hai dekhne ke liye apne laptop mein laga kar check kar loon!' Ye ek galti poore laptop ko kaise tabah kar sakti hai?
cards.illusion: Jab tak main pendrive ke andar ki kisi `.exe` file par double-click na karun, sirf laptop mein lagane se kuch nahi bigad sakta.
cards.myth: Windows mein AutoPlay band hai matlab anjaan pendrive lagane se bina click kiye kuch nahi ho sakta.
cards.reality: AutoPlay sirf storage files ke liye band hota hai—ek **BadUSB** pendrive khud ko **USB Keyboard** batati hai aur keyboard ko koi AutoPlay nahi rok sakta!

cards.title: Laptop/TV Screen ko Glass Cleaner (Colin) ya Sanitizer se Pochhna: Anti-Glare Coating Galna!
cards.hook: LED TV, laptop ya Monitor par ungliyon ke nishan saaf karne ke liye log khidki saaf karne wala blue 'Colin' spray ya Hand Sanitizer chhidak kar pochh dete hain—par screen par permanent badal jaise dhabbe kyun pad jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Kaanch saaf karne wala Colin spray ya rubbing alcohol kisi bhi TV ya Laptop screen ko bilkul naye jaisa chamka deta hai.
cards.myth: Laptop aur TV ki screen kaanch ki hoti hai isliye khidki wale blue Colin spray aur tissue paper se saaf karna best hai.
cards.reality: TVs/Monitors aksar coated matte polarizers ya anti-reflective glass hote hain—tissue paper micro-scratches karta hai aur Ammonia/Colin protective coating ko ghol kar permanent foggy daag bana deta hai!

cards.title: Internet Slow Lagte hi Plan Upgrade Karwana vs Router Placement + Custom DNS (1.1.1.1)!
cards.hook: 100 Mbps Fiber plan lagwane ke baad bhi web pages aur apps khulne mein 3–4 second atakte hain—to log 300 Mbps plan par upgrade karwa dete hain! Par kya problem bandwidth ki hai ya slow ISP DNS ki?
cards.illusion: Websites khulne mein delay hona hamesha kam Mbps speed ki wajah se hota hai aur 300 Mbps plan lene se har app double fast khulegi.
cards.myth: 300 Mbps plan lene par Social Media, Messaging App aur websites 100 Mbps se 3 guna zyada fast khulengi.
cards.reality: Webpages aur apps sirf kuch KB/MB ke hote hain—unhe kholne ki tezi bandwidth (Mbps) se nahi, balki **Ping/Latency aur DNS Lookup speed** se decide hoti hai!

cards.title: Bedroom mein Signal ke Liye ₹900 ka 'Wi-Fi Repeater' Lagana: Speed 50% Aadhi Kyun Ho Jaati Hai?
cards.hook: Pichhle bedroom mein Wi-Fi na pahunchne par log ₹900 wala wall-plug 'Wi-Fi Range Extender/Repeater' kharid laate hain—par full bars aane ke baad bhi 100 Mbps net 20 Mbps par kyun atakta hai?
cards.illusion: ₹900 ka wall-plug Wi-Fi Repeater lagane se pichhle kamre mein bhi hall jaisi full 100% speed milne lagti hai.
cards.myth: Wi-Fi Repeater ko jahan Wi-Fi bilkul nahi aata (0–1 bar wale kone mein) wahin lagana chahiye.
cards.reality: Repeater khud hawa se signal leta hai—agar aap usse 1 bar wale kamre mein lagayenge to wo usi toote-phootay 1 bar ko repeat karega! Repeater hamesha **strong signal aur dead zone ke beech** lagta hai.

cards.title: 'Smart Speaker / Search/Platform Home 24 Ghante Saari Baatein Record Kar ke Bhejta Hai': Wake-Word vs Human Review Truth!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki ghar mein rakha Smart Speakers (Voice Assistants) speaker chupchap 24 ghante unki saari baatein record kar ke cloud aur ad companies ko bhejta hai—par technical sach aur asli privacy risk kahan hai?
cards.illusion: Smart speakers ghar ki har private baat 24x7 lagatar upload karte hain—isliye hum jo bhi bolte hain usi ke ads dikhte hain.
cards.myth: Social Media Search/Platform Ads aapke phone ya Smart Speaker ke microphone se 24x7 sun kar ads dikhate hain.
cards.reality: Multiple independent packet-sniffing studies mein 24x7 secret audio streaming nahi mili—ads apps ki **Wi-Fi IP linking, location co-occurrence (dost se milna!), aur browsing cookies** se itne accurate dikhte hain!

cards.title: Ghar ka ₹1,500 wala Wi-Fi CCTV Camera Online Websites par Live Dikhna: Default Password Trap!
cards.hook: Shop aur ghar ke living room mein log ₹1,500 wala cheap Wi-Fi CCTV lagwa kar technician ke diye password (`admin / 123456`) par chhod dete hain—par hazaron ghar ke cameras public websites par live kyun dikh rahe hain?
cards.illusion: Jab tak maine apne CCTV app ka link kisi ko share nahi kiya, mere ghar ka camera koi aur nahi dekh sakta.
cards.myth: Mera CCTV camera sirf mere phone ke app se QR scan kar ke juda hai, internet par koi doosra usse dhundh hi nahi sakta.
cards.reality: Agar camera/DVR par default password hai, weak/leaked app password reuse hua hai, ya router ports open hain, to automated scanners minutes mein usse dhoondh kar access kar sakte hain!

cards.title: Bag ya Car mein Chhupa 'AirTag / Bluetooth Tracker': Stalking Alerts & Unknown Tracker Detection!
cards.hook: Kisi ke purse, bike ya car ke bumper ke neeche ek ₹2,500 ka chhota coin-sized 'smartphone/OS maker AirTag / JioTag' chhupa kar koi aapka live location track kar sakta hai! Par aapka apna phone isse kaise pakad sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Agar mere paas smartphone nahi aur main Android chalata hoon, to mere bag mein rakha smartphone/OS maker AirTag mujhe kabhi pata nahi chalega.
cards.myth: AirTag sirf smartphone/OS maker iPhones ko dikhta hai, Android phone par anjaan AirTag pakda hi nahi jaa sakta.
cards.reality: Search/Platform aur smartphone/OS maker ke joint DULT standard ke baad Android phones mein built-in Unknown Tracker Alerts aa chuke hain jo anjaan AirTags ko detect kar ke unki ghanti baja sakte hain!

cards.title: Airport Selfie mein Boarding Pass Barcode Post Karna: PNR Leak se Ticket Cancel & Details Chori!
cards.hook: Vacation ke excitement mein log Social Media Story par coffee cup ke sath apna **Flight Boarding Pass (with PNR & Barcode)** post kar dete hain—par sirf us ek photo se koi aapki wapsi ki ticket cancel kaise kar sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Boarding pass par sirf naam aur seat number hi likha hota hai—barcode mein kuch khaas nahi hota.
cards.myth: Mainne boarding pass par PNR number par ungli rakh li hai aur sirf side ka barcode dikh raha hai to koi nahi padh sakta.
cards.reality: 2D PDF417/Aztec barcodes mein error-correction aur redundant data hota hai—adhoora barcode bhi apps dwara decode ho jaata hai aur usmein PNR likha hota hai!

cards.title: 'Flight Search Karte hi Daam ₹1,500 Badh Gaye': Cookies Myth vs Airline Fare Buckets!
cards.hook: Aapne Delhi-Mumbai flight ₹4,500 mein dekhi, 10 minute baad dobara search ki to ₹5,800 dikhne lagi! Log kehte hain 'Incognito mode kholo, cookies dekh kar airline daam badha deti hai!' Asli karan kya hai?
cards.illusion: Incognito mode mein search karne se hamesha sasti flights milti hain kyunki websites aapki cookies se daam badhati hain.
cards.myth: Incognito Mode mein flight search karne se airlines hamesha ₹1,000–₹2,000 sasta rate dikhati hain.
cards.reality: Studies mein 95%+ cases mein Incognito aur normal browser mein identical airline fare buckets aate hain—price change seats hold hone aur dynamic fare-class inventory ki wajah se hota hai!

cards.title: ₹499 ki Ticket Checkout par ₹850 Ho Jaana: 'Drip Pricing' & 'Basket Sneaking' Dark Patterns!
cards.hook: Movie, food ya flight book karte waqt pehle page par ₹499 likha hota hai—par payment karte waqt ₹199 'Platform/Convenience Fee', ₹49 'Travel Insurance', aur ₹29 'Charity/Tip' chupchap kaise jud jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Checkout page par pehle se tick lage hue Insurance, Charity ya Seat charges lagana zaroori aur mandatory hota hai.
cards.myth: Booking page par 'I accept Travel Insurance / Priority Fee' wala tick pehle se laga hai matlab usse hatane par ticket cancel ho jayegi.
cards.reality: Wo sirf ek illegal 'Basket Sneaking' dark pattern hota hai—uncheck karne ya chhote grey 'Continue without securing' link par click karne par aapki booking bilkul normal hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Sirf 1 Room Bacha Hai / Offer Ends in 02:14!': Shopping Apps ka Fake Scarcity Countdown!
cards.hook: Hotel ya shopping website kholte hi laal rang mein likha aata hai: '14 people looking at this! Only 1 left! Sale ends in 04:59!' Par jab aap page refresh ya kal dobara kholte hain, to wahi timer phir 04:59 se shuru kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Website par chal raha countdown timer aur 'Only 1 Left' warning asli live stock dikha rahi hai.
cards.myth: Big Sale banners par '75% OFF — MRP ₹4,000 Now ₹999' ka matlab hai ki wo cheez saal bhar ₹4,000 ki hi bikti thi.
cards.reality: Online sellers aksar aam ₹999 wali cheez ka MRP paper par ₹4,000 chhaap kar '75% OFF' dikhate hain—**Price History graph** dekhenge to wo pichle 6 mahine se ₹999 ki hi bik rahi thi!

cards.title: 15-Second Reels/Shorts par 2 Ghante Kaise Gayab Ho Jaate Hain? Variable Reward Dopamine Slot Machine!
cards.hook: Aapne sone se pehle sirf '5 minute ke liye 2 Reels' dekhne ke liye phone uthaya—par achanak ghadi mein raat ke 1:30 baj gaye aur aankhein dard ho rahi hain! In apps ko itna addictive kaise banaya jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Reels/Shorts dekhna sirf meri khud ki marzi ka entertainment hai, phone mein koi addictive design nahi hota.
cards.myth: Sone se pehle 30 minute fast Reels/Shorts scroll karne se dimaag relax hokar jaldi neend aati hai.
cards.reality: Tez badalte sounds, blue light aur dopamine spikes dimaag ko alert mode mein rakhte hain—jisse neend aane mein deri hoti hai aur deep REM sleep kharab hoti hai!

cards.title: ChatGPT/AI se Medical Dose ya Legal Case Check Kar ke Aankh Moond kar Maan Lena: 'Confident Hallucination'!
cards.hook: Log ab bukhar ki dawai ka dose, kanooni section ya bank rule AI Chatbot se poochhte hain—aur kyunki AI behad confidence se saaf English/Hindi mein jawab deta hai, log bina check kiye maan lete hain! Par AI kab aur kaise jhooth banata hai?
cards.illusion: AI Chatbots ek giant encyclopedia ki tarah hote hain jo har sawal ka 100% verified aur sachcha jawab hi dete hain.
cards.myth: Agar AI chatbot ne jawab mein kisi kanoon ka section ya research paper ka naam likha hai, to wo 100% asli hoga.
cards.reality: LLMs aksar plausible-looking fake paper titles, fake authors aur non-existent court case numbers bana dete hain—jab tak aap khud open kar ke verify na karein, sach na maanein!

cards.title: video platforms/Social Media Celebrities ka AI Video: '₹21,000 Lagakar Roz ₹50,000 Kamayein!'
cards.hook: Social Media aur video platforms par Ratan vehicle OEM, Sachin Tendulkar, Mukesh Ambani ya Finance Minister ka bilkul asli lagne wala video ad aata hai: 'Is Sarkari AI Quantum Trading App mein ₹21,000 lagao aur mahine ke ₹5 Lakh kamao!' Asliyat kya hai?
cards.illusion: Video mein bade businessman khud bol rahe hain aur News reputed appliance brand interview le rahi hai matlab ye trading platform 100% asli aur government-backed hai.
cards.myth: video platforms aur Social Media paise dekar chalne wale 'Sponsored' ads pehle check ho kar aate hain isliye wo fake nahi ho sakte.
cards.reality: Platforms par hazaron fake/hacked pages se daily automated deepfake scam ads run hote hain jab tak users report na karein—Sponsored Ad ka matlab Verified/Safe bilkul nahi hota!

cards.title: SMS par 'Traffic Challan ₹500 Pending — Download eChallan.apk': Official `.gov.in` vs Malware APK!
cards.hook: Messaging App ya SMS par aapki gaadi ke number jaisa message aata hai: 'Traffic Rule Violation Challan ₹500 Pending — Pay Immediately via mParivahan_Challan.apk!' Download karte hi bank khali kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: SMS mein Traffic Police aur mParivahan ka naam aur logo hai matlab challan check karne ke liye bheji file download karni chahiye.
cards.myth: SMS mein meri gaadi ka sahi number ya chalan date likha hai matlab wo pakka RTO/Police ka hi message hai.
cards.reality: Public vehicle/RC details ya random guessing se message bheja jaa sakta hai—lekin Traffic Police kabhi `.apk` file ya `.com/.xyz` link nahi bhejti!

cards.title: 'Aapka Bijli Meter Aaj Raat 9:30 Baje Kat Jayega, Is Number par Call Karein' SMS: Classic Phishing!
cards.hook: Shaam 6 baje SMS aata hai: 'Dear Consumer, Your Electricity Power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 PM because previous month bill was not updated. Immediately call our Electricity Officer 98xxxxxxx.' Iske aage kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Raat 9:30 baje bijli katne ke dar se turant diye gaye mobile number par call kar ke bill update kara lena samajhdari hai.
cards.myth: SMS mein bill update na hone ki baat likhi hai isliye ek baar diye number par call kar ke poochhne mein kya burai hai.
cards.reality: Scammers psychology ke expert hote hain—call karte hi wo itne official tone aur pressure mein baat karte hain ki bahut se samajhdar log bhi unke link/app jaal mein phans jaate hain! Call hi mat karein.

cards.title: OLX par Sofa/Bike Bechte Waqt 'Fauji Officer' ka QR Scan Scam: Paise Lene mein PIN Nahi Lagta!
cards.hook: OLX/Quikr par purana fridge ya bike bechne ka ad daalte hi 5 minute mein call aata hai: 'Main Army Officer hoon, bina bargain ke poora paisa abhi bhej raha hoon—bas ₹10,000 lene ke liye ye QR code scan kar ke PIN daalo!' Kaise bachna hai?
cards.illusion: QR code scan kar ke ya 'Pay' request accept kar ke UPI PIN daalne se saamne wale se mere account mein paise aa jaate hain.
cards.myth: Buyer ne Messaging App par apna Aadhaar aur Army ID card ki photo bheji hai matlab wo bilkul genuine buyer hai.
cards.reality: Scammers kisi aur ke chori kiye hue Aadhaar aur online edit kiye fake Army ID cards bhejte hain—document photo kisi ki sacchai ka saboot nahi hoti!

cards.title: Raat ko Anjaan Ladki ka Messaging App Video Call -> 'Cyber Police / video platforms Upload' Blackmail: Kaise Rokein!
cards.hook: Raat 11 baje anjaan number se Messaging App/Social Media Video Call aata hai—uthate hi screen par ek nude video chalti hai aur 5 second baad ek fake 'Delhi Cyber Police / video platforms Threat' bhej kar ₹50,000 ki blackmail shuru ho jaati hai! Kya karein?
cards.illusion: Agar mainne 5 second ka video call utha liya aur blackmailer ne mera screenshot le liya, to paise dekar video delete karwana hi ekmatra rasta hai.
cards.myth: Ek baar blackmailer ko ₹10,000–₹20,000 de dene par wo 'Sorry bhai' bol kar meri video hamesha ke liye delete kar dega.
cards.reality: Cyber police records ke mutabik blackmailers paise milne ke baad kabhi delete nahi karte—wo 'Delete Fee', 'video platforms Server Fee', aur 'Fake Police Settlement' ke naam par 5x–10x aur paisa nikaalte rehte hain!

cards.title: 'TCS/IndiGo/Airport Job Guarantee — ₹2,500 Uniform/Registration Fee Bhejo': Fake Offer Letter Scam!
cards.hook: Job portals ya Messaging App par kisi badi company (TCS, Indigo Airlines, online shopping/delivery app, vehicle OEM) ka fake HR call aur PDF Offer Letter aata hai—bas joining se pehle ₹2,500 'Document Verification / Laptop Deposit' maanga jaata hai! Sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Offer letter par company ka logo, HR signature aur meri exact salary likhi hai matlab ₹2,500 refundable deposit dene par pakki naukri mil jayegi.
cards.myth: Offer letter mein mera naam, Aadhaar aur official company ka GST/CIN number likha hai matlab wo genuine HR letter hai.
cards.reality: Kisi bhi company ka CIN/GST Search engine par public hota hai—scammers 2 minute mein Word/graphic design par logo chipka kar fake PDF offer letter bana lete hain!

cards.title: Matrimony/Social Media Foreign Doctor/NRI Dost -> 'Crypto/Gold Trading karo' Scam: Pig Butchering!
cards.hook: Shaadi.com, Bumble ya Social Media ek handsome/rich NRI Doctor ya London Businessperson aapse hafton tak meethi baatein karta hai—aur phir dheere se apne uncle ke secret 'Gold/USDT Crypto Trading App' par invest karne ko kehta hai! Ye kya hai?
cards.illusion: Wo roz video/text par care dikhate hain aur apne personal profit screenshots bhej rahe hain matlab ye sachcha pyaar aur side-income hai.
cards.myth: Scammers sirf 1–2 din mein jaldi paise maangte hain—jo insaan 2 mahine tak roz baatein kare aur kabhi paise na maange wo scammer nahi ho sakta.
cards.reality: Pig Butchering gangs ka poora business model hi **1–3 mahine ka patience aur emotional grooming** hai taaki bada amount (₹10–₹50 Lakh) nikala jaa sake!

cards.title: 'Aapke ₹8,450 Reward Points Aaj Expire Ho Rahe Hain, Redeem Link Dabao': Phishing & APK Trap!
cards.hook: Bank jaisa dikhne wala SMS aata hai: 'Congratulations! Your ₹8,940 Bank/Bank Credit Card Reward Points are expiring tonight — Redeem Cash Now at bit.ly/sbi-reward!' Click karte hi kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: SMS mein mere bank ka naam aur ₹8,940 cash milne ki baat hai isliye expire hone se pehle turant redeem kar lena chahiye.
cards.myth: Agar SMS ke sender ID mein 'VM-SBIRWD' ya bank ka short code likha hai, to wo 100% bank ka asli message hai.
cards.reality: Scammers fake sender IDs, compromised bulk-SMS gateways, aur sim-boxes se bank-jaisa header dikha kar phishing links bhej sakte hain—hamesha URL/app khud open kar ke verify karein!

cards.title: +92, +254, +375 jaise Anjaan International Number se 1 Ring Missed Call: 'Wangiri' Callback Scam!
cards.hook: Raat ya dopahar mein kisi ajeeb country code (`+254`, `+375`, `+881`, `+92`) se sirf 1 ring baj kar call kat jaati hai! Curiosity mein aap call back karte hain—par kya aap jaante hain 1-ring callback mein ₹100+/min charge aur job/lottery scams kaise chalte hain?
cards.illusion: Kisi zaroori rishtedar ya foreign office ka call miss ho gaya hoga, ek baar call back kar ke poochhne mein sirf normal call rate lagega.
cards.myth: Mera unlimited free calling recharge hai matlab kisi bhi missed call par call back karne par ₹0 extra lagega.
cards.reality: Unlimited calling plans sirf Indian (`+91`) numbers ke liye hote hain—international (`+254`, `+881` etc.) numbers par callback karne par alag balance ya heavy postpaid ISD charges lagte hain!

cards.title: Fake Legal Notice Messaging App PDF: 'Aap par Arrest Warrant Nikla Hai, Paisa Bhejo' — RBI Recovery Rules!
cards.hook: Loan apps ya fake recovery agents Messaging App par ek lal stamp wala 'High Court / Police Arrest Warrant PDF' bhej kar dhamki dete hain ki '2 ghante mein ₹25,000 bhejo warna police ghar aayegi!' Kanoon aur RBI ke rules kya kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Messaging App par aaye 'Court Summons / Arrest Warrant PDF' ka matlab hai ki police 2 ghante mein ghar aakar giraftaar kar legi.
cards.myth: Loan ki 2 EMI late hone par recovery agent ghar ke bahar police laakar turant jail bhej sakta hai.
cards.reality: Loan default civil matter hai (sirf cheque bounce/Section 138 jaise cases mein bhi proper Court Summons process lagta hai—recovery agent ke paas giraftaar karne ya Messaging App par warrant bhejne ka koi adhikar nahi hota!).

cards.title: 'PM Free Laptop / Free 3-Month Recharge — 10 Groups mein Forward Karein' Messaging App Trap!
cards.hook: Messaging App groups mein message aata hai: 'telecom network/Modi Yojana ki taraf se 3 mahine ka FREE 5G Recharge ya Free Laptop mil raha hai—link par click kar ke 10 doston ko forward karein!' Kya kabhi kisi ko free recharge mila hai?
cards.illusion: Mere dost ne Messaging App par forward kiya hai aur neeche comments mein 50 logon ne 'Thank you, mujhe mil gaya!' likha hai matlab ye scheme sachchi hai.
cards.myth: Website par neeche 20 logon ke Social Media comments mein likha hai 'Thanks, mera recharge abhi aaya!' isliye ye sach hai.
cards.reality: Wo Social Media comments widget nahi, balki scammer ke dwara banayi gayi fake static HTML photo/script hoti hai jo har visitor ko wahi fake comments dikhati hai!

cards.title: Search engine par 'Bank NetBanking' Search Kar ke Pehle 'Sponsored' Ad par Click Karna: Clone Bank Login!
cards.hook: Laptop ya phone par aapne Search/Platform mein 'Bank NetBanking' ya 'EPFO Login' search kiya aur sabse upar aaye pehle result par click kar diya—par wo result ek paid 'Sponsored' phishing site tha jo bilkul bank jaisa dikhta tha! Kaise bachein?
cards.illusion: Search/Platform Search ke page par sabse upar aane wala pehla result hamesha sabse official aur 100% asli website hoti hai.
cards.myth: Browser ke address bar mein chhota Tala (🔒 HTTPS Lock) bana hai matlab ye website 100% asli aur government/bank verified hai.
cards.reality: 🔒 Lock icon sirf itna batata hai ki website aur aapke beech data encrypted hai—aaj har scammer ki fake phishing website par bhi free SSL 🔒 lock laga hota hai! Hamesha **exact Domain Name** padhein.

cards.title: Phone Chori Hote hi Sirf SIM Band Karwana Kaafi Nahi: `ceir.gov.in` par IMEI Block & Remote Wipe!
cards.hook: Bheed mein phone chori hote hi log sirf SIM block karwa kar naya SIM le aate hain—par chor Wi-Fi par ya doosra SIM daal kar aapka phone aur apps kaise chala sakta hai, aur Bharat Sarkar ka `ceir.gov.in` kya karta hai?
cards.illusion: SIM card block karwa dene se chori hua phone kisi kaam ka nahi rehta aur mera data apne aap safe ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Mere phone par tight fingerprint/screen lock laga hai matlab chor mera SIM nikaal kar bhi mere bank OTPs nahi le sakta.
cards.reality: Agar aapne **SIM PIN Lock** ON nahi kiya hai, to chor pin se aapka SIM nikaal kar apne khule phone mein daal kar aapke number ke saare SMS OTPs padh sakta hai!

cards.title: Purana Phone OLX/Dukaan par Bechte Waqt Sirf Photos Delete Karna vs Encrypted Factory Reset!
cards.hook: Naya phone kharidne par log purana Android/smartphone exchange ya OLX par bech dete hain—kuch log sirf Gallery se photos delete aur Messaging App uninstall karte hain! Par data-recovery software se purane deleted photos wapas kaise nikal aate hain?
cards.illusion: Gallery aur Messaging App se photos delete kar ke Trash khali kar dene par phone se saara personal data hamesha ke liye mit jaata hai.
cards.myth: Gallery aur 'Recently Deleted' folder khali kar ke saari apps uninstall kar dene se bilkul Factory Reset jaisi safai ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Manual delete se browser tokens, cached thumbnails, SD card fragments aur unencrypted pointers reh sakte hain—complete **Factory Data Reset** (after Search/Platform/iCloud logout) hi surakshit hai!

cards.title: 'Meri Photos Search/Platform Photos/iCloud mein Safe Hain': Sync-Delete Trap vs True 3-2-1 Backup!
cards.hook: Phone ki storage bharne par log sochte hain 'Search/Platform Photos / iCloud par toh saari photos hain hi!' aur phone gallery se delete maar dete hain—par achanak Cloud se bhi saari 5 saal ki photos gayab kyun ho jaati hain?
cards.illusion: Cloud Sync (iCloud/OneDrive/Search/Platform Photos) ek permanent safe locker hai—phone se delete karne par bhi cloud mein copy bachi rehti hai.
cards.myth: iCloud ya OneDrive mein photos upload ho gayi hain matlab ab phone ki gallery se normal 'Delete' dabane par bhi wo cloud mein safe rahengi.
cards.reality: iCloud aur OneDrive two-way sync hain—phone se normal delete dabate hi cloud se bhi photo delete ho jaati hai!

cards.title: Office/College Wi-Fi par Incognito Mode mein Private Search: Router Logs & Employer Visibility!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki Office laptop ya Hostel Wi-Fi par Web Browser mein 'Incognito / Private Window' khol kar kuch bhi search karne se koi dekh nahi sakta—par IT Admin aur ISP ko kya-kya dikhta hai?
cards.illusion: Incognito Mode on karne ke baad internet par aap bilkul invisible ho jaate hain aur Wi-Fi malik ya employer kuch nahi dekh sakta.
cards.myth: Incognito Mode aapke IP address ko chhupa deta hai aur ISP/Office Wi-Fi ko aapki visited websites nahi dikhtin.
cards.reality: Incognito IP address nahi chhupata aur na hi router/ISP DNS queries ko block karta hai—ye sirf aapke local device par history/cookies save hone se rokta hai!

cards.title: TWS Earbuds ko Hamesha 100% Case mein Rakhna: Tiny Lithium Cells 1.5 Saal mein Dead Kyun?
cards.hook: ₹2,000–₹15,000 ke wireless Bluetooth earbuds (wireless earbuds/Boat/smartphone brand) 1.5 se 2 saal mein sirf 20 minute chal kar band kyun ho jaate hain—jabki phone ki battery 4 saal chalti hai?
cards.illusion: TWS Earbuds chhote hote hain par unki battery bilkul phone ki tarah 4–5 saal tak full backup deti hai.
cards.myth: ₹15,000 wale flagship TWS earbuds mein company 4–5 saal mein battery replace kar deti hai ya unki battery phone jaisi lambi chalti hai.
cards.reality: Almost sabhi glue-sealed TWS earbuds mein battery repairable nahi hoti (service center poora bud replace karta hai) aur tiny cells ki wajah se 1.5–2.5 saal mein backup adha ho jaata hai!

cards.title: ANC Headphones Lagate hi Kaan mein 'Hawai Jahaz Jaisa Dabav': Acoustic Illusion vs Safe Volume!
cards.hook: Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) headphones pehante hi bina kisi hawa ke bhi kaan mein hawai jahaz mein baithne jaisa bhaari dabav (Eardrum Suck) kyun lagta hai—aur kya ANC kaan ko nuksan pahunchata hai?
cards.illusion: ANC headphones kaan ke andar vacuum pressure banate hain jisse kaan ka parda andar khinch kar kharab ho sakta hai.
cards.myth: ANC headphones kaan ke parde par pressure daal kar sunne ki shakti kharab karte hain.
cards.reality: Audiologists ne confirm kiya hai ki ANC koi physical air pressure nahi banata—ulta noisy jagah par lower volume par sunne mein madad kar ke kaanon ki **raksha** karta hai!

cards.title: Induction par Bartan Rakhte hi 'E0' Error Aana: Ferromagnetic Base Test with Fridge Magnet!
cards.hook: Naya Induction Cooktop laakar uspe sabhi purane Steel, Copper aur Aluminium ke bartan rakhte hi screen par 'E0 / E1' beep bajne lagti hai aur chai garam hi nahi hoti! Kaun sa steel kaam karta hai aur kaun sa nahi?
cards.illusion: Har Stainless Steel ka bartan Induction stove par kaam karta hai, sirf glass aur plastic nahi chalte.
cards.myth: Induction cooktop par 'Induction Adapter Steel Plate' rakh kar uspe Aluminium ki kadhai chalana utna hi fast aur safe hota hai.
cards.reality: Adapter plate khud 400°C laal garam hokar induction ke glass top ko crack aur overheat kar sakti hai aur 40% bijli waste karti hai—direct magnetic-base bartan use karna hi best hai!

cards.title: Band Bathroom ke Andar LPG Gas Geyser Lagwana: Silent Carbon Monoxide (CO) Behoshi & Maut!
cards.hook: Sardiyon mein bijli bachane ke liye log chhote band bathroom ke andar hi **LPG Gas Geyser** lagwa lete hain—par har sardiyon mein newspaper mein 'Bathroom mein nahate waqt behoshi aur maut' ki khabrein kyun aati hain?
cards.illusion: Gas Geyser ko chhote bathroom ke andar lagane se sirf garam paani jaldi aata hai, khidki-ventilator band rakhne se kuch nahi hota.
cards.myth: Gas Geyser ki gas jab leak hoti hai tab humein badbu se pata chal jaata hai, isliye chुपचाप behosh hone ka khatra nahi.
cards.reality: Kachchi LPG mein badbu (Mercaptan) hoti hai, par geyser chalne par kam oxygen se banne wali **Carbon Monoxide (CO) bilkul 100% GANDH-HEEN (Odorless)** hoti hai—aapko bilkul pata nahi chalta!

cards.title: Sardi mein Band Kamre mein Jalte Koile ya Red-Coil Heater Chhodna: Oxygen & CO Hazard vs Oil Heater!
cards.hook: North India ki December–January ki thand mein log darwaza-khidki band kar ke kamre mein saste ₹800 wale Laal Coil/Halogen Heater ya Koile ki Angeethi jala kar so jaate hain—subah tak isse ghutan, dry nose aur jaanlewa haadse kyun hote hain?
cards.illusion: Band kamre mein Angeethi ya Red-Hot Coil Heater raat bhar chala kar sone se sirf garmi milti hai, koi khatra nahi hota.
cards.myth: Blower aur Halogen electric heater kamre ki saari Oxygen jala kar khatam kar dete hain.
cards.reality: Electric heaters kuch jalate nahi (wo sirf bijli se coil garam karte hain isliye Oxygen khatam nahi hoti—wo sirf **hawa ko dry aur fire hazard** banate hain!). Asli Oxygen-killer aur CO-maker **Koila, Lakdi, aur Unvented Gas Heaters** hote hain!

cards.title: Normal 1200cc Car/Bike mein ₹10 Mehnga 'High-Octane 95 Petrol' Dalwana: Engine Compression Sach!
cards.hook: Petrol pump attendant bolta hai 'Sir Normal nahi, 95-Octane Petrol / Speed Power Petrol dalwao, mileage aur pickup 20% badh jayega!' Par kya normal low-compression hatchback/bike mein 95-Octane petrol sachmuch zyada power deta hai?
cards.illusion: 95-Octane ya 100-Octane Power Petrol mein zyada energy hoti hai isliye wo kisi bhi normal car/scooter ka mileage aur speed badha deta hai.
cards.myth: 95-Octane aur 100-Octane petrol normal petrol se zyada shuddh aur zyada mileage dene wala hota hai.
cards.reality: High-octane petrol mein shuddhata ya energy zyada nahi hoti—wo sirf high-compression/turbo engines mein pre-ignition (knocking) rokne ke liye slow-burn formula hota hai!

cards.title: Highway par 4 Ghante Car AC 'Recirculation Mode' par Drive Karna: CO2 Buildup & Jhapki!
cards.hook: Lambi highway drive par log thandak bachane ke liye car AC ka 'Recirculate (U-turn arrow)' button hamesha ON rakhte hain—par 2 ghante baad driver ko bhaari neend (jhapki) aur sar bhaari kyun lagne lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Highway par AC ko hamesha Recirculation Mode par band rakhna best hai taaki bahar ki hawa andar na aaye.
cards.myth: Car AC ka Fresh Air mode on karne par saari bahar ki garmi andar aa jaati hai aur AC kaam karna band kar deta hai.
cards.reality: Fresh Air mode mein bahar ki hawa AC cooling coil se thandi hokar hi andar aati hai—bas thoda zyada cooling load padta hai, isliye highway par har 45 min mein 5–10 min on karne se thandak bhi rehti hai aur Oxygen bhi!

cards.title: Baarish aur Kohre (Fog) mein Car ki Charon Indicator (Hazard) Lights Jala kar Chalana: Lane Confusion!
cards.hook: Tez baarish ya sardiyon ke ghane kohre (fog) mein highway par aadhe drivers charon blinkers (Hazard Lights) jala kar gaadi chalate hain—par traffic police aur road safety experts isse sabse khatarnak galti kyun kehte hain?
cards.illusion: Baarish aur fog mein Hazard Lights (charon indicators) jala kar chalane se peeche wali gaadi ko aap zyada safe aur door se dikhte hain.
cards.myth: Tez baarish aur kohre mein charon indicators (Hazard) jalane se piche wali gaadiyon ko door se warning milti hai aur police bhi khush rehti hai.
cards.reality: Traffic police kai states mein chalti gaadi par hazard light misuse par challan aur warning deti hai—kyunki ye stationary-car signal hai aur chalti car ke turn indicators ko disable kar deta hai!

cards.title: Bike Kharidte Waqt 'Single-Channel ABS' vs 'Dual-Channel ABS': Geeli Sadak par Pahiya Fisalna!
cards.hook: 150cc–200cc bike kharidte waqt ₹5,000–₹8,000 bachane ke liye log 'Single-Channel ABS' (ya bina ABS wala sasta model) le aate hain—par emergency brake maarne par Dual-Channel ABS kaise jaan bachata hai?
cards.illusion: Sirf aage ke pahiye mein ABS (Single-Channel) hona kaafi hai—peeche ke pahiye mein ABS ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
cards.myth: Bike ke ABS se rukne ki doori (Braking Distance) kam hone ke bajaye badh jaati hai, aur expert riders ABS se jaldi ruk sakte hain.
cards.reality: Real-world panic situations (baarrish/ret/achanak obstacle) mein IIHS aur reputed appliance brand tests mein ABS riders non-ABS experts se **kam doori mein aur bina gire** rukte hain!

cards.title: EV Car/Scooter ko Roz DC Fast Charger par Lagana vs Ghar ke AC Charger: Battery Degradation Sach!
cards.hook: Highway ke 60kW DC Fast Chargers par 40 minute mein EV full ho jaati hai—isliye log ghar par slow charging ki jagah roz DC fast charging karne lagte hain! Par kya roz DC Fast Charging battery ki umar ghata deti hai?
cards.illusion: EV ko rozana 100% DC Fast Charger se charge karne aur ghar ke slow AC charger se charge karne mein battery par bilkul koi farq nahi padta.
cards.myth: Highway trip par agar 2 baar DC fast charger laga liya to EV ki battery kharab hokar warranty khatam ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: Modern liquid-cooled EVs (aur LFP packs) highway DC fast charging ke liye hi design hoti hain—sirf *roz-roz* 100% DC charging avoid kar ke ghar ka AC charger primary rakhna chahiye!

cards.title: ₹25,000 ki '9H Ceramic Coating' vs ₹1,000 Wax vs PPF: Pathar ke Scratch aur Dhokhe!
cards.hook: Nayi car showroom se nikalte hi detailing studios ₹25,000–₹40,000 ki '9H Diamond Ceramic Coating' bechte hain aur lighter maar kar dikhate hain ki 'Ab car par koi scratch nahi lagega!' Sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: ₹30,000 ki 9H Ceramic Coating lagwane ke baad bike ke handle, key-scratch, aur highway ke pattharon se car par bilkul scratch nahi padta.
cards.myth: '9H Pencil Hardness' ka matlab hai ki Ceramic Coating 9H patthar aur chabi ke scratch se car ko 100% bacha leti hai.
cards.reality: Detailers ka '9H' pencil hardness scale (jo 9H graphite pencil test hota hai, Mohs diamond scale nahi!) sirf 2-micron film ki surface hardness hai—chabi, naakhun, ya gande kapde ki ret use aasani se scratch kar deti hai!

cards.title: Service Center ka '₹1,200 Engine Flush + Fuel Additive' Upsell: Kab Zaroori aur Kab Engine Seal Nuksan!
cards.hook: Car ya Bike ki regular service par advisor ₹4,000 ke bill mein ₹1,200 ka 'Engine Oil Flush, Throttle Body Spray, aur AC Disinfectant' chupchap jod deta hai—kya ye sachmuch zaroori hote hain?
cards.illusion: Har 10,000 km service par chemical Engine Flush aur Oil Additives dalwane se engine naya ho jaata hai aur mileage badhta hai.
cards.myth: Authorized service center wala agar Job Card mein Engine Flush aur Additives likh raha hai, to wo company ki warranty ke liye mandatory hai.
cards.reality: Kai car companies khud apne Owner's Manual mein likhti hain: **'Do NOT use engine oil additives or chemical flushes!'** Warranty sirf manual mein likhe oil/filter changes se valid rehti hai.

cards.title: Dead Car Battery ko Jumper Cable se Start Karna: Negative Wire Battery par Lagane se ECU Burn Risk!
cards.hook: Subah car ki battery dead hone par log kisi doosri car se Jumper Cables jod kar start karte hain—par aakhiri Black (Negative) cable ko dead battery ke `-` par lagane ke bajaye car ke unpainted metal part par lagane ko kyun kaha jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Jumper cable mein bas Red ko `+` aur Black ko `-` dono batteries par lagaa kar start kar do—order ya metal ground se koi farq nahi padta.
cards.myth: Automatic (AMT/CVT/AT) car ko bhi purani manual car ki tarah peeche se dhakka lagakar (Push-Start) start kar sakte hain.
cards.reality: Automatic transmission cars mein mechanical engine-to-wheel lock nahi hota—unhe **dhakka maar kar KABHI start nahi kiya jaa sakta** (aur galat tow karne par gearbox kharab ho jaata hai)! Sirf Jumper Cable ya Flatbed tow hi chalta hai.

cards.title: Chhat ki Tanki Over-Flow aur Motor Dry-Run se Jalna: ₹500 ka Automatic Float Switch!
cards.hook: Subah motor chala kar bhool jaane se chhat ki tanki se hazaron litre paani beh jaata hai, ya tanki mein paani na aane par khali motor chal kar ₹4,000 ki winding jal jaati hai! Iska sabse sasta permanent ilaaj kya hai?
cards.illusion: Tanki bharne par alarm bajne wali bell laga dena hi ekmatra tarika hai, automatic cutoff systems bahut mehenge aur kharab hone wale hote hain.
cards.myth: Tanki mein automatic float switch lagane se tanki ke paani mein bijli ka current aa jaata hai.
cards.reality: Quality **Sealed PVC Ball Float Switches** (ya low-voltage 12V relay controllers) 100% waterproof double-insulated hote hain—paani ko koi nanga taar chhoota hi nahi hai!

cards.title: 'UV Blue Light Mosquito Killer Lamp' Kamre mein Lagana: Asli Machhar Nahi, Parwane Marta Hai!
cards.hook: Online ₹400–₹1,200 mein USB wali neeli light ki 'Mosquito Killer Trap Lamp' milti hai—kamre mein raat bhar jalane par neeche tray mein dher keede marte hain, par aapko phir bhi machhar kyun kaat-te hain?
cards.illusion: UV blue light machine kamre ke saare Dengue aur Malaria machharon ko aakarshit kar ke maar deti hai.
cards.myth: Neeli UV light kamre mein jalane se sabhi machhar uske paas khinche chale aate hain aur all-out ki zaroorat nahi padti.
cards.reality: Biting female mosquitoes insaan ki **CO2 breath aur body heat** ko chase karti hain—UV light unhe lagbhag bilkul attract nahi karti!

cards.title: ₹400 ka 'Ultrasonic Plug-In Chuha/Machhar Bhagao Device': Scientific Studies mein 0% Asar!
cards.hook: Online aur TV ads mein ₹399 ka chhota sa socket-plug becha jaata hai: 'Bas wall socket mein lagao, iski Ultrasonic aawaz se 48 ghante mein saare Chuhe, Cockroach aur Chipkali ghar chhod kar bhaag jayenge!' Sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Ultrasonic plug-in device high-frequency sound waves chhodta hai jo deewaron ke paar jakar chuhon aur cockroaches ko bhaga deti hain.
cards.myth: Ultrasonic machine ki aawaz insaan ko sunai nahi deti par poore ghar ki deewaron ke andar se saare chuhe-machhar bhaga deti hai.
cards.reality: High-frequency sound waves wooden cabinets, beds aur walls ko paar hi nahi kar paatin, aur university tests mein chuhe aur machhar inpar bilkul react nahi karte!

cards.title: ₹18,000 ke Saste TV par '4K HDR10+ Dolby Vision' Sticker: 250 Nits Brightness par Fake HDR!
cards.hook: Budget 43-inch Smart TVs ke box par bade badges lage hote hain: '4K HDR10, Dolby Vision, 1 Billion Colours!' Par jab aap OTT/streaming service par koi dark movie chalate hain, to sab kuch kaala aur dhundhla kyun dikhta hai?
cards.illusion: Box par 'HDR10 / Dolby Vision Supported' likha hai matlab ₹18,000 wala TV bilkul ₹80,000 wale OLED/Mini-LED TV jaisa HDR dikhayega.
cards.myth: TV par 'Dolby Vision & Dolby Atmos' ka logo chhapa hai matlab TV khud bina soundbar ke 3D theatre sound aur cinema HDR dega.
cards.reality: Budget TVs mein ye logos sirf **software decoding license** hote hain—physical 250-nit backlight aur 20W tiny TV speakers physical HDR ya Atmos surround nahi bana sakte!

cards.title: ₹1,500 ke Bluetooth Party Speaker par '10,000W PMPO!': Asli RMS Wattage Math!
cards.hook: Local market aur online ₹1,500 ke chhote home-theatre/tower speaker ke box par bade aksharon mein '10,000W PMPO' likha hota hai—par jab ghar par bajao to phone se thodi si hi tez aawaz aati hai! PMPO kya dhokha hai?
cards.illusion: 10,000W PMPO wala ₹1,500 speaker ek ₹15,000 ke 100W RMS branded speaker se 100 guna zyada tez bajega.
cards.myth: 100W RMS aur 100W PMPO ek hi baat hai—bas do alag companies alag naam likhti hain.
cards.reality: RMS असली continuous electrical power hai, jabki PMPO ek unregulated marketing gimmick number hai jo aksar asli RMS se **20x se 500x badha-chadha kar** likha jaata hai!

cards.title: 'Air Fryer mein Khane se Cancer aur Radiation Hota Hai' Myth: Mini Convection Oven Physics!
cards.hook: Messaging App par message aata hai ki 'Air Fryer bhi Microwave jaisa radiation chhodta hai aur usmein samosa-fries pakane se Cancer hota hai!' Kya Air Fryer mein koi radiation hota hai?
cards.illusion: Air Fryer kisi ajeeb radiation wave se khana pakata hai aur deep-frying (kadhai mein talne) se zyada cancer-causing chemicals banata hai.
cards.myth: Air Fryer mein tel na daalne par bhi uski dangerous electromagnetic rays khane ko toxic bana deti hain.
cards.reality: Air Fryer mein koi electromagnetic waves nahi hotin—ye bilkul wahi normal electric heater rod aur pankha hai jo bakery ovens aur OTG mein 50 saal se use ho raha hai!

cards.title: 'Dishwasher Indian Bartan Saaf Nahi Karta aur Bijli-Paani Khata Hai' Myth: 10L vs 45L Hand Wash!
cards.hook: Log sochte hain ki 'Dishwasher sirf kaanch ke plate-spoon ke liye hai—hamare haldi-masale wale Indian cooker-kadhai saaf nahi karega aur 10x bijli-paani khayega!' Asli engineering data kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Haath se bartan dhone mein kam paani lagta hai, jabki Dishwasher bahut saara paani aur bijli kharch karta hai aur steel kadhai saaf nahi kar sakta.
cards.myth: Dishwasher chalane mein mahine ka ₹3,000 bijli bill aur tanki ka aadha paani khatam ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: 1 full cycle sirf ~10–12 Litre paani (haath dhone se 4x KAM!) aur ~1.1 Unit bijli (~₹8–₹10/cycle, yaani ~₹300/month!) leta hai.

cards.title: Vacuum Cleaner mein '20,000 Pa Suction' Hype vs Sealed HEPA Filter & Bed Dust-Mite Removal!
cards.hook: Online vacuum cleaners par '20,000 Pa Ultra Suction!' likha hota hai—par ghar mein dust allergy wale patients ke liye bina Sealed HEPA filter ke vacuum chalane se dhool kamre mein aur zyada kyun udti hai?
cards.illusion: Jitna zyada kPa suction power box par likha ho, wo vacuum cleaner ghar ki allergy dhool ko utna hi saaf kar deta hai.
cards.myth: ₹2,000 ka hand-held car vacuum '15,000 Pa Suction' ke sath ghar ke carpets aur gaddon ke saare dust mites nikaal deta hai.
cards.reality: Static kPa number bina high Airflow (CFM) aur spinning Motorized Brush ke sirf kagaz ki dhool utha sakta hai—carpet aur mattress ke andar ke fibres saaf nahi kar sakta!

cards.title: Geyser Thermostat ko 75°C Max par Rakhna vs 55°C–60°C Sweet Spot: Bijli Bachat & Safety!
cards.hook: Geyser mein log temperature dial ko full 75°C par set kar ke 24 ghante ON chhod dete hain—is se bijli bill kitna badhta hai, khare paani ki white papdi (Scaling) kitni jamti hai, aur sahi thermostat number kya hai?
cards.illusion: Geyser ka thermostat full high (75°C) par rakhne se paani jaldi garam hota hai aur bijli barabar hi lagti hai.
cards.myth: Geyser ka temperature dial 75°C Max par rakhne se subah paani aadhe time mein garam ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Thermostat sirf cut-off temperature set karta hai, heating speed nahi—2,000W rod paani ko 50°C tak hamesha ek hi speed se garam karti hai; 75°C sirf extra ubal, scaling aur bill badhata hai!

cards.title: 180 sq ft Kamre mein Sasta '1 Ton AC' Lagwana: Bijli Bachne ke Bajaye Compressor 100% Chal Kar Bill Badhna!
cards.hook: Bijli aur ₹5,000 bachane ke liye log bade 180–200 sq ft bedroom (ya top-floor dhoop wale kamre) mein chhota '1 Ton AC' lagwa lete hain—par unka bijli bill 1.5 Ton AC se bhi ZYADA kyun aata hai?
cards.illusion: Chhote 1 Ton AC ki motor chhoti hoti hai isliye wo bade kamre mein bhi 1.5 Ton AC se kam bijli khayega.
cards.myth: 1 Ton AC hamesha 1.5 Ton AC se kam bijli kharch karta hai chahe kamra kitna bhi bada ho.
cards.reality: Inverter AC mein ek undersized 1 Ton machine 100% load par lagatar chal kar ek half-load par cruise karne wale 1.5 Ton AC se **zyada bijli aur kam cooling** deti hai!

cards.title: Single-Door Fridge ke Freezer mein Jami Barf ko Chaku se Khodna: Gas Pipe Puncture!
cards.hook: Single-door fridge ke freezer box mein jab barf ka pahad jam jaata hai, to ghar mein log Chaku (Knife) ya Screwdriver lekar barf khod kar nikaalne lagte hain—par ek 'PHISSS!' aawaz ke baad poora fridge kyun mar jaata hai?
cards.illusion: Freezer ka metal box bahut mazboot hota hai isliye chaku ya pechkas se barf tod kar nikaalne mein koi nuksan nahi.
cards.myth: Freezer mein jitni zyada moti barf jami rehti hai, fridge utna hi zyada thanda rehta hai.
cards.reality: Ulta hota hai! Barf ek **Insulator** ki tarah kaam karti hai—1 inch barf jamne par freezer niche fridge mein thandak nahi bhej paata aur compressor lagatar chal kar bijli bill badhata hai!

cards.title: '120W Charger se 20W Phone Charge Karne par Phone Phat Jaata Hai' Myth: USB-PD Handshake!
cards.hook: Travel mein dost ka 65W Laptop Type-C charger ya 100W fast charger laga kar apna 20W smartphone charge karne se log darte hain ki 'High Wattage se mera phone jal jayega!' Asli USB-C electronics kya karti hai?
cards.illusion: 65W ya 100W ka charger jabardasti 100W bijli aapke 20W phone ke andar thons kar battery jala deta hai.
cards.myth: Agar phone ka charger 18W ka hai aur aapne 65W charger laga diya, to 65W current ghus kar battery phula dega.
cards.reality: Current aur wattage **Load (Phone) ke hisab se negotiate** hota hai—USB-PD 65W charger ek 20W phone ko sirf 20W (aur 2W earbuds ko sirf 2W!) hi bhejta hai.

cards.title: Bike Handlebar par Phone Lagane se Camera OIS Kharab Hona: High-Frequency Vibration Damage!
cards.hook: Delivery riders aur bike tourers ₹400 ke metal clamp holder mein apna ₹50,000 ka smartphone/smartphone brand handlebar par lagate hain—par 2 mahine baad camera kholte hi tasveer hill kar wave kyun maarne lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Bike ke handlebar par tight metal mobile holder lagane se sirf phone girne se bachta hai, andar ke camera par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.myth: Jab tak phone handlebar holder se neeche zameen par nahi girta, tab tak bike par lagane se phone ko koi damage nahi hota.
cards.reality: smartphone/OS maker ne officially confirm kiya hai ki high-amplitude/high-frequency motorcycle vibrations phone ke OIS springs aur autofocus magnets ko bina gire hi kharab kar deti hain!

cards.title: Sabhi Type-C Cables Ek Jaisi Nahi Hotin: 480 Mbps USB 2.0 vs 40 Gbps & 240W E-Marker Chips!
