cards.hook: Bahar se bilkul ek jaisi dikhne wali do USB Type-C cables mein ek phone ko 25 minute mein charge kar ke 10GB movie 5 second mein copy karti hai—to doosri mein 2 ghante aur 5 minute kyun lagte hain?
cards.illusion: Sabhi USB Type-C cables ek hi standard ki hoti hain—jo cable port mein lag jaaye wo same speed aur power deti hai.
cards.myth: Agar cable ke dono taraf USB-C pin hai to wo har USB-C monitor, SSD aur 100W laptop charger ko full speed par chala degi.
cards.reality: 90% phone charging Type-C cables mein sirf purani USB 2.0 (480 Mbps) data lines aur zero display pins hoti hain—SSD aur Monitor ke liye 10–40 Gbps cable alag leni padti hai!

cards.title: 'Mera 128GB Phone Slow Ho Gaya Hai': 95% Full Flash Storage & Messaging App Auto-Download Trap!
cards.hook: 1–2 saal baad har ₹25,000 wala phone achanak camera kholne aur typing karne mein 3 second hang kyun hone lagta hai—jabki processor wahi hai? Iske piche 95% bhari storage aur Messaging App Good-Morning videos ka kya haath hai?
cards.illusion: Phone slow hone ka matlab hai company ne update bhej kar phone purana kar diya—bas 'RAM Cleaner' app chalane se speed wapas aa jayegi.
cards.myth: Jab tak screen par 'Storage Full 127.9/128 GB' error na aaye, tab tak 98% bhari storage se phone ki speed par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.reality: Flash storage controllers ko background wear-leveling aur OS cache ke liye free blocks chahiye hote hain—90% bharne ke baad hi write speed tezi se girne lagti hai!

cards.title: Phone par Achanak 100 OTP SMS Aana ('OTP Bombing'): Real Bank Fraud SMS Chhupane ki Chaal!
cards.hook: Achanak aapke phone par 2 minute ke andar online shopping/delivery app, FlipKart, EV two-wheeler, aur random sites ke 100–200 OTP SMS lagatar aane lagte hain—aap irritate hokar phone silent kar dete hain! Par iske piche hacker kya chhupa raha hai?
cards.illusion: Achanak 100 OTP SMS aana sirf kisi dost ka prank ya network server glitch hai, bas phone silent kar ke chhod do.
cards.myth: Achanak 50 alag-alag apps ke OTP aane ka matlab hai bas koi network glitch hai, mera account safe hai.
cards.reality: Sudden OTP/Subscription bombing (Email/SMS bombing) cybercriminals ki ek documented **Distraction Technique** hai jo genuine fraud/order alerts chhupane ke liye use hoti hai!

cards.title: 'Aapka ₹18,450 Income Tax Refund Approved Hai, Bank Verify Karein' SMS: `incometax.gov.in` Check!
cards.hook: ITR filing season ke baad SMS aata hai: 'Income Tax Dept: Your tax refund of ₹18,450 has been approved. Update bank details here to credit immediately!' Click karte hi kya trap chhupa hota hai?
cards.illusion: SMS mein sahi refund ki tarah baat likhi hai aur link par Income Tax India ka blue logo dikhta hai matlab refund lene ke liye card/netbanking verify karna zaroori hai.
cards.myth: Agar mera tax refund delay ho gaya hai, to Income Tax department SMS par link bhej kar dobara bank card verify karwata hai.
cards.reality: ITD refunds sirf portal mein pehle se linked pre-validated bank account mein aate hain—agar kabhi bank fail ho bhi, to aapko **portal par khud login kar ke** refund reissue request dalni hoti hai, SMS link par nahi!

cards.title: Dost ya Anjaan Number se `Shadi_Card.apk` Aana: Kaise Bina Khole 1 Second mein Pakdein!
cards.hook: Shaadi ke season mein Messaging App par message aata hai: 'Welcome! Aap zaroor aayiyega — Wedding_Invitation_Card.apk!' Dost ke number se aane par log turant download kar lete hain—par ye `.apk` file kya hoti hai?
cards.illusion: Mere apne dost ya rishtedar ke Messaging App number se shaadi ka card aaya hai, isliye file khol kar card dekhne mein koi khatra nahi.
cards.myth: File mere sage bhai ya close friend ke Messaging App number se aayi hai matlab usmein virus ho hi nahi sakta.
cards.reality: Yahi malware ki sabse badi taakat hai—ek baar dost ka phone infect hone par virus unke hi Messaging App se sabko card bhejta hai! Hamesha file extension (`.apk` vs `.pdf`) dekhein.

cards.title: 'Aapka FASTag Blacklist Ho Raha Hai, Abhi KYC Update Karein' SMS: Official Bank Portal Rule!
cards.hook: Highway trip se pehle SMS aata hai: 'NHAI Alert: Your FASTag will be blacklisted in 24 hours due to incomplete KYC. Update now at fastag-kyc-update.in!' Asli NHAI rules aur scam kaise alag hain?
cards.illusion: SMS mein 'NHAI Alert' aur FASTag blacklist ki warning hai matlab link khol kar turant ₹10 ya PAN card daal kar KYC update kar leni chahiye.
cards.myth: FASTag Blacklist hone ka SMS aaya hai to link par jakar ₹10 recharge karne se turant active ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Phishing sites ₹10 ke bahane aapka card/UPI OTP lekar ₹50,000+ kaat leti hain—FASTag recharge aur KYC sirf UPI BBPS / Official Bank app se hi karein!

cards.title: Goa/Manali/Ayodhya mein Saste Hotel/Dharamshala Search/Platform Pin Number par 50% Advance UPI Scam!
cards.hook: Tirupati, Ayodhya, Goa ya Manali jaane se pehle Online Maps ek accha hotel/dharamshala dekh kar wahan likhe mobile number par call kiya—rate 40% sasta mila aur ₹3,000 advance UPI maanga gaya! Wahan pahunchne par hotel wala kya kehta hai?
cards.illusion: Online Maps hotel ki photo, 4.7 rating aur wahan likha phone number hamesha usi hotel ke owner ka asli number hota hai.
cards.myth: Online Maps 500 reviews aur 'Verified' dikh raha hai matlab wahan likha phone number 100% owner ka hi hai.
cards.reality: Online Maps unclaimed ya poorly monitored business pins par scammers crowd-sourced edit se apna number chadha dete hain—reviews asli hotel ke hote hain aur phone number scammer ka!

cards.title: 'Free Crypto Airdrop Claim Karo': 12-Word Seed Phrase & Wallet-Drainer Smart Contract Scam!
cards.hook: Cloud Messaging App, Social Media / Chat platforms message aata hai: 'Congratulations! You won $1,500 Free Token Airdrop — Connect Your Wallet to Claim!' Click kar ke sign dabate hi poora crypto wallet 1 second mein khali kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Sirf Web3 wallet connect kar ke ek 'Sign/Approve' button dabane se koi mera crypto nahi nikaal sakta jab tak main khud Transfer na karun.
cards.myth: Jab tak maine 'Send' button nahi dabaya, tab tak website par sirf wallet connect aur 'Approve' sign karne se tokens nahi jaa sakte.
cards.reality: Malicious smart-contract `Approve` / `Permit` signatures hacker ko aapke wallet se khud tokens transfer karne ka legal code-right de dete hain—bina aapke 'Send' dabaye!

cards.title: 'KBC ₹25 Lakh Lottery Won — ₹12,000 Tax/Processing Fee Bhejo' Classic Audio Scam!
cards.hook: Messaging App par Amitabh Bachchan ki photo aur KBC logo wali 4-minute ki audio clip aati hai: 'Badhai ho! Aapka Messaging App number ₹25 Lakh ke KBC Lucky Draw mein chuna gaya hai—Rana Pratap Singh Manager ko call karein!' Kaise kaam karta hai?
cards.illusion: Messaging App audio mein KBC ki asli music tune aur mera sahi phone number lekar badge bana hai matlab ₹12,000 GST bhar kar ₹25 Lakh mil jayenge.
cards.myth: Inam ki raashi ₹25 Lakh par 30% Government Income Tax pehle alag se bank mein jama karwana zaroori hota hai.
cards.reality: Kanoon ke mutabik genuine game shows (jaise asli KBC) TDS prize mein se **khud kaat kar bacha paisa** dete hain—winner ko kabhi apni jeb se advance tax nahi bhejna padta!

cards.title: 'London se Maine Aapke Liye smartphone aur £20,000 Gift Bheja Hai, Customs Fee ₹45,000 Bhejo' Scam!
cards.hook: Social Media ya Matrimony par mile 'Foreign Friend' ne kaha: 'Maine tumhare birthday par London se laptop, Watch aur £20,000 Cash parcel bheja hai!' Agle din 'Delhi Airport Customs Officer' ka call aakar ₹45,000 kyun maangta hai?
cards.illusion: Parcel mein smartphone aur £20,000 cash hai isliye Delhi Customs ko ₹45,000 clearance fee bhejne par ₹20 Lakh ka gift ghar aa jayega.
cards.myth: Mujhe courier website par mera naam, photo aur tracking number live dikh raha hai matlab airport par gift sachmuch aaya hai.
cards.reality: Scammers ₹1,000 mein fake courier tracking sites bana kar usmein koi bhi naam aur photo dikha dete hain—aapko bewakoof banane ke liye!

cards.title: 'Delivery Boy hoon, Order Cancel Karne ke Liye `*401*` ya OTP Bolo': Call Forwarding & Fraud!
cards.hook: Darwaze par ya phone par koi bolta hai: 'Sir aapka e-commerce/courier parcel aaya hai par address galat hai—cancel karne ke liye apne phone par `*401*98xxxxxx` dial kar dijiye ya cancellation OTP bataiye!' Isse kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: Sirf ek delivery cancel code `*401*...` dial karne ya 'Cancel OTP' batane se parcel wapas chala jaata hai, bank par koi asar nahi padta.
cards.myth: Delivery boy ke samne `*401*` dial karne se sirf courier server par delivery cancel hoti hai.
cards.reality: `*401*` Telecom networks ka Call Forwarding code hai—delivery companies ke paas aisa koi USSD dial code hota hi nahi hai!

cards.title: 'Aapka Credit Card Free mein ₹5 Lakh Limit Upgrade & Lifetime Free Ho Raha Hai': CVV/OTP Trap!
cards.hook: Meethi aawaz mein call aata hai: 'Ma'am aapke Bank Credit Card par ₹5 Lakh limit upgrade aur Lifetime-Free offer aaya hai—bas Messaging App par bheje link ya app mein card number aur last OTP verify kar dein!' Asliyat kya hai?
cards.illusion: Caller ko mere credit card ke pehle 4 digits aur mera naam pata hai matlab wo bank ke Credit Card dept se hi call kar rahi hai.
cards.myth: Caller ne mere card ke shuru ke 6 digits aur meri birth date sahi bata di, matlab call 100% bank ke headquarters se hi hai.
cards.reality: Card ke pehle 6 digits bank ke card-type (BIN) se public hote hain aur name/DOB purane third-party data leaks se mil jaate hain—ispar kabhi bharosa na karein!

cards.title: Thermal Paper par Chhape Warranty Bills 3 Mahine mein Gayab Hona: Photo Scan & BPA Hands!
cards.hook: AC, Mixer, ya Shoes ki dukan se mila chikna safed/peela thermal paper bill 4 mahine baad file se nikaalo to poora kagaz bilkul safa-chat (blank) nikalta hai—aur warranty claim reject ho jaata hai! Aisa kyun hota hai?
cards.illusion: Dukan ya mall se mila thermal bill file mein sambhal kar rakhne par 2 saal warranty tak bilkul padhne layak rehta hai.
cards.myth: Thermal paper bill ko transparent plastic file sleeve mein rakhne se uski print 5 saal tak safe rehti hai.
cards.reality: Ulta PVC plastic sleeves ke plasticizers thermal dye ke sath react kar ke print ko **aur tezi se mita** dete hain—sirf digital scan/PDF hi permanent hota hai!

cards.title: Flashlight/Photo Apps ko 'Always Allow Location, Contacts, Mic' Dena: Permission Hygiene!
cards.hook: Naya app kholte hi jaldbazi mein log har pop-up par 'Allow, Allow, Allow!' dabate chale jaate hain—par ek Calculator, Wallpaper ya Flashlight app ko aapke Contacts, Microphone aur Precise Location ki kya zaroorat hai?
cards.illusion: Play Store / App Store ki har app ko kaam karne ke liye saari permissions 'Allow' karna zaroori hota hai.
cards.myth: Agar mainne ek permission par 'Don't Allow' daba diya to poori app chalna band ho jayegi.
cards.reality: Mobile OS platform rules ke mutabik apps ko non-essential permissions deny karne par bhi chalna zaroori hota hai—sirf us specific feature (jaise voice note ke waqt Mic) ko aap 'Only This Time' de sakte hain!

cards.title: Bank/UPI Apps par 'Screen Recording / Accessibility Detected' Error: Remote Trojan Check!
cards.hook: Achanak aapka Bank ya UPI app khulne se mana kar deta hai aur screen par alert aata hai: 'Active Screen Sharing / Accessibility Service / Overlay Detected!' Log isse app ka bug samajh kar ignore kyun kar dete hain?
cards.illusion: Bank app par 'Accessibility / Screen Share Detected' error bas phone ka ek ajeeb technical glitch hai jise bypass karna chahiye.
cards.myth: Bank apps bekaar mein screen-recording error dikha kar pareshan karti hain; kisi third-party mod ya permission bypass se chala lena chahiye.
cards.reality: Ye check aapke paise bachane ke liye RBI security framework ka hissa hai—agar warning bina screen-cast ke aa rahi hai, to phone mein koi risky overlay/accessibility app chal rahi hai!

cards.title: 'Free Music/Video Streaming Mod APK / Paid Game Crack' Download Karna: Hidden Infostealers!
cards.hook: ₹119/month bachane ke liye log Cloud Messaging App ya websites se 'Music/Video Streaming Mod APKs', ya PC par 'Free GTA / paid creative software Crack' download kar lete hain—par kuch din baad Email Inbox, Social Media Crypto kyun hack ho jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Modded APKs aur cracked PC software sirf company ki subscription fees bypass karte hain—dene wale free mein madad ke liye banate hain.
cards.myth: Windows Defender ne crack file chalane par warn kiya par online video mein kaha tha 'Antivirus ko off kar do, ye false positive hai'—to off karna safe hai.
cards.reality: Antivirus band karwa kar file chalwana infostealer attackers ka #1 trick hai—95% baar wo false positive nahi, balki asli password-stealing trojan hota hai!

cards.title: Website par 'Verify Human: Press Win+R & Paste Ctrl+V': Latest 'ClickFix' Malware Trap!
cards.hook: Kisi website ya PDF link ko kholte hi ek bilkul authentic CAPTCHA jaisa box dikhta hai: 'Verify You Are Human — Step 1: Press Windows+R, Step 2: Press Ctrl+V, Step 3: Enter!' Ye ajeeb naya attack kya karta hai?
cards.illusion: Website kholne ke liye authentic CAPTCHA verification maang raha hai, bas keyboard ke 3 buttons dabane se page khul jayega.
cards.myth: Jab tak mainne koi `.exe` file download kar ke run nahi ki, tab tak website par sirf keyboard shortcut dabane se virus nahi aa sakta.
cards.reality: `Win + R` seedhe Windows ka **Run Command Box** kholta hai aur website aapke clipboard mein PowerShell download-and-execute command copy kar chuki hoti hai—`Enter` dabate hi virus bina download click ke run ho jaata hai!

cards.title: Scam Email ke Neeche 'Unsubscribe' Dabana: Real Newsletter vs Active-Email Confirmation Trap!
cards.hook: Inbox mein ajeeb 'You Won a Prize / Cheap Meds / Crypto Offer' spam emails roz aate hain—to log pareshan hokar unke neeche likhe 'Unsubscribe' link par click kar dete hain! Par uske baad spam kam hone ke bajaye 3x zyada kyun aane lagta hai?
cards.illusion: Har email ke bilkul neeche likhe 'Unsubscribe' link par click karne se wo email aana hamesha ke liye band ho jaata hai.
cards.myth: Kanoon ke hisab se har email ke neeche 'Unsubscribe' link kaam karna mandatory hai isliye sabhi emails par usse dabana safe hai.
cards.reality: CAN-SPAM/DPDP rules sirf legal businesses par lagte hain—cybercriminals aur illegal spammers 'Unsubscribe' button ko sirf live-email verification aur phishing link ke roop mein use karte hain!

cards.title: 'Resume mein Safed Rang mein Keywords Chhupane se ATS Pass Ho Jaata Hai' Myth!
cards.hook: Job seekers ko reels mein 'Secret Hack' bataya jaata hai: 'Apne Resume ke neeche safed (White) font mein saare Job Keywords paste kar do—HR ko nahi dikhega par AI/ATS machine select kar legi!' Par ATS mein kya hota hai?
cards.illusion: White-font mein invisible keywords chhupane se ATS software resume ko 100% match maan kar interview ke liye short-list kar leta hai.
cards.myth: ATS sirf keyword counter hai—white font mein 100 keywords chhupane par 100% interview call aati hai.
cards.reality: ATS colour attributes strip kar ke plain text recruiter ko dikhata hai—white-text stuffing turant pakdi jaati hai aur candidate ko blacklist/reject kara sakti hai!

cards.title: Phone Paani mein Girne par online '165Hz Water Eject Sound' Bajana: Speaker Mesh vs Motherboard!
cards.hook: Baarish ya sink mein phone girne par speaker se aawaz phatne lagti hai, to log online '165Hz Water Eject Sound' bajate hain—par kya sound wave phone ke andar ke paani ko sachmuch nikaal deti hai?
cards.illusion: video platforms ka 165Hz Water Eject sound bajane se phone ke andar gaya saara paani bahar nikal aata hai aur chawal ki bhi zaroorat nahi padti.
cards.myth: Phone poora paani mein doob jaaye to bhi 10 minute online '165Hz Water Eject Sound' bajane se andar ka saara paani bahar ud jaata hai.
cards.reality: Sound waves sirf speaker diaphragm ke paas 1–2 mm ki mesh droplets ko hila saktin hain—SIM slot, USB port, ya motherboard ke andar ghusa paani sound se bahar nahi aata!

cards.title: Camera Lens par ₹150 wala Kaanch ka Protector Chipkana: Night Flare, Focus Blur & Flash Fog!
cards.hook: Naya ₹40,000–₹1,20,000 ka phone kharidte hi log peeche camera lenses par ₹150 wala chaukora kaanch/metal ring chipka dete hain—par raat ki photos dhundhli aur flash maarne par safed dhundh kyun aane lagti hai?
cards.illusion: Camera lens par sasta glass protector lagane se sirf lens safe rehta hai, photo quality par koi farq nahi padta.
cards.myth: Camera protector ke upar aane wale scratches dikhate hain ki agar wo na hota to asli phone camera toot jaata.
cards.reality: Saste soda-lime glass protector bahut naram hote hain isliye wo jeans/fingernail se bhi scratch ho jaate hain—jabki phone ka asli glass/sapphire unse kahin zyada scratch-resistant hota hai!

cards.title: Flight ke Check-In Bag mein Power Bank Rakhna Mana Kyun Hai? 100Wh Cabin Rule & Fire Physics!
cards.hook: Airport security par check-in suitcase mein Power Bank, Laptop ya Vape rakhne se mana kiya jaata hai aur sirf hand-bag (cabin) mein le jaane ko kaha jaata hai—par cargo hold mein Lithium battery le jaana itna khatarnak kyun hai?
cards.illusion: Check-in suitcase mein Power Bank rakhna sirf airport security ki random rule hai taaki bag bhaari na ho.
cards.myth: 30,000 mAh ya 50,000 mAh ka jumbo power bank flight mein le jaana bilkul normal aur bina limit allowed hota hai.
cards.reality: IATA/DGCA ke mutabik bina special airline approval ke sirf **<=100 Wh (~27,000 mAh max at 3.7V)** hi allowed hai—30,000+ mAh (~111 Wh+) ko security checkpoint par roka jaa sakta hai!

cards.title: Keyless-Entry Car ki Chabi Darwaze ke Paas Rakhne se 'Relay Attack' Chori: Faraday Pouch / Foil Science!
cards.hook: Push-Button Start (Keyless Entry) wali nayi car ghar ke bahar khadi hai aur aap chabi ghar ke main door ke paas table par rakh kar so jaate hain—par chor bina sheesha tode 30 second mein aapki car start kar ke kaise le jaate hain?
cards.illusion: Jab tak meri Keyless Car Fob ghar ke andar surakshit rakhi hai, bahar khadi car ko koi bina chabi ke start nahi kar sakta.
cards.myth: Keyless chabi darwaze se 5 feet andar ghar mein rakhi hai matlab uska signal eent ki deewar paar nahi kar sakta.
cards.reality: High-sensitivity Relay Amplifier boxes 15–30 feet door darwaze aur khidkiyon ke paar se bhi passive key-fob signal capture kar ke relay kar sakte hain!

cards.title: AC Remote aur Toy mein Sasti Batteries Chhodna: White Acid Leak vs NiMH Rechargeable Cells!
cards.hook: Sardiyon ke baad jab aap AC Remote ya purane Camera/BP Machine ko kholte hain, to andar lagaye hue saste AA/AAA cells se safed kharab powder leak hokar poora remote aur ₹2,000 ki BP machine kharab kar chuka hota hai! Kyun?
cards.illusion: AC Remote aur BP machine mein saste ₹15 wale dry cells saal bhar pade rehne par kabhi leak nahi hote jab tak wo chal rahe hon.
cards.myth: Mehengi branded Alkaline batteries (₹40/cell) kabhi leak nahi hotin, sirf ₹10 wali sasti batteries hi leak hoti hain.
cards.reality: Alkaline cells bhi poori tarah discharge hone ke baad (khaaskar jab 1 naya aur 1 purana cell mix kiya jaaye!) leak kar saktin hain—isliye kabhi purana+naya cell mix na karein aur seasonal gadgets se cells nikaal kar rakhein!

cards.title: Solar Panel Lagwate Waqt Sasta 'PWM' vs 'MPPT' Charge Controller: 25%–30% Zyada Bijli Sach!
cards.hook: Chhat par Solar Panels lagwate waqt vendor ₹2,000 bachane ke liye sasta 'PWM Solar Inverter' laga deta hai—par sardiyon, subah-shaam aur halke badal mein 'MPPT' controller 25%–30% zyada bijli kaise nikaal leta hai?
cards.illusion: Solar power sirf chhat ke panels se banti hai—PWM aur MPPT solar inverter dono bilkul barabar units bijli banate hain.
cards.myth: 500W ka Solar Panel PWM inverter par bhi poora 500W dega, MPPT bas ek mehenga display feature hai.
cards.reality: High-voltage modern 400W–550W panels (Vmp ~35–42V) ko 12V/24V PWM par lagane se voltage drop ke karan 30%–50% power seedhe waste ho jaati hai—unhe sirf **MPPT** hi poori efficiency se use kar sakta hai!

cards.title: Purani Phooli Hui Phone Battery aur Chargers ko Ghar ke Kachre mein Phenkna: Garbage Fires & Toxic Lead!
cards.hook: Purana phone kharab hone par, ya phooli hui power bank aur laptop battery ko log normal geele-sookhe kachre ki balti mein phenk dete hain—par isse kachre ki gaadiyon mein aag aur zameen ka paani zehrila kaise hota hai?
cards.illusion: Ek chhoti si kharab mobile battery ya charger ghar ke kachre ke dabbe mein phenk dene se kuch nahi hota.
cards.myth: Phooli hui phone battery ko pin se halka chhed kar ke hawa nikaal dene par wo phir se normal aur flat ho jaati hai.
cards.reality: KHABARDAR! Phooli hui Lithium battery mein flammable gases hoti hain—sui/chaku se chhed karte hi hawa ke oxygen se mil kar usmein **turant jet-flame aag aur zeherila dhuan** phat sakta hai! Kabhi puncture na karein.

cards.title: Dashcam / CCTV mein Normal Phone SD Card Dalna: 3 Mahine mein Accident Clip Gayab!
cards.hook: ₹6,000 ka Car Dashcam ya Ghar ka Wi-Fi CCTV lagwate waqt log ₹350 wala normal consumer SD Card daal dete hain—par jab accident ya chori ke waqt video nikaalna hota hai, to card 'Corrupted' kyun nikalta hai?
cards.illusion: Sabhi Class-10 microSD cards ek jaise hote hain—jo phone camera chalata hai wo Dashcam aur CCTV mein bhi saalon chalega.
cards.myth: Box par 'A1 / V30 / 120 MB/s Fast Speed' likha hai matlab wo card Dashcam aur CCTV ke liye best hai.
cards.reality: Transfer speed (MB/s) aur **Write Endurance (TBW / Hours)** do alag cheezein hain! Standard fast cards sirf speed ke liye hote hain, 24x7 loop-recording ke liye **'High Endurance'** label zaroori hota hai.

cards.title: Laptop Camera par Tape/Slider Lagana vs Mic Recording: Camera Light Off par Mic Sun Sakta Hai?
cards.hook: Privacy ke liye log laptop ke camera par black tape ya plastic slider laga dete hain—par agar koi hacker laptop mein spyware daal de, to kya camera ki LED light band rakh kar aapka Microphone chupchap sun sakta hai?
cards.illusion: Laptop ke webcam par tape chipka dene se koi spyware aapko dekh ya sun nahi sakta, aur mic on hone par bhi hamesha webcam jaisi light jalti hai.
cards.myth: Laptop par koi bhi hard-plastic sliding webcam cover chipka lena 100% safe hai.
cards.reality: Ultra-thin laptops mein screen aur keyboard ke beech <0.5 mm gap hota hai—mota plastic slider lid band karte hi screen glass tod deta hai!

cards.title: 'Flight Mode mein Phone Charge Karne se 2x Tez Charge Hota Hai' Myth: Asli Wattage Farq!
cards.hook: Social media hacks mein bataya jaata hai ki 'Phone ko Airplane (Flight) Mode par daal kar charge karne se wo aadhe time mein 2x fast charge ho jaata hai!' Kya sachmuch 30 minute wali charging 15 minute mein ho jaati hai?
cards.illusion: Airplane Mode ON karte hi phone double (2x) charging speed par pahunch jaata hai.
cards.myth: Airplane Mode ON kar ke charge karne se phone 1 ghante ke bajaye 25 minute mein full ho jaata hai.
cards.reality: Modern USB-PD/fast charging mein idle cellular radio sirf ~3% power leta hai—real speedup sirf **screen band rakhne aur phone ko thanda rakhne** se aata hai!

cards.title: 'Smart Speakers (Voice Assistants) 24 Ghante Saari Baatein Record Kar Ke Ads Dikhata Hai' Myth: Wake-Word Reality!
cards.hook: Ghar mein log Smart Speakers (Voice Assistants) par kapda daal dete hain: 'Ye 24 ghante hamari har baat cloud par bhejta hai—kal humne sofa lene ki baat ki aur aaj Social Media sofa ke ads aa gaye!' Asli tech sach kya hai?
cards.illusion: Smart speakers 24 ghante kamre ki saari private baatein internet par upload aur record karte rehte hain.
cards.myth: Jab maine kisi product ka sirf zikr kiya aur Social Media uska ad aa gaya, iska 100% saboot hai ki phone/Smart Speaker mic chupchap sun kar ads dikhata hai.
cards.reality: Cybersecurity researchers ne hazaron hours phone aur Smart Speaker network traffic monitor kiya hai—ye ads **Wi-Fi IP household matching, location co-presence, browser cookies, aur predictive ad algorithms** se aate hain, live mic eavesdropping se nahi!

schedule_rule: One topic unlocks per day. Order round-robins the four pillars, and within a pillar round-robins its zones, so consecutive days never sit in one pillar or one zone.
